words.en: On the playing field, especially in sports like football (soccer).

words.tr: phrase. 离开球场；不在比赛中（常用于足球等运动语境，指球员被罚下场或暂时离开比赛场地）
words.ex: The players went off the pitch after the match ended.
words.ex_cn: 比赛结束后，球员们离开了球场。

words.ex: The pitcher threw the ball fast.
words.ex_cn: 投掷的人把球投得很快。
words.en: A pitcher is a player in baseball who throws the ball to the batter. It can also refer to a large container with a handle and a lip, used for holding and pouring liquids.

words.ex: He poured milk from a jug.
words.ex_cn: 他从一个水壶里倒牛奶。
words.en: A jug is a container used for holding and pouring liquids. It typically has a handle and a spout for easy pouring.

words.tr: v. 起绰号；把…称作；配音；译制
words.ex: They dubbed him 'Captain Cool' for his calm style.
words.ex_cn: 他们因为他冷静的风格给他起了个绰号叫‘冷静队长’。
words.en: To give a name, title, or nickname to someone or something; to provide a film or television program with a soundtrack in a different language from the original.

words.tr: phrase. 有权做某事；有资格做某事
words.ex: He is entitled to take a day off.
words.ex_cn: 他有权休一天假。
words.en: To have the legal right or qualification to perform a specific action.

words.ex: We waited in the lounge before our flight.
words.ex_cn: 我们在登机前等在休息室里。
words.en: A lounge is a room in a house or public building where people can sit and relax. As a verb, to lounge means to lie, sit, or stand in a relaxed or lazy way.

words.ex: The treaty brought a durable peace to the region.
words.ex_cn: 这项条约为该地区带来了持久的和平。

words.ex: The durability of this plastic makes it good for outdoor use.
words.ex_cn: 这种塑料的持久性使它适合户外使用。
words.en: The ability of something to last a long time without significant deterioration.

words.ex: He copes with stress by walking every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天散步来应对压力。
words.en: To cope with a problem or task means to deal with it successfully.

words.ex: The circulation of blood keeps us alive.
words.ex_cn: 血液的循环让我们活着。
words.en: The movement of something such as money or goods from place to place or from person to person; the number of copies of a newspaper or magazine that are sold.

words.ex: My family follows the tradition of eating dumplings on New Year's Eve.
words.ex_cn: 我的家庭遵循除夕吃饺子的传统。
words.en: A tradition is a custom or belief that has existed for a long time among a particular group of people.

words.tr:
v. 有益于；有助于；
n. 利益；好处；
words.ex: Exercise benefits your health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼有益于你的健康。
words.en: A benefit is something that helps you or improves your life in some way.

words.tr:
n. 腐烂；衰落；
v. 腐烂；
words.ex: The fruit began to show signs of decay.
words.ex_cn: 这水果开始出现腐烂的迹象。
words.en: To decay means to be slowly destroyed by a natural process or to become gradually worse in quality, condition, or strength.

words.ex: The distribution of students in the class is even.
words.ex_cn: 班级里学生的分布是均匀的。
words.en: The process of giving out or spreading something, or the way in which something is spread or arranged over an area or among a group of people.

words.ex: The defect in the phone made it hard to use.
words.ex_cn: 手机的缺陷让它很难使用。
words.en: A defect is a fault or imperfection in a person or thing.

words.ex: He opposes the new law.
words.ex_cn: 他反对这项新法律。
words.en: If you oppose someone or something, you disagree with them and try to prevent them from doing something, or you try to change what they are doing.

words.ex: The statistics show a rise in sales last year.
words.ex_cn: 这些统计数字显示去年销售额有所上升。
words.en: Statistics is a branch of mathematics dealing with the collection, analysis, interpretation, presentation, and organization of data.

words.ex: He tries to cope with stress by walking every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天散步来应对压力。
words.en: To deal effectively with something difficult.

words.tr:
n. 流动；
v. 流动；
words.ex: The flow of water in the river is very fast.
words.ex_cn: 河里水的流动非常快。
words.en: To move along or out steadily and continuously in a current or stream.

words.ex: He wears traditional clothes on holidays.
words.ex_cn: 他在节日时穿传统服装。
words.en: Traditional refers to customs, beliefs, or methods that have existed for a long time without changing.

words.ex: Traditionally, people eat rice on New Year's Day.
words.ex_cn: 传统上，人们在新年那天吃米饭。
words.en: If something is done traditionally, it is done in a way that has been the custom for a long time.

words.tr: phrase. 从某事中受益；得益于某事物
words.ex: Many people benefit from walking every day.
words.ex_cn: 许多人从每天走路中受益。
words.en: To gain an advantage or profit from something.

words.ex: He benefits by eating healthy food.
words.ex_cn: 他从吃健康食品中获益。

words.tr: phrase. 物质利益；实际好处；有形收益
words.ex: The company offers its employees various material benefits to retain talent.
words.ex_cn: 公司为员工提供各种物质利益以留住人才。
words.en: A material benefit refers to a tangible advantage or gain, often in the form of money, property, or other physical assets.

words.tr: phrase. 为了……的利益；为了帮助……
words.ex: He did it for the benefit of the community.
words.ex_cn: 他这样做是为了社区的利益。
words.en: If you do something for the benefit of someone, you do it in order to help them or be useful to them.

words.tr: phrase. 社会福利；社会救济；社会保障福利
words.ex: Social benefits include unemployment insurance, healthcare, and housing assistance.
words.ex_cn: 社会福利包括失业保险、医疗保健和住房援助。
words.en: Social benefits refer to the various types of assistance and support provided by the government or other organizations to improve the welfare of individuals and communities, including but not limited to healthcare, education, housing, and financial aid.

words.tr:
n. 家庭；
adj. 家庭的；
words.ex: This household has three children.
words.ex_cn: 这个家庭有三个孩子。
words.en: A household is all the people in a family or group who live together in a house.

words.tr: phrase. 牙齿蛀蚀；蛀牙；龋齿
words.ex: He has dental decay because he eats too much sugar.
words.ex_cn: 他因为吃太多糖而有蛀牙。
words.en: Dental decay refers to the destruction of tooth structure, leading to cavities, which are holes in the teeth. It is caused by the action of acids produced by bacteria in the mouth on the enamel and dentin of the teeth.

words.tr: phrase. 发行渠道；销售渠道
words.ex: The company is looking to expand its distribution channels in Asia.
words.ex_cn: 该公司正在寻求扩大其在亚洲的分销渠道。
words.en: A distribution channel is a chain of businesses or intermediaries through which a good or service passes until it reaches the final buyer or the end consumer. Distribution channels can include wholesalers, retailers, distributors, and even the internet.

words.ex: The foetus is growing inside the mother.
words.ex_cn: 胎儿正在母亲体内发育。
words.en: An unborn or unhatched offspring of a mammal, in particular an unborn human more than eight weeks after conception.

words.ex: The fetus is growing inside the mother's womb.
words.ex_cn: 胎儿正在母亲的子宫内成长。
words.en: An unborn or unhatched offspring of a mammal, in particular an unborn human more than eight weeks after conception.

words.ex: The baby grows in the mother's womb.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿在母亲的子宫里成长。
words.en: The organ in the lower body of a woman or female mammal where offspring are conceived and in which they gestate before birth.

words.tr: adj. 有缺点的；有缺陷的；有毛病的；
words.ex: The defective phone wouldn't turn on.
words.ex_cn: 这部有缺点的手机无法开机。
words.en: If something is defective, there is something wrong with it and it does not work properly.

words.tr: phrase. 反对；抵制某事；与某事相对立
words.ex: He opposes himself to the new rule.
words.ex_cn: 他反对这项新规定。

words.ex: The room was stuffy and hard to breathe in.
words.ex_cn: 房间闷热得让人难以呼吸。
words.en: If you describe a place as stuffy, you mean that it is unpleasantly warm and has no fresh air.

words.ex: The trip takes approximately 30 minutes.
words.ex_cn: 这段旅程大约需要30分钟。
words.en: Used to indicate that something is close to the actual, but not completely accurate or exact.

words.tr: adj. 可原谅的；情有可原的；
words.ex: His excuse was excusable because he was sick.
words.ex_cn: 他的借口是可以原谅的，因为他生病了。
words.en: If something is excusable, it can be forgiven or understood because there is a good reason for it.

words.ex: He propose to go to the park after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他提议午饭后去公园。
words.en: If you propose something, you suggest it as a plan or course of action.

words.ex: The tree has many colorful ornaments.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树上有许多彩色的装饰品。
words.en: An ornament is an object that is used to make something look more attractive but is usually considered to have no practical purpose.

words.tr: adj. 有活力的；精力旺盛的；
words.ex: The energetic boy ran around the park all afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 这个有活力的男孩整个下午都在公园里跑来跑去。
words.en: Someone who is energetic is very active and does not tire easily.

words.ex: The atmospheric pressure dropped before the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风暴来临前，大气压下降了。
words.en: Relating to the atmosphere of the Earth or another planet; creating a distinctive mood, typically of romance or nostalgia.

words.tr:
adj. 合作的；
n. 合作社；
words.ex: The two companies made a cooperative effort to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 两家公司合作努力解决问题。
words.en: A cooperative is an organization or business that is owned and run jointly by its members, who share the profits or benefits.

words.ex: The iron fence will corrode in the rain.
words.ex_cn: 铁栅栏在雨中会生锈。
words.en: If metal or stone corrodes, or if something corrodes it, it is gradually destroyed by a chemical reaction.

words.ex: He tried to strangle his enemy with a rope.
words.ex_cn: 他试图用绳子勒死他的敌人。
words.en: To strangle someone means to kill them by squeezing their throat tightly so that they cannot breathe.

words.tr: v. （使）窒息而死；使呼吸困难；闷死
words.ex: The smoke is suffocating him.
words.ex_cn: 烟雾正在让他窒息。
words.en: To cause someone to die or to make it difficult for someone to breathe by preventing air from reaching the lungs.

words.tr: v. 厚厚地覆盖；使…窒息；闷死
words.ex: He tried to smother the fire with a blanket.
words.ex_cn: 他试图用毯子把火闷灭。
words.en: To smother someone or something means to kill them by covering their face so that they cannot breathe, or to put out a fire by covering it.

words.ex: The smoke made him choke.
words.ex_cn: 烟让他窒息。
words.en: If you choke, or if something chokes you, you cannot breathe properly because there is not enough air or because something is blocking your throat.

words.ex: Forgetting a name is an excusable mistake.
words.ex_cn: 忘记一个名字是一个可原谅的错误。

words.tr: n. 健忘; 心不在焉; 心神不定
words.ex: He was criticized for his absent-mindedness during the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上的心不在焉受到了批评。
words.en: The state or quality of being forgetful or inattentive.

words.ex: He made a proposal to improve the school lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他提出了一个改善学校午餐的提案。
words.en: A proposal is a plan or suggestion, especially a formal one that is put forward for people to think about and decide upon.

words.tr: adj. 皇家的；尊贵的；富丽堂皇的
words.ex: The queen wore a regal crown.
words.ex_cn: 女王戴着一顶威严的王冠。
words.en: If you describe something as regal, you mean that it is suitable for a king or queen, because it is very impressive or beautiful.

words.ex: The ornate ceiling had gold patterns and flowers.
words.ex_cn: 华丽的天花板上有金色的图案和花朵。
words.en: Something that is ornate is highly decorated with complex patterns.

words.tr: phrase. 为装饰用的；用于装饰
words.ex: The flowers are placed for ornament on the table.
words.ex_cn: 这些花摆放在桌上只是为了装饰。

words.tr: phrase. 被用某物装饰；以某物点缀
words.en: To be adorned or decorated with a particular item or feature.

words.ex: He put ointment on his cut.
words.ex_cn: 他把药膏涂在伤口上。
words.en: A smooth substance that is rubbed on the skin to heal wounds or soothe pain.

words.ex: The garden has ornamental flowers.
words.ex_cn: 这个花园里有装饰性的花卉。
words.en: Something that is ornamental is intended to be attractive and is not necessary or useful.

words.ex: He is an ornamenter who designs beautiful patterns on pottery.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位装饰师，为陶器设计美丽的图案。
words.en: A person or thing that adorns, decorates, or adds ornamental details to something else.

words.ex: He is an energetic person who runs every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个每天早上跑步的精力充沛的人。

words.ex: Atmospheric pressure affects weather patterns.
words.ex_cn: 大气压影响天气模式。
words.en: Atmospheric pressure is the pressure exerted by the weight of air in the atmosphere of Earth (or that of another planet).

words.tr: phrase. 大气状况；气象条件
words.ex: The pilots checked the atmospheric conditions before takeoff.
words.ex_cn: 飞行员在起飞前检查了大气状况。
words.en: The prevailing weather or environmental conditions in a particular place or at a specific time, including factors like temperature, humidity, and precipitation.

words.tr: phrase. 合作企业；协作型企业
words.ex: Local farmers formed cooperative enterprises to sell their produce.
words.ex_cn: 当地农民成立了合作企业来销售他们的农产品。

words.tr: phrase. 合作努力；协同工作
words.ex: They make a cooperative effort to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他们合作努力按时完成项目。

words.tr: adj. 不愿合作的；不愿配合的
words.ex: He was uncooperative during the interview.
words.ex_cn: 他在面试中不配合。
words.en: If you describe someone as uncooperative, you mean that they do not want to help or support other people.

words.ex: They cooperate to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他们合作以按时完成项目。
words.en: If you cooperate with someone, you work with them or help them for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The two companies showed good cooperation on the project.
words.ex_cn: 这两家公司在这个项目上表现出良好的合作。
words.en: Cooperation is the process of working or acting together, which can be seen in many aspects of life, including business, science, and social interactions.

words.ex: He practices karate every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上练习空手道。
words.en: A Japanese martial art in which sharp blows and kicks are administered to pressure-sensitive points on the body of an opponent.

words.ex: The mantle lies below the Earth's crust.
words.ex_cn: 地幔位于地球地壳之下。
words.en: The mantle is the part of the earth between the crust and the core. It can also refer to a cloak or covering.

words.tr:
n. 荣誉；荣幸；
v. 尊敬；
words.ex: He received an honour for his brave actions.
words.ex_cn: 他因英勇的行为获得了荣誉。
words.en: Honour is a quality that combines respect, pride, and honesty. It is a measure of a person's reputation and the esteem in which they are held by others.

words.ex: He used a stick to dislodge the rock from the path.
words.ex_cn: 他用一根棍子把石头从路上移出。
words.en: To dislodge something means to remove it from a place where it is fixed or held.

words.ex: The body expels waste through the kidneys.
words.ex_cn: 身体通过肾脏排出废物。
words.en: If someone is expelled from a school or organization, they are officially told to leave because they have behaved badly or broken the rules.

words.ex: The king was sent into exile after the revolution.
words.ex_cn: 革命后，国王被流放了。
words.en: Exile is the state of being sent away from one's home country or place of residence, often for political or punitive reasons.

words.ex: The king banish the traitor from the kingdom.
words.ex_cn: 国王将叛徒驱逐出王国。
words.en: To banish someone means to send them away from a country or place and not allow them to return.

words.ex: Salt is soluble in water.
words.ex_cn: 盐可以溶于水。
words.en: A substance that is soluble can be dissolved in a liquid.

words.ex: The administration of the school is very organized.
words.ex_cn: 学校的行政管理非常有条理。
words.en: The process or activity of running a business, organization, etc., or the people who run it.

words.ex: He protects the environment by recycling.
words.ex_cn: 他通过回收利用来保护环境。
words.en: The environment is the natural world in which people, animals, and plants live.

words.ex: He got a driving licence last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周拿到了驾驶执照。
words.en: A licence is an official document which gives you permission to do, use, or own something.

words.ex: He got a driver's license last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周拿到了驾照。
words.en: A license is an official document which gives you permission to do, use, or own something.

words.ex: The teacher underlined the key point.
words.ex_cn: 老师强调了这个关键点。
words.en: To draw a line under a word or phrase, especially in order to emphasize it.

words.tr: v. 激活；使活动；使活化；
words.ex: Press the button to activate the device.
words.ex_cn: 按下按钮来激活设备。
words.en: If a device or process is activated, it starts working or becomes operational.

words.tr:
adj. 主要的；
n. 大调；主修课；
words.ex: Math is a major subject in school.
words.ex_cn: 数学是学校里的主要科目。
words.en: A major is a student's principal field of study or specialization in college or university.

words.w: He was for a time called Hershel
words.tr: 他曾一度被称为赫舍尔。
words.uk: hi wəz fɔːr ə taɪm kɔːld ˈhɜːʃəl
words.us: hi wəz fɔːr ə taɪm kɔːld ˈhɜːrʃəl
words.ex: He was for a time called hershel.
words.ex_cn: 他曾一度被称为 hershel。

words.ex: A monument was built in honour of the soldiers who died in the war.
words.ex_cn: 为了纪念在战争中牺牲的士兵，建立了一座纪念碑。
words.en: If something is done in honour of a particular person or event, it is done to show respect or admiration for them.

words.ex: They planted a tree in memory of her.
words.ex_cn: 他们种了一棵树以纪念她。
words.en: If you do something in memory of a dead person, you do it as a way of showing that you want to remember them and that you respect them.

words.ex: They stayed in a small lodge near the forest.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在森林附近的一座小屋里。
words.en: A lodge is a small house in the country, especially one that is used by people on holiday or by people taking part in a sport such as skiing or hunting. As a verb, to lodge means to stay somewhere, especially temporarily, or to formally submit something, such as a complaint or an application.

words.tr: phrase. 超出他能力范围的；他够不着的；他无法得到的
words.ex: The book was placed out of his reach on the top shelf.
words.ex_cn: 那本书被放在他够不到的顶层架子上。
words.en: Beyond his ability to grasp or achieve.

words.ex: Salt is a soluble material that dissolves in water.
words.ex_cn: 盐是一种可溶于水的可溶性物质。

words.ex: He will restore the old bike.
words.ex_cn: 他将修复这辆旧自行车。
words.en: To restore something means to bring it back to its original condition or to a state of health, efficiency, or good management.

words.ex: He reverted to his old habits after the holiday.
words.ex_cn: 假期后，他恢复了旧习惯。
words.en: To return to a former state, practice, topic, etc.

words.ex: He converts old paper into new notebooks.
words.ex_cn: 他把旧纸张转换成新笔记本。
words.en: To change something into a different form or to change someone's beliefs, especially their religious beliefs.

words.ex: He tries to invert the numbers to find the answer.
words.ex_cn: 他试图将数字倒过来以找到答案。
words.en: To invert something means to turn it upside down or to reverse its position, order, or relationship.

words.ex: The road was diverted around the park.
words.ex_cn: 这条路被改道绕过公园。
words.en: If you divert someone or something, you cause them to change direction or to go somewhere different.

words.tr: adj. 可分解的；可溶解的
words.ex: The problem was resoluble with the right approach.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题用正确的方法是可以解决的。
words.en: Capable of being dissolved or solved.

words.tr: adj. 无法解决的；无法溶解的
words.ex: This math problem is unsolvable.
words.ex_cn: 这个数学问题无解。
words.en: If a problem is unsolvable, it is impossible to find an answer or solution to it.

words.tr: phrase. 工作环境；职业场所的物理与心理条件
words.ex: He likes his new working environment.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢他的新工作环境。
words.en: The conditions and influences that affect the functioning and well-being of employees in their workplace.

words.tr: phrase. 学习环境；教学环境；有助于学习的场所或氛围
words.ex: The school has a good learning environment.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校有一个良好的学习环境。
words.en: The physical or virtual setting in which learning takes place, encompassing the culture, context, and resources available to learners.

words.tr: phrase. 政治环境；政治氛围
words.ex: The political environment affects business decisions.
words.ex_cn: 政治环境影响商业决策。
words.en: The political environment refers to the current political situation and the attitudes and policies of the government that affect the economic and social conditions of a country or region.

words.tr: adj. 环境的；有关环境的；
words.ex: The government is protecting the environmental balance.
words.ex_cn: 政府正在保护环境平衡。
words.en: Relating to the natural world and the impact of human activity on its condition.

words.ex: He got his driving licence last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月拿到了驾照。
words.en: A driving licence is an official document permitting a specific individual to operate one or more types of motorized vehicles on public roads.

words.ex: The government granted a licence to the new company.
words.ex_cn: 政府授予了这家新公司许可证。

words.tr:
n. 凝块；泥团；密集的一群
v. 凝结成块
words.ex: The blood began to clot after the cut.
words.ex_cn: 伤口流血后开始凝固。
words.en: A clot is a sticky lump that forms when blood dries up or becomes thick. If blood clots, it becomes thick and forms a lump.

words.ex: The wound formed clots to stop bleeding.
words.ex_cn: 伤口形成了血凝块以止血。

words.ex: An activator is often used in chemical reactions to speed up the process.
words.ex_cn: 活化剂常用于化学反应中以加速过程。
words.en: An activator is a substance that increases the rate of a chemical reaction by reducing the activation energy.

words.ex: The enzyme helps to catalyze the reaction.
words.ex_cn: 这种酶有助于催化反应。
words.en: To cause or accelerate a reaction, process, or change.

words.ex: The catalyzer helps the chemical reaction happen faster.
words.ex_cn: 催化剂帮助化学反应更快发生。

words.ex: The enzyme helps break down food in the stomach.
words.ex_cn: 这种酶帮助分解胃里的食物。
words.en: An enzyme is a protein that acts as a catalyst to bring about a specific biochemical reaction.

words.tr: adj. 特定的；明确的；具体的；
words.ex: He gave a specific reason for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他给出了一个迟到的具体原因。
words.en: If someone is specific, they give a description that is precise and exact.

words.tr:
adj. 客观的；
n. 目标；目的；
words.ex: He gave an objective opinion about the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他对这部电影给出了一个客观的看法。
words.en: An objective is something that you plan to do or achieve.

words.ex: You must concentrate on your homework.
words.ex_cn: 你必须集中精力做作业。
words.en: If you concentrate on something, you give it your full attention and think about it carefully.

words.ex: The conflict between the two countries lasted for years.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家之间的冲突持续了多年。
words.en: A conflict is a serious disagreement or argument, typically a protracted one.

words.ex: The doctor gave him an antidote for the poison.
words.ex_cn: 医生给了他一种解毒剂来对抗毒药。
words.en: An antidote is a substance that counteracts the effects of poison or something harmful.

words.ex: He discovered a new planet last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年发现了一颗新行星。
words.en: If you discover something that you did not know about before, you become aware of it or find it.

words.ex: He doesn't necessarily agree with you.
words.ex_cn: 他并不必然同意你。
words.en: If you say that something necessarily happens or is the case, you mean that it has to happen or be the case and cannot be any different.

words.ex: The castle has a small turret on each corner.
words.ex_cn: 这座城堡的每个角落都有一个小塔。
words.en: A turret is a small tower on top of a building, especially a castle, or a structure on a military vehicle that can turn around and from which guns are fired.

words.ex: He explained the rules specifically.
words.ex_cn: 他具体地解释了规则。
words.en: You use specifically to emphasize that something is given special attention and considered separately from other things of the same kind.

words.tr: phrase. 战略目标；战略性目的
words.ex: The company has set clear strategic objectives for the next five years.
words.ex_cn: 公司为未来五年设定了明确的战略目标。
words.en: A strategic objective is a goal that is set by an organization to achieve its long-term aims and is usually focused on improving the organization's position in the market.

words.tr: phrase. 实现目标；达成目的
words.ex: He works hard to achieve the objective.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以实现目标。
words.en: Succeed in reaching a goal or target.

words.tr: phrase. 受支配；从属于；受制；常遭受...
words.ex: He is subject to fines if he breaks the rules.
words.ex_cn: 如果他违反规则，就会被罚款。
words.en: If someone or something is subject to something, especially something bad, it is likely or certain to be affected by it.

words.tr: phrase. 对某事保持客观的

words.ex: Scientists mapped the human genome last year.
words.ex_cn: 科学家们去年绘制了人类基因组。
words.en: The complete set of genes or genetic material present in a cell or organism.

words.tr: phrase. 客观现实；独立于个人意识而存在的外部世界事实
words.ex: Scientists strive to understand objective reality through observation and experimentation.
words.ex_cn: 科学家通过观察和实验努力理解客观实在。
words.en: Objective reality refers to the existence of things as they are, independent of any individual's perception or beliefs.

words.ex: There was an array of people at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 音乐会上人山人海。
words.en: An array of different things or people is a large number or wide range of them.

words.ex: The sun's ray came through the window.
words.ex_cn: 阳光透过窗户照进来。
words.en: A ray of light or heat is a narrow beam of it.

words.tr: phrase. 集中于； 专心于
words.ex: He must concentrate on his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他必须专心做作业。
words.en: To direct all your attention and effort towards a particular activity, subject, or problem.

words.ex: The spoon has a concave surface.
words.ex_cn: 勺子有一个凹的表面。
words.en: A concave surface is curved inward, like the inside of a bowl.

words.ex: He showed great concentration while solving the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他在解这道数学题时非常专注。
words.en: Concentration is the ability to focus all your attention on one thing without being distracted.

words.ex: The disease afflicted many people in the village.
words.ex_cn: 这种疾病使村子里许多人遭受痛苦。
words.en: If you are afflicted by pain, illness, or misfortune, it causes you great suffering and distress.

words.tr:
n. 酷刑；拷打
v. 拷打；折磨
words.ex: The prisoner suffered from torture during the war.
words.ex_cn: 这名囚犯在战争期间遭受了酷刑。
words.en: Torture is the act of deliberately inflicting severe physical or psychological pain on someone, typically to extract information or a confession, or as a punishment.

words.tr: v. 把…强加给；使遭受；使承受
words.ex: The storm inflicted heavy damage on the village.
words.ex_cn: 风暴给村庄造成了严重破坏。
words.en: If you inflict something unpleasant on someone, you make them suffer it.

words.ex: He incurred a fine for speeding.
words.ex_cn: 他因超速而招致了一笔罚款。
words.en: If you incur something unpleasant, it happens to you because of something you have done.

words.ex: He came into conflict with his boss over the work schedule.
words.ex_cn: 他因为工作时间表与老板发生了冲突。
words.en: To have a disagreement or clash with someone.

words.tr: phrase. 对…的解毒剂；对抗…的良方（尤指用于抵消不良影响或负面情绪）
words.ex: Honey is an antidote to a sore throat.
words.ex_cn: 蜂蜜是缓解喉咙痛的良方。
words.en: Something that counteracts or neutralizes a problem or poison.

words.ex: The discovery of penicillin saved millions of lives.
words.ex_cn: 青霉素的发现拯救了数百万人的生命。
words.en: The act of finding something that had not been known before.

words.tr: adj. 有资格的；合格的；合意的；
words.ex: He is eligible to vote because he is 18 years old.
words.ex_cn: 他年满18岁，有资格投票。
words.en: Someone who is eligible for something is qualified or allowed to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 有资格的；符合某事的条件
words.ex: He is eligible for a scholarship.
words.ex_cn: 他有资格获得奖学金。
words.en: To have the right to do or obtain something through satisfying the appropriate conditions.

words.ex: She consulted the tarot for guidance on her career path.
words.ex_cn: 她咨询塔罗牌以寻求职业道路上的指导。
words.en: Tarot refers to a set of playing cards used for divination, typically consisting of 78 cards divided into the Major Arcana and Minor Arcana.

words.ex: Asia is the largest continent.
words.ex_cn: 亚洲是最大的洲。
words.en: A continent is a very large area of land, such as Africa or Asia, that consists of several countries.

words.ex: The trip is contingent on the weather.
words.ex_cn: 这次旅行取决于天气情况。
words.en: A contingent event or situation depends on something else in order to happen or exist.

words.ex: The rubber band is elastic.
words.ex_cn: 橡皮筋是有弹性的。
words.en: An elastic material is able to stretch and then return to its original shape or size.

words.ex: Exercise can enhance your health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以提高你的健康。
words.en: To enhance something means to improve its value, quality, or attractiveness.

words.ex: The teacher gave a demonstration of how to solve the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 老师演示了如何解这道数学题。
words.en: A demonstration is a public meeting or march in which people show their opposition to something or their support for something.

words.ex: He interrupted me while I was speaking.
words.ex_cn: 我在说话时他打断了我。
words.en: To interrupt someone means to stop them from speaking by saying or doing something, or to cause something to stop happening for a period of time.

words.ex: The extra chair is redundant because we have enough seats.
words.ex_cn: 这把额外的椅子是多余的，因为我们已经有足够的座位了。
words.en: If you are made redundant, your employer tells you to leave because your job is no longer necessary or because there is no more work for you.

words.tr: v. 处理不当；使用不当
words.ex: He mishandled the situation and made it worse.
words.ex_cn: 他处理不当，让情况变得更糟。
words.en: If you mishandle something, you deal with it badly or carelessly, often causing problems or damage.

words.ex: He amended the letter before sending it.
words.ex_cn: 他在发送信件之前修正了它。
words.en: To amend something means to make changes to it in order to improve it or make it more accurate.

words.ex: He revised his answer to make it correct.
words.ex_cn: 他修正了他的答案，使其正确。
words.en: To revise something means to alter or amend it, especially in order to correct or improve it.

words.tr: adj. 欧洲大陆的；大陆的；
words.ex: He prefers continental breakfast with bread and coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他更喜欢欧洲大陆式的早餐，有面包和咖啡。
words.en: Continental is used to describe something that relates to or is characteristic of a continent, especially the mainland of Europe as distinct from the British Isles.

words.ex: He donated money to the school to enhance his reputation.
words.ex_cn: 他捐钱给学校以提升自己的声誉。

words.tr: phrase. 增强某人的自信心
words.ex: She practices speaking every day to enhance her confidence.
words.ex_cn: 她每天练习说话以增强自信心。
words.en: To increase or boost someone's self-assurance.

words.ex: Exercise can enhance the ability to focus.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以提高专注力。

words.tr: phrase. 打断工作；中断工作
words.ex: The noise interrupted the work.
words.ex_cn: 噪音打断了工作。
words.en: Stop or hinder an ongoing task or activity.

words.ex: The phone call caused an interruption in the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 电话打断了会议。
words.en: An interruption is something that temporarily stops an activity or a situation.

words.ex: Water is indispensable for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命是必不可少的。
words.en: Absolutely necessary or essential.

words.ex: The nurse will dispense medicine to the patients.
words.ex_cn: 护士将分发药品给病人。
words.en: To dispense means to distribute or provide something, especially in a systematic way, or to prepare and give out medicine.

words.ex: The teacher will assign homework today.
words.ex_cn: 老师今天会布置作业。
words.en: To give someone a particular job or task; to allocate a resource or responsibility to a particular person or purpose.

words.ex: The teacher will distribute the books to students.
words.ex_cn: 老师将把书分发给学生。
words.en: If you distribute things, you hand them or deliver them to a number of people.

words.ex: The teacher will allocate books to students.
words.ex_cn: 老师将给学生分配书籍。
words.en: To allocate something means to give it to a particular person or use it for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The teacher will allot five minutes for questions.
words.ex_cn: 老师会分配五分钟提问。
words.en: If something is allotted to someone, it is given to them as their share.

words.tr: adj. 欠缺的；过小的；少量的
words.ex: He had scanty food for the whole day.
words.ex_cn: 他一整天的食物很少。
words.en: If something is scanty, there is not enough of it or it is too small in amount.

words.tr: adj. 不足的；欠缺的；微小的；
words.ex: There is scant evidence to support the claim.
words.ex_cn: 支持这一说法的证据不足。
words.en: If you describe something as scant, you mean that there is not enough of it or that it is not as much as it should be.

words.ex: The company announced redundancy due to low profits.
words.ex_cn: 公司因利润低下宣布裁员。
words.en: Redundancy refers to the state of being not or no longer needed or useful; the inclusion of extra components which are not strictly necessary to functioning, in case of failure in other components; or the dismissal of employees from work for being no longer necessary.

words.ex: The extra words are superfluous.
words.ex_cn: 这些额外的词是多余的。
words.en: Something that is superfluous is unnecessary or no longer needed.

words.ex: He ate excessive amounts of candy.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了过多的糖果。
words.en: If you describe the amount or level of something as excessive, you disapprove of it because it is more or higher than is necessary or reasonable.

words.ex: He eats excessively sweets.
words.ex_cn: 他吃太多甜食。
words.en: To an excessive degree; more than is necessary, normal, or desirable; inordinately.

words.tr:
adv. 非常；很；
adj. 恰好是；正是；
words.ex: He is very happy today.
words.ex_cn: 他今天非常开心。
words.en: Used to emphasize the degree or extent of something.

words.tr: phrase. 行李处理不当；被错误处理的行李
words.ex: The airline apologized for the mishandled baggage.
words.ex_cn: 航空公司为行李处理不当道歉。

words.ex: He tried to suppress his anger.
words.ex_cn: 他试图抑制自己的愤怒。
words.en: To suppress something means to prevent it from being expressed, known, or continuing.

words.ex: The government tried suppression of the protest.
words.ex_cn: 政府试图压制抗议。
words.en: The act of ending something by force or preventing it from being expressed or continuing.

words.tr: phrase. 火灾抑制系统；一种用于自动检测和扑灭火灾的装置或系统，常用于建筑物或工业设备中
words.ex: The building was equipped with a state-of-the-art fire suppression system to ensure safety.
words.ex_cn: 该建筑配备了一个最先进的消防抑制系统，以确保安全。
words.en: A fire suppression system is a system used to extinguish or prevent the spread of fire in a building.

words.ex: He tried to repress his anger.
words.ex_cn: 他试图抑制自己的愤怒。
words.en: If you repress a feeling, you deliberately do not express it, often because it is considered unacceptable or inappropriate.

words.ex: The clay is malleable and easy to shape.
words.ex_cn: 这种黏土是可塑的，容易塑形。
words.en: If you say that someone is malleable, you mean that they are easily influenced or controlled by other people.

words.tr: phrase. 知识产权；智力成果权
words.ex: He protects his intellectual property with a patent.
words.ex_cn: 他用专利保护自己的知识产权。
words.en: Intellectual property refers to creations of the mind, such as inventions; literary and artistic works; designs; and symbols, names and images used in commerce.

words.ex: The assignment of property was signed by both parties.
words.ex_cn: 财产转让由双方签署了。

words.tr: phrase. 失物；遗失物品；失物招领处
words.ex: He found his wallet in the lost property office.
words.ex_cn: 他在失物招领处找到了他的钱包。
words.en: Items that have been lost and are waiting to be reclaimed by their owners.

words.ex: Gold has high malleability and can be shaped easily.
words.ex_cn: 金具有很高的延展性，容易塑形。
words.en: Malleability is the quality of something that can be shaped or stretched without breaking, especially referring to metals.

words.ex: The blacksmith malleated the iron into a horseshoe.
words.ex_cn: 铁匠将铁锤打成马蹄铁。
words.en: To hammer or beat (metal) into shape.

words.tr:
n. 锻造车间；
v. 建立（联系等）；
words.ex: The blacksmith works in the forge every morning.
words.ex_cn: 铁匠每天早上都在锻造车间工作。
words.en: To forge something means to create it, especially by using considerable effort or skill. It can also mean to make or produce something, especially with some difficulty or effort. Additionally, it refers to the act of making a copy or imitation of something with the intent to deceive.

words.ex: The luminant stars lit up the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 发光的星星照亮了夜空。
words.en: Emitting or reflecting light; luminous.

words.ex: The sun is a bright luminary in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 太阳是天空中一个明亮的发光体。
words.en: A luminary is a person who is very famous and highly respected, especially in a particular field.

words.tr: v. 阐明；“illuminate”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 被照亮的；
words.ex: The teacher illuminated the difficult concept with a simple example.
words.ex_cn: 老师用一个简单的例子阐明了这个难懂的概念。
words.en: To illuminate something means to shine light on it and to make it brighter and more visible.

words.ex: The lamp illuminate the dark room.
words.ex_cn: 这盏灯照亮了黑暗的房间。
words.en: To illuminate something means to shine light on it and to make it brighter and more visible.

words.ex: The luminous moon lights up the night.
words.ex_cn: 明亮的月亮照亮了夜晚。
words.en: Something that is luminous shines or glows in the dark.

words.tr: n. 收容所；避难所；精神病院；（政治）庇护
words.ex: The old building now serves as an asylum for the homeless.
words.ex_cn: 这栋旧建筑现在是无家可归者的收容所。
words.en: An asylum is a place where people who are in danger or who have no homes can go for safety and protection.

words.tr: phrase. 区别性特征；显著特点；辨别标志
words.ex: The distinguishing feature of this phone is its long battery life.
words.ex_cn: 这款手机的显著特点是电池续航时间长。
words.en: A distinguishing feature is a characteristic that makes someone or something different from others.

words.tr: v. 区分；“distinguish”的现在分词； adj. 区别性的；
words.ex: He is distinguishing between the two similar colors.
words.ex_cn: 他正在区分这两种相似的颜色。
words.en: Serving to identify someone or something as different from others.

words.tr: v. 区分；“distinguish”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 卓越的；著名的；
words.ex: He distinguished the fake coin from the real one.
words.ex_cn: 他把假硬币和真硬币区分开来。
words.en: If you describe a person or their work as distinguished, you mean that they have been very successful in their career and have a good reputation.

words.tr: adj. 可区别的；可辨别的
words.ex: The two colors are distinguishable under bright light.
words.ex_cn: 在强光下，这两种颜色是可以区分的。
words.en: If something is distinguishable, it can be recognized or identified as different from something else.

words.tr: adj. 不对称的；不均匀的
words.ex: The two sides of the box are asymmetric.
words.ex_cn: 盒子的两边不对称。
words.en: An asymmetric object does not have the same shape, size, or arrangement on both sides of a central line.

words.ex: The painting has asymmetry in its design.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画的构图不对称。
words.en: The quality of being asymmetrical; lack of symmetry.

words.ex: The butterfly has perfect symmetry.
words.ex_cn: 这只蝴蝶有完美的对称性。
words.en: Symmetry is the quality of being made up of exactly similar parts facing each other or around an axis.

words.ex: She coordinates the team's schedule.
words.ex_cn: 她协调团队的安排。
words.en: If you coordinate an activity, you organize the various people and things involved in it. If you coordinate the different parts of your body, you make them work together efficiently.

words.ex: I love learning about different cultures.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢了解不同的文化。
words.en: The ideas, customs, and social behavior of a particular people or society.

words.ex: Mother's milk nourishes the baby.
words.ex_cn: 母乳滋养婴儿。
words.en: To nourish someone or something means to provide them with the food and other substances they need in order to live, grow, and be healthy.

words.ex: Farmers cultivate rice in the fields.
words.ex_cn: 农民在田里种植水稻。
words.en: To cultivate land means to prepare it and grow crops on it. To cultivate a particular quality, skill, or attitude means to try hard to develop it and make it stronger.

words.tr: adj. 有营养的； v. “nourish”的现在分词；
words.ex: This soup is nourishing and keeps you healthy.
words.ex_cn: 这汤很有营养，能让你保持健康。
words.en: If you say that food is nourishing, you mean that it is good for your health because it contains substances that help your body to be healthy.

words.ex: Eating fruits and vegetables is nutritious.
words.ex_cn: 吃水果和蔬菜是有营养的。
words.en: Nutritious food contains substances which help your body to be healthy.

words.tr:
n. 教养；养育；培育；
v. 培养；
words.ex: Her parents gave her good nurture.
words.ex_cn: 她的父母给了她良好的教养。
words.en: To nurture someone or something is to care for and encourage their growth or development.

words.ex: Parents should foster good habits in children.
words.ex_cn: 父母应该培养孩子的好习惯。
words.en: To foster something means to encourage and promote its development.

words.tr:
v. 定罪；宣判有罪
n. 罪犯；囚犯
words.ex: The court convicted him of theft.
words.ex_cn: 法院判定他犯有盗窃罪。
words.en: If someone is convicted of a crime, they are found guilty of that crime in a court of law.

words.ex: He tried to smuggle cigarettes across the border.
words.ex_cn: 他试图走私香烟过境。
words.en: To smuggle goods or people means to move them into or out of a country illegally.

words.tr: v. 繁荣兴旺；茁壮成长；
words.ex: The business flourishes in the new market.
words.ex_cn: 这家企业在新市场中繁荣兴旺。
words.en: If something flourishes, it is successful, active, or common, and developing quickly and strongly.

words.tr: adv. 以华丽的手法；以炫耀的方式
words.ex: He signed his name with a flourish.
words.ex_cn: 他以华丽的手法签下了名字。
words.en: With a dramatic, flamboyant, or confident gesture or action.

words.tr: adv. 全盛时期；蓬勃发展
words.ex: The castle was in full flourish during the king's reign.
words.ex_cn: 这座城堡在国王统治时期处于全盛时期。
words.en: At the peak of development, activity, or success; thriving or flourishing completely.

words.tr:
n. 保护区；储备；保留；
v. 预订；
words.ex: The wildlife reserve is home to many endangered animals.
words.ex_cn: 这个自然保护区是许多濒危动物的家园。
words.en: If you reserve something such as a table, ticket, or magazine, you arrange for it to be kept for you and not given to anyone else.

words.ex: I made a reservation for two at the restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 我在餐厅预订了两个人的座位。
words.en: A reservation is an arrangement whereby something, especially a seat or room, is kept for a particular person who will arrive later.

words.tr: adj. 维度的；空间的；尺寸的
words.ex: The box has three dimensional shapes.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子有三个维度的形状。
words.en: Relating to measurements in length, width, and height, or to the spatial extent of something.

words.tr: n. 三维图像；立体图像
words.ex: The computer shows a three-dimensional image of the heart.
words.ex_cn: 电脑显示了一个心脏的三维图像。
words.en: A lifelike image that appears to have depth and volume.

words.ex: The children played on the gravel path.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在砾石小路上玩耍。
words.en: Gravel consists of very small stones. It is often used to make paths and roads.

words.ex: The house has good insulation to keep warm in winter.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子有良好的绝缘层以在冬天保暖。
words.en: Insulation is a material or substance that is used to stop heat, electricity, or sound from going from one place to another.

words.ex: The insulation layer keeps the house warm in winter.
words.ex_cn: 绝缘层在冬天使房子保持温暖。
words.en: A layer of material designed to prevent the transfer of heat, sound, or electricity.

words.tr: phrase. 声学绝缘；隔音；防止声音传播的材料或结构
words.ex: The walls have acoustic insulation to reduce noise.
words.ex_cn: 墙壁有声学绝缘材料以减少噪音。
words.en: Materials or structures designed to reduce sound transmission.

words.ex: The house has good thermal insulation to keep warm in winter.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子有良好的隔热材料，以便冬天保暖。
words.en: material or a method used to prevent heat from passing through a structure, such as a wall or roof

words.tr: v. 隔离；使隔热；使隔音；使绝缘
words.ex: The walls insulate the house from cold air.
words.ex_cn: 墙壁将房子与冷空气隔离开。
words.en: To insulate something means to protect it from heat, cold, noise, or electricity by covering it in a material that prevents it from passing through.

words.ex: The hospital will isolate the patient to stop the spread.
words.ex_cn: 医院将隔离这名病人以防止传播。
words.en: To isolate someone or something means to separate them from other people or things, often in order to protect them or to prevent the spread of something harmful.

words.ex: The room has good acoustic properties.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有良好的声音效果。
words.en: Relating to sound or the sense of hearing.

words.ex: The thermal blanket keeps you warm.
words.ex_cn: 这个保暖毯让你暖和。
words.en: relating to heat or temperature

words.ex: The auctioneer brought the gavel down with a decisive strike.
words.ex_cn: 拍卖师果断地敲下小木槌。
words.en: A gavel is a small wooden hammer that a person in charge of a meeting or an auction hits against a wooden block to call for attention or order.

words.ex: Add a pinch of nutmeg to the sauce for extra flavor.
words.ex_cn: 在酱汁中加入少许肉豆蔻以增加风味。
words.en: Nutmeg is a spice made from the seed of the nutmeg tree, which is native to several Indonesian islands. It is used in cooking for its warm, nutty flavor.

words.tr: n. 一捆；一束（干草、稻草）；
words.ex: He carried a truss of hay to the barn.
words.ex_cn: 他扛了一捆干草到谷仓。
words.en: To tie up or bind tightly; to support or strengthen with a framework.

words.ex: The molecule has a tetrahedral shape.
words.ex_cn: 这个分子具有四面体的形状。
words.en: Having the shape of a tetrahedron; pertaining to or forming a tetrahedron.

words.ex: The war impoverished many families.
words.ex_cn: 这场战争使许多家庭变得贫困。
words.en: To make someone poor or to reduce the quality, strength, or richness of something.

words.tr: v. 即兴创作；即兴表演；临时准备；
words.ex: He improvise a song on the piano.
words.ex_cn: 他即兴创作了一首钢琴曲。
words.en: If you improvise, you make or do something using whatever you have or without having planned it in advance.

words.ex: He spoke without hesitation.
words.ex_cn: 他毫不犹豫地说了。
words.en: Hesitation is the act of pausing before doing something, especially because you are nervous or not certain about it.

words.tr: phrase. 毫不犹豫地；毫不迟疑地
words.ex: He jumped into the water without hesitation.
words.ex_cn: 他毫不犹豫地跳进了水里。
words.en: If you say that someone does something without hesitation, you are emphasizing that they do it immediately and willingly.

words.w: have no hesitation in doing sth
words.tr: 短语. 在做某事时毫不犹豫
words.uk: hæv nəʊ ˌhezɪˈteɪʃn ɪn ˈduːɪŋ sʌmθɪŋ
words.us: hæv noʊ ˌhɛzɪˈteɪʃn ɪn ˈduːɪŋ ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.ex: I have no hesitation in helping my friend.
words.ex_cn: 我毫不犹豫地帮助我的朋友。
words.en: To do something without any doubt or delay.

words.tr: v. 逐渐削弱；暗中损害；
words.ex: Constant criticism can undermine your confidence.
words.ex_cn: 不断的批评会逐渐削弱你的信心。
words.en: To undermine something means to weaken it or make it less effective, often in a gradual or sneaky way.

words.ex: His mistake undermined his position in the team.
words.ex_cn: 他的错误削弱了他在团队中的立场。

words.ex: Lying to the public can undermine one's credibility.
words.ex_cn: 对公众撒谎会削弱一个人的信誉。

words.ex: He is a underminer who spreads doubt in the team.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个在团队中散布怀疑的破坏者。
words.en: A person or factor that weakens, undermines, or gradually erodes the foundation, authority, or effectiveness of something.

words.ex: We must eliminate the waste to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 我们必须消除浪费以保护环境。
words.en: To eliminate something, especially something you do not want or need, means to remove it completely.

words.tr: phrase. 消除贫困；根除贫穷
words.ex: The government wants to eliminate poverty.
words.ex_cn: 政府希望消除贫困。
words.en: To eliminate poverty means to completely remove or get rid of poverty, ensuring that people have the necessary resources and opportunities to live a decent life.

words.ex: The government wants to eliminate crime by improving education.
words.ex_cn: 政府希望通过改善教育来消除犯罪。

words.ex: The rule excludes children under 12.
words.ex_cn: 这条规则排除了12岁以下的孩子。
words.en: To exclude someone or something means to prevent them from entering a place or taking part in an activity.

words.tr: v. 将某物排除在某物之外
words.ex: The school excludes phones from the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 学校将手机排除在教室之外。

words.tr: n. 要洗的衣物；洗衣店；
words.ex: I put the dirty laundry in the washing machine.
words.ex_cn: 我把脏衣服放进洗衣机里。
words.en: Laundry refers to the clothes and linens that need to be washed or that have just been washed. It can also refer to the place or business where clothes and linens are washed and ironed.

words.ex: She does the laundry every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 她每周日洗衣服。
words.en: To wash clothes, sheets, and other items using a washing machine or by hand.

words.ex: She washed the linen in cold water.
words.ex_cn: 她用冷水洗亚麻布。
words.en: Linen is a kind of cloth that is made from the fibers of the flax plant. It is used to make clothes, sheets, and tablecloths.

words.ex: He likes coffee, whereas she prefers tea.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢咖啡，然而她更喜欢茶。
words.en: You use whereas to introduce a comment which contrasts with what is said in the main clause.

words.ex: He was imprisoned for stealing.
words.ex_cn: 他因偷窃而被监禁。
words.en: To put someone in prison or keep them as a prisoner.

words.ex: He tried to detach himself from the group.
words.ex_cn: 他试图脱离这个群体。
words.en: If you detach one thing from another that it is fixed to, you remove it. If one thing detaches from another, it becomes separated from it.

words.ex: The witness lost credibility after lying.
words.ex_cn: 证人因撒谎而失去了可信性。
words.en: The quality of being trusted and believed in.

words.tr:
n. 信用；赊账；赞扬；贷款；荣誉；
v. 相信；
words.ex: He has good credit with the bank.
words.ex_cn: 他在银行有良好的信用。
words.en: If you are allowed credit, you are allowed to pay for goods or services several weeks or months after you have received them.

words.ex: The storm weakened the old bridge.
words.ex_cn: 风暴削弱了那座旧桥。
words.en: To weaken something means to reduce its strength, intensity, or effectiveness.

words.ex: Exercise can strengthen your muscles.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以增强你的肌肉。
words.en: To strengthen something means to make it stronger or more effective.

words.ex: The storm will intensify tonight.
words.ex_cn: 风暴今晚会加强。
words.en: To make or become more intense or intensive.

words.ex: Exercise can reinforce your muscles.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以增强你的肌肉。
words.en: To reinforce something means to make it stronger or more effective.

words.tr:
v. 促进；使增长；
n. 提高；增强；
words.ex: Exercise can boost your energy.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以促进你的精力。
words.en: If one thing boosts another, it causes it to increase, improve, or be more successful.

words.ex: Exercise can bolster your health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以增强你的健康。
words.en: If you bolster something such as someone's confidence or courage, you increase it. A bolster is also a long, firm pillow.

words.ex: The lamp illuminate the dark room.
words.ex_cn: 这盏灯照亮了黑暗的房间。
words.en: To illuminate something means to shine light on it and to make it brighter and more visible.

words.tr: v. 阐明；“illuminate”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 被照亮的；
words.ex: The teacher illuminated the difficult concept with a simple example.
words.ex_cn: 老师用一个简单的例子阐明了这个难懂的概念。
words.en: To illuminate something means to shine light on it and to make it brighter and more visible.

words.ex: The sun is a bright luminary in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 太阳是天空中一个明亮的发光体。
words.en: A luminary is a person who is very famous and highly respected, especially in a particular field.

words.ex: The luminant stars lit up the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 发光的星星照亮了夜空。
words.en: Emitting or reflecting light; luminous.

words.tr: vt. 启发; 照亮，照明
words.ex: The lamp will illumine the dark room.
words.ex_cn: 这盏灯会照亮黑暗的房间。
words.en: To light up or illuminate; to make something clear or understandable.

words.ex: The sentence has ambiguity because it can mean two things.
words.ex_cn: 这句话有歧义，因为它可以有两种意思。
words.en: If you say that there is ambiguity in something, you mean that it is unclear or confusing, or it can be understood in more than one way.

words.tr: adv. 显然；表面上看起来；
words.ex: He is apparently late for the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他显然迟到了会议。
words.en: You use apparently to indicate that the information you are giving is something that you have heard, but you are not certain that it is true.

words.ex: He added gelatin to make the dessert firm.
words.ex_cn: 他加了明胶使甜点变硬。
words.en: Gelatin is a clear substance obtained from animal bones and used in food preparation, especially to make jelly, and in photographic processes.

words.ex: The bright light stimulated her eyes.
words.ex_cn: 强烈的光线刺激了她的眼睛。
words.en: To stimulate something means to encourage it to begin or develop further.

words.tr:
n. 燃料；燃油；
v. 加剧；
words.ex: The rocket uses fuel 627 for propulsion.
words.ex_cn: 火箭使用627号燃料推进。
words.en: Fuel is a substance such as coal, gas, or oil that is burned to provide heat or power.

words.ex: The old stove burns solid fuel to produce heat.
words.ex_cn: 旧炉子用固体燃料来产生热量。
words.en: A fuel that is burned directly in solid form, such as coal, wood, or charcoal, for heating or energy.

words.ex: The power plant uses nuclear fuel to generate electricity.
words.ex_cn: 发电厂使用核燃料来发电。
words.en: Nuclear fuel is a material that can be used in nuclear power stations to produce heat by nuclear fission.

words.tr: phrase. 火上浇油；使情况更加恶化
words.ex: His angry words add fuel to the fire.
words.ex_cn: 他愤怒的话火上浇油。
words.en: To make a bad situation worse by saying or doing something that causes more anger or problems.

words.ex: The nucleus of the team is the captain.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队的核心是队长。
words.en: The central and most important part of an object, movement, or group, forming the basis for its activity and growth.

words.ex: The operational system runs smoothly every day.
words.ex_cn: 这个运作系统每天运行顺畅。
words.en: If a system or service is operational, it is working or able to be used.

words.tr: n. 图像；形象；画面；影像；
words.ex: The photo shows a clear image of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片展示了山脉的清晰图像。
words.en: An image is a picture that you have in your mind, especially about what someone or something is like or the way they look.

words.ex: The teacher will distribute the books to students.
words.ex_cn: 老师将把书分发给学生。
words.en: If you distribute things, you hand them or deliver them to a number of people.

words.ex: The teacher distributed the cookies equally among the students.
words.ex_cn: 老师把饼干平均分给了学生们。

words.ex: We distribute expenses equally among all roommates.
words.ex_cn: 我们把费用平均分摊给所有室友。

words.ex: The distribution of students in the class is even.
words.ex_cn: 班级里学生的分布是均匀的。
words.en: The process of giving out or spreading something, or the way in which something is spread or arranged over an area or among a group of people.

words.ex: I intend to go to the park tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我打算明天去公园。
words.en: If you intend to do something, you have decided or planned to do it.

words.ex: His intention was to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他的意图是帮助他的朋友。
words.en: An intention is an idea or plan of what you are going to do.

words.ex: The accident was an unintended result of the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 这场事故是这个错误的无意结果。
words.en: An unintended result or effect is one that you did not plan or intend to happen.

words.tr: adj. 经验主义的；以经验为根据的；
words.ex: The scientist used empirical data to support her theory.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家使用经验数据来支持她的理论。
words.en: Empirical evidence or study relies on practical experience rather than theories.

words.ex: He is on probation for one year.
words.ex_cn: 他被判缓刑一年。
words.en: Probation is a period of time during which someone who has committed a crime has to behave well and not commit any more crimes in order to avoid being sent to prison.

words.ex: He is on probationary status at his new job.
words.ex_cn: 他在新工作中处于试用期。
words.en: Relating to a period of testing or trial, especially for a new employee or a criminal on parole.

words.tr:
n. 遗嘱检验；遗嘱认证
v. 核实（或检验）遗嘱
words.ex: The lawyer is handling the probate of the estate.
words.ex_cn: 律师正在处理遗产的遗嘱认证。
words.en: Probate is the legal process in which a will is reviewed to determine whether it is valid and authentic.

words.tr: n. 试用人员；见习生；缓刑犯
words.ex: The probationer was closely monitored during his first month at the company.
words.ex_cn: n. 试用人员在公司的第一个月受到了密切监控。
words.en: A probationer is someone who is on probation, either as a new employee in a trial period, a student undergoing training, or a criminal serving a sentence under supervision rather than in prison.

words.ex: He gave a contemptuous smile when she spoke.
words.ex_cn: 当她说话时，他露出轻蔑的微笑。
words.en: If you are contemptuous of someone or something, you do not like or respect them at all.

words.tr: adj. 现代的；当代的；同时代的；
words.ex: This museum displays contemporary art.
words.ex_cn: 这个博物馆展示现代艺术。
words.en: Belonging to or occurring in the present; or a person or thing living or existing at the same time as another.

words.ex: The caretaker cleans the building every day.
words.ex_cn: 看管人每天打扫这座大楼。
words.en: A caretaker is a person whose job is to look after a large building such as a school or a block of flats or apartments, and deal with small repairs to it.

words.ex: He took a temporary job during summer.
words.ex_cn: 他在暑假期间做了一份短暂的工作。
words.en: Something that is temporary lasts for only a limited time.

words.tr: adj. 无力的；虚弱的；阳痿的
words.ex: He felt impotent after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到无能为力。
words.en: If someone feels impotent, they feel that they have no power to influence people or events.

words.ex: The medicine is potent and works quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这种药物非常有效，起效很快。
words.en: Something that is potent is very effective and powerful.

words.ex: She put the food on a clean plate.
words.ex_cn: 她把食物放在一个干净的盘子里。
words.en: A flat dish, typically circular and made of china, from which food is eaten or served.

words.tr: phrase. 查阅；提到；涉及；指的是
words.ex: Please refer to the dictionary for the meaning.
words.ex_cn: 请查阅字典以了解这个词的意思。
words.en: If you refer to a particular subject or person, you talk about them or mention them.

words.tr: v. 把某人称为某物；把某人当作某人/某事物
words.ex: They refer to him as a hero.
words.ex_cn: 他们把他称为英雄。

words.tr:
n. 火焰
v. 燃烧；爆发；面红
words.ex: The candle flame flickered in the wind.
words.ex_cn: 蜡烛的火焰在风中摇曳。
words.en: A flame is a hot bright stream of burning gas that comes from something that is burning.

words.ex: The book was dusty on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书在架子上积满了灰尘。
words.en: Covered with or resembling dust; dry and powdery.

words.ex: He made a mistake in his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他在作业中犯了一个错误。
words.en: If you make a mistake, you do something which you did not intend to do, or which produces a result that you do not want.

words.tr: adj. 搞错的；弄错的；误解的； v. “mistake”的过去分词；
words.ex: He was mistaken about the time of the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他对会议的时间搞错了。
words.en: If you are mistaken about something, you are wrong about it.

words.ex: He is learning theoretical physics at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学学习理论物理。
words.en: A theoretical study or explanation is based on or uses the ideas and abstract principles of a subject, rather than the practical aspects or uses of it.

words.ex: The imperial palace was built long ago.
words.ex_cn: 这座帝国宫殿是很久以前建造的。
words.en: relating to an empire or an emperor; majestic or superior in quality or size

words.ex: The country practiced imperialism in the 1800s.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家在19世纪实行帝国主义。
words.en: Imperialism is a policy or ideology of extending a country's rule over foreign nations, often by military force or by gaining political and economic control of other areas.

words.ex: He felt deep depression after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到深深的抑郁。
words.en: A period during which business, employment, and stock-market values decline severely or remain at a very low level of activity.

words.ex: Many people lost their jobs during the great depression.
words.ex_cn: 在大萧条期间，许多人失去了工作。
words.en: The Great Depression was a severe worldwide economic depression that took place mostly during the 1930s, originating in the United States.

words.ex: Many people lost jobs during the economic depression.
words.ex_cn: 在经济萧条期间，许多人失去了工作。
words.en: A period of drastic decline in a national or international economy, characterized by decreasing business activity, falling prices, and unemployment.

words.ex: The proximity of the school to the park makes it nice for kids.
words.ex_cn: 学校靠近公园，对孩子们来说很好。
words.en: Proximity refers to the state of being near in space or time.

words.ex: The two houses are in close proximity.
words.ex_cn: 这两所房子彼此很近。
words.en: Very near or close to something or someone.

words.tr:
adj. 近似的；大约的；
v. 接近；
words.ex: The approximate cost is $50.
words.ex_cn: 费用大约是50美元。
words.en: An approximate number, time, or position is close to the correct number, time, or position, but is not exact.

words.ex: The approximation of pi is 3.14.
words.ex_cn: π的近似值是3.14。
words.en: An approximation is a fact, object, or description which is similar to something else, but which is not exactly the same.

words.ex: The two houses are adjacent to each other.
words.ex_cn: 这两栋房子彼此相邻。
words.en: If one thing is adjacent to another, it is next to it or adjoining it.

words.ex: The proximate cause of the accident was bad weather.
words.ex_cn: 事故的直接原因是恶劣天气。
words.en: If something is proximate, it is nearest in space, time, or relationship.

words.ex: The park is in the vicinity of my house.
words.ex_cn: 公园在我家附近。
words.en: The area or region near or about a place; the surrounding district.

words.ex: The distance between the two towns is 10 kilometers.
words.ex_cn: 两个城镇之间的距离是10公里。
words.en: The amount of space between two places or things.

words.ex: The child needs attention when he does homework.
words.ex_cn: 孩子做作业时需要被关注。
words.en: Attention is the act of focusing your mind on something and taking notice of it.

words.tr: v. 吸引某人的注意力到某物
words.ex: The bright sign attracts his attention to the sale.
words.ex_cn: 这个醒目的标志吸引了他的注意力到促销活动上。

words.tr: v. 引起某人的注意；使某人注意到某事
words.ex: The bright color drew my attention to the sign.
words.ex_cn: 鲜艳的颜色引起了我对这个标志的注意。

words.tr: v. 将某人的注意力从某事上转移开
words.ex: The loud music diverted her attention from the homework.
words.ex_cn: 嘈杂的音乐将她的注意力从作业上转移开了。

words.tr: phrase. 注意某事；关注某事；对某事加以留意
words.ex: Please pay attention to the teacher in class.
words.ex_cn: 请在课堂上注意听老师讲课。
words.en: To pay attention to something means to focus your mind on it or to take notice of it.

words.ex: The bright poster caught the attention of the students.
words.ex_cn: 这幅鲜艳的海报吸引了学生的注意。
words.en: To attract or draw someone's interest or notice.

words.tr: adj. 根据事实的；真实的；
words.ex: His report is factual and accurate.
words.ex_cn: 他的报告是基于事实且准确的。
words.en: If something is factual, it is based on facts or concerns facts.

words.ex: The actor received acclaim for his performance.
words.ex_cn: 这位演员因他的表演而受到赞扬。
words.en: If someone or something is acclaimed, they are praised enthusiastically and publicly.

words.ex: The film won worldwide acclaim for its powerful story.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影因其动人的故事赢得了全球赞誉。

words.ex: The actor received great acclaim for his performance.
words.ex_cn: 这位演员因他的表演受到高度赞扬。

words.ex: He carries a bag to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天带一个包去学校。
words.en: To carry something means to move it while supporting it, especially in your hands or arms.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 成功地处理或应对（困难或尴尬的情况）；夺走；使显得有魅力
words.ex: He carried off the awkward silence with a joke.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个笑话成功应对了尴尬的沉默。
words.en: To succeed in doing or achieving something, especially something difficult.

words.tr: phrase. 继续；坚持；进行；开展
words.ex: He will carry on working after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午饭后会继续工作。
words.en: If you carry on, you continue doing something.

words.ex: They will carry out the experiment tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们明天将进行这个实验。
words.en: To perform or complete a task, duty, or project.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 坚持到底；完成；帮助某人渡过难关
words.ex: He worked hard to carry through his plan.
words.ex_cn: 他努力实施他的计划。
words.en: To complete something or to continue doing something until it is finished, especially something difficult.

words.ex: He was put through a tough training program.
words.ex_cn: 他经受了一项严格的训练计划。
words.en: To cause someone to experience something, especially something difficult or unpleasant, or to connect a telephone call.

words.ex: The earthquake devastated the small town.
words.ex_cn: 地震摧毁了这个小镇。
words.en: To devastate means to destroy or ruin something completely, or to cause someone to feel extreme sadness or shock.

words.ex: The earthquake caused total devastation in the city.
words.ex_cn: 地震给这座城市造成了严重的破坏。
words.en: The state of being devastated; severe and widespread destruction or damage.

words.tr: v. 意识到；认识到；实现；
words.ex: He finally realised his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他终于意识到自己的错误。
words.en: To realise means to become fully aware of something as a fact; understand clearly. It also means to achieve something desired or anticipated.

words.ex: I recognised my old friend at the station.
words.ex_cn: 我在车站认出了我的老朋友。
words.en: to know someone or something because you have seen or heard him or her or experienced it before

words.ex: The storm destroyed the old bridge.
words.ex_cn: 风暴摧毁了那座旧桥。
words.en: To destroy something means to cause so much damage to it that it is completely ruined or does not exist any more.

words.ex: They will demolish the old building next week.
words.ex_cn: 他们下周会拆掉那座旧建筑。
words.en: To demolish something such as a building means to destroy it completely. It can also mean to defeat someone completely in a discussion, argument, or competition.

words.ex: The noise will diminish after midnight.
words.ex_cn: 午夜后噪音会减少。
words.en: If something diminishes, or if something diminishes it, it becomes reduced in size, importance, or intensity.

words.ex: He detests eating broccoli.
words.ex_cn: 他讨厌吃西兰花。
words.en: If you detest something, you dislike it intensely.

words.ex: His sadness manifested in his quiet eyes.
words.ex_cn: 他的悲伤表现在他安静的眼神中。
words.en: To manifest something means to show it clearly and visibly.

words.ex: He attests that the document is true.
words.ex_cn: 他证明这份文件是真实的。
words.en: To attest something means to declare or affirm that it is true or genuine, often in a formal or legal context.

words.ex: Please verify your email address.
words.ex_cn: 请核实你的电子邮件地址。
words.en: To verify something means to check or prove that it is true, accurate, or justified.

words.ex: The police arrested the thief last night.
words.ex_cn: 警察昨晚逮捕了那个小偷。
words.en: If the police arrest you, they take charge of you and take you to a police station, because they believe you may have committed a crime.

words.ex: His response to the question was quick.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题的反应很快。
words.en: A reaction to a situation or event.

words.ex: They shouted, 'Welcome home!' when he walked through the door.
words.ex_cn: 当他走进门时，他们大喊：‘欢迎回家！’
words.en: A greeting used to express pleasure at someone's return to their home.

words.ex: He smiled in response to her question.
words.ex_cn: 他针对她的问题笑了。
words.en: as a reply or reaction to something

words.tr: adj. 易反应的；应答的；回答的；
words.ex: The child is responsive to his mother's voice.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子对母亲的声音反应灵敏。
words.en: If someone or something is responsive, they react quickly and favorably.

words.tr: adj. 阴暗的；枯燥的；无趣的；
words.ex: The room was dull because the windows were covered.
words.ex_cn: 房间很阴暗，因为窗户被遮住了。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as dull, you mean they are not interesting or exciting.

words.ex: The basis of math is numbers.
words.ex_cn: 数学的基础是数字。
words.en: The underlying support or foundation for an idea, argument, or process.

words.tr: phrase. 以...为基础；根据；按照
words.ex: He made a decision on the basis of the facts.
words.ex_cn: 他基于事实做出了决定。
words.en: On the basis of means using something as the foundation or starting point for something else.

words.ex: He lives in a tropical island near the equator.
words.ex_cn: 他住在赤道附近的一个热带岛屿上。
words.en: relating to or situated in or characteristic of the tropics (the region on either side of the equator)

words.tr: n. 热带状况；热带气候条件
words.ex: The island has a tropical condition with high heat and heavy rain all year.
words.ex_cn: 这个岛屿终年高温多雨，属于热带状况。

words.tr: phrase. 热带疾病（指主要在热带地区流行的疾病）
words.ex: He got a tropical disease after traveling to the jungle.
words.ex_cn: 他去丛林旅行后染上了一种热带疾病。
words.en: A tropical disease is an illness that is prevalent in or unique to tropical and subtropical regions.

words.tr: phrase. 热带雨林；位于赤道附近高温多雨地区的茂密常绿森林
words.ex: The tropical rainforest has many strange animals.
words.ex_cn: 热带雨林有许多奇特的动物。
words.en: A tropical rainforest is a type of ecosystem found near the Earth's equator, characterized by high rainfall and a diverse range of flora and fauna.

words.ex: The tropical marine climate is characterized by warm temperatures and high humidity.
words.ex_cn: n. 热带海洋性气候的特点是温暖的气温和高湿度。
words.en: A tropical marine climate is a type of climate characterized by warm temperatures and high humidity, typically found in regions near the equator and influenced by the ocean.

words.tr:
n. 谣言
v. 谣传
words.ex: There is a rumour that he will quit his job.
words.ex_cn: 有一个传言说他要辞职。
words.en: A rumour is a story or piece of information that may or may not be true, but that people are talking about.

words.tr: n. 流言很快流传开来
words.ex: The rumour soon gained currency after the news broke.
words.ex_cn: 这个流言在新闻曝光后很快流传开来。

words.tr:
n. 尽力；尝试；
v. 尽力；奋力；
words.ex: His endeavor to finish the project took all his energy.
words.ex_cn: 他为完成这个项目付出了全部努力。
words.en: An endeavor is an attempt to do something, especially something new or original.

words.tr: phrase. 努力做某事；试图完成某事
words.ex: He endeavour to do his homework every day.
words.ex_cn: 他努力每天做作业。
words.en: To endeavour to do something means to try very hard to do it.

words.tr:
n. 地址；演讲；
v. 解决；向…讲话；
words.ex: Please write your address on the form.
words.ex_cn: 请把你的地址写在表格上。
words.en: The particulars of the place where someone lives or an organization is situated; a formal speech delivered to an audience.

words.tr: v. 写信封地址；给信件写收件人地址
words.ex: He addressed a letter to his friend in London.
words.ex_cn: 他给在伦敦的朋友写信封地址。

words.tr: v. 向人们讲话；对公众发言
words.ex: The mayor will address to people at the town meeting.
words.ex_cn: 市长将在市政会议上向人们讲话。

words.ex: He made the payment online.
words.ex_cn: 他在线支付了。
words.en: A payment is an amount of money that is paid to someone, or the act of paying this money.

words.ex: The food at this restaurant is superb.
words.ex_cn: 这家餐厅的食物极佳。
words.en: If something is superb, its quality is very good indeed.

words.ex: His rude words provoked her anger.
words.ex_cn: 他粗鲁的话激怒了她。
words.en: If you provoke someone, you deliberately annoy them and try to make them behave aggressively.

words.tr: adj. 单调乏味的；毫无变化的；
words.ex: The work is monotonous and boring.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作单调乏味。
words.en: Something that is monotonous is very boring because it has a regular, repeated pattern which never changes.

words.ex: The long meeting was tedious.
words.ex_cn: 这场漫长的会议很沉闷。
words.en: If you describe something such as a job, task, or situation as tedious, you mean it is boring and rather frustrating.

words.ex: He went to a tutorial to understand math better.
words.ex_cn: 他去参加辅导以更好地理解数学。
words.en: A tutorial is a period of teaching and discussion with a tutor, especially in a British university or college.

words.tr:
n. 接触（的机会或权利）；进入；通道；
v. 获取；使用；接近；
words.ex: Students need access to the library.
words.ex_cn: 学生需要有接触图书馆的机会。
words.en: If you have access to a building or other place, you are able to enter it or use it.

words.ex: The currency in Japan is the yen.
words.ex_cn: 日本的货币是日元。
words.en: The system of money in general use in a particular country.

words.tr: 短语动词。开始被广泛接受或流行起来；获得认可
words.ex: This idea is gaining currency among scientists.
words.ex_cn: 这个观点在科学家中正变得流行。
words.en: To become widely accepted or popular.

words.ex: The exchange rate is high today.
words.ex_cn: 今天的汇率很高。
words.en: The exchange rate is the rate at which one currency will be exchanged for another. It is also regarded as the value of one country's currency in relation to another currency.

words.tr: adj. 永久的；永恒的；经久不变的
words.ex: The love between them is everlasting.
words.ex_cn: 他们之间的爱是永恒的。
words.en: Something that is everlasting lasts forever or for a very long time.

words.ex: He made a permanent change to his lifestyle.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己的生活方式做出了永久的改变。
words.en: Something that is permanent exists or happens all the time, or exists for a long time without changing.

words.ex: The machine makes a perpetual noise.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器发出持续的噪音。
words.en: Something that is perpetual continues indefinitely or for a very long time without interruption.

words.tr:
n. 压力；强调；
v. 着重；强调；
words.ex: He feels stress from too much work.
words.ex_cn: 他因为工作太多而感到压力。
words.en: Stress is a state of mental or emotional strain or tension resulting from adverse or demanding circumstances.

words.ex: He emphasizes the importance of homework.
words.ex_cn: 他强调作业的重要性。
words.en: To give special importance or prominence to (something) in speaking or writing.

words.ex: She accentuates the first syllable when she says the word.
words.ex_cn: 她说这个词时重读第一个音节。
words.en: To accentuate something means to emphasize it or make it more noticeable.

words.ex: The teacher underlined the key point.
words.ex_cn: 老师强调了这个关键点。
words.en: To draw a line under a word or phrase, especially in order to emphasize it.

words.ex: The king will bestow a medal on the hero.
words.ex_cn: 国王将把奖章授予这位英雄。
words.en: To bestow something on someone means to give or present it to them.

words.ex: The supreme leader makes the final decision.
words.ex_cn: 至上的领导人做出最终决定。
words.en: If you say that something is supreme, you mean that it is the most important or the best of its kind.

words.ex: The experiment demonstrates that water boils at 100°C.
words.ex_cn: 这个实验证明水在100摄氏度时沸腾。
words.en: To demonstrate means to show something clearly by giving proof or evidence.

words.ex: The teacher gave a demonstration of how to solve the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 老师演示了如何解这道数学题。
words.en: A demonstration is a public meeting or march in which people show their opposition to something or their support for something.

words.ex: We will review the meeting agenda tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我们明天将审查会议议程。
words.en: An agenda is a list or plan of things to be done or considered, especially in a meeting.

words.tr: adj. 苗条的；纤细的；微小的；
words.ex: She has a slim figure.
words.ex_cn: 她身材苗条。
words.en: If someone is slim, they are thin in an attractive way.

words.ex: The evidence warrants a new investigation.
words.ex_cn: 证据使新的调查成为必要。
words.en: If something warrants a particular action, it makes the action seem necessary or appropriate for the circumstances.

words.tr: n. 保证；保修单；保证书
words.ex: The phone comes with a one-year warranty.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机有一年的保修期。
words.en: A warranty is a written guarantee, often given to the purchaser of an article by its manufacturer, promising to repair or replace it if necessary within a specified period of time.

words.tr: n. 乐观；乐观主义；乐观精神；
words.ex: His optimism helps him stay happy even when things are hard.
words.ex_cn: 他的乐观让他即使在困难时也能保持快乐。
words.en: Optimism is a feeling of hopefulness and confidence about the future or the success of something.

words.tr:
n. 等级；
v. 分等级；
words.ex: He earned a high rank in the army.
words.ex_cn: 他在军队中获得了很高的等级。
words.en: If you rank things or people, you arrange them in order of importance or quality. If someone or something ranks in a particular position, they are in that position on a scale that measures something such as importance or quality.

words.tr:
n. 轮廓；纲要；
v. 描画轮廓；概述；
words.ex: The artist drew the outline of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 艺术家画出了山的轮廓。
words.en: An outline is a line that shows or forms the outer edge of something, or a general description or plan showing the essential features of something but not the detail.

words.tr:
n. 展示；陈列；
v. 展示；陈列；
words.ex: The store has a big display of new phones.
words.ex_cn: 商店里有一个新手机的展示。
words.en: To display something means to put it in a place where people can see it easily, or to show it to people.

words.tr: v. 举例说明；给书籍、杂志等加插图；
words.ex: The teacher illustrated the point with a simple story.
words.ex_cn: 老师用一个简单的故事来举例说明这个观点。
words.en: To illustrate something means to explain or demonstrate it clearly, often by giving examples or by using pictures or diagrams.

words.tr:
v. 展示；表明；给...看；
n. 节目；演出；展览会；表现；
words.ex: He shows his photos to his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他向朋友们展示他的照片。
words.en: To show something means to make it visible or to allow it to be seen. It can also refer to a performance or exhibition intended to entertain or educate.

words.ex: The architect showed us the blueprint of the new house.
words.ex_cn: 建筑师给我们看了新房子的蓝图。
words.en: A blueprint is a detailed plan or design of something, often used in the context of buildings or machinery, which shows how it is to be made or how it will work.

words.ex: She has a slender figure.
words.ex_cn: 她身材苗条。
words.en: Someone or something that is slender is thin and graceful.

words.tr: adj. 不足的；欠缺的；微小的；
words.ex: There is scant evidence to support the claim.
words.ex_cn: 支持这一说法的证据不足。
words.en: If you describe something as scant, you mean that there is not enough of it or that it is not as much as it should be.

words.tr: adj. 欠缺的；过小的；少量的
words.ex: He had scanty food for the whole day.
words.ex_cn: 他一整天的食物很少。
words.en: If something is scanty, there is not enough of it or it is too small in amount.

words.tr: adj. 缺乏的；不足的；稀有的；
words.ex: Water is scarce in the desert.
words.ex_cn: 沙漠里水很缺乏。
words.en: If something is scarce, there is not enough of it.

words.tr: adj. 不足的；缺乏的；有缺陷的
words.ex: The plant is deficient in sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 这株植物缺乏阳光。
words.en: If someone or something is deficient in a particular thing, they do not have the full amount of it that they need.

words.ex: The water supply is insufficient for the whole village.
words.ex_cn: 供水对整个村庄来说是不充分的。
words.en: If something is insufficient, it is not enough for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He dismissed her advice and walked away.
words.ex_cn: 他不理会她的建议，走开了。
words.en: If you dismiss someone, you send them away or allow them to leave.

words.ex: His pessimism made him expect the worst.
words.ex_cn: 他的悲观主义让他总是预期最坏的结果。
words.en: Pessimism is the belief that bad things are going to happen or that something is going to turn out badly.

words.tr: v. 摆脱悲观情绪；摒弃消极看法
words.ex: He tried to dismiss pessimism and focus on the good things.
words.ex_cn: 他努力摆脱悲观情绪，专注于积极的事情。

words.ex: The dimension of the box is 10 cm by 5 cm.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子的尺寸是10厘米乘5厘米。
words.en: A dimension is a measurement of something in a particular direction, or the scope or scale of something.

words.ex: He did not avail himself of the opportunity.
words.ex_cn: 他没有利用这个机会。
words.en: If you avail yourself of something, you use it or take advantage of it.

words.tr:
n. 大楼；大厦；块；街区；障碍物；
v. 阻塞；阻碍；
words.ex: The new block is next to the park.
words.ex_cn: 这栋新大楼就在公园旁边。
words.en: A block is a large solid piece of material with flat surfaces on each side. As a verb, to block means to prevent movement or progress.

words.ex: The blockage in the pipe caused water to stop flowing.
words.ex_cn: 管道中的堵塞导致水停止流动。
words.en: A blockage is a situation in which something is preventing movement or flow in a passage or pipe.

words.ex: The big rock was an obstacle on the road.
words.ex_cn: 那块大石头是路上的障碍。
words.en: An obstacle is something which makes it difficult for you to go forward or to achieve something.

words.ex: The administrative office handles school records.
words.ex_cn: 行政办公室负责管理学校档案。
words.en: Relating to the management of a company, organization, or institution.

words.tr: adj. 令人沮丧的；令人泄气的；让人懊恼的； v. “frustrate”的现在分词；
words.ex: The slow internet is frustrating.
words.ex_cn: 网速慢让人沮丧。
words.en: If something is frustrating, it annoys you or makes you angry because you cannot do anything about the problems it causes.

words.ex: This plant is resistant to drought.
words.ex_cn: 这种植物对干旱有抵抗力。
words.en: If someone is resistant to something, they are opposed to it and want to prevent it.

words.tr: phrase. 抵抗…的；对…有抵抗力的
words.ex: The new material is resistant to high temperatures.
words.ex_cn: 这种新材料对高温有抵抗力。
words.en: To be able to withstand or oppose something, such as a force, influence, or condition.

words.ex: The tank is made of acid-resistant material.
words.ex_cn: 这个罐子是由耐酸材料制成的。

words.ex: The house is quake-resistant.
words.ex_cn: 这栋房子是抗震的。
words.en: Designed or built to withstand earthquakes without significant damage.

words.ex: The tent is wind-resistant.
words.ex_cn: 这个帐篷抗风。
words.en: Designed or able to withstand or resist the force or effects of wind, often used for structures, fabrics, or materials.

words.ex: The book is overdue at the library.
words.ex_cn: 这本书在图书馆逾期了。
words.en: If you say that a change or an event is overdue, you mean that you think it should have happened before now.

words.tr: adj. 已过期的；超出有效期的
words.ex: The milk is out of expiry, so don't drink it.
words.ex_cn: 这牛奶已过期，别喝了。

words.ex: His speech was very impressive.
words.ex_cn: 他的演讲非常令人印象深刻。
words.en: Something that is impressive makes you admire it because it is very good, large, important, etc.

words.ex: She solved the math problem impressively.
words.ex_cn: 她令人印象深刻地解出了这道数学题。
words.en: In a manner that attracts attention or admiration through being notable or extraordinary.

words.ex: He did an analysis of the data.
words.ex_cn: 他对数据进行了分析。
