words.ex: The festival helps to promote cultural communication.
words.ex_cn: 这个节日有助于促进文化交流。
words.en: To encourage and facilitate the exchange of cultural ideas and practices between different groups or societies.

words.ex: He flipped through the album with old photos.
words.ex_cn: 他翻看着装满旧照片的相册。
words.en: An album is a collection of several pieces of music, songs, or photographs that are intended to form a single item.

words.ex: He ate a lump of sugar.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一块糖。
words.en: A lump is a solid piece of something, often with no particular shape. If you lump things together, you put them together in a group or treat them as the same.

words.tr:
n. 屁股；乞丐；游民
v. 讨要；游荡
adj. 糟糕的；令人不快的
words.ex: He fell on his bum.
words.ex_cn: 他摔在了屁股上。
words.en: If someone is bumming around, they are spending time in a relaxed and lazy way, often without a fixed plan or purpose.

words.ex: He ate a bun for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了一个面包卷。
words.en: A bun is a small, usually round piece of bread. It can also refer to a hairstyle in which the hair is gathered into a tight coil or knot at the back of the head.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 碰撞；偶然遇到
words.ex: Be careful not to bump against the table.
words.ex_cn: 小心别撞到桌子。
words.en: To come into contact with something or someone in a way that is usually not intended or expected.

words.tr: phrase. 偶然遇见；意外碰到
words.ex: I bump into my friend at the store.
words.ex_cn: 我在商店碰到了我的朋友。
words.en: If you bump into someone you know, you meet them unexpectedly.

words.tr: v. 颠簸前行；勉强继续
words.ex: The old car bumps along the dirt road.
words.ex_cn: 那辆旧车在土路上颠簸前行。

words.tr: v. 使颠簸下降；（因颠簸而）降低
words.ex: The plane bumped down on the rough runway.
words.ex_cn: 飞机在颠簸的跑道上颠簸着降落。

words.ex: They had a bumper harvest this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年他们获得了异常大的收成。
words.en: A bumper is a bar at the front and back of a vehicle that reduces damage if the vehicle hits something.

words.tr: adj. 崎岖不平的；颠簸的；
words.ex: The car drove over a bumpy road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车开过一条崎岖不平的路。
words.en: If you say that something is bumpy, you mean that it is uneven, with a lot of bumps.

words.ex: The family had a reunion last Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 这家人上个星期天举行了团聚。
words.en: A reunion is a gathering of people who have been separated, especially members of a family or old friends, coming together again.

words.ex: The digestive system breaks down food.
words.ex_cn: 消化系统分解食物。
words.en: Relating to the process of digesting food.

words.ex: I live with a local family during my homestay.
words.ex_cn: 我在寄宿家庭期间和一个当地家庭住在一起。
words.en: A homestay is a form of tourism and/or study abroad program that allows the visitor to rent a room from a local family to better learn the local lifestyle as well as improve their language ability.

words.tr: v. 承诺；犯（罪、错）；（公开地）表达意见；
words.ex: He commit to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺帮助他的朋友。
words.en: To commit means to carry out or perpetrate a mistake, crime, or immoral act; or to pledge or bind oneself to a certain course of action.

words.ex: He is practically always late for class.
words.ex_cn: 他几乎总是上课迟到。
words.en: In a way that is almost true or almost the case; virtually.

words.tr: n. 杂技演员；立场观点善变的人
words.ex: The acrobat jumps high on the tightrope.
words.ex_cn: 杂技演员在钢丝上跳得很高。
words.en: An acrobat is someone who entertains people by performing difficult physical acts such as jumping and balancing, especially in a circus.

words.ex: Our family holds an annual reunion every summer.
words.ex_cn: 我们家每年夏天举行一次年度聚会。

words.ex: We had a family reunion last Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们上个星期天举行了家庭聚会。
words.en: A family reunion is a gathering of family members, often extended family, who come together to celebrate their familial bonds, share memories, and enjoy each other's company. These events are typically organized on a regular basis, such as annually, and can take place in various locations, including family homes, parks, or rented venues.

words.tr: phrase. 消化道；消化管（指从口腔到肛门的整个消化系统管道）
words.ex: The digestive tract breaks down food in the body.
words.ex_cn: 消化道在体内分解食物。
words.en: The system of organs in the body responsible for breaking down food and absorbing nutrients.

words.tr:
v. 喂；吃；
n. 饲养；喂养；
words.ex: She feeds the cat every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上喂猫。
words.en: To give food to a person or an animal; to supply something to a machine or a system.

words.tr: n. 感觉； v. 感到；“feel”的现在分词；
words.ex: I have a feeling it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我感觉明天会下雨。
words.en: An emotion or a physical sensation.

words.tr: n. 海星（一种海洋动物）
words.ex: The starfish lives in the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 海星生活在海洋中。
words.en: A starfish is a flat, star-shaped creature that lives in the sea. It has five arms and feeds on small sea creatures.

words.tr: phrase. 寄宿家庭；指留学生或访客在留学或访问期间所寄宿的当地家庭
words.ex: I live with a homestay family in London.
words.ex_cn: 我住在伦敦的一个寄宿家庭里。
words.en: A homestay family is a family that hosts a foreign student or visitor in their home, providing them with a place to stay and often meals, as part of a cultural exchange or educational program.

words.ex: Some people commit crimes because they are poor.
words.ex_cn: 有些人因为贫穷而犯罪。
words.en: To perform illegal activities or actions that are punishable by law.

words.tr: phrase. 自杀；结束自己的生命
words.ex: He decided to commit suicide because he felt hopeless.
words.ex_cn: 他感到绝望，决定自杀。
words.en: To kill oneself intentionally.

words.tr: phrase. 使自己致力于；承诺做某事；投入于
words.ex: He commit himself to exercise every day.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺自己每天锻炼。
words.en: To dedicate oneself to a particular task or purpose.

words.tr: v. 犯罪；做错事；“commit”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 忠诚的；
words.ex: He was committed for stealing a car.
words.ex_cn: 他因偷车而被定罪。
words.en: If you are committed to something, you are willing to give your time and energy to it because you believe in it.

words.ex: He made a commitment to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺按时完成这个项目。
words.en: A commitment is something that regularly takes up some of your time because of an agreement you have made or because of responsibilities that you have.

words.ex: The committee meets every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 委员会每周一开会。
words.en: A committee is a group of people who are chosen to do a particular job or make decisions on behalf of a larger group.

words.tr:
n. 练习；实践；惯常做法；
v. 从事；练习；
words.ex: Daily practice helps you improve your skills.
words.ex_cn: 每天的练习帮助你提高技能。
words.en: Practice is the act of rehearsing a behavior over and over, or engaging in an activity again and again, for the purpose of improving or mastering it, as in the phrase 'practice makes perfect'.

words.tr: n. 反作用原理；反冲原理
words.ex: The rocket works by the reaction principle.
words.ex_cn: 火箭依靠反作用原理工作。

words.tr: adj. 实用的；实际的；实践的；
words.ex: This tool is practical for everyday use.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具日常使用很实用。
words.en: relating to what is real rather than to what is possible or imagined; likely to succeed or be effective in real circumstances; involving or concerned with experience or actual use; not theoretical

words.ex: She tries to juggle her job and caring for her kids.
words.ex_cn: 她努力兼顾工作和照顾孩子。
words.en: If you juggle, you keep several objects in motion in the air at the same time by repeatedly throwing and catching them. Juggle can also mean to deal with several things at the same time, often in a skillful way.

words.ex: The company's revenue increased last year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司的收入去年增加了。
words.en: Revenue is the income that a company, organization, or government receives regularly.

words.ex: The coin is made of nickel.
words.ex_cn: 这枚硬币是镍制的。
words.en: A hard silver-white metal that is used in making alloys and is a chemical element. It is also a coin worth five cents in the US and Canada.

words.tr:
v. 跛行；蹒跚；瘸着走
adj. 无力的；无生气的
words.ex: He limps after hurting his leg.
words.ex_cn: 他受伤后走路一瘸一拐。
words.en: If someone limps, they walk with difficulty or in an uneven way because one of their legs or feet is hurt.

words.tr:
v. 喷吐；吐痰；吐口水
n. 唾沫；一块陆地；烤肉叉
words.ex: He likes to spit watermelon seeds.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢吐西瓜籽。
words.en: To spit means to force out the contents of the mouth, especially saliva, through the lips. It can also refer to the act of ejecting saliva or phlegm from the mouth, often as a gesture of contempt or disrespect.

words.tr: n. 不规则；无规律；不合常规；不整齐
words.ex: The teacher noticed an irregularity in the test scores.
words.ex_cn: 老师注意到考试成绩中有一个异常。
words.en: The state or quality of being irregular; something that is irregular.

words.ex: A gentle breeze blew through the trees.
words.ex_cn: 一阵微风轻轻吹过树梢。
words.en: A breeze is a gentle wind.

words.ex: There are many shops on this avenue.
words.ex_cn: 这条大街上有许多商店。
words.en: An avenue is a wide street or main thoroughfare, often lined with trees or other landscaping.

words.ex: The microscope can magnify small objects.
words.ex_cn: 显微镜可以放大微小的物体。
words.en: To magnify something means to make it appear larger than it is, especially by using a lens or microscope. It can also mean to exaggerate or make something seem more important or serious than it really is.

words.ex: The bees built a hive in the tree.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂在树上建了一个蜂巢。
words.en: A hive is a structure where bees live, consisting of a series of cells in which they store honey and raise their young.

words.tr: n. 定价； v. “price”的现在分词；
words.ex: The pricing of the new phone is very fair.
words.ex_cn: 这部新手机的定价非常合理。
words.en: The process of deciding how much to charge for a product or service.

words.tr: n. 预期收入；预计收入
words.ex: The company expected its anticipated revenue to rise next quarter.
words.ex_cn: 该公司预期其预期收入将在下个季度上升。

words.tr: n. 财政收入；财务收入
words.ex: The company earns financial revenue from sales.
words.ex_cn: 该公司通过销售获得财政收入。
words.en: Income generated from business or investment activities.

words.ex: The government uses tax revenue to build roads.
words.ex_cn: 政府用税收收入来修建道路。
words.en: Tax revenue refers to the income that is gained by governments through taxation.

words.ex: The limpness of her body indicated she was exhausted.
words.ex_cn: 她身体的柔弱表明她已经筋疲力尽。
words.en: The quality of being limp; lacking stiffness or firmness.

words.tr: phrase. 吐出；说出（尤指不情愿地）；迅速说出
words.ex: He had to spit out the bad apple.
words.ex_cn: 他不得不把那个坏苹果吐出来。
words.en: To expel something from the mouth, often because it is unpleasant or unwanted.

words.ex: To date, no one has solved the problem.
words.ex_cn: 到此为止，还没有人解决这个问题。
words.en: Up to the present time.

words.ex: He keeps his knowledge up to date.
words.ex_cn: 他让自己的知识保持最新。
words.en: If something is up to date, it is the newest thing of its kind.

words.ex: Hitherto, no one has solved the problem.
words.ex_cn: 迄今为止，没有人解决过这个问题。
words.en: Until now or until the point in time under discussion.

words.ex: To this date, no one has solved the puzzle.
words.ex_cn: 到目前为止，还没有人解开这个谜题。

words.ex: The speaker will amplify the sound for everyone to hear.
words.ex_cn: 扬声器会放大声音，让每个人都能听到。
words.en: To amplify something means to make it louder, stronger, or more detailed.

words.ex: The roses are in bloom in spring.
words.ex_cn: 玫瑰在春天开花。
words.en: When a plant or tree blooms, it produces flowers. The period during which a plant or tree produces flowers is also known as its bloom.

words.ex: Beekeepers take care of bees and collect honey.
words.ex_cn: 养蜂人照顾蜜蜂并收集蜂蜜。

words.tr: phrase. v. 出租；把……租出去；受雇于他人提供服务
words.ex: They hire out bikes near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们在公园附近出租自行车。
words.en: To allow someone to use something temporarily in exchange for money; to work for someone temporarily in exchange for money.

words.tr: phrase. 出租；租出（房屋、设备等）
words.ex: They rent out their spare room to students.
words.ex_cn: 他们把多余的房间租给学生。
words.en: To allow someone to use a property that you own in return for regular payments.

words.ex: Rust is an oxide of iron.
words.ex_cn: 铁锈是铁的氧化物。
words.en: An oxide is a chemical compound that contains at least one oxygen atom and one other element in its chemical formula.

words.tr:
adj. 最重要的；
adv. 首要地；
words.ex: He is the foremost expert in this field.
words.ex_cn: 他是这个领域最重要的专家。
words.en: Most important or prominent; leading.

words.ex: Follow the procedure step by step.
words.ex_cn: 一步一步地按照步骤进行。
words.en: A procedure is a way of doing something, especially the usual or correct way.

words.ex: He will assemble the toy for his son.
words.ex_cn: 他将为儿子组装玩具。
words.en: If people assemble or if someone assembles them, they come together in a group, usually for a particular purpose such as a meeting.

words.ex: He was punished for plagiarism in his essay.
words.ex_cn: 他因论文剽窃而受到惩罚。
words.en: Plagiarism is the practice of using or copying someone else's idea or work and pretending that you thought of it or created it.

words.tr:
v. 奔驰；飞奔
n. 奔驰；飞奔
words.ex: The horse gallops across the field.
words.ex_cn: 马在田野上疾驰。
words.en: If a horse gallops, it runs very fast so that all four legs are off the ground at the same time in each stride.

words.ex: He made a pledge to help the poor.
words.ex_cn: 他做出了帮助穷人的保证。
words.en: A pledge is a serious promise or agreement, especially one made publicly or officially. It can also refer to something given as security for the fulfillment of a contract or the payment of a debt.

words.ex: This medicine is effective against colds.
words.ex_cn: 这种药对感冒有效。
words.en: Something that is effective works well and produces the results that were intended.

words.ex: The plant needs nitrous fertilizer to grow well.
words.ex_cn: 这种植物需要含氮肥料才能良好生长。
words.en: Relating to or containing nitrogen, especially in a compound with a lower valency.

words.tr: adv. 在全球范围内（通常应为 in global terms，意为：从全球角度来看）
words.ex: In global terms, this problem affects many countries.
words.ex_cn: 从全球角度来看，这个问题影响了许多国家。

words.tr:
n. 术语；学期；期限；措辞；
v. 把…称作；把…叫做；
words.ex: The word 'algorithm' is a technical term in computer science.
words.ex_cn: ‘算法’是计算机科学中的一个术语。
words.en: A term is a word or expression used in relation to a particular subject, especially one that has a specific meaning, or a fixed period of time during which something lasts or is intended to happen.

words.ex: The heavy snow cumbered our progress.
words.ex_cn: 大雪阻碍了我们的前进。
words.en: To hinder or obstruct the movement or progress of someone or something.

words.tr: n. 被接受的做法；公认的惯例
words.ex: Wearing seat belts is an accepted practice in most countries.
words.ex_cn: 在大多数国家，系安全带是一种被接受的做法。

words.tr: n. 常规程序；标准流程
words.ex: The school has a regular procedure for handling absences.
words.ex_cn: 学校有一个处理缺勤的常规程序。

words.tr: phrase. 注册程序；登记手续
words.ex: The registration procedure takes only five minutes.
words.ex_cn: 注册程序只需要五分钟。

words.tr: phrase. 紧急程序；应急措施
words.ex: The pilot followed the emergency procedure during the landing.
words.ex_cn: 飞行员在着陆时遵循了紧急程序。
words.en: A set of actions to be taken in a specific situation, especially an emergency.

words.tr: v. 遵循被接受的程序
words.ex: You must follow the accepted procedure when applying for a visa.
words.ex_cn: 申请签证时，你必须遵循被接受的程序。

words.ex: The assembly of the car took three days.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的装配花了三天时间。
words.en: An assembly is a group of people gathered together for a particular purpose, such as a meeting or a legislative session. It can also refer to the process of fitting together the component parts of a machine or other object.

words.ex: The old system is cumbersome and slow.
words.ex_cn: 这个旧系统复杂而低效。
words.en: Something that is cumbersome is large and heavy and therefore difficult to carry, wear, or handle.

words.ex: He did not plagiarise the essay; he wrote it himself.
words.ex_cn: 他没有抄袭这篇文章；他是自己写的。
words.en: To plagiarise means to use someone else's ideas or work and pretend that it is your own.

words.tr: phrase. 以最快的速度，飞快地
words.ex: The horse ran at a gallop across the field.
words.ex_cn: 那匹马在田野上全速奔跑。
words.en: Moving at the fastest speed possible; very quickly.

words.ex: He fulfilled his pledge to help the poor.
words.ex_cn: 他履行了帮助穷人的承诺。

words.w: make a pledge to do sth
words.uk: meɪk ə pledʒ tə duː ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.us: meɪk ə pledʒ tə duː ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.ex: He made a pledge to study harder.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺要更加努力学习。

words.w: give a pledge to do sth
words.uk: ɡɪv ə pledʒ tu duː ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.us: ɡɪv ə plɛdʒ tu du ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.ex: He gave a pledge to do his homework every day.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺每天做作业。

words.tr:
n. 袭击；罢工；
v. 击打；侵袭；突然想到；
words.ex: The strike on the base happened at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 对基地的袭击发生在黎明时分。
words.en: To hit someone or something forcefully; to stop work as a form of protest.

words.tr: v. 击；袭击；打；“strike”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The hammer struck the nail.
words.ex_cn: 锤子击中了钉子。
words.en: If you strike someone or something, you deliberately hit them.

words.ex: The village was stricken by a sudden flood.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄遭受了一场突如其来的洪水。
words.en: If a person or place is stricken by something such as an unpleasant feeling, an illness, or a natural disaster, they are severely affected by it.

words.tr: n. 受干旱影响的农民
words.ex: Drought-stricken farmers lost their crops this year.
words.ex_cn: 受干旱影响的农民今年失去了他们的庄稼。

words.tr: phrase. 有效的措施；行之有效的办法
words.ex: The government took an effective measure to reduce pollution.
words.ex_cn: 政府采取了一项有效的措施来减少污染。
words.en: A practical and successful action or policy designed to achieve a specific goal.

words.tr: phrase. 有效的补救措施；有效的补救方法
words.ex: This medicine is an effective remedy for headaches.
words.ex_cn: 这种药是治疗头痛的有效方法。
words.en: An effective remedy is a solution or treatment that successfully solves a problem or cures a disease.

words.ex: The government will implement new rules next month.
words.ex_cn: 政府下个月将实施新规定。
words.en: To implement something means to ensure that what has been planned is done.

words.tr: adj. 无效果的；不起作用的；不奏效的；
words.ex: The medicine was ineffective against the cold.
words.ex_cn: 这种药对感冒无效。
words.en: If someone or something is ineffective, they do not achieve the intended result.

words.ex: The effectiveness of the new medicine was proven in trials.
words.ex_cn: 这种新药的有效性在试验中得到了证实。
words.en: The ability to produce a desired or intended result.

words.ex: She completed the task effectively.
words.ex_cn: 她有效地完成了任务。
words.en: In a way that produces the intended result or a successful outcome.

words.ex: I appreciate the beauty of nature.
words.ex_cn: 我欣赏大自然的美。
words.en: If you appreciate something, you recognize its value and feel grateful for it.

words.ex: He denies taking the money.
words.ex_cn: 他否认拿了钱。
words.en: To deny means to declare that something is not true, or to refuse to give or grant something.

words.ex: The two countries formed a union to strengthen trade.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家组成了一个联盟以加强贸易。
words.en: An organization of workers formed to protect their rights and interests; the act of joining two or more things together.

words.ex: He took responsibility for the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他承担了这个错误的责任。
words.en: If you have responsibility for something or someone, or if they are your responsibility, it is your job or duty to deal with them and to take decisions relating to them.

words.ex: He accepted liability for the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他承担了事故的责任。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is a liability, you mean that they cause a lot of problems or embarrassment.

words.ex: He conform to the rules of the school.
words.ex_cn: 他遵守学校的规章制度。
words.en: To conform means to behave in a way that is accepted by most people or to obey a rule, law, or custom.

words.ex: A pocket calculator is handy for math problems.
words.ex_cn: 便携式计算器对于数学问题很方便。
words.en: If something is handy, it is useful and easy to use or to reach.

words.ex: The teacher will notify the students about the test.
words.ex_cn: 老师会通知学生们关于考试的事。
words.en: If you notify someone of something, you officially inform them about it.

words.ex: Please inform me when the meeting starts.
words.ex_cn: 请在会议开始时通知我。
words.en: To inform someone means to tell them about something.

words.tr:
n. 广播节目；电视节目；
v. 广播；播送；
words.ex: I listened to the morning broadcast on the radio.
words.ex_cn: 我听了早上的广播节目。
words.en: To broadcast is to transmit (a program or some information) by radio or television.

words.ex: I appreciate reading books in the evening.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢在晚上读书。
words.en: To be grateful for or enjoy doing something.

words.ex: He showed appreciation for her hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他对她的辛勤工作表示欣赏。
words.en: Recognition of the quality, value, significance, or magnitude of people and things.

words.tr: adj. 感激的；欣赏的；表示赞赏的
words.ex: She was appreciative of his help.
words.ex_cn: 她对他的帮助心怀感激。
words.en: If you are appreciative of something, you are grateful for it.

words.tr: adj. 可觉察的；很可观的
words.ex: There is an appreciable difference in his grades.
words.ex_cn: 他的成绩有明显的差异。
words.en: If something is appreciable, it is large enough to be noticed or considered important.

words.tr: phrase. 克制自己；克制自己的欲望；自我克制
words.ex: He denies himself sweets to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他为了保持健康而不吃甜食。
words.en: To refuse to allow oneself to have or do something, especially something that one would like to have or do.

words.ex: He denied stealing the book.
words.ex_cn: 他否认偷了那本书。
words.en: To refuse to admit the truth or existence of something; to declare untrue.

words.ex: He denied a charge of stealing money.
words.ex_cn: 他否认了偷钱的指控。

words.tr: v. 主持；指挥；担任会议主席
words.ex: He presides over the meeting every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周一主持会议。
words.en: To preside means to be in charge of a formal meeting, ceremony, or other event.

words.tr: phrase. 欧洲联盟，简称欧盟，是由欧洲多国共同组成的区域性政治经济一体化组织
words.ex: The European Union helps countries trade easily.
words.ex_cn: 欧盟帮助各国轻松贸易。
words.en: The European Union (EU) is a political and economic union of 27 member states that are located primarily in Europe. The EU has developed an internal single market through a standardized system of laws that apply in all member states in those matters, and only those matters, where members have agreed to act as one.

words.ex: The labour union negotiated a new contract with the company.
words.ex_cn: 工会与公司谈判了一份新合同。
words.en: A labour union is an organization that represents the collective interests of workers, negotiating with employers on issues such as wages, working conditions, and benefits.

words.ex: He speculates that it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他推测明天会下雨。
words.en: If you speculate about something, you make guesses about its nature or identity, or about what might happen.

words.ex: I presume he will arrive tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我假设他明天会到。
words.en: If you presume that something is the case, you think that it is the case, although you are not certain.

words.ex: I assume it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我假定明天会下雨。
words.en: If you assume that something is true, you accept that it is true without proof.

words.ex: He will assume the responsibility for the project.
words.ex_cn: 他将承担这个项目的责任。
words.en: Take on the duty or obligation for something.

words.ex: He took on the responsibility of caring for his younger brother.
words.ex_cn: 他承担起了照顾弟弟的责任。

words.ex: He must perform his responsibility as a father.
words.ex_cn: 他必须履行作为父亲的责任。

words.ex: Children must obey their parents.
words.ex_cn: 孩子必须遵守父母的规定。
words.en: To obey means to do what you are told or expected to do according to a rule, law, or someone with authority over you.

words.ex: The dog follows its owner every day.
words.ex_cn: 狗每天跟随它的主人。
words.en: To go or come after (a person or thing proceeding ahead); move or travel behind.

words.ex: You must abide by the school rules.
words.ex_cn: 你必须遵守校规。
words.en: To accept or act in accordance with a rule, decision, or recommendation.

words.ex: You must comply with the rules.
words.ex_cn: 你必须遵守规则。
words.en: To act in accordance with a wish, command, or rule.

words.ex: He must conform to the school rules.
words.ex_cn: 他必须遵守校规。
words.en: To comply with rules, standards, or laws; to behave according to socially acceptable conventions or standards.

words.tr: n. 习俗；习惯；关税；海关；“custom”的复数；
words.ex: In this village, it is a custom to light lanterns during the festival.
words.ex_cn: 在这个村庄，节日里点灯笼是一种习俗。
words.en: The place at a port, airport, or border where officials check the goods or luggage of people entering or leaving a country, and where they collect taxes on goods being imported.

words.ex: In this village, it is a custom to light lanterns during the festival.
words.ex_cn: 在这个村庄，节日期间点灯笼是一种习俗。
words.en: A custom is an activity, a way of behaving, or an event which is usual or traditional in a particular society or in particular circumstances.

words.tr: v. 遵循习俗；顺应风俗
words.ex: He conforms to the customs of his village.
words.ex_cn: 他遵循自己村庄的习俗。

words.ex: He adapted to the new school quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快就适应了新学校。
words.en: To make suitable to or fit for a specific use or situation.

words.tr: adj. 壮观的；辉煌的；极好的；
words.ex: The sunset over the mountains was splendid.
words.ex_cn: 山上的日落非常壮观。
words.en: If you say that something is splendid, you mean that it is very good.

words.ex: He asked for the direction to the station.
words.ex_cn: 他问了去车站的方向。
words.en: A direction is the way that you have to travel to get from one place to another, or the way that something is moving or pointing.

words.ex: The computer will execute the program quickly.
words.ex_cn: 计算机将快速执行该程序。
words.en: To execute means to carry out or put into effect a plan, order, or course of action. It can also refer to the act of legally killing someone as a punishment.

words.tr:
v. 见证；
n. 证人；目击者；
words.ex: He witnessed the accident yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天目睹了那起事故。
words.en: A witness is someone who sees an event happen, especially a crime or an accident. Witnesses are often called upon to give evidence in court.

words.tr:
n. 肘部
v. 用肘推挤
words.ex: He hurt his elbow while playing basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他在打篮球时伤了肘部。
words.en: The joint between the forearm and the upper arm; to push someone with your elbow.

words.tr: adj. 有限的； v. 限制；“limit”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: We have limited time to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 我们完成这个项目的时间是有限的。
words.en: If something is limited, there is only a certain amount of it.

words.ex: The fishing vessel sailed out at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 那艘渔船在黎明时出海。
words.en: A vessel is a large boat or a container for holding liquids.

words.ex: He keeps his diary private.
words.ex_cn: 他把日记保密。
words.en: If something is private, it is for the use of one person or group, rather than for the general public.

words.tr:
n. 立体声；立体声音响
adj. 立体声的
words.ex: He plays music on the stereo.
words.ex_cn: 他通过立体声收音机播放音乐。
words.en: A stereo is a sound system that uses two or more separate microphones to record sound and two or more loudspeakers to play it back, so that you hear different parts of the sound coming from different directions.

words.tr:
n. 浸泡；
v. 吸收；
words.ex: The clothes went into a soak overnight.
words.ex_cn: 衣服泡了一整晚。
words.en: To soak something means to make it very wet by leaving it in a liquid, or to become very wet in this way. It can also mean to absorb or take in something.

words.tr: v. 使浸透；使湿透；使满；使饱和
words.ex: The sponge will saturate if you pour too much water.
words.ex_cn: 如果你倒太多水，海绵会吸满。
words.en: To saturate something means to make it completely wet, or to fill it completely with something so that no more can be added.

words.ex: The old tree has a stout trunk.
words.ex_cn: 这棵老树有一个粗壮的树干。
words.en: Someone who is stout is rather fat or heavy.

words.tr: adj. 强健的；强壮的；结实的；
words.ex: The dog is robust and runs every day.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗很强健，每天跑步。
words.en: Strong and healthy; vigorous. (of an object) sturdy in construction.

words.ex: The sunset over the mountains created a splendid scene.
words.ex_cn: 山上的日落创造了一幅壮丽的景色。

words.ex: The homeowner fixed the roof himself.
words.ex_cn: 房主自己修了屋顶。
words.en: A homeowner is a person who owns the house or apartment they live in.

words.tr:
n. 决策人；行政官；管理人员；
adj. 行政的；决策的；
words.ex: The executive decided to launch the new product.
words.ex_cn: 这位决策人决定推出新产品。
words.en: An executive is a person who has a senior management position in a business or other organization.

words.ex: He hit the ball with his forearm.
words.ex_cn: 他用前臂击中了球。
words.en: The part of the arm between the elbow and the wrist.

words.ex: The advent of smartphones changed how we communicate.
words.ex_cn: 智能手机的到来改变了我们的交流方式。
words.en: The arrival of a notable person, thing, or event.

words.tr: n. 个人立体声收音机；随身听
words.ex: He listens to music with his personal stereos on the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他在公交车上用个人立体声收音机听音乐。

words.ex: They shouted, 'Welcome home!' when he walked through the door.
words.ex_cn: 当他走进门时，他们大喊：‘欢迎回家！’
words.en: A greeting used to express pleasure at someone's return to their home.

words.ex: The sailors sailed on a stout ship through the storm.
words.ex_cn: 水手们乘坐一艘坚固的船穿越了风暴。

words.ex: The engine has four cylinders.
words.ex_cn: 发动机有四个气缸。
words.en: A cylinder is a geometric figure with straight parallel sides and a circular or oval cross section.

words.ex: The greasy pan needed a good wash.
words.ex_cn: 这个油污的平底锅需要好好洗一洗。
words.en: Something that is greasy has a lot of grease or oil on it or in it.

words.tr: v. 自夸；夸耀；自豪地拥有
words.ex: He boasts about his new car.
words.ex_cn: 他夸耀自己的新车。
words.en: If someone boasts about something that they have done or that they own, they talk about it very proudly, in a way that other people may find irritating or offensive.

words.tr:
adj. 迅速的；敏捷的；快的；
n. 雨燕；
words.ex: The swift runner won the race.
words.ex_cn: 这位迅速的跑步者赢得了比赛。
words.en: moving or capable of moving at great speed, or happening within a very short time; fast.

words.ex: Planting trees can mitigate air pollution.
words.ex_cn: 植树可以减轻空气污染。
words.en: To mitigate something means to make it less unpleasant, serious, or painful.

words.ex: Drugs can alleviate pain.
words.ex_cn: 药物可以减轻疼痛。
words.en: To make something less severe or intense.

words.tr: v. 使安静；安慰；使缓和
words.ex: She sang a song to soothe the baby.
words.ex_cn: 她唱了一首歌来安抚婴儿。
words.en: To soothe someone means to make them feel calmer and less anxious, upset, or angry.

words.ex: His ignorance of the rules caused the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他对规则的无知导致了这个错误。
words.en: Lack of knowledge or information.

words.ex: The painting has a simple aesthetic appeal.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画有一种简单的审美吸引力。
words.en: Concerned with beauty or the appreciation of beauty.

words.tr:
n. 屏幕；屏风；掩蔽物；
v. 筛查；掩蔽；
words.ex: The movie is playing on the screen.
words.ex_cn: 电影正在屏幕上播放。
words.en: A screen is a flat surface on which pictures or words are shown, such as the one on a television or computer. It can also refer to a partition used to divide or protect an area. As a verb, to screen means to examine something in order to decide whether it is suitable for a particular purpose, or to protect someone or something from something harmful or unpleasant.

words.ex: He was absent from school yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天缺席了学校。
words.en: If someone or something is absent from a place or situation where they should be or where they usually are, they are not there.

words.tr:
v. 刮；擦；刮出刺耳声；勉强通过
n. 刮；擦；擦痕；刮擦声
words.ex: He scraped his knee on the rough ground.
words.ex_cn: 他在粗糙的地面上擦伤了膝盖。
words.en: To remove something from a surface using a sharp or rough edge, or to injure a part of the body by rubbing it against a rough surface.

words.ex: The new policy is for the promotion of clean energy.
words.ex_cn: 这项新政策是为了促进清洁能源。
words.en: A promotion is a move to a more important job or rank in a company or organization.

words.tr: phrase. 对……的无知；对……的不了解
words.ex: He showed ignorance about basic math.
words.ex_cn: 他对基础数学一无所知。
words.en: Lack of knowledge or information about a subject.

words.tr: adj. 实用的；功利主义的；
words.ex: The chair is utilitarian and comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子实用又舒适。
words.en: Utilitarian means relating to or adhering to the belief that the value of a thing or an action is determined by its utility.

words.ex: He posted an anonymous comment online.
words.ex_cn: 他在网上发布了一条匿名评论。
words.en: If you remain anonymous when you do something, you do not let people know that you were the person who did it.

words.tr: n. 审美对象；具有艺术美感的物体
words.ex: The museum displays many aesthetic objects from ancient times.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆展出了许多来自古代的审美对象。

words.ex: The team was unanimous in choosing the new leader.
words.ex_cn: 团队在选择新领导时意见完全一致。
words.en: When a group of people are unanimous, they all agree about something or all vote for the same thing.

words.ex: Their answers were concordant.
words.ex_cn: 他们的答案是一致的。
words.en: If two things are concordant, they are in agreement or harmony with each other.

words.tr: adj. 不调和的；不一致的；不和谐的
words.ex: The two voices sounded discordant.
words.ex_cn: 这两声音听起来不和谐。
words.en: Something that is discordant is strange or unpleasant because it does not fit in with other things.

words.ex: He asked for her consent before starting the project.
words.ex_cn: 他在开始这个项目之前征求了她的同意。
words.en: Consent is permission for something to happen or agreement to do something.

words.ex: The team reached a consensus on the project plan.
words.ex_cn: 团队就项目计划达成了共识。
words.en: A consensus is general agreement among a group of people.

words.tr:
n. 规模；等级；比例（尺）；刻度；秤；
v. 改变…大小；
words.ex: The scale of the project surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目的规模让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: A scale is a set of levels or numbers which are used in a particular system of measuring things or are used when comparing things.

words.tr:
n. 小块；碎片；废金属；吵架
v. 废弃；取消
adj. 废弃的
words.ex: He picked up a scrap of paper from the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他从地上捡起一张纸片。
words.en: A scrap is a small piece or amount of something, especially one that is left over after the greater part has been used. It can also mean to discard or get rid of something as being no longer useful or necessary.

words.tr: n. 娱乐；消遣；休闲活动
words.ex: Reading books is his favorite recreation.
words.ex_cn: 读书是他最喜欢的消遣。
words.en: Recreation is activity that you do for enjoyment or amusement when you are not working.

words.ex: He specialises in repairing old clocks.
words.ex_cn: 他专用于修理老式钟表。
words.en: To concentrate on and become expert in a particular subject or skill.

words.ex: The sunset over the mountains was magnificent.
words.ex_cn: 山上的日落壮丽极了。
words.en: If you say that something or someone is magnificent, you mean that you think they are extremely good, beautiful, or impressive.

words.tr: adj. 痉挛的；间歇的；一阵阵的
words.ex: He had spasmodic coughing at night.
words.ex_cn: 他晚上有阵发性的咳嗽。
words.en: Something that is spasmodic happens suddenly and irregularly, often in short periods of time.

words.tr:
n. 基金；资金；
v. 提供资金；
words.ex: The school raised a fund for new books.
words.ex_cn: 学校为购买新书筹集了一笔基金。
words.en: A sum of money saved or made available for a particular purpose.

words.ex: I perceive a change in his mood.
words.ex_cn: 我察觉到他的情绪有变化。
words.en: If you perceive something, you see, notice, or realize it, especially when it is not obvious.

words.ex: We waited in the lounge before our flight.
words.ex_cn: 我们在登机前等在休息室里。
words.en: A lounge is a room in a house or public building where people can sit and relax. As a verb, to lounge means to lie, sit, or stand in a relaxed or lazy way.

words.ex: They stayed in a small lodge near the forest.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在森林附近的一座小屋里。
words.en: A lodge is a small house in the country, especially one that is used by people on holiday or by people taking part in a sport such as skiing or hunting. As a verb, to lodge means to stay somewhere, especially temporarily, or to formally submit something, such as a complaint or an application.

words.ex: The family had a picnic in the recreation area.
words.ex_cn: 这家人在娱乐区野餐。

words.tr: n. 户外娱乐；露天休闲活动
words.ex: Families enjoy open-air recreation in the park on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 家庭在周末喜欢在公园里进行户外娱乐。

words.tr: phrase. 户外休闲；户外运动；野外娱乐活动
words.ex: They enjoy outdoor recreation like hiking and camping.
words.ex_cn: 他们喜欢户外休闲活动，比如徒步和露营。
words.en: Leisure activities performed in natural environments, such as hiking, cycling, or camping.

words.ex: He enjoys recreational activities like swimming and hiking.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢游泳和徒步等娱乐活动。
words.en: Relating to or denoting activity done for enjoyment when one is not working.

words.ex: The movie recreates the battle of Waterloo.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影再现了滑铁卢战役。
words.en: To recreate something means to make it exist or happen again, or to make a copy of something that existed in the past.

words.tr: n. 专用设备；专门装备
words.ex: The hospital uses specialised equipment for heart surgery.
words.ex_cn: 这家医院使用专用设备进行心脏手术。

words.ex: His specialisation is in computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他的专门化领域是计算机科学。
words.en: the process of becoming specialized or the state of being specialized; a particular area of study or work that someone focuses on.

words.ex: The microscope can magnify small objects.
words.ex_cn: 显微镜可以放大微小的物体。
words.en: To magnify something means to make it appear larger than it is, especially by using a lens or microscope. It can also mean to exaggerate or make something seem more important or serious than it really is.

words.ex: The speaker will amplify the sound for everyone to hear.
words.ex_cn: 扬声器会放大声音，让每个人都能听到。
words.en: To amplify something means to make it louder, stronger, or more detailed.

words.ex: His performance in the game was excellent.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中的表现非常出色。
words.en: The act of performing a play, concert, or some other form of entertainment.

words.ex: The fireworks burned magnificently in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 烟花在夜空中绚丽地燃放。
words.en: In a manner that is extremely beautiful, elaborate, or impressive.

words.ex: The magnificence of the palace amazed everyone.
words.ex_cn: 宫殿的壮丽让每个人都很惊讶。
words.en: If you say that something or someone is magnificent, you mean that you think they are extremely good, beautiful, or impressive.

words.tr: phrase. 肌肉痉挛；肌肉抽搐
words.ex: He experienced a muscle spasm in his back after lifting heavy weights.
words.ex_cn: 他在举重后背部出现了肌肉痉挛。
words.en: A muscle spasm is a sudden, involuntary contraction of a muscle or group of muscles, often causing pain and temporary immobility.

words.ex: The car made a lateral move to avoid the dog.
words.ex_cn: 汽车横向移动以避开狗。
words.en: Relating to the side or sides; situated at or extending to the side.

words.tr: adj. 多边的；多国参加的
words.ex: The multilateral agreement helped many countries work together.
words.ex_cn: 这个多边协议帮助许多国家共同合作。
words.en: Involving or agreed upon by three or more parties, especially the governments of different countries.

words.tr: phrase. 筹集资金；筹措款项
words.ex: They raise funds for the school trip.
words.ex_cn: 他们为学校旅行筹款。
words.en: To raise funds means to collect money for a specific purpose, often for a project, charity, or organization.

words.tr: n. 额外资金；追加资金
words.ex: The school asked for additional fund to buy new books.
words.ex_cn: 学校请求额外资金来购买新书。

words.tr: n. 额外资金；备用资金
words.ex: The school got extra fund to buy new books.
words.ex_cn: 学校获得了额外资金来购买新书。

words.tr: phrase. 共有基金；互助资金；共同资金
words.ex: Investing in mutual funds can diversify your portfolio.
words.ex_cn: 投资于共同基金可以分散你的投资组合。
words.en: A mutual fund is an investment vehicle made up of a pool of funds collected from many investors for the purpose of investing in securities such as stocks, bonds, money market instruments and other assets.

words.ex: They have a reciprocal agreement to help each other.
words.ex_cn: 他们有一个互相帮助的互惠协议。
words.en: A reciprocal action or agreement involves two people or groups who do the same thing to each other or agree to help each other in a similar way.

words.ex: They have mutual respect for each other.
words.ex_cn: 他们彼此相互尊重。
words.en: Mutual is used to describe a situation, feeling, or action that is experienced, felt, or done by each of two or more parties towards the other or others.

words.ex: I can detect a change in her mood.
words.ex_cn: 我能察觉到她情绪的变化。
words.en: To detect something means to find it or discover it, often using special equipment or methods.

words.ex: He cannot comprehend the simple math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他无法理解这个简单的数学问题。
words.en: To comprehend something means to understand it fully.

words.ex: The manufacturer makes cars in this factory.
words.ex_cn: 这家制造商在这家工厂生产汽车。
words.en: A manufacturer is a person or company that produces goods in large quantities, especially in a factory.

words.ex: The engineer checked the specification for the machine.
words.ex_cn: 工程师检查了机器的规格。
words.en: A specification is a detailed description of the design and materials used to make something.

words.ex: I checked the class schedule for tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我查看了明天的课程时间表。
words.en: A schedule is a plan that gives a list of events or tasks and the times at which each one should happen or be done.

words.ex: We made an arrangement to meet at 6 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 我们安排好晚上六点见面。
words.en: An arrangement is a plan or preparation which you make so that something can happen.

words.tr: n. 毁灭；引起毁灭的根源；
words.ex: The storm caused the destruction of the village.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴摧毁了村庄。
words.en: The act of destroying something, or the state of being destroyed.

words.ex: He picked up the fire extinguisher to put out the flames.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起灭火器来扑灭火焰。
words.en: An extinguisher is a device that is used to put out fires.

words.ex: I assume it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我假定明天会下雨。
words.en: If you assume that something is true, you accept that it is true without proof.

words.ex: I presume he will arrive tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我假设他明天会到。
words.en: If you presume that something is the case, you think that it is the case, although you are not certain.

words.ex: He speculates that it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他推测明天会下雨。
words.en: If you speculate about something, you make guesses about its nature or identity, or about what might happen.

words.ex: The proportion of students who passed the test was high.
words.ex_cn: 通过考试的学生比例很高。
words.en: A proportion is a part of a whole, or the relationship of one part to another in terms of size, amount, or degree.

words.ex: The sentence has a clause that explains why he left.
words.ex_cn: 这个句子有一个解释他为什么离开的从句。
words.en: A clause is a particular section of a legal document such as a contract, will, or treaty, that contains a condition or stipulation.

words.ex: The ship carries a provision of food for the journey.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船为旅程准备了食物供应。
words.en: A provision is a condition or requirement in a legal document. It can also refer to the act of supplying or providing something that is needed.

words.tr: n. 微波炉的技术规格；微波炉的详细参数
words.ex: The specification of a microwave includes power level and timer settings.
words.ex_cn: 微波炉的技术规格包括功率级别和定时设置。

words.ex: The teacher gave clear instruction on how to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 老师给出了如何解决这个问题的明确教授。
words.en: Detailed information telling how something should be done, operated, or assembled.

words.ex: He finished the project ahead of schedule.
words.ex_cn: 他提前完成了项目。
words.en: If something is done ahead of schedule, it is done before the time that was planned.

words.ex: The train schedule shows when the train leaves.
words.ex_cn: 列车时刻表显示火车何时发车。
words.en: A published list of times when trains depart from and arrive at stations along a route.

words.tr: phrase. 航班时刻表；飞行时间安排
words.ex: He checked the flight schedule for tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他查看了明天的航班时刻表。
words.en: A flight schedule is a list of planned flights, including the times of departure and arrival, the flight numbers, and the destinations.

words.ex: The train arrived on schedule.
words.ex_cn: 火车准时到达。
words.en: If something happens on schedule, it happens at the time that was planned.

words.tr: phrase. 落后于计划；误点；拖延的
words.ex: The train is behind schedule.
words.ex_cn: 火车晚点了。
words.en: If someone or something is behind schedule, they are not progressing as quickly as planned or expected.

words.tr: v. 被安排做某事；被预定用于某事

words.ex: The school changed the course arrangement for next semester.
words.ex_cn: 学校更改了下学期的课程安排。
words.en: The organization and scheduling of courses within an educational program.

words.ex: The teacher changed the seat arrangement for the test.
words.ex_cn: 老师为了考试改变了座位安排。
words.en: The organization or placement of seats in a particular order or pattern for an event or gathering.

words.tr:
n. 实验；试验；
v. 做试验；进行实验；
words.ex: The boy did a science experiment in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩在课堂上做了一个科学实验。
words.en: An experiment is a scientific procedure undertaken to make a discovery, test a hypothesis, or demonstrate a known fact.

words.ex: The storm destroyed the old bridge.
words.ex_cn: 风暴摧毁了那座旧桥。
words.en: To destroy something means to cause so much damage to it that it is completely ruined or does not exist any more.

words.ex: They will demolish the old building next week.
words.ex_cn: 他们下周会拆掉那座旧建筑。
words.en: To demolish something such as a building means to destroy it completely. It can also mean to defeat someone completely in a discussion, argument, or competition.

words.ex: The earthquake devastated the small town.
words.ex_cn: 地震摧毁了这个小镇。
words.en: To devastate means to destroy or ruin something completely, or to cause someone to feel extreme sadness or shock.

words.ex: The noise will diminish after midnight.
words.ex_cn: 午夜后噪音会减少。
words.en: If something diminishes, or if something diminishes it, it becomes reduced in size, importance, or intensity.

words.tr: v. 降低规模或档次；adj. 低档次的
words.ex: The company decided to downscale its operations to save money.
words.ex_cn: 公司决定缩减业务规模以节省资金。
words.en: To reduce in size, extent, or scope; to make something less elaborate or less expensive.

words.tr: phrase. 环境破坏；生态环境的毁坏
words.ex: The factory caused environmental destruction.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂造成了环境破坏。
words.en: Environmental destruction refers to the deterioration of the environment through depletion of resources such as air, water and soil; the destruction of ecosystems; habitat destruction; the extinction of wildlife; and pollution.

words.ex: The indigenous people live in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 本土居民住在森林里。
words.en: Indigenous people or things belong to the country in which they are found, rather than coming there or being brought there from another country.

words.ex: He bought fresh vegetables from the local market.
words.ex_cn: 他从本地市场买了新鲜蔬菜。
words.en: Something that is local relates to a particular area or to the area where you live.

words.tr: adj. 家庭的；国内的；驯养的；
words.ex: She prefers domestic chores over going out.
words.ex_cn: 她更喜欢做家务而不是外出。
words.en: Domestic means relating to the home, family, or household affairs. It can also refer to something that is made or produced within a country and not imported.

words.tr:
n. 废墟；
v. 破坏；
words.ex: The old temple is now a ruin.
words.ex_cn: 这座古老的寺庙现在已成为废墟。
words.en: Ruin means the physical destruction or disintegration of something or the state of disintegrating or being destroyed.

words.ex: The establishment of the school took five years.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校的建立花了五年时间。
words.en: The act of establishing something or the state of being established. It can also refer to an organization or institution, especially a business or public body.

words.ex: The construction of the new bridge took two years.
words.ex_cn: 新桥的建筑花了两年时间。
words.en: The process or method of building or making something, especially buildings, bridges, etc.

words.ex: He extinguished the fire with water.
words.ex_cn: 他用水把火扑灭了。
words.en: To extinguish a fire or a light means to stop it burning or shining.

words.tr: adj. 灭绝的；熄灭的；绝种的；
words.ex: The dodo is an extinct bird.
words.ex_cn: 渡渡鸟是一种灭绝的鸟。
words.en: If a species of animals or plants is extinct, it no longer has any living members, either in the world or in a particular place.

words.ex: He assumes an obligation to pay back the loan.
words.ex_cn: 他承担了偿还贷款的义务。
words.en: To take on a duty or promise.

words.ex: He must assume responsibility for his mistakes.
words.ex_cn: 他必须为自己的错误负责。
words.en: To take on a duty or task as one's own.

words.ex: He walked forth to meet the sun.
words.ex_cn: 他向前走去迎接太阳。
words.en: Forward in time, place, or order; onward.

words.tr: n. 裁判；介绍人；仲裁者
words.ex: The referee blew the whistle for a foul.
words.ex_cn: 裁判吹哨判罚犯规。
words.en: A referee is an official who watches a game or match closely to ensure that the rules are adhered to and sometimes to arbitrate on matters arising from the play.

words.ex: He will forgo dessert to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 为了保持健康，他将放弃甜点。
words.en: If you forgo something, you decide to do without it, even though you would like it.

words.tr: n. （大学）研究生助教奖学金
words.ex: He got an assistantship to help with research.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了一份助教职位来协助研究。
words.en: An assistantship is a position of a graduate student that involves teaching or research duties in exchange for financial support.

words.ex: We had a short conversation about the weather.
words.ex_cn: 我们简短地聊了聊天气。
words.en: A conversation is a talk between two or more people, in which news and ideas are exchanged.

words.ex: The teacher gave me a recommendation for the scholarship.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我写了一封奖学金推荐信。
words.en: A suggestion or proposal as to the best course of action, especially one put forward by an authoritative body.

words.ex: The rain offset the heat yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 昨天的雨抵消了炎热。
words.en: If one thing is offset by another, the effect of the first thing is reduced by the second, so that any advantage or disadvantage is cancelled out.

words.ex: He takes a siesta after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午饭后小睡一会儿。
words.en: A siesta is a short sleep or rest which you have in the early afternoon, especially in hot countries.

words.ex: The cost is in proportion to the size of the room.
words.ex_cn: 费用与房间的大小成正比。
words.en: If one thing changes or is done in proportion to another, it changes or is done according to how much the other thing changes or is done.

words.tr: adj. 与某物不成比例的；不相称的
words.ex: The punishment was out of proportion to the crime.
words.ex_cn: 这个惩罚与罪行不成比例。
words.en: Excessively or unfairly compared to something else; disproportionate.

words.tr: n. 某物的比例；某物的份额
words.ex: The proportion of water in this fruit is high.
words.ex_cn: 这种水果中水的比例很高。

words.ex: Children take a small proportion of the population in this village.
words.ex_cn: 儿童在这个村庄的人口中占较小比例。

words.tr: phrase. v. 引起；唤起；使出现
words.ex: The story can call forth strong feelings in people.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事能唤起人们的强烈情感。
words.en: To cause something to happen or to evoke a particular reaction or response.

words.tr: phrase. 提出；产生；生出；使显现
words.ex: He brought forth a new idea in the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上提出了一个新想法。
words.en: To bring forth means to produce or cause something to happen or exist.

words.tr: phrase. 阐明；提出；陈列；出发；把…提前
words.ex: He set forth his ideas clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他清楚地提出了自己的想法。
words.en: To present or introduce something, such as an idea, plan, or argument, in a clear and detailed way.

words.ex: He bought apples, bananas, and so forth.
words.ex_cn: 他买了苹果、香蕉等等。
words.en: Used at the end of a list to indicate that there are other items that could be mentioned.

words.ex: He moves back and forth between two chairs.
words.ex_cn: 他在两把椅子之间来回移动。
words.en: Moving in one direction and then in the opposite direction repeatedly.

words.ex: From this day forth, I will wake up early.
words.ex_cn: 从今以后，我会早起。

words.tr: adv. 从今天起；从今以后
words.ex: From this day on, I will wake up early.
words.ex_cn: 从今天起，我会早起。

words.tr: adv. 从今天起；从今以后
words.ex: From this day onwards, I will wake up early.
words.ex_cn: 从今天起，我会早起。

words.ex: The refugee walked to a new country.
words.ex_cn: 这名难民步行去了一个新国家。
words.en: A refugee is a person who has been forced to leave their country in order to escape war, persecution, or natural disaster.

words.ex: The ship carries a large cargo of rice.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船运载了大量大米货物。
words.en: Cargo refers to the goods carried by a ship, aircraft, or other large vehicle.

words.ex: The freight train carried boxes to the city.
words.ex_cn: 货运列车把箱子运到了城市。
words.en: Freight refers to goods transported in bulk by truck, train, ship, or aircraft. It can also mean the charge for such transportation.

words.ex: His converse was the opposite of what he said earlier.
words.ex_cn: 他的相反言论与他之前说的话相反。
words.en: To engage in conversation; to talk informally with someone.

words.tr:
n. 反面；
v. 使倒转；（使）倒车；撤销；
words.ex: The reverse of the coin has a picture of a tree.
words.ex_cn: 硬币的反面有一棵树的图案。
words.en: If you reverse the order of a set of things, you arrange them in the opposite order, so that the first thing comes last.

words.ex: He speaks in a conversational tone with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他和朋友说话时用会话式的语调。
words.en: Relating to or in the style of a conversation; informal and friendly.

words.ex: He asked his teacher for a letter of recommendation.
words.ex_cn: 他请老师写一封推荐信。
words.en: A letter of recommendation is a letter in which the writer describes the qualities, skills, and achievements of a person they know well, with the purpose of supporting that person's application for a job, admission to a school, or other opportunities.

words.ex: I took the job on my friend's recommendation.
words.ex_cn: 我根据朋友的建议接受了这份工作。

words.ex: Wear a helmet to counteract the risk of head injury.
words.ex_cn: 戴头盔以对抗头部受伤的风险。
words.en: If you counteract something, you reduce its effect by doing something that produces an opposite effect.

words.tr:
n. 柜台；
v. 抵消；反驳；
adv. 相反地；
words.ex: The customer paid at the counter.
words.ex_cn: 顾客在柜台付款。
words.en: A counter is a long flat surface in a shop or bank on which customers are served. It can also refer to a device that counts something, or an action taken to oppose something.

words.tr:
v. 抵消；使平衡
n. 衡重体；平衡力
words.ex: The weight acts as a counterbalance to the arm.
words.ex_cn: 这个重量作为手臂的平衡物。
words.en: A counterbalance is a weight or force that balances or counteracts another.

words.tr: n. 人性；人类；人道；仁慈；
words.ex: Kindness shows the best of humanity.
words.ex_cn: 善良展现了人性中最美好的一面。
words.en: Humanity refers to all human beings collectively or the qualities that make us human, such as kindness, compassion, and the ability to reason.

words.ex: The vase remained intact after the fall.
words.ex_cn: 花瓶从高处摔下后依然完整无缺。
words.en: Something that is intact is complete and has not been damaged or changed.

words.ex: The tiger has black stripes on its orange fur.
words.ex_cn: 老虎的橙色皮毛上有黑色条纹。
words.en: A stripe is a long, narrow band or strip differing in color or texture from the surface on either side of it.

words.ex: The mechanical toy moves with batteries.
words.ex_cn: 这个机械玩具用电池驱动。
words.en: Relating to machines or machinery; operated by or involving a machine or machines.

words.ex: The car stopped at the junction.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在交叉路口停了下来。
words.en: A junction is a place where two or more things, especially roads or railways, come together.

words.ex: We took a detour to avoid the traffic.
words.ex_cn: 我们绕道以避开交通拥堵。
words.en: A detour is a longer, less direct way to go somewhere, used to avoid a problem or to visit something along the way.

words.ex: He has arthritis in his hands.
words.ex_cn: 他双手有关节炎。
words.en: Arthritis is a medical condition in which the joints in someone's body are swollen and painful.

words.ex: The judge made a fair decision to show justice.
words.ex_cn: 法官做出了公正的裁决以体现公正。
words.en: Justice is fairness in the way that people are treated.

words.tr: adj. 人道主义的；慈善的；
words.ex: The humanitarian aid helped the hungry children.
words.ex_cn: 人道主义援助帮助了饥饿的孩子们。
words.en: A humanitarian is someone who is involved in or connected with improving people's lives and reducing suffering.

words.ex: Humankind needs to protect the Earth.
words.ex_cn: 人类需要保护地球。
words.en: Humankind refers to all human beings collectively; the human race.

words.tr:
n. 声音；声响；
v. 听起来；
adj. 健全的；合理的；可靠的；
words.ex: I heard a strange sound at night.
words.ex_cn: 我半夜听到了一个奇怪的声音。
words.en: Sound is a vibration that propagates as an acoustic wave, through a transmission medium such as a gas, liquid or solid. In human physiology and psychology, sound is the reception of such waves and their perception by the brain.

words.ex: Eating wholesome food helps you stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 吃有益身心的食物有助于保持健康。
words.en: Conducive to or suggestive of good health and physical well-being.

words.ex: The book has a compact design.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的设计很紧凑。
words.en: A compact object or substance is small and dense, with all its parts closely packed together.

words.tr: adj. 未损坏的；完好无损
words.ex: The box was undamaged after the delivery.
words.ex_cn: 包裹送达后完好无损。
words.en: Not harmed or damaged; intact.

words.tr: v. 使粉碎；使破碎；使破灭；“shatter”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The stone shattered when it hit the ground.
words.ex_cn: 石头撞到地面时碎裂了。
words.en: If something is shattered, it is broken into many small pieces, or it is extremely tired or shocked.

words.tr: adj. 破损的；弄坏的； v. 打破；打断；“break”的过去分词；
words.ex: The broken cup lay on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 破了的杯子躺在地板上。
words.en: Damaged or shattered into pieces, typically as a result of force or impact.

words.tr: n. 机械劳动；机械化劳作
words.ex: He does mechanical labour in a factory.
words.ex_cn: 他在工厂里从事体力劳动。
words.en: Work that is repetitive, unskilled, and requires little mental effort or creativity.

words.ex: The mechanic fixed my car quickly.
words.ex_cn: 机修工很快修好了我的车。
words.en: A mechanic is a person whose job is to repair and maintain machines and engines, especially those of vehicles.

words.tr: adj. 未分离的；未脱离的
words.ex: The two parts remain undetached during the experiment.
words.ex_cn: 在实验过程中，这两部分保持未分离。

words.ex: He has an autoimmune disease that affects his skin.
words.ex_cn: 他患有一种影响皮肤的自身免疫性疾病。
words.en: An autoimmune disease or condition is one in which your immune system mistakenly attacks your own body.

words.tr: phrase. 类风湿性关节炎；一种慢性自身免疫性疾病，主要影响关节，导致疼痛、肿胀和功能障碍
words.ex: He has rheumatoid arthritis in his hands.
words.ex_cn: 他的双手患有类风湿性关节炎。
words.en: A chronic progressive disease causing inflammation in the joints and resulting in painful deformity and immobility, especially in the fingers, wrists, feet, and ankles.

words.ex: Lupus is an autoimmune disease that affects the skin and joints.
words.ex_cn: 系统性红斑狼疮是一种影响皮肤和关节的自身免疫疾病。

words.w: Where might is master justice is servant
words.tr: 当强权是主人时，正义只是仆人；意指权力凌驾于公正之上
words.uk: weə maɪt ɪz ˈmɑːstə ˈdʒʌstɪs ɪz ˈsɜːvənt
words.us: wer maɪt ɪz ˈmæstər ˈdʒʌstɪs ɪz ˈsɜːrvənt
words.ex: Where might is master, justice is servant.
words.ex_cn: 当强权是主人时，正义只是仆人。

words.tr: v. 可能；也许；“may”的过去式； n. 强大力量；
words.ex: He might come to the party tonight.
words.ex_cn: 他今晚可能会来参加派对。
words.en: Might is used to indicate that something is possible or might happen, or to ask for permission in a polite way.

words.ex: The fence is a barrier to animals.
words.ex_cn: 这道围栏是动物的障碍。
words.en: A barrier is something such as a rule, law, or policy that makes it difficult or impossible for something to happen or be achieved.

words.ex: He will replace the broken chair.
words.ex_cn: 他将代替这把坏掉的椅子。
words.en: If one thing or person replaces another, the first is used or acts instead of the second.

words.tr: n. 毕业文凭；学位证书；
words.ex: He received his diploma last June.
words.ex_cn: 他去年六月拿到了毕业文凭。
words.en: A diploma is a document which may be awarded by a university or college, or by a high school, showing that someone has successfully completed a course of study.

words.ex: The cosmic rays come from outer space.
words.ex_cn: 宇宙射线来自外太空。
words.en: Relating to the universe or cosmos, especially as distinct from the earth.

words.tr: adj. 宇宙的；广大无边的
words.ex: The cosmical view from the space station was breathtaking.
words.ex_cn: 从空间站看到的宇宙景象令人叹为观止。
words.en: Relating to the universe or cosmos, especially as distinct from the earth.

words.ex: He loves to watch the cosmos at night.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在夜晚观看宇宙。
words.en: The cosmos refers to the universe seen as a well-ordered whole, or to any system or structure that is complex and orderly.

words.tr: adj. 可展开的；可延伸的；可延展的；
words.ex: This table is extendable, so it can fit more people.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是可展开的，因此可以容纳更多人。
words.en: Capable of being extended or stretched out.

words.ex: There is an abundance of food at the party.
words.ex_cn: 聚会上食物非常丰富。
words.en: A very large quantity of something.

words.ex: The supervisor checked the workers' progress.
words.ex_cn: 主管检查了工人们的进展。
words.en: A supervisor is a person who oversees and directs the work of others.

words.tr:
v. 使混乱；使杂乱
n. 杂乱；混乱
words.ex: He jumbled the letters and could not read the word.
words.ex_cn: 他把字母弄乱了，无法认出这个单词。
words.en: To mix things together in a confused or untidy way.

words.ex: The magic show amazed the children.
words.ex_cn: 魔术表演让孩子们感到惊奇。
words.en: To amaze someone means to surprise them very much.

words.ex: The heavy snow cumbered our progress.
words.ex_cn: 大雪阻碍了我们的前进。
words.en: To hinder or obstruct the movement or progress of someone or something.

words.tr: adj. 完全的；荒凉的；光秃秃的；僵硬的；严厉的
words.ex: There was a stark difference between the two results.
words.ex_cn: 这两个结果之间有完全的差异。
words.en: Stark means complete, severe, or obvious in a way that is impossible to avoid noticing.

words.ex: He cannot talk to the doctor because of the language barrier.
words.ex_cn: 由于语言障碍，他无法和医生交流。
words.en: A language barrier is a figurative phrase used primarily to refer to linguistic barriers to communication, i.e., the difficulties in communication experienced by people or groups originally speaking different languages, or even dialects in some cases.

words.ex: The country removed the trade barrier to help imports.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家取消了贸易壁垒以促进进口。
words.en: A trade barrier is a government-imposed restriction on the free international exchange of goods or services.

words.tr: v. 以鲜明简洁的方式展现自己
words.ex: He presented himself in stark form during the interview.
words.ex_cn: 他在面试中以鲜明简洁的方式展现自己。

words.ex: The teacher bought a replacement for the broken chair.
words.ex_cn: 老师买了一把新椅子来替换坏掉的椅子。
words.en: The act of replacing something or someone, or the thing or person that replaces them.

words.ex: The telescope saw cosmic dust in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 望远镜在夜空中看到了宇宙尘埃。
words.en: Cosmic dust consists of small particles in space, which are remnants from the formation of the solar system and other cosmic events.

words.ex: The extendable rod can be pulled to make it longer.
words.ex_cn: 这根可伸缩的杆可以拉长。

words.tr: n. 可伸缩的手臂；可延伸的手部装置
words.ex: The robot has an extendable hand to reach high shelves.
words.ex_cn: 这个机器人有一个可伸缩的手臂，可以够到高处的架子。

words.tr:
n. 纽带；联系；债券；保释金；协定
v. （使）黏合；相互联结
words.ex: Family is the bond that keeps us together.
words.ex_cn: 家庭是我们团结的纽带。
words.en: A bond between people is a strong feeling of friendship, love, or shared beliefs and experiences that unites them.

words.tr: n. 可延长的债券；可展期债券
words.ex: The company issued an extendable bond that can be extended for five more years.
words.ex_cn: 该公司发行了一种可延长五年期限的债券。

words.tr: phrase. 可赎回债券；可召回债券（发行人有权在到期前按约定价格购回的债券）
words.ex: The company issued a callable bond to raise money.
words.ex_cn: 该公司发行了一种可赎回债券来筹集资金。
words.en: A callable bond is a type of bond that allows the issuer to redeem the bond before its maturity date, typically at a premium.

words.ex: There is ample food for everyone.
words.ex_cn: 每个人都有足够的食物。
words.en: If there is an ample amount of something, there is enough of it and usually some extra.

words.tr: adj. 大量的；不吝惜的；浪费的
words.ex: He was profuse in thanks after the rescue.
words.ex_cn: 获救后，他表达了深深的感谢。
words.en: If you describe something as profuse, you mean that it is very plentiful or abundant.

words.ex: The affluent family bought a big house by the lake.
words.ex_cn: 这个富裕的家庭在湖边买了一栋大房子。
words.en: Having a great deal of money; wealthy.

words.ex: The palace had opulent carpets and golden chandeliers.
words.ex_cn: 宫殿里有华丽的地毯和金色的吊灯。
words.en: Having or displaying great wealth or richness.

words.tr: n. 大量；丰富；慷慨；浪费
words.ex: There is a profusion of flowers in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 花园里有大量花朵。
words.en: If there is a profusion of something or it occurs in profusion, there is a very large quantity or variety of it.

words.ex: His family's affluence allowed him to travel the world.
words.ex_cn: 他家的富裕让他能环游世界。
words.en: Affluence is the state of having a lot of money or owning many things.

words.tr: adj. 不足的；欠缺的；微小的；
words.ex: There is scant evidence to support the claim.
words.ex_cn: 支持这一说法的证据不足。
words.en: If you describe something as scant, you mean that there is not enough of it or that it is not as much as it should be.

words.tr: adj. 欠缺的；过小的；少量的
words.ex: He had scanty food for the whole day.
words.ex_cn: 他一整天的食物很少。
words.en: If something is scanty, there is not enough of it or it is too small in amount.

words.tr: adj. 缺乏的；不足的；稀有的；
words.ex: Water is scarce in the desert.
words.ex_cn: 沙漠里水很缺乏。
words.en: If something is scarce, there is not enough of it.

words.ex: The water supply is insufficient for the whole village.
words.ex_cn: 供水对整个村庄来说是不充分的。
words.en: If something is insufficient, it is not enough for a particular purpose.

words.tr: adj. 不足的；缺乏的；有缺陷的
words.ex: The plant is deficient in sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 这株植物缺乏阳光。
words.en: If someone or something is deficient in a particular thing, they do not have the full amount of it that they need.

words.ex: He built his wealth by starting a small business.
words.ex_cn: 他通过创办一家小企业积累了财富。
words.en: Wealth refers to an abundance of valuable possessions or money.

words.ex: The scarcity of water caused problems in the village.
words.ex_cn: 水的缺乏给村庄带来了问题。
words.en: A scarcity of something is a situation in which there is not enough of it.

words.ex: His deficiency in math made him struggle in class.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学上的缺乏让他在课堂上很吃力。
words.en: A deficiency is a lack or shortage of something that is needed.

words.ex: She tries to juggle her job and caring for her kids.
words.ex_cn: 她努力兼顾工作和照顾孩子。
words.en: If you juggle, you keep several objects in motion in the air at the same time by repeatedly throwing and catching them. Juggle can also mean to deal with several things at the same time, often in a skillful way.

words.tr: n. 杂乱的一堆；混乱的组合
words.ex: There was a jumble of books on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 地板上有一堆杂乱的书。

words.tr: phrase. 旧物义卖；杂物义卖会（尤指慈善性质的跳蚤市场）
words.ex: They had a jumble sale to raise money for the school.
words.ex_cn: 他们举办了一场旧物义卖来为学校筹款。
words.en: A sale of miscellaneous second-hand items, often held for charity in a community hall or church.

words.tr: v. 混杂；把某物胡乱地放在一起
words.ex: He jumbled the keys together in his pocket.
words.ex_cn: 他把钥匙胡乱混在一起放在口袋里。

words.tr: v. 混乱地混合；把某物弄得杂乱无章
words.ex: He jumbled up the keys in his pocket.
words.ex_cn: 他把钥匙在口袋里弄乱了。

words.ex: The butterfly has perfect symmetry.
words.ex_cn: 这只蝴蝶有完美的对称性。
words.en: Symmetry is the quality of being made up of exactly similar parts facing each other or around an axis.

words.ex: The painting has asymmetry in its design.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画的构图不对称。
words.en: The quality of being asymmetrical; lack of symmetry.

words.ex: The loud noise startle the bird.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音惊动了那只鸟。
words.en: If something or someone startles you, they surprise and frighten you slightly.

words.ex: The magic trick will astonish you.
words.ex_cn: 这个魔术会让你惊讶。
words.en: If something or someone astonishes you, they surprise you very much.

words.ex: The school bought permanent equipment for the science lab.
words.ex_cn: 学校为科学实验室购买了永久性设备。

words.ex: The machine makes a perpetual noise.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器发出持续的噪音。
words.en: Something that is perpetual continues indefinitely or for a very long time without interruption.

words.tr: adj. 永久的；永恒的；经久不变的
words.ex: The love between them is everlasting.
words.ex_cn: 他们之间的爱是永恒的。
words.en: Something that is everlasting lasts forever or for a very long time.

words.ex: He embeds the photo in the document.
words.ex_cn: 他把照片插入到文档中。
words.en: To fix something firmly and deeply in a surrounding mass.

words.tr: n. 入学介绍；岗前训练；方向；取向；
words.ex: The school held an orientation for new students on Monday.
words.ex_cn: 学校在周一为新生举行了入学介绍。
words.en: The act of orienting or the state of being oriented; the determination of the relative position of something or someone (especially oneself).

words.ex: The storm deprived us of electricity.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴剥夺了我们的电力。
words.en: If you deprive someone of something that they want or need, you take it away from them, or you prevent them from having it.

words.tr: n. 被除数；股份红利；股息
words.ex: In 12 ÷ 3 = 4, the dividend is 12.
words.en: A dividend is a sum of money paid regularly (typically annually) by a company to its shareholders out of its profits (or reserves).

words.ex: He has a preference for tea over coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他更喜欢茶而不是咖啡。
words.en: A preference is a greater liking for one alternative over another or others.

words.tr:
n. 合同；契约；
v. 收缩；
words.ex: They signed a contract to buy the house.
words.ex_cn: 他们签署了一份购买房子的合同。
words.en: A contract is a legal agreement between two or more parties. It can also mean to become smaller or tighter, or to catch a disease.

words.tr: v. 布置家具；配备；供给；提供
words.ex: He will furnish the apartment with new furniture.
words.ex_cn: 他将为公寓配备新家具。
words.en: To furnish a place means to put furniture and other things into it.

words.ex: The lab is equipped with new computers.
words.ex_cn: 实验室配备了新的电脑。
words.en: To be provided with the necessary items for a particular purpose.

words.tr: adj. 虚拟的；几乎的；实际上的；事实上的；
words.ex: He played a virtual game on his computer.
words.ex_cn: 他在电脑上玩了一个虚拟游戏。
words.en: If you describe something as virtual, you mean that it is so nearly true that for most purposes it can be regarded as true.

words.ex: The gym has new exercise equipment.
words.ex_cn: 健身房有新的健身设备。
words.en: The necessary items for a particular purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 永久住址；常住地址
words.ex: He wrote his permanent address on the form.
words.ex_cn: 他在表格上写了永久地址。
words.en: A person's permanent, official place of residence, used for official correspondence.

words.ex: He dwells in a small house near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他住在湖边的一所小房子里。
words.en: If you dwell on something, especially something unpleasant, you think, speak, or write about it a lot or for quite a long time.

words.tr:
n. 住宅；住所
v. 居住；栖身；沉湎于；“dwell”的现在分词
words.ex: He lives in a small dwelling near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他住在湖边的一个小住所里。
words.en: A dwelling is a place where someone lives, such as a house or apartment.

words.ex: The permanency of the rule surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个规则的永久性让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: The state of being permanent; permanence.

words.ex: He permanently moved to Canada last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年永久搬到了加拿大。
words.en: In a way that continues or lasts forever without changing.

words.tr: phrase. 被嵌入；被嵌入其中；被牢固地置于
words.ex: The truth is embedded in the story.
words.ex_cn: 真相隐藏在这个故事中。
words.en: To be fixed firmly and deeply in a surrounding mass; to be an integral part of.

words.tr: v. 加浮雕花纹于；饰以浮饰；使凸出
words.ex: He embosses the card with his name.
words.ex_cn: 他把名字压印在卡片上。
words.en: To decorate a surface by making raised designs or patterns on it.

words.ex: The embedment of the pipe in the wall is strong.
words.ex_cn: 管道嵌入墙内的部分很牢固。
words.en: The act or process of fixing something firmly within a surrounding material, often used in construction or engineering contexts.

words.tr:
n. 楔子；三角木；楔形物
v. 把…楔住 ；将…挤入（或塞进、插入）
words.ex: He used a wedge to split the wood.
words.ex_cn: 他用楔子把木头劈开。
words.en: A wedge is a piece of wood, metal, or other material with one thick end and one thin edge, used to keep something in position or to split something apart.

words.ex: He will fix the broken chair tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会修理那把坏掉的椅子。
words.en: To fix something means to repair it, to make it firm or stable, or to arrange or decide it.

words.ex: Now that it is sunny, we can go outside.
words.ex_cn: 既然天晴了，我们可以出去了。
words.en: Used to introduce a reason or explanation, often implying that the situation has changed.

words.ex: All new students must attend the orientation meeting on Monday.
words.ex_cn: 所有新生必须参加周一的新生报到会。
words.en: An orientation meeting is a gathering designed to introduce new members, employees, or students to an organization or institution, providing them with essential information and helping them to adapt to their new environment.

words.tr: phrase. 迎新课程；导向课程；入职培训
words.ex: He took an orientation course before starting his job.
words.ex_cn: 他在开始工作前参加了一个入门课程。
words.en: A course designed to introduce new students or employees to an organization, its policies, and its procedures.

words.ex: This tradition originates from ancient times.
words.ex_cn: 这个传统起源于古代。
words.en: To come from a particular place or start in a particular situation.

words.ex: This word derives from Latin.
words.ex_cn: 这个词源自拉丁语。
words.en: To obtain something from a specified source.

words.tr: phrase. 剥夺某人某物；使某人失去某物
words.ex: They can't deprive him of his job.
words.ex_cn: 他们不能剥夺他的工作。
words.en: If you deprive someone of something, you take it away from them or prevent them from having it.

words.ex: Please remove the trash from the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 请把厨房的垃圾去掉。
words.en: To take something or someone away from a place or off a surface.

words.tr: adj. 有偏见的； v. “bias”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The judge was biased against the defendant.
words.ex_cn: 这位法官对被告有偏见。
words.en: If someone is biased, they prefer one group of people to another, and behave unfairly as a result.

words.ex: You must abide by the school rules.
words.ex_cn: 你必须遵守校规。
words.en: To accept or act in accordance with a rule, decision, or recommendation.

words.ex: The dog follows its owner every day.
words.ex_cn: 狗每天跟随它的主人。
words.en: To go or come after (a person or thing proceeding ahead); move or travel behind.

words.tr: phrase. 符合，与……一致；遵守（规定、标准等）
words.ex: He must conform with the school rules.
words.ex_cn: 他必须遵守校规。
words.en: To comply with rules, standards, or laws; to be similar in form or type.

words.ex: He must conform to the school rules.
words.ex_cn: 他必须遵守校规。
words.en: To comply with rules, standards, or laws; to behave according to socially acceptable conventions or standards.

words.ex: You must comply with the rules.
words.ex_cn: 你必须遵守规则。
words.en: To act in accordance with a wish, command, or rule.

words.tr:
v. 分包；转包
n. 分包合同；转包契约
words.ex: The company subcontracted the work to a small firm.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司把工作分包给了一家小公司。
words.en: To subcontract means to arrange for work to be done by another company or person as part of a larger project.

words.ex: He felt uneasy when he heard the strange noise.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到奇怪的声音时，他感到不安。
words.en: If you are uneasy, you feel anxious, afraid, or embarrassed, because you think that something is wrong or that there is danger.

words.ex: The door opens automatically when you get close.
words.ex_cn: 当你靠近时，门会自动打开。
words.en: If something happens automatically, it happens as a part of the normal process or system, without needing to be started by someone.

words.tr:
adj. 女性的；雌性的；
n. 雌性；女性；
words.ex: The female teacher is very kind.
words.ex_cn: 这位女老师非常和蔼。
words.en: A female is a person or animal that belongs to the sex that can have babies or produce eggs.

words.tr: n. 有价值的人或物；长处；
words.ex: He is an asset to the team because he works hard.
words.ex_cn: 他是个有价值的人，因为他工作努力。
words.en: An asset is something valuable that an individual, corporation, or country owns or controls with the expectation that it will provide a future benefit.

words.tr: n. 运动员；田径运动员；
words.ex: The athlete ran fast and won the race.
words.ex_cn: 这位运动员跑得很快，赢得了比赛。
words.en: An athlete is a person who is proficient in sports and other forms of physical exercise.

words.ex: The clarity of her explanation helped everyone understand.
words.ex_cn: 她解释的清晰帮助了每个人理解。
words.en: Clarity is the quality of being clear, in particular the quality of being easy to understand or see.

words.tr:
v. 交换；
n. 交换；
words.ex: They swap books every week.
words.ex_cn: 他们每周交换书籍。
words.en: If you swap something with someone, you give it to them and receive a different thing in exchange.

words.tr: adj. 精密复杂的；老练的；
words.ex: The phone has a sophisticated camera.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机有一个精密复杂的摄像头。
words.en: A sophisticated person is intelligent and knows a lot, so that they are able to understand complicated situations. A sophisticated machine, device, or method is more advanced or complex than others.

words.ex: The bulk of the students passed the exam.
words.ex_cn: 大部分学生通过了考试。
words.en: The bulk of something is most of it. The bulk of something is its size, especially when it is very large.

words.ex: He has the calibre to lead the team.
words.ex_cn: 他有领导团队的能力。
words.en: The quality of someone's character or the level of their ability; the diameter of the inside of a tube, especially of a gun barrel.

words.ex: His competence in math helped him solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学方面的能力帮助他解决了这个问题。
words.en: Competence is the ability to do something well or efficiently.

words.ex: The scientist calibrates the scale every morning.
words.ex_cn: 科学家每天早上标定秤。
words.en: To calibrate something means to mark or adjust it so that it can be used for measuring accurately.

words.ex: The ostrich runs very fast on the grassland.
words.ex_cn: 鸵鸟在草原上跑得很快。
words.en: An ostrich is a large African bird that cannot fly and has long legs and a long neck.

words.tr: phrase. 职业运动员；以体育为专业并领取薪酬的选手
words.ex: He is a professional athlete who plays soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名踢足球的职业运动员。
words.en: A professional athlete is someone who is paid to compete in sports.

words.tr: adj. 运动的；身强力壮的；
words.ex: He is an athletic boy who loves running.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个热爱跑步的运动型男孩。
words.en: Athletic is used to describe someone who is physically strong, fit, and good at sports, or something related to sports or physical activities.

words.tr:
n. 交换；兑换；交易所；
v. 交换；
words.ex: They made an exchange of books.
words.ex_cn: 他们进行了书籍的交换。
words.en: If you exchange something, you give it to someone and receive something else in return.

words.tr:
n. 贸易；交易；行业；
v. 贸易；交易；
words.ex: The two countries increased their trade last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年这两个国家增加了贸易。
words.en: Trade involves the buying and selling of goods and services. It can refer to the exchange of goods and services between parties, or to the business of buying and selling goods and services.

words.tr: adj. 老练的；复杂的；见多识广的 n. 专栏作家 —— 老练的专栏作家
words.ex: The sophisticated columnist writes with deep insight and calm style.
words.ex_cn: 这位老练的专栏作家以深刻的见解和冷静的风格写作。

words.ex: The columnist writes a weekly opinion piece.
words.ex_cn: 这位专栏作家每周写一篇观点文章。
words.en: A columnist is a journalist who regularly writes a particular kind of article in a newspaper or magazine.

words.ex: The sophistication of the machine allows it to work very precisely.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器的精密使其能够非常精确地工作。
words.en: Sophistication refers to the quality of being sophisticated, which includes complexity, refinement, and worldly experience.

words.tr: v. 经历；体验；“experience”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 有经验的；
words.ex: He experienced a sudden storm while hiking.
words.ex_cn: 他在徒步时经历了一场突如其来的暴风雨。
words.en: Someone who is experienced has knowledge or skill in a particular job or activity because they have done it for a long time.

words.ex: He is proficient in playing the piano.
words.ex_cn: 他弹钢琴很熟练。
words.en: If you are proficient in something, you can do it well because you have learned how to do it.

words.ex: The math problem is complicated.
words.ex_cn: 这个数学问题很复杂。
words.en: Involving many different and confusing aspects.

words.ex: He gave an unsophisticated answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了一个不老练的回答。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as unsophisticated, you mean that they are simple and not complicated, often in a way that is considered positive because it is natural or honest.

words.ex: The child gave a naive smile when he believed the story.
words.ex_cn: 当孩子相信这个故事时，他露出了天真的微笑。
words.en: If you describe someone as naïve, you think they lack experience and so expect things to be easy or people to be honest or kind.

words.ex: His childish laugh made everyone smile.
words.ex_cn: 他孩子气的笑声让每个人都笑了。
words.en: If you describe someone, especially an adult, as childish, you disapprove of them because they behave in an immature way.

words.tr: n. 总量大小；整体规模
words.ex: The bulk magnitude of the shipment surprised the warehouse staff.
words.ex_cn: 这批货物的总量大小让仓库员工感到惊讶。

words.ex: A multitude of people attended the festival.
words.ex_cn: 大量的人参加了这个节日。
words.en: A multitude of things or people is a very large number of them.

words.ex: His naivety made him trust strangers easily.
words.ex_cn: 他的天真使他很容易相信陌生人。
