words.tr: phrasal verb. （因压力或情绪失控）崩溃，大笑；吹捧，夸赞
words.ex: He will crack up if he hears that funny story.
words.ex_cn: 如果他听到那个有趣的故事，他会笑得前仰后合。
words.en: If someone cracks up, they suddenly start laughing. If someone cracks up, they become mentally ill because they cannot deal with their problems or the pressure they are under.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 对…进行严厉打击；采取严厉措施制止
words.ex: The government will crack down on people who break the rules.
words.ex_cn: 政府将严厉打击违反规则的人。
words.en: To take severe measures against someone or something, especially in order to stop them from doing something illegal or harmful.

words.ex: The volcano spilled hot lava down the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 火山喷出炽热的岩浆流下山。
words.en: Lava is the molten rock that comes out of a volcano during an eruption.

words.ex: The butterfly starts as a larva.
words.ex_cn: 蝴蝶从幼虫开始。
words.en: An insect in the stage of development when it has just come out of an egg and before it changes into its adult form.

words.tr: adj. 软而黏的；情意绵绵的
words.ex: The chocolate cake is gooey inside.
words.ex_cn: 这个巧克力蛋糕里面很黏稠。
words.en: If you describe a food or other substance as gooey, you mean that it is very soft and sticky.

words.tr: adj. 黑暗的；幽暗的；忧郁的；沮丧的
words.ex: The room was gloomy with no windows.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间没有窗户，很黑暗。
words.en: If a place is gloomy, it is almost dark so that you cannot see very well. If people are gloomy, they are unhappy and have no hope.

words.tr:
n. 侧面；侧翼；胁腹
v. 在…侧面（有）
words.ex: The soldiers moved to the flank to avoid the enemy.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们移动到侧翼以避开敌人。
words.en: The side of something, especially a part of the body between the ribs and the hip; to be situated on each side of or on one side of (something).

words.ex: The artist drew a side face of the woman.
words.ex_cn: 艺术家画了这位女士的侧面像。

words.ex: The lateral side of the box is painted blue.
words.ex_cn: 盒子的侧面被涂成了蓝色。

words.ex: The apples ripen in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 苹果在秋天成熟。
words.en: When crops ripen or when the sun ripens them, they become ripe and ready to eat.

words.ex: The company is doing vetting for new employees.
words.ex_cn: 公司正在对新员工进行背景审查。
words.en: The process of carefully and critically examining someone or something, especially to ensure suitability or safety.

words.tr: n. 仔细研究；详细检查；
words.ex: The teacher examined the student's work under close scrutiny.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生的作业进行了仔细研究。
words.en: If someone or something is under scrutiny, they are being studied or observed very carefully.

words.tr:
n. 审查员；检查员
v. 检查；审查
words.ex: The censor removed the bad words from the movie.
words.ex_cn: 审查员从电影中删除了粗俗用语。
words.en: A censor is a person who supervises conduct and morals: in particular, one who examines books, films, or other material for objectionable matter.

words.ex: The government imposed censorship on the news.
words.ex_cn: 政府对新闻实施了审查。
words.en: Censorship is the censoring of books, plays, films, or reports, especially by government officials, because they are considered immoral or secret in some way.

words.ex: The team reached a consensus on the project plan.
words.ex_cn: 团队就项目计划达成了共识。
words.en: A consensus is general agreement among a group of people.

words.ex: The trip is contingent on the weather.
words.ex_cn: 这次旅行取决于天气情况。
words.en: A contingent event or situation depends on something else in order to happen or exist.

words.ex: The delegation met with the president yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 代表团昨天会见了总统。
words.en: A delegation is a group of people who have been sent somewhere to have talks with other people on behalf of a larger group of people.

words.ex: The manager will delegate the task to her assistant.
words.ex_cn: 经理将把这个任务委派给她的助手。
words.en: A delegate is a person who is chosen or elected to vote or make decisions on behalf of a group of people, especially at a conference or a meeting. As a verb, to delegate means to give a task or responsibility to another person, especially someone who is less senior than you.

words.ex: The music resonates with her emotions.
words.ex_cn: 音乐与她的情感产生共鸣。
words.en: If something resonates, it vibrates and produces a deep, strong sound. If a place or situation resonates, it seems full of a particular quality or feeling.

words.ex: She will divide the cake into two parts.
words.ex_cn: 她将把蛋糕分成两部分。
words.en: If you divide something, you separate it into two or more parts.

words.ex: The gross income of the company is $5 million.
words.ex_cn: 公司的总收入是500万美元。
words.en: If you describe something as gross, you mean it is very obvious, unacceptable, or unpleasant.

words.ex: Please leave your coat in the cloakroom.
words.ex_cn: 请把你的外套放在衣帽间。
words.en: A cloakroom is a room where coats, hats, luggage, or other items may be left temporarily, as in a theater, public building, or school.

words.ex: His refusal to apologize made everyone angry.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝道歉，让所有人都生气了。
words.en: The act of refusing to do something or to accept something.

words.tr: phrase. 一种自律且有原则的性格
words.ex: He has a disciplined and principled character.
words.ex_cn: 他具有自律且有原则的性格。
words.en: A person who consistently adheres to a set of moral or ethical rules and demonstrates self-control in their behavior.

words.ex: We divide the cake into six pieces.
words.ex_cn: 我们把蛋糕分成六块。
words.en: To separate or split something into parts or groups.

words.ex: Divide the cake into four pieces.
words.ex_cn: 把蛋糕分成四块。

words.tr: phrase. 国内生产毛额；国内生产总值
words.ex: The country's gross domestic product increased last year.
words.ex_cn: 该国的国内生产总值去年增加了。
words.en: The total value of goods produced and services provided in a country during one year.

words.ex: The country's gross national product increased last year.
words.ex_cn: 该国的国民生产总值去年增加了。
words.en: The total value of goods produced and services provided by a country during one year, equal to the gross domestic product plus the net income from foreign investments.

words.tr:
n. 斗篷；掩护物
v. 隐瞒；掩饰
words.ex: He wore a black cloak to hide his face.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着一件黑色斗篷来遮住脸。
words.en: A cloak is a long, loose outer garment which is worn over other clothes, especially in cold weather. It can also refer to something that hides or covers another thing.

words.tr:
adv. 彻底地；立刻地；
adj. 完全的；彻底的；
words.ex: He refused the offer outright.
words.ex_cn: 他彻底拒绝了这个提议。
words.en: If something is done outright, it is done completely and without any hesitation or attempt to hide it.

words.tr: n. 优惠券；息票；配给券
words.ex: He used a coupon to buy milk at half price.
words.ex_cn: 他用一张优惠券以半价买了牛奶。
words.en: A coupon is a piece of printed paper that allows you to pay less money than usual for a product, or to get it free.

words.tr: n. 大部头的书；大册书
words.ex: He read a large tome about ancient history.
words.ex_cn: 他读了一本关于古代历史的厚书。
words.en: A tome is a large, heavy book, especially one dealing with a serious topic.

words.ex: The poison in the snake is a natural toxin.
words.ex_cn: 蛇的毒液是一种天然毒素。
words.en: A toxin is a poisonous substance, especially one produced by bacteria, which causes disease.

words.ex: He sings and plays guitar simultaneously.
words.ex_cn: 他一边唱歌一边弹吉他。
words.en: If two or more things happen simultaneously, they happen at exactly the same time.

words.ex: It's ridiculous to think he can run a mile in one minute.
words.ex_cn: 认为他能在一分钟内跑完一英里是荒谬的。
words.en: If you say that something or someone is ridiculous, you mean that they are very foolish.

words.tr:
n. 芯片；
v. 削成碎片；碎裂；
words.ex: The computer chip is very small.
words.ex_cn: 计算机芯片非常小。
words.en: A chip is a small piece which has been broken off something larger, or a small piece of silicon used to make computer parts.

words.tr:
n. 光泽；上光剂；
v. 擦亮；润色；
words.ex: The polish of the wooden table made it shine.
words.ex_cn: 木桌的光泽让它闪闪发亮。
words.en: If you polish something, you make it smooth and shiny by rubbing it with a cloth or a special substance. Polish is also a substance that you use to make things smooth and shiny.

words.tr:
v. 想知道；
n. 惊奇；奇迹；
words.ex: I wonder why he is late.
words.ex_cn: 我想知道他为什么迟到了。
words.en: To feel curiosity or doubt about something; a feeling of surprise mingled with admiration, caused by something beautiful, unexpected, unfamiliar, or inexplicable.

words.ex: He won a scholarship to study at Harvard.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了一项去哈佛学习的奖学金。
words.en: A scholarship is a grant or payment made to support a student's education, awarded on the basis of academic or other achievement.

words.ex: He used a voucher to buy a coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他用一张代金券买了一杯咖啡。
words.en: A voucher is a piece of paper that can be used instead of money to pay for something, or that allows you to pay less than the usual price for something.

words.tr:
n. 毛孔；小孔
v. 细看；钻研；凝视
words.ex: Sweat comes out through the pores of the skin.
words.ex_cn: 汗水通过皮肤上的毛孔排出。
words.en: A pore is a tiny opening in a surface that allows liquids or gases to pass through. As a verb, to pore means to read or study something very carefully.

words.tr: adj. 沉重的；重要的；重大的；
words.ex: The box is weighty and hard to carry.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子很重，很难搬。
words.en: Something that is weighty is important and serious, or seems to be so.

words.ex: He delves into the history of ancient civilizations.
words.ex_cn: 他探究古代文明的历史。
words.en: If you delve into something, you try to discover new information about it by searching or investigating carefully.

words.tr: phrase. 仔细研究；专心致志地钻研一个问题
words.ex: He pored over a problem for hours until he found the solution.
words.ex_cn: 他仔细研究了一个问题好几个小时，直到找到解决方法。

words.tr:
v. 焊接
n. 焊接
words.ex: He welds metal pieces together with a torch.
words.ex_cn: 他用焊枪把金属片焊接在一起。
words.en: To join pieces of metal together by heating the surfaces until they melt and pressing them together.

words.ex: The cows graze in the field every morning.
words.ex_cn: 奶牛每天早上在田野里吃草。
words.en: To graze means to feed on grass or to touch something lightly in passing.

words.tr: v. 擦伤；挫伤；出现伤痕；
words.ex: He bruised his knee when he fell off the bike.
words.ex_cn: 他从自行车上摔下来时擦伤了膝盖。
words.en: A bruise is a mark that appears on your skin after you have been injured, but the skin is not broken.

words.ex: He bought a brass lamp at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了一个黄铜制品台灯。
words.en: Brass is a yellow-coloured metal made from copper and zinc. It is used especially for making ornaments and musical instruments.

words.tr: phrase. 钎焊；用钎料进行的焊接
words.ex: The mechanic used braze welding to join the metal pipes.
words.ex_cn: 技工使用钎焊来连接金属管道。

words.ex: The statue is made of bronze.
words.ex_cn: 这座雕像由青铜制成。
words.en: Bronze is a yellowish-brown metal which is a mixture of copper and tin.

words.tr: phrase. 牛群吃草；牲畜在牧场放牧
words.ex: The cattle graze in the field every morning.
words.ex_cn: 牛群每天早上在田野里吃草。

words.ex: He wears blue trousers to work.
words.ex_cn: 他上班穿蓝色的裤子。
words.en: Trousers are a piece of clothing that you wear over your body from the waist downwards, and that cover each leg separately.

words.tr:
n. 长裤子；短内裤； “pant”的复数
v. 喘气；喘息；“pant”的第三人称单数
words.ex: He is wearing blue pants.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着蓝色的裤子。
words.en: Pants are a piece of clothing that covers the body from the waist to the ankles and divides into two parts to cover each leg separately.

words.ex: She bought some cloth to make a dress.
words.ex_cn: 她买了一些布来做裙子。
words.en: Cloth is fabric which is made by weaving or knitting cotton, wool, silk, or other threads. Cloth is used especially for making clothes.

words.ex: He hangs his clothes on the line to dry.
words.ex_cn: 他把衣服挂在绳子上晾干。
words.en: Clothes are the things that people wear, such as shirts, coats, trousers, and dresses.

words.ex: At a given time, only one person can use the computer.
words.ex_cn: 在特定时间，只有一个人能使用电脑。
words.en: At a specific moment or period.

words.tr: phrase. 被雕琢成形；被逐步修整成特定形状
phrase. 提升自己的英语水平；精进英语
words.ex: He practices every day to polish his English.
words.ex_cn: 他每天练习以提升自己的英语水平。

words.tr: phrase. 波兰家具（指来自波兰的风格或制造的家具）
words.ex: They bought polish furniture for their living room.
words.ex_cn: 他们为客厅买了波兰家具。

words.ex: He picked up an axe to chop wood.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起一把斧子去砍柴。
words.en: An axe is a tool used for chopping wood, typically consisting of a heavy metal blade fixed at a right angle at the end of a long handle. As a verb, to axe means to dismiss or reduce something drastically.

words.ex: He grinds the coffee beans into powder.
words.ex_cn: 他把咖啡豆碾成粉末。
words.en: To reduce something to small particles or powder by crushing it.

words.ex: No wonder he is tired, he worked all night.
words.ex_cn: 难怪他累了，他整晚都在工作。
words.en: It is not surprising that something is the case.

words.ex: The teacher will familiarise students with basic math rules.
words.ex_cn: 老师将使学生熟悉基本的数学规则。
words.en: To make someone or yourself familiar with something; to learn about something so that you know it well.

words.ex: He has high expectancy for the future.
words.ex_cn: 他对未来有很高的预期。
words.en: The feeling of excitement about something that is going to happen.

words.ex: His expectation was to pass the test.
words.ex_cn: 他的期待是通过考试。
words.en: An expectation is a belief about what might happen in the future, especially about something that you think is likely or that you hope will happen.

words.ex: The architect showed us the blueprint of the new house.
words.ex_cn: 建筑师给我们看了新房子的蓝图。
words.en: A blueprint is a detailed plan or design of something, often used in the context of buildings or machinery, which shows how it is to be made or how it will work.

words.ex: The interplay between light and shadow creates beauty.
words.ex_cn: 光与影的相互作用创造了美。
words.en: The way in which two or more things have an effect on each other.

words.ex: This store is convenient for buying groceries.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店买杂货很方便。
words.en: If something is convenient, it is easy to use or do, or it is useful and suitable for a particular purpose.

words.ex: This is a genuine diamond.
words.ex_cn: 这是一颗真正的钻石。
words.en: If something is genuine, it is real and exactly what it appears to be.

words.tr: adj. 真正的；真实的；真迹的；可靠的；
words.ex: This is an authentic painting by Picasso.
words.ex_cn: 这是一幅毕加索的真迹。
words.en: If something is authentic, it is real, true, or what people say it is.

words.tr: adj. 真实的；真的；真正的；
words.ex: This is a real diamond, not fake.
words.ex_cn: 这是一颗真正的钻石，不是假的。
words.en: Something that is real actually exists and is not imagined, invented, or theoretical.

words.tr: adj. 注意的；专心的；留心的；关心的
words.ex: The child is attentive in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子上课很专心。
words.en: If you are attentive, you are paying close attention to what is being said or done.

words.tr: n. 观察；观测；注意；监视；(观察后的）意见；
words.ex: The scientist made an observation about the bird's behavior.
words.ex_cn: 科学家对这只鸟的行为进行了观察。
words.en: The act of noticing or watching something carefully in order to gain information.

words.ex: This is my personal notebook.
words.ex_cn: 这是我的个人笔记本。
words.en: Relating to or belonging to a particular person rather than to a group or an organization.

words.ex: The child shows great vitality while playing.
words.ex_cn: 孩子玩耍时充满活力。
words.en: Vitality refers to the state of being strong and active; energy.

words.ex: He drew a flow chart to show the steps.
words.ex_cn: 他画了一个流程图来展示步骤。
words.en: A flow chart is a diagram that represents a process or algorithm, showing the steps as boxes of various kinds, and their order by connecting them with arrows.

words.ex: You should familiarise yourself with the rules before the game starts.
words.ex_cn: 你应该在游戏开始前熟悉一下规则。

words.ex: He surpassed his brother in math scores.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学成绩上超过了他弟弟。
words.en: If one person or thing surpasses another, the first is better than, or has more of a particular quality than, the second.

words.ex: The rain precedes the storm.
words.ex_cn: 雨先于风暴来临。
words.en: If one event or period of time precedes another, it happens before it.

words.tr: phrase. 对……方便的；适合于……的便利的
words.ex: This app is convenient for students.
words.ex_cn: 这个应用对学生来说很方便。
words.en: To be suitable or advantageous for someone or something, making it easy or comfortable to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 方便做某事；对做某事很方便

words.ex: Please verify your email address.
words.ex_cn: 请核实你的电子邮件地址。
words.en: To verify something means to check or prove that it is true, accurate, or justified.

words.ex: The verification of the password took only a few seconds.
words.ex_cn: 密码的验证只花了几秒钟。
words.en: Verification is the process of establishing the truth, accuracy, or validity of something.

words.tr: adj. 现实的；现实主义的；
words.ex: He made a realistic plan to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他制定了一个现实的存钱计划。
words.en: If you are realistic about a situation, you recognize and accept its true nature and try to deal with it in a practical way.

words.ex: The scientist observe the birds every morning.
words.ex_cn: 科学家每天早上观察鸟类。
words.en: If you observe a person or thing, you watch them carefully, especially in order to learn something about them.

words.ex: He must conform to the school rules.
words.ex_cn: 他必须遵守校规。
words.en: To comply with rules, standards, or laws; to behave according to socially acceptable conventions or standards.

words.ex: You must abide by the school rules.
words.ex_cn: 你必须遵守校规。
words.en: To accept or act in accordance with a rule, decision, or recommendation.

words.tr: phrase. 与...同在；忠于；忍受（与...共处）
words.ex: I will abide with you in hard times.
words.ex_cn: 我会在艰难时刻与你同在。

words.ex: You must comply with the rules.
words.ex_cn: 你必须遵守规则。
words.en: To act in accordance with a wish, command, or rule.

words.ex: He got a personal loan to buy a car.
words.ex_cn: 他申请了一笔个人贷款来买一辆车。
words.en: A loan of money from a financial institution to an individual for personal use.

words.tr: phrase. 个人物品；随身携带的小件行李（如手提包、笔记本电脑包等）
words.ex: She carries a small personal item on the plane.
words.ex_cn: 她随身携带一件个人物品登机。
words.en: An object belonging to an individual.

words.ex: Do not share your personal information online.
words.ex_cn: 不要在网上分享你的个人信息。
words.en: Information about a particular person, such as their name, address, and phone number, that can be used to identify or contact them.

words.tr: n. 全体人员；人事部；职员；
words.ex: The company hired new personnel last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司上个月雇佣了新员工。
words.en: The people who are employed in a company or organization.

words.tr: v. 使个人化；使（某事物）针对个人；个性化
words.ex: She can personalize her phone with a new wallpaper.
words.ex_cn: 她可以用新的壁纸来个性化她的手机。
words.en: To make something suitable for the needs of a particular person, often by changing or adding to it.

words.tr: adv. 就本人而言；亲自地；
words.ex: Personally, I like tea more than coffee.
words.ex_cn: 就本人而言，我更喜欢茶而不是咖啡。
words.en: If you do something personally, you do it yourself rather than letting someone else do it. You can also use personally to show that you are talking about your own opinion or experience.

words.ex: Water is vital for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命至关重要。
words.en: If you say that something is vital, you mean that it is necessary or very important.

words.ex: The old man still has vital energy to walk every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人仍有充沛的生命力每天早晨散步。

words.tr: n. 需求；要求；必要条件；
words.ex: The job has a requirement of two years of experience.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作的要求是两年经验。
words.en: A requirement is something that is necessary or that must be done.

words.ex: It is advisable to wear a helmet when riding a bike.
words.ex_cn: 骑自行车时戴头盔是明智的。
words.en: If something is advisable, it will avoid problems if you do it.

words.ex: The company is bankrupt after losing all its money.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司失去所有钱后破产了。
words.en: If a person or a company is bankrupt, they have been declared by a court of law to be unable to pay their debts.

words.ex: The drought depletes the water supply.
words.ex_cn: 干旱耗尽了水源。
words.en: If you deplete something, you reduce the amount of it that is available or that exists.

words.tr:
n. 影响（力）；
v. 影响；
words.ex: The teacher had a big influence on her students.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生们有很大的影响。
words.en: The power to affect, control, or manipulate someone or something.

words.ex: The child loves to play with fantasy stories about dragons.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子喜欢玩关于龙的幻想故事。
words.en: A fantasy is a pleasant situation or event that you imagine, which is unlikely to happen.

words.tr: adj. 悲剧的；悲惨的；不幸的；
words.ex: The accident was a tragic event.
words.ex_cn: 这场事故是一场悲剧。
words.en: A tragic event or situation is extremely sad, usually because it involves death or suffering.

words.ex: The doctor put a splint on his broken arm.
words.ex_cn: 医生给他骨折的手臂上了夹板。
words.en: A splint is a long, thin piece of wood or metal that is used to hold a broken bone in place while it heals.

words.ex: The beer left foam on the top of the glass.
words.ex_cn: 啤酒在杯子顶部留下了一层泡沫。
words.en: Foam is a mass of small bubbles that are formed in or on a liquid.

words.tr: phrase. 充满活力的；生机勃勃的
phrase. 异常的活力；非凡的生命力
words.ex: The child showed exceptional vitality after recovering from illness.
words.ex_cn: 孩子康复后表现出异常的活力。

words.ex: I advise you to eat more vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 我建议你多吃蔬菜。
words.en: If you advise someone to do something, you tell them what you think they should do.

words.tr: phrase. 请赐教；请告知建议
words.ex: Please advise how to solve this problem.
words.ex_cn: 请赐教如何解决这个问题。

words.ex: The depletion of natural resources is a serious problem.
words.ex_cn: 自然资源的损耗是一个严重的问题。
words.en: The act of reducing something by a large amount so that there is not enough left.

words.ex: The tip of the pencil broke off.
words.ex_cn: 铅笔的尖端断了。
words.en: The end of a pointed or projecting object; a sum of money given to someone as a reward for their services; to give someone a small amount of money as a reward for their services.

words.tr:
n. 外衣；大衣；
v. 覆盖；
words.ex: He put on his coat before going out.
words.ex_cn: 他出门前穿上了外衣。
words.en: A coat is a piece of clothing with long sleeves which you wear over your other clothes when you go outside.

words.ex: Sulphur smells like rotten eggs.
words.ex_cn: 硫磺闻起来像臭鸡蛋。
words.en: Sulphur is a yellow chemical element that is found in various forms and is used in industry and medicine.

words.ex: The volcano released sulfur into the air.
words.ex_cn: 火山向空气中释放了硫。
words.en: Sulfur is a pale yellow, odorless, brittle solid, which is insoluble in water but soluble in carbon disulfide.

words.ex: The lab uses sulphuric acid for cleaning.
words.ex_cn: 实验室用硫酸进行清洁。
words.en: Sulphuric is an adjective used to describe something that contains or relates to sulphur.

words.ex: Sulfuric acid is used in car batteries.
words.ex_cn: 硫酸用于汽车电池中。
words.en: Sulfuric refers to anything related to or containing sulfur, especially in its higher valency.

words.ex: Bananas have a lot of potassium.
words.ex_cn: 香蕉含有大量的钾。
words.en: A soft silver-white reactive metal of the alkali metal group, occurring principally in the form of salts in seawater and in minerals such as sylvite and carnallite.

words.ex: The water contains chlorate.
words.ex_cn: 水中含有氯酸盐。
words.en: A chlorate is a compound that contains the chlorate ion, ClO₃⁻, which is a polyatomic ion with a chlorine atom in the +5 oxidation state bonded to three oxygen atoms.

words.tr:
n. 溢出；
v. 泛滥；
words.ex: The rain caused an overflow of the river.
words.ex_cn: 雨水导致河水溢出。
words.en: If a liquid or a river overflows, it flows over the edges of the container or place it is in.

words.ex: The occupation of the city by foreign troops lasted for years.
words.ex_cn: 外国军队对这座城市的占领持续了多年。
words.en: An occupation is a job or profession, or a way of spending your time.

words.tr:
n. 格式；
v. 格式化；
words.ex: The file is in PDF format.
words.ex_cn: 这个文件是PDF格式。
words.en: The way in which something is arranged or set out.

words.ex: He earned a bachelor in computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了计算机科学学士学位。
words.en: A bachelor is a man who has never been married.

words.ex: I have an appointment with my doctor at 3 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 我下午三点有个医生的约会。
words.en: An appointment is a formal arrangement to meet or visit someone at a particular time, especially for a purpose connected with their work or official position.

words.ex: The children played on the slope behind the house.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在房子后面的斜坡上玩耍。
words.en: A slope is a surface that is at an angle, so that one end is higher than the other.

words.tr:
adj. 复杂的；
n. 综合楼（群）；
words.ex: The instructions are too complex for children.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明对孩子来说太复杂了。
words.en: Something that is complex has many different parts, and is therefore often difficult to understand.

words.ex: The lock has an intricate design.
words.ex_cn: 这个锁有复杂的结构。
words.en: You use intricate to describe something that has many small parts or details.

words.ex: The math problem is complicated.
words.ex_cn: 这个数学问题很复杂。
words.en: Involving many different and confusing aspects.

words.tr:
adj. 在头顶上的；
adv. 在空中；
words.ex: The overhead light is too bright.
words.ex_cn: 头顶上的灯太亮了。
words.en: You use overhead to indicate that something is above you or above the place that you are talking about.

words.ex: You need basic math as a prerequisite for this course.
words.ex_cn: 你学习这门课程的前提是掌握基础数学。
words.en: A prerequisite is something that must exist or happen before something else can exist or happen.

words.ex: The cat occupies the sofa all day.
words.ex_cn: 这只猫整天占据着沙发。
words.en: If people or things occupy a place, they are in it or fill it.

words.tr: phrase. 常规职业；固定工作
words.ex: His regular occupation is teaching English.
words.ex_cn: 他的常规职业是教英语。

words.tr: phrase. 格式化自己的磁盘
words.ex: I formatted my disc to fix the error.
words.ex_cn: 我格式化了自己的磁盘以修复错误。

words.tr: adj. 增进知识的；提供消息的；
words.ex: The documentary is very informative.
words.ex_cn: 这部纪录片非常增进了知识。
words.en: Providing useful or interesting information.

words.ex: The CD is a type of disc.
words.ex_cn: CD是一种圆盘。
words.en: A disc is a flat, circular object or a device used to store information in a form that can be read by a computer.

words.ex: The formation of clouds happens when water vapor cools.
words.ex_cn: 云的形成发生在水蒸气冷却时。
words.en: The process of forming or making something, or the way something is formed or made.

words.ex: The teacher gave formative feedback to help students improve.
words.ex_cn: 老师给出了影响形成的学习反馈，以帮助学生改进。
words.en: Relating to or characterized by the formation or development of something.

words.ex: He earned a bachelor's degree in biology.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了生物学学士学位。
words.en: A bachelor's degree is an undergraduate academic degree awarded by colleges and universities upon completion of a course of study lasting three to seven years (depending on institution and academic discipline).

words.ex: She earned a Bachelor of Arts in History.
words.ex_cn: 她获得了历史学学士学位。
words.en: A Bachelor of Arts (BA or AB) is an undergraduate academic degree awarded for a course or program in the arts and/or sciences.

words.ex: She earned a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science.
words.ex_cn: 她获得了计算机科学理学学士学位。
words.en: A Bachelor of Science (BS, BSc, SB, or ScB; from the Latin scientiae baccalaureus) is an undergraduate academic degree awarded for completed courses that generally last three to five years.

words.ex: I will make an appointment with the doctor tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天要预约医生。
words.en: To arrange a meeting or consultation at a specific time.

words.ex: The police told everyone to evacuate the building.
words.ex_cn: 警察让所有人撤离大楼。
words.en: To evacuate means to remove people from a place of danger to a safer place.

words.ex: The sun makes the puddle evaporate quickly.
words.ex_cn: 太阳使水坑很快蒸发。
words.en: If a liquid evaporates, or if something evaporates it, it changes from a liquid state to a gas, because its temperature has increased.

words.ex: He bought timber to build a fence.
words.ex_cn: 他买了木材来建篱笆。
words.en: Wood prepared for use in building and carpentry.

words.ex: The factory buys lumber to make furniture.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂购买木材来制造家具。
words.en: Lumber refers to wood that has been processed into beams and planks, a stage in the process of wood production. It is also used to describe the action of moving in a slow, heavy, awkward way.

words.ex: The lumberjack skillfully felled the massive tree.
words.ex_cn: 伐木工人熟练地砍倒了那棵大树。
words.en: A lumberjack is a person whose job is to cut down trees for timber.

words.tr: n. 伐木工；砍伐木材的人
words.ex: The timbercutter worked hard in the forest every day.
words.ex_cn: 这位伐木工每天在森林里努力工作。

words.ex: The camper parked near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 露营车停在湖边。
words.en: A camper is someone who stays in a tent or a caravan, especially for a holiday.

words.ex: The child hurt his limb while playing.
words.ex_cn: 孩子玩耍时伤到了肢体。
words.en: A limb is one of the jointed appendages of an animal used for locomotion or grasping: arm; leg; wing; flipper.

words.tr:
adj. 柔软的；可塑的；易弯曲的；有弹性的
v. 使柔软；把（火炮）系在前车上；做热身运动
n. （拖炮车的）前车
words.ex: The gymnast's body is remarkably limber.
words.ex_cn: 这位体操运动员的身体非常柔软。
words.en: Capable of moving or bending easily; flexible.

words.tr:
v. 跛行；蹒跚；瘸着走
adj. 无力的；无生气的
words.ex: He limps after hurting his leg.
words.ex_cn: 他受伤后走路一瘸一拐。
words.en: If someone limps, they walk with difficulty or in an uneven way because one of their legs or feet is hurt.

words.ex: I caught a glimpse of the cat before it ran away.
words.ex_cn: 我在它跑掉之前瞥了一眼那只猫。
words.en: A glimpse is a brief, quick look at something or someone.

words.tr:
v. 密谋；激起…的兴趣
n. 阴谋诡计；密谋策划
words.ex: They intrigue to take over the company.
words.ex_cn: 他们密谋接管这家公司。
words.en: If something intrigues you, it interests you a lot because it seems strange or mysterious.

words.ex: The police discovered a scheme to steal money.
words.ex_cn: 警方发现了一个偷钱的阴谋。
words.en: A scheme is a plan or arrangement, especially one produced by a government or other organization, or a secret plan to do something, especially something illegal or dishonest.

words.tr:
n. 情节；小块用地；
v. 绘图；
words.ex: The plot of the movie was very exciting.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影的情节非常精彩。
words.en: A plot is a secret plan by a group of people to do something that is illegal or wrong, especially against a person or a government. It can also refer to the main events of a play, novel, movie, or similar work, devised and presented by the writer as an interrelated sequence. Additionally, a plot can be a small piece of land that is used or intended for a specific purpose.

words.tr: adj. 有关的；有牵连的；繁杂的； v. 包括；牵涉；“involve”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is involved in the school project.
words.ex_cn: 他与这个学校项目有关。
words.en: If a situation or activity is involved, it has a lot of different parts or aspects, often making it complicated or difficult to understand.

words.tr: adj. 多结节的；难以解决的；棘手的
words.ex: The old tree had a knotty trunk.
words.ex_cn: 这棵老树有一个多结节的树干。
words.en: A knotty problem or issue is very complicated and difficult to solve.

words.ex: He unraveled the knotted string.
words.ex_cn: 他把打结的绳子拆散了。
words.en: To unravel means to separate or disentangle the threads of a fabric or a rope, or to solve or explain something that is complicated or mysterious.

words.ex: He tied a knot in the rope.
words.ex_cn: 他在绳子上打了一个结。
words.en: A knot is a fastening made by tying a piece of string, rope, or something similar. It can also refer to a hard mass formed in a tree trunk at the intersection with a branch, or a unit of speed equal to one nautical mile per hour, used especially by ships and aircraft.

words.ex: This is a simple math problem.
words.ex_cn: 这是一道简单的数学题。
words.en: If you describe something as simple, you mean that it is not complicated, and is therefore easy to understand.

words.ex: The ceiling is white and low.
words.ex_cn: 天花板是白色的，而且很低。
words.en: The ceiling is the upper interior surface of a room or other similar compartment.

words.ex: The teacher used an overhead projector to show the diagram.
words.ex_cn: 老师使用高射投影机展示图表。
words.en: An overhead projector is a device that projects images or text onto a screen or wall, typically used in classrooms or meetings for presentations.

words.tr: adj. 必需的；必备的；必不可少的；
words.ex: A passport is a requisite for international travel.
words.ex_cn: 护照是国际旅行所必需的。
words.en: Something that is necessary for a particular purpose.

words.tr: v. （下级对上级的）请求；请求得到；索取；邀请；（下级对上级的）请求( request的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The student requested permission to leave early.
words.ex_cn: 学生请求提前离开。
words.en: Formally asked for by someone.

words.ex: Wear a helmet as a precaution when riding a bike.
words.ex_cn: 骑自行车时戴头盔作为一种预防措施。
words.en: A precaution is an action that is intended to prevent something dangerous or unpleasant from happening.

words.tr:
v. 测量；衡量；度量；
n. 衡量；量度；措施；
words.ex: He uses a ruler to measure the length of the table.
words.ex_cn: 他用尺子测量桌子的长度。
words.en: To measure something means to determine its size, amount, or degree, often by using a tool or device designed for this purpose.

words.ex: The measurement of temperature is important in science.
words.ex_cn: 温度的衡量在科学中很重要。
words.en: The action of measuring something.

words.ex: The population of this city is growing fast.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市的人口正在快速增长。
words.en: The number of people living in a particular area, city, or country; the total number of people who live in a place.

words.tr:
n. 猎物；受害者；受骗者；
v. 捕食；坑害；折磨；
words.ex: The lion chased its prey across the plain.
words.ex_cn: 狮子在平原上追逐它的猎物。
words.en: An animal that is hunted and killed by another for food.

words.ex: He prays every morning before breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃早餐前祈祷。
words.en: To pray means to speak to God in order to give thanks or to ask for something.

words.ex: He looked at the catalogue to find the book.
words.ex_cn: 他翻看目录来找那本书。
words.en: A catalogue is a list of things such as the goods you can buy from a particular company, the objects in a museum, or the books in a library.

words.ex: He looked at the catalog to find the book.
words.ex_cn: 他翻看目录来找那本书。
words.en: A catalog is a list of things, such as the goods you can buy from a particular company, the objects in a museum, or the books in a library.

words.ex: The teacher gave an assessment of the students' work.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生的作品进行了评估。
words.en: An assessment is a judgment about something, especially about how good or bad it is, or an amount that is calculated for something, especially for tax purposes.

words.ex: His silence suggested he was unhappy.
words.ex_cn: 他的沉默暗示他并不开心。
words.en: If you suggest something, you put forward a plan or idea for someone to think about.

words.tr:
n. 螺丝钉；
v. 拧紧；
words.ex: He tightened the screw with a screwdriver.
words.ex_cn: 他用螺丝刀拧紧了螺丝钉。
words.en: A screw is a metal object similar to a nail, with a raised spiral line around it. Screws are used to fasten things together.

words.ex: The teacher will enlighten the students about the truth.
words.ex_cn: 老师将向学生们阐明真相。
words.en: To enlighten someone means to give them more knowledge and greater understanding about something.

words.ex: The book brought him great enlightenment.
words.ex_cn: 这本书给了他极大的启迪。
words.en: Enlightenment is the act of enlightening or the state of being enlightened. It can refer to the acquisition of spiritual knowledge or understanding, especially in Buddhism.

words.ex: Her story inspires me to work harder.
words.ex_cn: 她的故事激励我更加努力。
words.en: If someone or something inspires you to do something new or unusual, they make you want to do it.

words.ex: The store sells many kinds of textile, like cotton and silk.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售多种纺织品，比如棉和丝绸。
words.en: Textiles are types of cloth or fabric, especially ones that have been woven.

words.tr:
n. 账户；叙述；账目；
v. 占…；说明；
words.ex: I opened a bank account last week.
words.ex_cn: 我上周开了一家银行账户。
words.en: An account is a detailed report or description of an event or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 人口爆炸；人口激增
words.ex: The country faces problems because of population explosion.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家因人口爆炸而面临问题。
words.en: A sudden, large increase in the size of a population.

words.tr: phrase. 人口控制；对人口数量或增长的限制与管理措施
words.ex: The government uses population control to manage resources.
words.ex_cn: 政府通过人口控制来管理资源。
words.en: Measures or policies aimed at regulating the size and growth of a population.

words.ex: He cleaned the floor by means of a mop.
words.ex_cn: 他用拖把打扫了地板。
words.en: If you do something by means of a particular method, instrument, or process, you do it using that method, instrument, or process.

words.ex: He passed the test by virtue of his hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他凭借努力学习通过了考试。
words.en: Because of or as a result of something.

words.ex: He had to resort to asking for help.
words.ex_cn: 他不得不求助于别人。
words.en: If you resort to a particular course of action, you do it because other methods have failed.

words.tr: phrase. 以昆虫为食；捕食昆虫
words.ex: Bats prey on insects at night.
words.ex_cn: 蝙蝠在夜间以昆虫为食。

words.ex: The workers load stones from the quarry.
words.ex_cn: 工人们从采石场装载石头。
words.en: A quarry is a place where stone, sand, etc., is dug out of the ground. It can also refer to an animal or person that is being hunted or chased.

words.ex: The victim cried for help.
words.ex_cn: 受害者呼救。
words.en: A victim is someone who has been harmed, injured, or killed as a result of a crime, accident, or other event or action.

words.ex: The disease afflicted many people in the village.
words.ex_cn: 这种疾病使村子里许多人遭受痛苦。
words.en: If you are afflicted by pain, illness, or misfortune, it causes you great suffering and distress.

words.tr:
n. 酷刑；拷打
v. 拷打；折磨
words.ex: The prisoner suffered from torture during the war.
words.ex_cn: 这名囚犯在战争期间遭受了酷刑。
words.en: Torture is the act of deliberately inflicting severe physical or psychological pain on someone, typically to extract information or a confession, or as a punishment.

words.ex: Don't bother to clean the room, I'll do it later.
words.ex_cn: 别麻烦去打扫房间了，我稍后会做。
words.en: To bother someone means to cause them trouble or to annoy them.

words.ex: The university does a research assessment every year.
words.ex_cn: 大学每年进行一次研究评估。
words.en: The systematic process of evaluating the quality and impact of research activities and outputs, often used to inform funding decisions, policy making, and academic strategy.

words.tr: 名词短语。评估方法；评定方式
words.ex: The teacher uses simple assessment methods to check student progress.
words.ex_cn: 老师使用简单的评估方法来检查学生的进步。
words.en: Techniques or procedures used to evaluate learning, performance, or quality.

words.tr: n. 织物；（建筑物的）结构；
words.ex: The dress is made of soft fabric.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子是由柔软的织物制成的。
words.en: Fabric refers to cloth or other material produced by weaving together cotton, nylon, wool, silk, or other threads. It can also refer to the basic structure of a building or a system.

words.ex: The shirt is made of synthetic fabric.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫是合成纤维制成的。
words.en: Synthetic products are made from chemicals or artificial substances rather than from natural ones.

words.ex: They laid new tile in the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 他们在厨房铺了新的瓷砖。
words.en: A tile is a flat piece of baked clay, carpet, cork, or other material, used especially for covering roofs and floors.

words.ex: The texture of the bread is soft and fluffy.
words.ex_cn: 这种面包的质地柔软蓬松。
words.en: The feel, appearance, or consistency of a surface or a substance.

words.ex: My tutor helps me with math homework.
words.ex_cn: 我的导师帮我做数学作业。
words.en: A tutor is someone who gives private lessons to one pupil or a very small group of pupils.

words.ex: My mentor helped me choose my career path.
words.ex_cn: 我的导师帮助我选择了职业道路。
words.en: A mentor is a person who gives a younger or less experienced person help and advice over a period of time, especially at work or school.

words.ex: He hesitates to ask for help.
words.ex_cn: 他犹豫着是否要寻求帮助。
words.en: If you hesitate, you pause slightly while you are doing something or just before you do it, usually because you are uncertain, embarrassed, or worried.

words.ex: Farmers protect the topsoil to grow healthy crops.
words.ex_cn: 农民保护表土以种植健康的作物。
words.en: Topsoil is the upper layer of soil, usually the top 2 inches (5.1 cm) to 8 inches (20 cm). It has the highest concentration of organic matter and microorganisms and is where most of the Earth's biological soil activity occurs.

words.ex: He changed his job because of his background.
words.ex_cn: 他因为自己的背景换了工作。
words.en: The background is the situation that exists at a particular time, or the situation in which something happens, which helps to explain it.

words.ex: It is impossible to finish the race in five minutes.
words.ex_cn: 五分钟内完成比赛是不可能的。
words.en: If something is impossible, it cannot be done or cannot happen.

words.ex: The surgeon fixed the broken bone.
words.ex_cn: 外科医生修复了断裂的骨头。
words.en: A surgeon is a medical doctor who performs operations.

words.tr:
v. 承诺；答应；
n. 许诺；希望；成功的征兆（或理由）；
words.ex: He promised to help me with my homework.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺帮我做作业。
words.en: A promise is a statement that you will definitely do something or that something will definitely happen.

words.ex: We heard thunder during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风暴期间我们听到了雷声。
words.en: the loud noise that you hear during a storm, usually after a flash of lightning

words.tr: adj. 精致的；微妙的；易碎的；脆弱的；
words.ex: She wore a delicate lace dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条精致的蕾丝连衣裙去参加派对。
words.en: Something that is delicate is small and beautifully shaped. It can also be easily broken or damaged.

words.ex: The school changed its curriculum last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年学校更改了课程。
words.en: A curriculum is the subjects that are studied in a school, college, or university.

words.ex: The doctor found a tumor in his lung.
words.ex_cn: 医生在他的肺里发现了一个肿瘤。
words.en: A tumor is a mass of tissue that's formed by an accumulation of abnormal cells. Normally, the cells in your body age, die, and are replaced by new cells. With cancer and other tumors, something disrupts this cycle. Tumor cells grow, even though the body does not need them, and unlike normal old cells, they don't die. As this process goes on, the tumor continues to grow as more and more cells are added to the mass.

words.tr:
n. 谣言
v. 谣传
words.ex: The rumor spread quickly that the school would close.
words.ex_cn: 学校即将关闭的谣言迅速传播开来。
words.en: A rumor is a story or piece of information that may or may not be true, but that people are talking about.

words.ex: He went to a tutorial to understand math better.
words.ex_cn: 他去参加辅导以更好地理解数学。
words.en: A tutorial is a period of teaching and discussion with a tutor, especially in a British university or college.

words.tr: phrase. 将某事纳入考虑；考虑到某事；把…考虑进去
words.ex: Please take the weather into consideration before you go out.
words.ex_cn: 出门前请把天气考虑进去。
words.en: To include something in one's decision-making process.

words.tr: phrase. 考虑到某事物；将某因素纳入考量
words.ex: We must take the weather into account when planning the trip.
words.ex_cn: 计划旅行时，我们必须把天气考虑进去。
words.en: To consider or remember something when judging a situation.

words.tr: phrase. 是…的原因；解释；负责；（数量或比例上）占
words.ex: The rain can account for the delay.
words.ex_cn: 下雨是延误的原因。
words.en: If a particular thing accounts for a part or proportion of something, that part or proportion consists of that thing, or is used or produced by it.

words.ex: He was late on account of the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他迟到了，因为公交车。
words.en: Because of something; due to something.

words.tr: phrase. 向某人详细描述；向某人讲述……的情况
words.ex: He gave me an account of what happened last night.
words.ex_cn: 他向我详细描述了昨晚发生的事情。

words.tr: phrase. 绝不；无论如何都不
words.ex: Not on any account should you touch that wire.
words.ex_cn: 你绝不能碰那根电线。

words.ex: He spoke without hesitation.
words.ex_cn: 他毫不犹豫地说了。
words.en: Hesitation is the act of pausing before doing something, especially because you are nervous or not certain about it.

words.tr: phrase. 教育背景；受教育的经历
words.ex: He has a strong education background in science.
words.ex_cn: 他有扎实的科学教育背景。
words.en: The academic and professional qualifications one has acquired, especially those that are relevant to a particular field or job.

words.ex: He shares his cultural background with his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他向同学们分享自己的文化背景。
words.en: The cultural background refers to the customs, beliefs, and social norms that are characteristic of a particular society or group.

words.tr: phrase. 家庭背景；指一个人成长的家庭环境，包括父母的职业、教育水平、经济状况、文化背景等
words.ex: Her family background is very influential in her career.
words.ex_cn: 她的家庭背景对她的职业生涯影响很大。
words.en: The social, economic, and cultural circumstances of a person's family.

words.tr: phrase. 理论背景；指支撑某一研究或观点的理论基础或学术框架
words.ex: We need to understand the theoretical background of this experiment.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要了解这个实验的理论背景。
words.en: The knowledge or understanding of the theories and principles that form the basis of a subject or discipline.

words.ex: The restaurant plays soft background music.
words.ex_cn: 餐厅播放轻柔的背景音乐。
words.en: Music that is played quietly in the background to create a particular atmosphere or to accompany another activity.

words.ex: The physician checked the patient's temperature.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了病人的体温。
words.en: A physician is a medical doctor who is trained in the diagnosis and treatment of diseases and injuries.

words.tr: phrase. 牙科医生；牙外科医生
words.ex: The dental surgeon fixed my tooth.
words.ex_cn: 牙医给我修好了牙齿。
words.en: A medical specialist qualified to perform surgical procedures on the teeth, gums, and jaw.

words.ex: He tried to conceal the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他试图隐藏真相。
words.en: If you conceal something, you prevent it from being seen or known about.

words.tr:
v. 隐藏；躲藏；
n. 兽皮；
words.ex: He hides the key under the mat.
words.ex_cn: 他把钥匙藏在垫子下面。
words.en: To conceal something or someone from view or discovery.

words.tr: n. 牛皮，牛皮鞭；母牛皮，母牛皮革; vt. 用牛皮鞭抽打
words.ex: He used a cowhide whip to discipline the horse.
words.ex_cn: 他用牛皮鞭来管教马匹。
words.en: The skin of a cow, especially when used for leather.

words.ex: He bought a leather jacket for winter.
words.ex_cn: 他冬天买了一件皮夹克。
words.en: Leather is a material made from the skin of an animal by tanning or a similar process.

words.ex: The thunderstorm woke us up at night.
words.ex_cn: 雷雨在夜里把我们吵醒了。
words.en: A thunderstorm is a storm with thunder and lightning and typically also heavy rain or hail.

words.ex: A thundercloud is dark and moves slowly.
words.ex_cn: 雷雨云是黑色的，移动缓慢。
words.en: A thundercloud is a large, dark cloud that is associated with thunderstorms and often brings heavy rain, lightning, and thunder.

words.tr: phrase. 教学大纲；课程纲要
words.ex: The teacher explained the teaching syllabus at the beginning of the class.
words.ex_cn: 老师在课程开始时解释了教学大纲。
words.en: A structured plan of topics, content, and assessments to be covered in a course of study.

words.ex: The teacher gave us the syllabus for the course.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们这门课的教学大纲。
words.en: A syllabus is an outline or summary of the main points of a text, lecture, or course of study.

words.ex: The word 'cat' has one syllable.
words.ex_cn: 单词 'cat' 有一个音节。
words.en: A syllable is a unit of organization for a sequence of speech sounds. It is typically made up of a syllable nucleus (most often a vowel) with optional initial and final margins (typically, consonants).

words.ex: The layout of the room makes it feel bigger.
words.ex_cn: 房间的布局让它显得更大。
words.en: The way in which the parts of something are arranged or laid out.

words.tr:
n. 冒险事业；商业冒险；投机；
v. 冒险；投机；
words.ex: He started a new venture in technology.
words.ex_cn: 他创办了一项新的科技冒险事业。
words.en: If you venture somewhere, you go somewhere that might be dangerous. If you venture a question or statement, you say it in an uncertain way because you are afraid it might be stupid or wrong.

words.ex: The sweater shrinks in hot water.
words.ex_cn: 这件毛衣在热水中会收缩。
words.en: If something shrinks or you shrink it, it becomes smaller.

words.ex: The gland makes saliva in her mouth.
words.ex_cn: 这个腺体在她的嘴里产生唾液。
words.en: An organ in the body which produces and releases substances that perform a specific function in the body, such as hormones or sweat.

words.ex: There is a shortage of clean water in the village.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄的清洁用水不足。
words.en: A shortage is a situation in which there is not enough of something that is needed.

words.ex: The school received accreditation from the government.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校获得了政府的认可。
words.en: Accreditation is the act of granting credit or recognition, especially to an educational institution that maintains suitable standards.

words.tr: v. 归于；委托；授权；信任
words.ex: They accredit the discovery to the scientist.
words.ex_cn: 他们将这一发现归功于这位科学家。
words.en: To officially recognize or approve someone or something as having a particular status or meeting certain standards.

words.tr: phrase. 办公室的布局；办公室的平面布置
words.ex: The layout of an office affects how people work.
words.ex_cn: 办公室的布局影响人们的工作效率。

words.tr: phrase. 简历的布局；简历的版式设计
words.ex: The layout of a cv should be clear and simple.
words.ex_cn: 简历的布局应该清晰简单。

words.ex: The product layout of a supermarket helps customers find items easily.
words.ex_cn: 超市的商品布局帮助顾客轻松找到商品。

words.ex: He is working on his doctoral thesis in physics.
words.ex_cn: 他正在撰写他的物理学博士论文。
words.en: Relating to or constituting a doctorate.

words.tr: phrase. 冒险进入未知领域；探索陌生或不确定的境地
words.ex: He decided to venture into the unknown to find new land.
words.ex_cn: 他决定进入未知领域去寻找新土地。
words.en: To take a risk by exploring or engaging with something unknown.

words.tr: phrase. 冒险进入某事；涉足某领域
words.ex: He decided to venture into business with no experience.
words.ex_cn: 他决定冒险进入商业领域，尽管没有任何经验。

words.tr: phrase. 冒险做某事；大胆尝试某事
words.ex: He ventured on telling the truth despite the risk.
words.ex_cn: 尽管有风险，他还是冒险说了实话。

words.ex: He is studying anthropology at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学里学习人类学。
words.en: Anthropology is the study of human societies and cultures and their development.

words.ex: The tribe lives in a primitive hut.
words.ex_cn: 这个部落住在原始的小屋里。
words.en: Belonging to a very early period in the history of the world, or to a time before modern things existed.

words.ex: The primal forest has never been touched by humans.
words.ex_cn: 这片原始森林从未被人类触碰过。
words.en: Primal means relating to an early stage in the development of something, or being the most important or basic part of something.

words.ex: The forest looked primeval and untouched.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林看起来远古而未被破坏。
words.en: relating to the earliest ages of the world or the universe; ancient or prehistoric.

words.tr: adj. 首要的；小学的；初等的；原来的；最初的；
words.ex: Primary goal is to stay safe.
words.ex_cn: 首要目标是保持安全。
words.en: Something that is primary is more important than anything else.

words.ex: He did a preliminary test before the main experiment.
words.ex_cn: 他在主要实验之前做了一个初步测试。
words.en: Preliminary means something that is done or happens before the main part or event, especially as an introduction or preparation.

words.ex: The cloth shows shrinkage after washing.
words.ex_cn: 这块布在洗涤后出现了缩水。
words.en: The process, fact, or amount of shrinking.

words.ex: He had pain in his gallbladder after eating fried food.
words.ex_cn: 他吃完油炸食物后胆囊疼痛。
words.en: A small, pear-shaped organ located beneath the liver that stores and concentrates bile for digestion.

words.ex: He feels pain in his bladder.
words.ex_cn: 他感到膀胱疼痛。
words.en: A bladder is a part of your body that is shaped like a bag and holds urine until it is passed out of the body.

words.tr:
n. 胆汁；胆量；怨恨；磨伤
v. 使愤怒（尤指因不公平引起）
words.ex: The bitter gall made him feel sick.
words.ex_cn: 苦涩的胆汁让他感到恶心。
words.en: Gall can refer to a bitter liquid produced by the liver, or it can describe someone's boldness or impudence. It can also mean to irritate or annoy someone.

words.tr: adj. 松果体的；松果状的; n. 松果腺；松果体
words.ex: The pineal gland helps control sleep.
words.ex_cn: 松果体帮助调节睡眠。
words.en: Relating to the pineal gland, a small endocrine gland in the brain of vertebrates that produces melatonin.

words.ex: The pineal gland makes melatonin at night.
words.ex_cn: 松果体在晚上分泌褪黑素。
words.en: A small endocrine gland in the brain of vertebrates that produces melatonin, a hormone that affects the modulation of sleep patterns in both circadian and seasonal cycles.

words.tr: phrase. 资金短缺；财政不足
words.ex: He faced a financial shortage and could not pay his rent.
words.ex_cn: 他面临资金短缺，付不起房租。
words.en: A situation where there is not enough money available for a particular purpose.

words.ex: There is a shortage of spare time because of his busy job.
words.ex_cn: 由于他工作繁忙，空闲时间很缺乏。

words.ex: He greet his friend with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 他微笑着向朋友问好。
words.en: To greet someone means to say hello to them or to welcome them.

words.tr:
n. 缺乏；短缺；
v. 缺乏；短缺；
words.ex: There is a lack of clean water in the village.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄缺乏干净的水。
words.en: If there is a lack of something, there is not enough of it or it does not exist at all.

words.ex: His deficiency in math made him struggle in class.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学上的缺乏让他在课堂上很吃力。
words.en: A deficiency is a lack or shortage of something that is needed.

words.tr: n. 不足，不充分；机能不全；不适当
words.ex: The insufficiency of water caused the plants to die.
words.ex_cn: 水的不足导致植物死亡。
words.en: If there is an insufficiency of something, there is not enough of it for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The water in the pond was stagnant.
words.ex_cn: 池塘里的水不流动。
words.en: If something such as a business or economy is stagnant, there is little activity or change.

words.ex: Please attach the file to the email.
words.ex_cn: 请将文件附加到邮件中。
words.en: To attach something to something else means to fasten or join it to the other thing.

words.ex: He flipped the pancake with a spatula.
words.ex_cn: 他用铲子快速翻转了煎饼。
words.en: To flip something means to turn it over quickly one or more times, or to make something do this.

words.tr:
v. 评论；表达意见；
n. 评论；意见；
words.ex: He commented on the movie last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚对这部电影发表了评论。
words.en: A comment is something that you say which expresses your opinion of something or which gives an explanation of it.

words.tr:
n. 火焰
v. 燃烧；爆发；面红
words.ex: The candle flame flickered in the wind.
words.ex_cn: 蜡烛的火焰在风中摇曳。
words.en: A flame is a hot bright stream of burning gas that comes from something that is burning.

words.ex: He emphasizes the importance of homework.
words.ex_cn: 他强调作业的重要性。
words.en: To give special importance or prominence to (something) in speaking or writing.

words.tr: phrase. 依附于；连接到； attaching oneself or something to a person, object, or place
words.ex: The child attaches to his mother when he is scared.
words.ex_cn: 当孩子害怕时，他会依附于母亲。
words.en: To fasten, join, or connect something to something else.

words.tr: adj. 无能力的；不称职的；不能胜任的；
words.ex: He is incompetent at managing simple tasks.
words.ex_cn: 他无法胜任简单的任务。
words.en: If you describe someone as incompetent, you are criticizing them because they are unable to do their job or a task properly.

words.ex: He is a competent teacher who helps students easily.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有能力的老师，能轻松帮助学生。
words.en: If you are competent to do something, you have the skills, abilities, or experience necessary to do it well.

words.ex: He shows strong competency in math.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学方面表现出很强的能力。
words.en: Competency refers to the ability to do something successfully or efficiently.

words.ex: He has the calibre to lead the team.
words.ex_cn: 他有领导团队的能力。
words.en: The quality of someone's character or the level of their ability; the diameter of the inside of a tube, especially of a gun barrel.

words.tr:
v. 拍动；摆动；
n. 薄片；
words.ex: The bird flaps its wings to fly.
words.ex_cn: 鸟拍动翅膀飞翔。
words.en: A flap is a piece of cloth, paper, skin etc that is fixed at one edge to a surface, which you can lift up easily. If something such as a piece of cloth or paper flaps or if you flap it, it moves quickly up and down or from side to side.

words.ex: He did revision for his math test last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚为数学考试进行了复习。
words.en: The act or process of revising; a revised or new version, as of a book or other written material.

words.ex: He collates the papers before the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议前整理了这些文件。
words.en: To collate information or data means to collect it together and examine it carefully in order to compare it or find something out.

words.ex: The scientist calibrates the scale every morning.
words.ex_cn: 科学家每天早上标定秤。
words.en: To calibrate something means to mark or adjust it so that it can be used for measuring accurately.

words.tr: v. 使合乎标准；使合规格
words.ex: The school will standardize the test scores next month.
words.ex_cn: 学校下个月将统一评分标准。
words.en: To standardize something means to make it conform to a standard or norm, especially in order to ensure consistency and uniformity.

words.ex: The teacher will allot five minutes for questions.
words.ex_cn: 老师会分配五分钟提问。
words.en: If something is allotted to someone, it is given to them as their share.

words.ex: The teacher will allocate books to students.
words.ex_cn: 老师将给学生分配书籍。
words.en: To allocate something means to give it to a particular person or use it for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The teacher will distribute the books to students.
words.ex_cn: 老师将把书分发给学生。
words.en: If you distribute things, you hand them or deliver them to a number of people.

words.ex: The teacher will assign homework today.
words.ex_cn: 老师今天会布置作业。
words.en: To give someone a particular job or task; to allocate a resource or responsibility to a particular person or purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 评论；发表意见关于
words.ex: He comment about the weather every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都评论天气。
words.en: To express an opinion or observation on a subject.

words.ex: He will comment on the game after it ends.
words.ex_cn: 比赛结束后，他会对此发表评论。
words.en: To express an opinion or reaction about something.

words.ex: The commentator explained the game clearly.
words.ex_cn: 评论员清晰地解释了比赛。
words.en: A commentator is someone who gives a commentary on something such as a sports event or a television program.

words.tr:
v. 落下；
adj. 点亮的；
words.ex: The bird alighted on the tree.
words.ex_cn: 鸟落在了树上。
words.en: If someone alights from a vehicle or if they alight, they get out of it after a journey.

words.tr:
v. 开始燃烧；开始烧
adj. 燃烧的；烧尽的
words.ex: The wood combusts quickly in the fire.
words.ex_cn: 木头在火中迅速燃烧。
words.en: To burn or cause to burn; to consume by fire.

words.ex: He touched his cheek gently.
words.ex_cn: 他轻轻摸了摸脸颊。
words.en: The soft part of a person's face below the eye and between the nose and ear.

words.ex: I cannot foresee what will happen tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我无法预知明天会发生什么。
words.en: If you foresee something, you expect and believe that it will happen.

words.tr: adj. 有历史意义的；历史性的；
words.ex: This is a historic moment for our country.
words.ex_cn: 这是对我们国家有历史意义的时刻。
words.en: Something that is historic is important in history, or potentially so.

words.ex: The ship carries a provision of food for the journey.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船为旅程准备了食物供应。
words.en: A provision is a condition or requirement in a legal document. It can also refer to the act of supplying or providing something that is needed.

words.ex: The president signed the new contract.
words.ex_cn: 总裁签署了新合同。
words.en: The president is the elected head of a republic or the head of a company or organization.

words.ex: The internist treats adults with heart problems.
words.ex_cn: 内科医生治疗成人心脏问题。
words.en: An internist is a doctor who specializes in the diagnosis and medical treatment of adults.

words.ex: The physician checked the patient's temperature.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了病人的体温。
words.en: A physician is a medical doctor who is trained in the diagnosis and treatment of diseases and injuries.

words.ex: The surgeon fixed the broken bone.
words.ex_cn: 外科医生修复了断裂的骨头。
words.en: A surgeon is a medical doctor who performs operations.

words.ex: The oculist checked his eyes last week.
words.ex_cn: 眼科医生上周检查了他的眼睛。
words.en: An oculist is a medical doctor who specializes in the diagnosis and treatment of eye disorders and diseases.

words.ex: The dental physician fixed my toothache.
words.ex_cn: 牙科医生治好了我的牙痛。

words.ex: The reception at the hotel was very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的接待非常友好。
words.en: The act of receiving or being received, especially in a formal or official context.

words.tr: v. 暂停；中止；延期； suspending
words.ex: The school will suspend the class due to snow.
words.ex_cn: 由于下雪，学校将暂停课程。
words.en: If you suspend something, you delay it or stop it from happening for a while or until a decision is made about it.

words.tr: adj. 不能信赖的；不可靠的；
words.ex: He is untrustworthy because he always lies.
words.ex_cn: 他总是撒谎，所以不可信赖。
words.en: If you describe someone as untrustworthy, you think they are not reliable and cannot be trusted.

words.tr: n. 前任；前辈；原有事物
words.ex: He became the new manager, replacing his predecessor.
words.ex_cn: 他成为了新经理，接替了他的前任。
words.en: A predecessor is someone who had a job or a position before someone else, or something that comes before another thing in time or in a series.

words.ex: He propose to go to the park after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他提议午饭后去公园。
words.en: If you propose something, you suggest it as a plan or course of action.

words.ex: He made a proposal to improve the school lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他提出了一个改善学校午餐的提案。
words.en: A proposal is a plan or suggestion, especially a formal one that is put forward for people to think about and decide upon.

words.tr: v. 提议；“propose”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 被提议的；
words.ex: He proposed a new plan to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他提议了一个新的省钱计划。
words.en: If you propose something such as a plan or an idea, you suggest it for people to think about and decide upon.

words.ex: The old woman predict rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 那位老妇人预言明天会下雨。
words.en: If you predict an event, you say that it will happen.

words.ex: He can foretell the weather by looking at the sky.
words.ex_cn: 他可以通过观察天空来预知天气。
words.en: To tell or indicate beforehand; predict.

words.tr:
n. 预测；预报；
v. 预测；预报；
words.ex: The weather forecast says it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 天气预测说明天会下雨。
words.en: If you forecast future events, you say what you think is going to happen in the future.

words.ex: The moon landing was a historical moment.
words.ex_cn: 登月是一个历史时刻。

words.ex: The ship arrived at the dock at sunrise.
words.ex_cn: 船在日出时到达了码头。
words.en: A dock is an enclosed area of water in a port where ships go to be loaded, unloaded, and repaired.

words.ex: Farmers grow grain like wheat and rice.
words.ex_cn: 农民种植小麦和大米等谷物。
words.en: A grain is a small, hard seed of a food plant such as wheat, rice, or corn, or the plant itself.

words.ex: He grinds the coffee beans into powder.
words.ex_cn: 他把咖啡豆碾成粉末。
words.en: To reduce something to small particles or powder by crushing it.

words.tr: phrase. 预先准备；预先安排；为…做好准备；预留款项
words.ex: We need to make provision for the possibility of bad weather.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要为可能出现的坏天气做好准备。
words.en: To make provision means to prepare for something or to make arrangements for something that might happen in the future.

words.ex: He was paid under the provision of the contract.
words.ex_cn: 他根据合同条款获得报酬。

words.ex: The preparation for the exam took two weeks.
words.ex_cn: 考试的准备花了两周时间。
words.en: Preparation is the process of getting something ready for use or for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The sentence has a clause that explains why he left.
words.ex_cn: 这个句子有一个解释他为什么离开的从句。
words.en: A clause is a particular section of a legal document such as a contract, will, or treaty, that contains a condition or stipulation.

words.ex: He eats healthy food every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃健康的食物。
words.en: Food is what people and animals eat to live and grow.

words.ex: The presidential speech was broadcast on TV.
words.ex_cn: 总统的演讲在电视上播出。
words.en: Relating to a president or presidency.

words.ex: The refugees went to the reception centre for help.
words.ex_cn: 难民们去接待中心寻求帮助。
words.en: A reception centre is a place where visitors or new arrivals are received and provided with information or assistance.

words.ex: He asked for help at the reception desk.
words.ex_cn: 他在前台寻求帮助。
words.en: A reception desk is a counter or desk in a public area of a building where visitors or guests are received and attended to.

words.ex: He lives in the dormitory with three roommates.
words.ex_cn: 他和三个室友住在宿舍里。
words.en: A dormitory is a large bedroom where many people sleep, especially in a school or college.

words.ex: The receptionist greeted the visitors with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 接待员微笑着迎接了访客。
words.en: A receptionist is a person whose job is to deal with people arriving at or telephoning a hotel, office building, doctor's surgery, etc.

words.tr: v. 悬浮；暂停；“suspend”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The particles are suspended in water.
words.ex_cn: 这些颗粒悬浮在水中。
words.en: If something is suspended, it is hanging from somewhere or is not moving or active for a period of time.

words.tr: n. 吊袜带；悬挂用的物体
words.ex: She wore a dress with white suspenders.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条带有白色吊袜带的裙子。
words.en: A suspender is a strap or band worn over the shoulders to hold up trousers or a skirt.

words.ex: The police suspended his driving licence after he drove drunk.
words.ex_cn: 警察在他酒后驾车后暂停了他的驾驶执照。

words.ex: The company will suspend payment until the contract is signed.
words.ex_cn: 公司将暂停付款，直到合同签署。

words.ex: He is a prospective student at Harvard.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的预期学生。
words.en: Prospective is used to describe someone or something that is expected or likely to happen or be in the future.

words.ex: The percentage of students who passed the test was 85.
words.ex_cn: 通过考试的学生百分比是85。
words.en: A percentage is a proportion or ratio expressed as a fraction of 100.

words.ex: The police found a clue at the crime scene.
words.ex_cn: 警察在犯罪现场找到了一条线索。
words.en: A clue is an object or piece of information that helps to solve a problem or mystery.

words.tr: n. 暗示；提示；有益的建议；
words.ex: He gave me a hint about the surprise party.
words.ex_cn: 他给了我关于惊喜派对的暗示。
words.en: A hint is a slight or indirect indication or suggestion.

words.tr:
v. 口吃；结结巴巴地说
n. 口吃；结巴
words.ex: He stammers when he is nervous.
words.ex_cn: 他紧张时会结巴。
words.en: If someone stammers, they speak with difficulty, hesitating and repeating words or sounds.

words.tr:
v. 口吃；结结巴巴地说；缓慢地颠簸前进
n. 口吃；结巴
words.ex: He stutters when he is nervous.
words.ex_cn: 当他紧张时，他会结巴。
words.en: If someone stutters, they have difficulty speaking because they find it hard to say the first sound of a word, and so they often hesitate or repeat that sound several times.

words.ex: The swamp is full of tall grass and frogs.
words.ex_cn: 这个沼泽里长满了高草和青蛙。
words.en: A swamp is an area of low-lying, uncultivated ground where water collects; a bog or marsh.

words.ex: He is jealous of his brother's new bike.
words.ex_cn: 他嫉妒他弟弟的新自行车。
words.en: If someone is jealous, they feel angry or bitter because they think that another person is trying to take a lover or friend, or a possession, away from them.

words.tr:
n. 喜爱；赞同；
v. 赞成；偏爱；有利于；
words.ex: He has a favour for chocolate ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 他特别喜欢巧克力冰淇淋。
words.en: If you regard something or someone with favour, you like or support them.

words.tr: adj. 易变的；无常的；感情不专的
words.ex: He is fickle and changes his mind every day.
words.ex_cn: 他善变，每天都会改变主意。
words.en: If you describe someone as fickle, you disapprove of them because they keep changing their mind about what they like or want.

words.tr:
adj. 漫长而艰难的；
adv. 朝上坡方向；
words.ex: Losing weight is an uphill task for many people.
words.ex_cn: 对许多人来说，减肥是一项漫长而艰难的任务。
words.en: If something is uphill, it is going up a slope or hill. If you say that something is uphill, you mean that it is difficult and requires effort.

words.ex: The team's defence was very strong in the match.
words.ex_cn: 这支队伍在比赛中防守非常坚强。
words.en: The action of defending from or resisting attack.

words.ex: The prospect of a better job makes him happy.
words.ex_cn: 更好工作的前景让他感到高兴。
words.en: A prospect is the possibility that something will happen, or a view of a wide area.

words.tr: phrase. 由……组成；构成（注意：正确搭配应为 'composed of'，'compose of' 常见于误用，正确表达为 'be composed of'，意为 '由……组成'）
words.ex: Water is compose of hydrogen and oxygen.
words.ex_cn: 水由氢和氧组成。
words.en: To be made up of; to consist of.

words.tr: phrase. 预期的损害；潜在的损害
words.ex: The contract lists the prospective damage if the project is delayed.
words.ex_cn: 合同列出了项目延误时预期的损害。

words.ex: I anticipate rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我预料明天会下雨。
words.en: If you anticipate an event, you realize in advance that it may happen and you are prepared for it.

words.ex: He is an eminent scientist who won the Nobel Prize.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位获得诺贝尔奖的杰出科学家。
words.en: An eminent person is well-known and respected, especially because they are good at their profession.

words.tr: adj. 卓越的；杰出的；出类拔萃的
words.ex: He is a preeminent scientist in his field.
words.ex_cn: 他是该领域最杰出的科学家。
words.en: Standing out in importance or reputation; superior to all others.

words.tr: adj. 即将发生的；临近的；
words.ex: An imminent storm is coming soon.
words.ex_cn: 一场即将发生的风暴很快就要来了。
words.en: If you say that something is imminent, especially something unpleasant, you mean it is almost certain to happen very soon.

words.tr: v. 预料；“anticipate”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 预期的；
words.ex: He anticipated the rain and brought an umbrella.
words.ex_cn: 他预料到会下雨，所以带了伞。
words.en: If you anticipate an event, you realize in advance that it may happen and you are prepared for it.

words.tr: n. 劳动力；工人总数；职工总数；
words.ex: The factory needs a larger workforce to meet demand.
words.ex_cn: 工厂需要更多的劳动力来满足需求。
words.en: The workforce is the total number of people who are employed by a particular company or who are available to work in a particular country or area.

words.tr:
n. 元帅；高级军官；典礼官；消防局长
v. 整理；集结
words.ex: The marshal led the army into battle.
words.ex_cn: 元帅率领军队上战场。
words.en: A marshal is a high-ranking officer in the armed forces, especially in the army or air force, or a person who arranges or directs a public event.

words.ex: The birds live in a quiet marsh.
words.ex_cn: 这些鸟生活在一片宁静的沼泽中。
words.en: A marsh is an area of low-lying land which is flooded in wet seasons or at high tide, and typically remains waterlogged at all times.

words.ex: He practices martial arts every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天练习武术。
words.en: Martial is used to describe things relating to soldiers or war.

words.tr: v. 使不知所措；使无法解决；击败；压垮；淹没
words.ex: The homework overwhelms her every night.
words.ex_cn: 每天晚上的作业让她感到不堪重负。
words.en: To overwhelm means to bury or drown beneath a huge mass of something, or to defeat someone completely.

words.tr:
v. 轻弹；轻击；轻拂；忽然摇动
n. 轻弹；轻拂；快速的轻打
words.ex: He flicked the light switch on.
words.ex_cn: 他 flick 了一下电灯开关。
words.en: To move or hit something with a quick, sharp movement.

words.ex: The candle's flicker lit up the dark room.
words.ex_cn: 蜡烛的闪现照亮了黑暗的房间。
words.en: If a light or flame flickers, it shines unsteadily.

words.ex: The glow of the fire warmed the room.
words.ex_cn: 火的炽热温暖了房间。
words.en: If something glows, it produces a dull, steady light.

words.tr:
v. （使）发痒；胳肢；逗乐
n. 痒；胳肢；呵痒
words.ex: The feather tickles my arm.
words.ex_cn: 羽毛挠得我手臂发痒。
words.en: If something tickles you, it touches you in a way that makes you laugh or feel slightly uncomfortable, usually because it is touching a sensitive part of your body. If something tickles you, it also makes you feel amused or pleased.

words.tr:
v. 滴流；慢慢移动
n. 细流；徐徐地流
words.ex: Water trickles down the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 水从山上缓缓流下。
words.en: If a liquid trickles somewhere, it flows slowly in a thin stream.

words.ex: Plants have natural defence mechanisms against insects.
words.ex_cn: 植物有对抗昆虫的天然防御机制。

words.tr: phrase. 对…的防御；抵御…的保护措施
words.ex: The shield provides defence against arrows.
words.ex_cn: 这个盾牌提供对箭矢的防御。
words.en: An action or argument used to protect oneself or something from attack, criticism, or harm.

words.tr: adj. 加强的； v. 增强；“reinforce”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The concrete wall is reinforced with steel bars.
words.ex_cn: 这堵混凝土墙用钢筋加固了。
words.en: To reinforce something means to make it stronger or more able to withstand pressure, especially by adding extra material or support.

words.tr:
v. 促进；使增长；
n. 提高；增强；
words.ex: Exercise can boost your energy.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以促进你的精力。
words.en: If one thing boosts another, it causes it to increase, improve, or be more successful.

words.ex: Exercise can strengthen your muscles.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以增强你的肌肉。
words.en: To strengthen something means to make it stronger or more effective.

words.ex: Exercise can enhance your health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以提高你的健康。
words.en: To enhance something means to improve its value, quality, or attractiveness.

words.ex: Her hard work led to success.
words.ex_cn: 她的努力带来了成功。
words.en: The achievement of something desired, planned, or attempted.

words.ex: The survey asks about your gender.
words.ex_cn: 这个调查询问你的性别。
words.en: Gender is the state of being male or female, especially when considered with reference to social and cultural differences, not just biological ones.

words.ex: He missed three consecutive days of school.
words.ex_cn: 他连续三天没上学。
words.en: Consecutive events, numbers, etc. follow one after another without an interruption.

words.ex: The loud music was a diversion from his worries.
words.ex_cn: 那嘈杂的音乐分散了他对烦恼的注意力。
words.en: A diversion is an action or event that attracts your attention away from what you are doing or should be doing.

words.ex: He donate money to the poor children.
words.ex_cn: 他向贫困儿童捐赠钱。
words.en: To donate means to give something, especially money, to a person or organization that needs help.

words.ex: The volume of the box is 10 cubic meters.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子的体积是10立方米。
words.en: A volume is a book, especially one that is part of a series of books. It can also refer to the amount of space that a substance or object occupies, or the level of sound produced by a television, radio, etc.

words.ex: I asked for a refund after the product broke.
words.ex_cn: 产品坏了之后，我要求退款。
words.en: A refund is a sum of money that is returned to you, for example because you have paid too much or because you have returned goods to a shop.

words.tr: phrase. 成功做成某事；在做某事上取得成功
words.ex: He will succeed in doing something if he works hard.
words.ex_cn: 如果他努力，他就会成功做成某事。
words.en: To achieve a desired outcome or complete a task successfully.

words.tr: phrase. 性别平等；指男女在权利、机会、资源和待遇等方面享有平等的地位和机会
words.ex: The school promotes gender equality in all classes.
words.ex_cn: 学校在所有课程中促进性别平等。
words.en: Gender equality refers to the state in which access to rights or opportunities is unaffected by gender.

words.tr: v. 使减细；使减小；使减弱
words.ex: The wire attenuates as it gets longer.
words.ex_cn: 这根电线随着变长而变细。
words.en: To reduce the force, effect, or value of something.

words.tr: v. 叙述；给（电视或电影）作旁白
words.ex: He will narrate the story to his little sister.
words.ex_cn: 他将为他的小妹妹讲述这个故事。
words.en: If you narrate a story, you tell it from your own point of view.

words.tr:
n. 叙述；叙事；
adj. 叙述性的；
words.ex: He told a simple narrative about his childhood.
words.ex_cn: 他讲了一个关于他童年的简单故事。
words.en: A narrative is a story or an account of a series of events.

words.ex: He worked for five consecutive days without rest.
words.ex_cn: 他连续五天没有休息地工作。

words.ex: He won the championship for three consecutive years.
words.ex_cn: 他连续三年赢得了冠军。

words.tr:
n. 反面；
v. 使倒转；（使）倒车；撤销；
words.ex: The reverse of the coin has a picture of a tree.
words.ex_cn: 硬币的反面有一棵树的图案。
words.en: If you reverse the order of a set of things, you arrange them in the opposite order, so that the first thing comes last.

words.ex: The road was diverted around the park.
words.ex_cn: 这条路被改道绕过公园。
words.en: If you divert someone or something, you cause them to change direction or to go somewhere different.

words.tr: adj. 不同的；多种多样的；
words.ex: The class has diverse students from many countries.
words.ex_cn: 这个班级有来自许多国家的不同学生。
words.en: If a group or range of things is diverse, it is made up of a wide variety of things.

words.ex: The adverse weather delayed the flight.
words.ex_cn: 不利的天气延误了航班。
words.en: If something is adverse, it is harmful or unfavorable.

words.tr: 短语动词. 制造混乱以转移注意力；声东击西
words.ex: He created a diversion to escape.
words.ex_cn: 他制造了一个分散注意力的举动来逃跑。
words.en: To deliberately draw attention away from something, especially to distract someone.

words.ex: They donate money and materials to help the poor.
words.ex_cn: 他们捐赠金钱和物资来帮助穷人。

words.ex: The hospital received a donation of books.
words.ex_cn: 医院收到了一批书籍捐赠。
words.en: A donation is a gift which is given to a charity or other organization.

words.ex: The donator gave money to the children's hospital.
words.ex_cn: 捐赠者向儿童医院捐了钱。
words.en: A donator is someone who gives something, such as money or goods, to a person or organization, especially for a good cause.

words.tr: v. 贡献；促成；捐献；投稿；
words.ex: He contributes money to the charity.
words.ex_cn: 他向慈善机构捐款。
words.en: If you contribute to something, you help to cause it or make it happen.

words.tr:
adj. 目前的；在场的；
n. 目前；礼物；
v. 呈现；提出；
words.ex: The present situation is very difficult.
words.ex_cn: 目前的形势非常困难。
words.en: If you say that someone is present at an event, you mean that they are there.

words.ex: He drinks two litres of water every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天喝两升水。
words.en: A litre is a metric unit of capacity, formerly defined as the volume of one kilogram of pure water under standard conditions; now equal to 1,000 cubic centimetres (or approximately 1.75 pints).

words.ex: He got a full refund for the broken phone.
words.ex_cn: 他因为坏了的手机得到了全额退款。
words.en: A full refund is the return of the entire amount of money paid for a product or service, typically due to dissatisfaction or defect.

words.ex: The store gave me a refund because the product was broken.
words.ex_cn: 商店因为我买的产品坏了而给我退款。

words.tr: adj. 可归还的；可退还的；
words.ex: The deposit is refundable if you return the item.
words.ex_cn: 如果你退回物品，押金是可以退还的。
words.en: If something is refundable, it means that the money you have paid for it can be returned to you under certain conditions.

words.ex: The company will reimburse you for your travel expenses.
words.ex_cn: 公司会报销你的旅行费用。
words.en: If you reimburse someone for something, you pay them back the money that they have spent or lost because of it.

words.ex: He asked for reimbursement for his travel costs.
words.ex_cn: 他要求报销旅行费用。
words.en: The act of compensating someone for an expense or loss incurred.

words.ex: He went outside regardless of the rain.
words.ex_cn: 他不顾下雨就出去了。
words.en: If you say that someone does something regardless, you mean that they do it without taking account of the possible problems or difficulties.

words.tr: v. 加浮雕花纹于；饰以浮饰；使凸出
words.ex: He embosses the card with his name.
words.ex_cn: 他把名字压印在卡片上。
words.en: To decorate a surface by making raised designs or patterns on it.

words.tr:
n. 国际主义者
adj. 国际主义的
words.ex: He is an internationalist who supports global cooperation.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位支持全球合作的国际主义者。
words.en: An internationalist is someone who believes that nations should work together and help each other.

words.ex: The wind scatter the leaves everywhere.
words.ex_cn: 风把树叶吹得四处分散。
words.en: To scatter means to throw or drop things over a wide area in an irregular way, or to cause a group of people or animals to move apart in different directions.

words.ex: He has an appetite for spicy food.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢辛辣食物。
words.en: A desire or liking for something, especially food.

words.ex: She tried to prevail on him to change his mind.
words.ex_cn: 她试图劝服他改变主意。
words.en: If a proposal, principle, or opinion prevails, it gains influence or is accepted, often after a struggle or argument.

words.ex: He checked the glossary for the meaning of new words.
words.ex_cn: 他查阅了术语表以了解新词的含义。
words.en: A glossary is a list of terms in a particular domain of knowledge with the definitions for those terms.

words.ex: The company's consolidation improved its market position.
words.ex_cn: 公司的巩固增强了其市场地位。
words.en: The act of combining two or more things into a single more effective or coherent whole.

words.ex: He lives in a big mansion near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他住在湖边的一座大宅子里。
words.en: A mansion is a very large, impressive house, especially one that is the home of a wealthy or important person.

words.ex: The nail protrudes from the wood.
words.ex_cn: 钉子从木头里凸出来。
words.en: If something protrudes from somewhere, it sticks out.

words.ex: They decided to embank the river to prevent flooding.
words.ex_cn: v. 他们决定筑堤围住河流以防止洪水。
words.en: To provide or protect with a bank or mound, especially to prevent flooding.

words.ex: He decided to embark on a new career.
words.ex_cn: 他决定从事一份新职业。
words.en: To embark on something means to start it, especially something new, difficult, or exciting.
