words.ex_cn: 这种药对感冒无效。
words.en: If someone or something is ineffective, they do not achieve the intended result.

words.ex: The reservoir provides water for the nearby town.
words.ex_cn: 这个水库为附近的城镇提供水源。
words.en: A reservoir is a large quantity of a substance that is stored and can be used when needed.

words.ex: The adverse weather delayed the flight.
words.ex_cn: 不利的天气延误了航班。
words.en: If something is adverse, it is harmful or unfavorable.

words.ex: He faced his adversary in the final match.
words.ex_cn: 他在决赛中对阵对手。
words.en: An adversary is someone who you are competing with, or who is opposing you or what you are trying to do.

words.ex: He defeated his opponent in the chess game.
words.ex_cn: 他在国际象棋比赛中击败了对手。
words.en: An opponent is someone who is competing against you in a contest, game, or argument, or someone who is opposed to an idea or plan.

words.ex: He stayed strong through adversity.
words.ex_cn: 他在逆境中保持坚强。
words.en: Adversity refers to a difficult or unlucky situation or event.

words.tr:
n. 保护区；储备；保留；
v. 预订；
words.ex: The wildlife reserve is home to many endangered animals.
words.ex_cn: 这个自然保护区是许多濒危动物的家园。
words.en: If you reserve something such as a table, ticket, or magazine, you arrange for it to be kept for you and not given to anyone else.

words.ex: His love of music stems from his childhood.
words.ex_cn: 他对音乐的热爱源于他的童年。
words.en: If a condition or problem stems from something, it was caused originally by that thing.

words.ex: This tradition originates from ancient times.
words.ex_cn: 这个传统起源于古代。
words.en: To come from a particular place or start in a particular situation.

words.ex: This word derives from Latin.
words.ex_cn: 这个词源自拉丁语。
words.en: To obtain something from a specified source.

words.tr: n. 普通教育；基础教育
words.ex: He received normal education in a public school.
words.ex_cn: 他在公立学校接受了普通教育。

words.ex: After the surgery, he returned to his normal state.
words.ex_cn: 手术后，他恢复了正常状态。

words.ex: The noise was 80 decibels.
words.ex_cn: 噪音是80分贝。
words.en: A decibel is a unit used to measure the intensity of a sound or the power level of an electrical signal by comparing it with a given level on a logarithmic scale.

words.ex: He crossed the threshold of adulthood at 18.
words.ex_cn: 他在18岁时进入了成年的起始点。
words.en: The threshold of something is the point at which it begins or changes.

words.ex: He normally goes to bed at 10 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 他通常晚上10点睡觉。
words.en: If you say that something normally happens or that you normally do a particular thing, you mean that it is what usually happens or what you usually do.

words.ex: He generalized the results from the small group to everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他将小群体的结果概括为全体情况。
words.en: If you generalize, you say something that seems to be true in most situations or for most people, but that may not be completely true in all cases.

words.tr:
n. 秘密；
adj. 秘密的；
words.ex: He kept the secret from everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他把秘密藏了起来，谁也没告诉。
words.en: If something is secret, it is known about by only a small number of people, and is not told or shown to anyone else.

words.tr: n. 胎儿教育（指在胎儿发育阶段进行的早期教育）
words.ex: Some mothers listen to music for foetus education.
words.ex_cn: 一些母亲通过听音乐来进行胎儿教育。

words.ex: The gland secrete sweat to cool the body.
words.ex_cn: 腺体分泌汗液来降温。
words.en: If part of a plant, animal, or human secretes a liquid or substance, it produces it.

words.ex: The roller coaster gave her a thrill.
words.ex_cn: 过山车让她感到兴奋。
words.en: A thrill is a sudden feeling of great excitement, pleasure, or fear.

words.ex: The merger of two companies created a bigger business.
words.ex_cn: 两家公司的合并创建了一家更大的企业。
words.en: A merger is the joining together of two separate companies or organizations so that they become one.

words.ex: The house has a small annex for storage.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子有一个用于存放物品的小附属物。
words.en: To annex means to take control of a country, region, etc., especially by force; to add an area or region to a country, state, etc. : to take control of (a territory or place).

words.tr: n. 惊险小说（或戏剧、电影）；
words.ex: He loves watching thriller movies at night.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢晚上看惊险电影。
words.en: A thriller is a book, film, or play that tells an exciting story about something such as criminal activities or spying.

words.ex: The kidneys excrete waste from the body.
words.ex_cn: 肾脏将废物排出体外。
words.en: If someone excretes waste matter from their body, they get rid of it in faeces, urine, or sweat.

words.ex: The dog left its excreta on the grass.
words.ex_cn: 狗在草地上留下了排泄物。
words.en: Waste matter discharged from the body, especially feces and urine.

words.ex: The dog left excrement on the grass.
words.ex_cn: 狗在草地上留下了粪便。
words.en: Excrement is waste matter that is excreted from the body, especially feces.

words.ex: He is aware of the danger.
words.ex_cn: 他意识到危险。
words.en: If you are aware of something, you know about it.

words.tr:
n. 标签；
v. 用标签标明；
words.ex: The bottle has a label with the name of the drink.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子上有一个写着饮料名称的标签。
words.en: A label is a piece of paper, polymer, cloth, metal, or other material affixed to a container or article, on which is written or printed information or symbols about the product or item.

words.tr:
v. 保证；确保；
n. 保证；保证书；
words.ex: The store guarantees a refund if you are not happy.
words.ex_cn: 如果你不满意，商店保证退款。
words.en: A guarantee is a formal promise that certain conditions will be fulfilled, especially that a product will be repaired or replaced if it is not of a specified quality.

words.tr: n. 相互关联；相互联系
words.ex: The interrelationship between sleep and mood is clear.
words.ex_cn: 睡眠与情绪之间的相互关系是明显的。
words.en: An interrelationship is a close connection between two or more things or people.

words.ex: He bought new stationery for school.
words.ex_cn: 他为学校买了新的文具。
words.en: Stationery refers to the materials used for writing, such as paper, pens, and envelopes.

words.ex: The building is made of limestone.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑是由石灰岩建造的。
words.en: Limestone is a sedimentary rock composed largely of the mineral calcite (calcium carbonate: CaCO3).

words.tr: phrase. 意识到；察觉到；知道
words.ex: Be aware of the danger near the river.
words.ex_cn: 注意河边的危险。
words.en: To have knowledge or understanding of something.

words.tr: n. 生态学家；生态学者；
words.ex: The ecologist studied birds in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这位生态学家研究了森林里的鸟类。
words.en: An ecologist is a scientist who studies the relationships between living things and their environment.

words.tr: adj. 没意识到的；不知道的；
words.ex: He was unaware of the rain until he got wet.
words.ex_cn: 他直到被淋湿了才意识到下雨了。
words.en: If you are unaware of something, you do not know about it.

words.ex: He has awareness of the environmental problems.
words.ex_cn: 他意识到环境问题。
words.en: Knowledge or perception of a situation or fact.

words.ex: The team is composed of five players.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队由五名队员组成。
words.en: If something is composed of particular things, people, or elements, it is made from those things, people, or elements.

words.ex: They labeled him as a hero.
words.ex_cn: 他们将他标记为英雄。

words.ex: He put the lid on the box.
words.ex_cn: 他把盖子盖在盒子上。
words.en: A lid is a cover for a container, or the movable cover of the eye, known as the eyelid.

words.ex: Five apples constitute a basket.
words.ex_cn: 五个苹果构成一篮子。
words.en: If something constitutes a particular thing, it can be regarded as being that thing.

words.ex: The team comprises five players and one coach.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队包括五名球员和一名教练。
words.en: If you say that something comprises or is comprised of a number of things or people, you mean it has them as its parts or members.

words.tr: v. 向某人保证；向某人担保
words.ex: I guarantee to you that the package will arrive tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我向你保证，包裹明天会到。

words.ex: I guarantee you a good grade if you study hard.
words.ex_cn: 如果你努力学习，我保证你取得好成绩。

words.ex: I managed to finish my homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我设法在晚饭前完成了作业。
words.en: To manage means to be in charge of or control something, especially a business or a group of people.

words.ex: The chair is stationary and does not move.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子是固定的，不会移动。
words.en: not moving or not intended to be moved

words.tr: adj. 固定的；不能变的； v. 修理；固定；确定；“fix”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He has a fixed schedule every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都有一个固定的日程。
words.en: If something is fixed, it is attached or positioned so that it cannot move, or is arranged in a particular way and cannot be changed.

words.ex: Farmers spread lime on the soil to make it less acidic.
words.ex_cn: 农民在土壤上撒石灰以降低其酸性。
words.en: Lime is a white substance obtained by heating limestone, used in making cement and in farming to improve soil. It is also a small green fruit that is similar to a lemon.

words.ex: Lye is a strong alkali used in cleaning.
words.ex_cn: 氢氧化钠是一种用于清洁的强碱。
words.en: An alkali is a chemical compound that neutralizes acids to form salts and turns red litmus paper blue.

words.ex: The teacher writes on the board with chalk.
words.ex_cn: 老师用粉笔在黑板上写字。
words.en: A soft white limestone (calcium carbonate) formed from the skeletal remains of sea creatures.

words.tr: phrase. 设法做成某事；成功完成某事
words.ex: He manages to do his homework every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都能设法完成作业。
words.en: To succeed in doing something, especially something that requires effort or skill.

words.tr:
pron. 我的（东西）；
n. 矿；
v. 采矿；
words.ex: This book is mine.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是我的。
words.en: Used to refer to a thing or things belonging to or associated with the speaker. A place where minerals are extracted from the earth. To extract minerals from the earth.

words.ex: The dog fell into a deep pit.
words.ex_cn: 狗掉进了一个深坑。
words.en: A pit is a large hole in the ground, either natural or as a result of digging. It can also refer to a hollow or indentation in a surface, or a place where something is extracted, such as a mine. As a verb, to pit means to set someone or something in competition or to make a hollow or indentation in a surface.

words.ex: He acted on impulse and bought the car.
words.ex_cn: 他一时冲动买了那辆车。
words.en: An impulse is a sudden strong desire to do something without thinking about the consequences.

words.tr:
n. 蜡；
v. 给…上蜡；
words.ex: Bees make wax to build their hives.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂用蜡建造蜂巢。
words.en: Wax is a solid, slightly shiny substance made of fat or oil that is used to make candles, polish, and other products. It can also refer to the process of applying wax to something or the natural substance found in the ear.

words.ex: The injury incapacitated him for weeks.
words.ex_cn: 这次受伤使他几周无法行动。
words.en: To make someone unable to do something, especially because of injury or illness.

words.ex: The sun appears in the sky at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 太阳在黎明时出现。
words.en: If someone or something appears, they come into sight or become noticeable.

words.tr:
v. 检查；核对；
n. 检查；支票；阻止；
words.ex: Please check your homework before class.
words.ex_cn: 请在上课前检查你的作业。
words.en: To examine something in order to determine its accuracy, quality, or condition, or to make sure that something is correct or safe.

words.ex: He paid with a cheque yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天用支票付款了。
words.en: A written order to a bank to pay a specified sum from someone's account.

words.ex: He collects stamps every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周收集邮票。
words.en: If you collect a number of things, you gather them together, usually because you want them for a particular purpose.

words.tr: adj. 凭冲动行事的；易冲动的
words.ex: He made an impulsive decision to quit his job.
words.ex_cn: 他一时冲动决定辞掉工作。
words.en: If you describe someone as impulsive, you mean that they do things suddenly without thinking about them carefully first.

words.ex: He made an impetuous decision to quit his job.
words.ex_cn: 他冲动地决定辞去工作。
words.en: If you describe someone as impetuous, you mean that they are likely to act quickly and suddenly without thinking or being careful.

words.tr: adj. 易怒的；性急的；易激动的
words.ex: He was too hotheaded to make a good leader.
words.ex_cn: 他太性急了，不适合做领导。
words.en: If you describe someone as hotheaded, you are criticizing them for acting too quickly, without thinking of the consequences.

words.tr: adv. 出于某种冲动；一时兴起地
words.ex: He quit his job on the impulse of anger.
words.ex_cn: 他出于愤怒的冲动辞了工作。

words.tr: phrase. 即兴购买；未经考虑仅凭一时冲动的购物行为
words.ex: He stopped and did impulse buying at the supermarket.
words.ex_cn: 他在超市停下来进行了冲动购物。
words.en: The act of purchasing goods or services without planning in advance, often driven by a sudden desire or urge.

words.tr:
n. 欲望；渴望；
v. 渴望；期望；
words.ex: He felt a strong desire to travel the world.
words.ex_cn: 他有一种强烈的环游世界的欲望。
words.en: A strong feeling of wanting to have something or wishing for something to happen.

words.tr:
v. 力劝；
n. 强烈欲望；
words.ex: My teacher urged me to study harder.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师力劝我更加努力学习。
words.en: If you urge someone to do something, you try hard to persuade them to do it.

words.tr: v. 使根深蒂固；使处于牢固地位；用壕沟围住
words.ex: The habit entrenches itself over time.
words.ex_cn: 这个习惯随着时间的推移变得根深蒂固。
words.en: To establish something very firmly so that it is very difficult to change.

words.ex: The extraction of coal harms the environment.
words.ex_cn: 煤炭的开采对环境有害。
words.en: The process of removing or obtaining something from something else.

words.tr: phrase. 蜡烛蜡；用于制作蜡烛的蜡
words.ex: The candle wax melted in the sun.
words.ex_cn: 蜡烛蜡在阳光下融化了。
words.en: The solid, fatty substance used in candles for burning.

words.tr: n. 萃取，提取，提炼 v. 提取( extract的现在分词 ); （费力地）拔出; 选取; 获得
words.ex: He is extracting data from the spreadsheet.
words.ex_cn: 他正在从电子表格中提取数据。
words.en: To remove or take out something, especially by effort or force.

words.ex: He is capable of solving hard math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他能解决复杂的数学问题。
words.en: If a person or thing is capable of doing something, they have the ability or potential to do it.

words.tr: n. 构成；作曲；（学生）作文；创作技巧；
words.ex: The composition of the rock includes sand and clay.
words.ex_cn: 这种岩石的构成包括沙子和黏土。
words.en: The way in which something is composed or arranged; the act of creating something, especially a piece of writing or music.

words.tr: v. 似乎要做某事；看起来要做某事
words.ex: He appears to leave early tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他似乎明天要早点离开。

words.tr:
n. 检验员；审核员；检验机；方格图案
v.  使呈现方格图案或不同颜色
words.ex: He uses a checker to count the coins.
words.ex_cn: 他用点钞机数硬币。
words.en: A checker is a person or thing that checks something, or a pattern of squares, typically of two colors.

words.ex: Please complete the check-in at the front desk.
words.ex_cn: 请在前台完成签到。
words.en: The act of reporting one's presence, especially at a hotel or an airport, or the place where this happens.

words.ex: The check-out of the equipment took two hours.
words.ex_cn: 对设备的检验花了两个小时。
words.en: The process of completing a purchase or settling a bill, often at a counter or online.

words.ex: He had a check-up at the hospital last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周在医院做了体检。
words.en: A check-up is a medical examination by your doctor to make sure that there is nothing wrong with your health.

words.tr: n. 清单；检查表；备忘录；目录册；
words.ex: He made a checklist for his trip.
words.ex_cn: 他为旅行列了一份清单。
words.en: A checklist is a list of items required, things to be done, or points to be considered, used as a reminder.

words.tr: v. 检查；“check”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The teacher checked the students' homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师检查了学生的作业。
words.en: Having a pattern of squares, typically of two colors; past tense and past participle of check, meaning to examine something in order to determine its accuracy, quality, or condition.

words.tr:
adj. 集体的；
n. 集体；
words.ex: The collective decision was made by all members.
words.ex_cn: 这个集体决定是由所有成员做出的。
words.en: done or shared by all members of a group of people

words.ex: His collection of old coins is very rare.
words.ex_cn: 他收集的旧硬币非常稀有。
words.en: A collection is a group of things, often of the same type, that have been gathered together over a period of time.

words.ex: The teacher will allocate books to students.
words.ex_cn: 老师将给学生分配书籍。
words.en: To allocate something means to give it to a particular person or use it for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The teacher will assign homework today.
words.ex_cn: 老师今天会布置作业。
words.en: To give someone a particular job or task; to allocate a resource or responsibility to a particular person or purpose.

words.ex: The teacher will distribute the books to students.
words.ex_cn: 老师将把书分发给学生。
words.en: If you distribute things, you hand them or deliver them to a number of people.

words.ex: He collates the papers before the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议前整理了这些文件。
words.en: To collate information or data means to collect it together and examine it carefully in order to compare it or find something out.

words.ex: The scientist calibrates the scale every morning.
words.ex_cn: 科学家每天早上标定秤。
words.en: To calibrate something means to mark or adjust it so that it can be used for measuring accurately.

words.tr: v. 使合乎标准；使合规格
words.ex: The school will standardize the test scores next month.
words.ex_cn: 学校下个月将统一评分标准。
words.en: To standardize something means to make it conform to a standard or norm, especially in order to ensure consistency and uniformity.

words.ex: He has the calibre to lead the team.
words.ex_cn: 他有领导团队的能力。
words.en: The quality of someone's character or the level of their ability; the diameter of the inside of a tube, especially of a gun barrel.

words.ex: The bright flowers attract bees.
words.ex_cn: 鲜艳的花朵吸引蜜蜂。
words.en: If something or someone attracts you, they have particular qualities which cause you to like or admire them.

words.tr:
v. 吸引；诱惑；引诱
n. 诱惑；诱饵；吸引力
words.ex: The bright colors lure the birds to the feeder.
words.ex_cn: 鲜艳的颜色吸引鸟类来到喂食器。
words.en: If you lure someone, you tempt them to do something or to go somewhere, especially by offering some form of reward.

words.ex: The shop tries to entice customers with cheap prices.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店试图以低价吸引顾客。
words.en: If you entice someone, you attract them to a particular place or activity by making it seem attractive or interesting.

words.ex: He tried to seduce her with flowers and gifts.
words.ex_cn: 他试图用鲜花和礼物引诱她。
words.en: To seduce someone means to persuade them to do something, especially something wrong or unwise, by making it seem attractive or exciting.

words.tr: v. 诱惑；引诱；怂恿；劝诱；
words.ex: The smell of cookies tempted him to eat one.
words.ex_cn: 饼干的香味诱惑他吃了一块。
words.en: If something tempts you, it makes you want to have it or do it, even though you know you should not.

words.tr:
v. 陷入（困境）；设圈套；
n. 圈套；陷阱；困境；
words.ex: He trapped himself in debt by spending too much.
words.ex_cn: 他因花钱太多而陷入债务困境。
words.en: A trap is a device or enclosure designed to catch and retain animals, typically by allowing entry but not exit or by catching hold of a part of the body.

words.tr:
n. 鱼饵；诱惑物
v. 下诱饵
words.ex: He used bread as bait to catch fish.
words.ex_cn: 他用面包当诱饵来钓鱼。
words.en: Bait is something which is used to attract fish or animals so that they can be caught. It can also refer to something that is offered to someone to persuade them to do something.

words.ex: He can describe the picture in one sentence.
words.ex_cn: 他能用一句话描述这幅画。
words.en: If you describe a person, object, event, or situation, you say what they are like or what happened.

words.ex: He ate a chunk of cheese for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃了一大块奶酪。
words.en: A chunk of something is a large piece or amount of it.

words.ex: The agency helps people find jobs.
words.ex_cn: 这个机构帮助人们找工作。
words.en: An agency is a business which provides a service on behalf of other businesses.

words.ex: She blends flour and water to make dough.
words.ex_cn: 她把面粉和水混合在一起做面团。
words.en: To mix substances together so that they combine into a single substance.

words.ex: He could not conceive a world without technology.
words.ex_cn: 他无法设想一个没有科技的世界。
words.en: To conceive means to form or devise a plan or idea in the mind; to become pregnant.

words.ex: Rain can affect the crop growth.
words.ex_cn: 雨水会影响作物生长。
words.en: To have an influence on or cause a change in someone or something.

words.ex: The slow internet frustrates me.
words.ex_cn: 慢速的网络让我感到沮丧。
words.en: If something frustrates you, it upsets or angers you because you are unable to deal with the problems it creates.

words.ex: They will extend the deadline by one week.
words.ex_cn: 他们将截止日期延长一周。
words.en: To extend something means to make it longer or larger, or to spread it over a larger area.

words.tr: n. 食物诱饵；引诱动物进食的食品添加剂
words.ex: The food attractant lured the animals to the trap.
words.ex_cn: 食物诱饵把动物引到了陷阱里。

words.ex: The bread contains a food additive to keep it fresh.
words.ex_cn: 这种面包含有食品添加剂以保持新鲜。
words.en: A food additive is a substance added to food to preserve flavor or enhance its taste and appearance.

words.ex: This bread contains a food preservative to last longer.
words.ex_cn: 这种面包含有食品防腐剂以延长保质期。

words.ex: The attraction of the city draws many tourists.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市的吸引力吸引了许多游客。
words.en: An attraction is something that makes people want to go to a place or do a particular thing because they are interested in it.

words.ex: The flower produces a sweet attractant to draw bees.
words.ex_cn: 这种花产生一种甜味的吸引物来吸引蜜蜂。
words.en: A substance that attracts, especially one used to lure animals or insects into a trap.

words.tr: 短语动词. 吸引某人的注意力
words.ex: The bright colors attract her attention.
words.ex_cn: 鲜艳的颜色吸引了她的注意。
words.en: To cause someone to notice or focus on something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 吸引人们的兴趣；引起人们的关注
words.ex: The colorful poster attracts people's interest.
words.ex_cn: 这幅色彩鲜艳的海报吸引了人们的兴趣。
words.en: To draw the attention or curiosity of others.

words.ex: The teacher gave a clear description of the experiment.
words.ex_cn: 老师对实验做了清晰的描述。
words.en: A description of someone or something is a statement that explains what they are or what they are like.

words.tr: phrase. 拿起；开始从事；接受（提议）；占用
words.ex: He took up the book from the table.
words.ex_cn: 他从桌子上拿起了书。
words.en: To begin to do or deal with something; to occupy or fill a particular amount of time or space; to accept an offer or challenge.

words.tr: phrase. 呈现；承担；接受；较量；雇用
words.ex: The sky takes on a pink color at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 日落时，天空呈现出粉红色。
words.en: To undertake or begin to deal with a task or responsibility; to hire someone; to acquire a particular appearance or quality.

words.tr: n. 代理人；特工；经纪人；（药）剂；动因；
words.ex: The real estate agent helped them buy a house.
words.ex_cn: 房地产代理人帮助他们买了一所房子。
words.en: An agent is a person who acts on behalf of another person or group.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 融入；与……协调一致
words.ex: He tries to blend in with the group.
words.ex_cn: 他试图融入这个群体。
words.en: To mix or combine things together so that they cannot be easily separated, or to become part of something so that you are not noticed.

words.ex: The paint blends with the wall easily.
words.ex_cn: 这种油漆很容易与墙壁融为一体。
words.en: To mix or combine (something) with something else so that they become one substance or so that they exist or work together.

words.ex: It's difficult to conceive of a world without music.
words.ex_cn: 很难想象一个没有音乐的世界。
words.en: To form a mental representation or idea of something.

words.tr: v. 怀孕；受孕；怀上孩子
words.ex: They want to conceive a child next year.
words.ex_cn: 他们想明年要个孩子。
words.en: To become pregnant.

words.ex: I think it is a good idea.
words.ex_cn: 我认为这是个好主意。
words.en: To have a particular opinion, belief, or idea about someone or something.

words.ex: Can you imagine a world without phones?
words.ex_cn: 你能想象一个没有电话的世界吗？
words.en: To imagine means to form a mental image or concept of something that is not present or real.

words.ex: The city needs better infrastructure for roads and water.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市需要更好的道路和供水设施。
words.en: The basic physical and organizational structures and facilities (e.g., buildings, roads, power supplies) needed for the operation of a society or enterprise.

words.ex: He will introduce his friend to the class.
words.ex_cn: 他将向全班介绍他的朋友。
words.en: If you introduce someone, you tell someone else their name so that they can know each other.

words.ex: My teacher gave me good advice about studying.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师给了我关于学习的好建议。
words.en: If you give someone advice, you tell them what you think they should do in a particular situation.

words.ex: His attitude toward homework is very positive.
words.ex_cn: 他对作业的态度非常积极。
words.en: An attitude is a way of thinking or feeling about something, which is often reflected in a person's behavior.

words.tr: v. 兑现；递送；交付；发表；为…接生；
words.ex: He promised to deliver on his goal.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺要兑现自己的目标。
words.en: To bring and hand over (a letter, parcel, or ordered goods) to the proper recipient or address.

words.ex: The course of the river changed after the flood.
words.ex_cn: 河流的流程在洪水后发生了变化。
words.en: A course is a series of lessons or lectures on a particular subject.

words.tr:
v. 相配；
n. 比赛；
words.ex: The curtains match the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 窗帘和沙发相配。
words.en: A match is a competition or game in which people or teams compete against each other. It can also refer to a small stick that produces a flame when rubbed against a rough surface, used for lighting a fire, cigarette, etc. Additionally, it can mean a person or thing that is equal to another in quality, strength, or suitability.

words.ex: The company will employ five new workers next month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司下个月将雇佣五名新员工。
words.en: If a person or company employs you, they pay you to work for them.

words.ex: He pressed the pedal to speed up the bike.
words.ex_cn: 他踩下踏板让自行车加速。
words.en: A pedal is a lever that you press with your foot in order to control a vehicle or machine.

words.tr: v. 开设一门课程；介绍一门课程
words.ex: The school will introduce a course on environmental science next year.
words.ex_cn: 学校明年将开设一门环境科学课程。

words.ex: The book has a short introduction at the beginning.
words.ex_cn: 这本书开头有一段简短的引言。
words.en: The act of presenting something new to someone or something, or the process of making something known or familiar to people.

words.tr: v. 写信给某人征求意见
words.ex: I wrote to my teacher for advice on my project.
words.ex_cn: 我写信给老师征求关于我项目的建议。

words.tr: n. 专家建议；专业意见
words.ex: He followed the expert advice and passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 他按照专家的建议做了，通过了考试。
words.en: expert advice: Guidance from individuals with specialized knowledge and experience

words.tr:
n. 金融；财务；
v. 提供资金；
words.ex: He works in finance in New York.
words.ex_cn: 他在纽约从事金融工作。
words.en: Finance is the management of large amounts of money, especially by governments or large companies.

words.ex: Her attitude to work is very professional.
words.ex_cn: 她对工作的态度非常专业。
words.en: A manner of thinking, feeling, or behaving that reflects a state of mind or disposition towards someone or something.

words.ex: His attitude towards homework is very positive.
words.ex_cn: 他对待作业的态度非常积极。
words.en: A person's feelings, opinions, or way of thinking about something.

words.tr: n. 个人财务；个人理财
words.ex: He learned to manage his personal finance by budgeting each month.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每月制定预算来学习管理个人财务。

words.tr: v. 由电视播送；用电视放映
words.ex: The news will televise the election results tonight.
words.ex_cn: 今晚电视将播出选举结果。
words.en: To broadcast something on television.

words.tr: 短语动词. 发表演讲；发表讲话
words.ex: He will deliver a speech at the school meeting tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他将在学校的会议上发表演讲。
words.en: To give a formal talk or presentation to an audience.

words.ex: The judge will deliver a judgement tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 法官明天将宣判。

words.ex: The president gave a televised speech last night.
words.ex_cn: 总统昨晚发表了一次电视播出的演讲。

words.ex: The delivery of the package took three days.
words.ex_cn: 这个包裹的交付花了三天时间。
words.en: The act of delivering letters, parcels, or goods.

words.ex: He found his keys in the course of cleaning his room.
words.ex_cn: 他在打扫房间的过程中找到了钥匙。
words.en: During the process or period of something happening.

words.w: over the course of your life
words.tr: 在你的一生中；在你整个生命的过程中
words.uk: ˌəʊvə ðə ˈkɔːs əv jɔː laɪf
words.us: ˌoʊvər ðə ˈkɔːrs əv jɔːr laɪf
words.ex: You will change over the course of your life.
words.ex_cn: 在你的一生中，你会改变。

words.ex: Of course, I will help you with your homework.
words.ex_cn: 当然，我会帮你做作业。
words.en: Used to express agreement or to indicate that something is expected or obvious.

words.tr: phrase. 初级课程；入门课程
words.ex: He signed up for a beginning course in Spanish.
words.ex_cn: 他报名参加了一个西班牙语入门课程。
words.en: An introductory or initial level of study or instruction in a particular subject or field.

words.ex: He took basic courses in math and science.
words.ex_cn: 他学习了数学和科学的基础课程。

words.ex: The course code is MATH101.
words.ex_cn: 这门课的课程代码是MATH101。
words.en: A unique identifier for a specific educational course, often used in registration systems.

words.tr: n. 主场赛事；主场比赛
words.ex: The team won the home match last Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 这支队伍在上星期六的主场赛事中赢了。

words.tr: phrase. 客场比赛；在对方场地举行的比赛
words.ex: The team prepared thoroughly for the away match next week.
words.ex_cn: n. 球队为下周的客场比赛做了充分的准备。
words.en: A game played at the opponent's ground.

words.ex: He watches a football match every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末看一场足球比赛。
words.en: A football match is a game of football, especially one that is part of a competition.

words.ex: He was named man of the match for scoring two goals.
words.ex_cn: 他因进两个球被评为本场最佳球员。

words.ex: The team will match against their rivals next week.
words.ex_cn: 这支队伍下周将与对手对抗。

words.tr: phrase. 与…匹配；与…相配；使与…一致
words.ex: The curtains don't match with the paint color.
words.ex_cn: 窗帘与油漆的颜色不搭配。
words.en: To be compatible or suitable with something or someone.

words.tr: adj. 无与伦比的；无双的；无可匹敌的
words.ex: Her smile is matchless.
words.ex_cn: 她的微笑无与伦比。
words.en: If you describe something as matchless, you mean that it is extremely good and that nothing else is as good.

words.ex: The scotsman wears a kilt to the festival.
words.ex_cn: 这位苏格兰人穿着苏格兰短裙参加节日。
words.en: A Scotsman is a man who comes from Scotland.

words.ex: The employee arrived at work early.
words.ex_cn: 这位雇员早早到达了工作地点。
words.en: An employee is a person who is paid to work for an organization or for another person.

words.ex: The employer gave her a raise.
words.ex_cn: 雇主给她加了薪。
words.en: An employer is a person or organization that employs people, paying them for their work.

words.ex: He found employment after graduating from university.
words.ex_cn: 他大学毕业后找到了工作。
words.en: the condition of having paid work

words.ex: She is highly employable due to her extensive experience.
words.ex_cn: 由于她丰富的经验，她非常有资格任职。
words.en: If someone is employable, they are suitable for being employed, usually because they have the necessary skills or qualities.

words.ex: The rocky path made hiking difficult.
words.ex_cn: 多岩石的小路让徒步变得困难。
words.en: A rocky area is covered with rocks or consists of large areas of rock and has nothing growing on it.

words.tr:
adj. 居住的；常驻的；
n. 常住居民；
words.ex: The resident population grew last year.
words.ex_cn: 居住人口去年增加了。
words.en: A resident is someone who lives in a particular place or a person who has their home in a place.

words.ex: The optometrist checked my eyes last week.
words.ex_cn: 验光师上周检查了我的眼睛。
words.en: An optometrist is a person whose job is to examine people's eyes and to recommend and sell glasses.

words.ex: The soil degrades over time without proper care.
words.ex_cn: 如果没有适当照料，土壤会逐渐退化。
words.en: If something degrades or is degraded, it becomes worse in quality, or weaker in power or status.

words.ex: Dust particles float in the air.
words.ex_cn: 灰尘微粒漂浮在空气中。
words.en: A particle is a very small piece or amount of something.

words.tr:
n. 运输；
v. 运输；
words.ex: He uses public transport to go to work.
words.ex_cn: 他乘坐公共交通去上班。
words.en: To transport something or someone is to move them from one place to another, especially over long distances.

words.ex: I prepare my lunch every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上准备午餐。
words.en: If you prepare something, you make it ready for something that is going to happen.

words.ex: He completed the registration for the course.
words.ex_cn: 他完成了这门课程的登记。
words.en: Registration is the act of officially recording something, especially in an official list or record.

words.ex: The hikers walked through a deep gorge.
words.ex_cn: 徒步者走过一个深峡谷。
words.en: A gorge is a deep, narrow valley with steep sides, often carved by a river. It can also refer to the act of eating greedily.

words.ex: The river flows through a deep canyon.
words.ex_cn: 河流流经一个深峡谷。
words.en: A canyon is a large valley with very steep sides and usually a river flowing along the bottom.

words.ex: His residence is near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他的住所靠近公园。
words.en: A residence is a house or place where someone lives.

words.ex: They stayed in a small lodge near the forest.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在森林附近的一座小屋里。
words.en: A lodge is a small house in the country, especially one that is used by people on holiday or by people taking part in a sport such as skiing or hunting. As a verb, to lodge means to stay somewhere, especially temporarily, or to formally submit something, such as a complaint or an application.

words.ex: He lives in a residential area near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他住在公园附近的一个住宅区。
words.en: Relating to or suitable for residence.

words.ex: He uses optical lenses to see small objects.
words.ex_cn: 他使用光学镜片来看小物体。
words.en: Relating to sight, especially in relation to the physical action of light.

words.ex: He tried to debase the coin with cheap metal.
words.ex_cn: 他试图用廉价金属贬低硬币的价值。
words.en: To debase something means to reduce its value or quality.

words.ex: He abased himself before the king.
words.ex_cn: 他在国王面前贬低自己。
words.en: To abase someone or something means to lower them in rank, status, or esteem.

words.ex: The manager decided to demote him for poor performance.
words.ex_cn: 经理因他表现不佳决定降职他。
words.en: If someone is demoted, they are given a lower rank or a less important position than they had before.

words.ex: He condescended to explain the simple math to his little brother.
words.ex_cn: 他屈尊向弟弟解释了简单的数学。
words.en: If someone condescends to do something, they agree to do it in a way which shows that they think they are superior to the people they are doing it for.

words.ex: He composes music in his spare time.
words.ex_cn: 他在空闲时间创作音乐。
words.en: To compose something means to make it by combining parts or elements.

words.ex: The pollution caused the degradation of the river.
words.ex_cn: 污染导致了河流的恶化。
words.en: The process by which something is reduced in quality, value, or status.

words.ex: The apple will decompose in the soil.
words.ex_cn: 苹果会在土壤中分解。
words.en: If something decomposes, or if it is decomposed, it decays or breaks down into smaller parts or substances.

words.ex: The transit of goods takes three days.
words.ex_cn: 货物的运输需要三天。
words.en: The act or process of passing through or across; the conveyance of people or goods from one place to another.

words.tr: phrase. 在运输中；在途中；在转运过程中
words.ex: The package is in transit.
words.ex_cn: 这个包裹正在运输途中。
words.en: If someone or something is in transit, they are travelling or being taken from one place to another.

words.tr: n. 晶体管；晶体管收音机
words.ex: The radio uses a small transistor.
words.ex_cn: 这个收音机使用了一个小晶体管。
words.en: A transistor is a semiconductor device used to amplify or switch electronic signals and electrical power.

words.tr: n. 避难所；庇护所；庇护；
words.ex: The birds found sanctuary in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这些鸟在森林里找到了避难所。
words.en: A sanctuary is a place where people or animals are protected from danger or trouble.

words.tr: phrase. phr. 在公共交通工具上；乘坐公共交通
words.ex: I always read a book on public transport.
words.ex_cn: 我总是在公共交通工具上看书。
words.en: Using or traveling by public transportation such as buses, trains, or subways.

words.tr: adv. 乘坐公共交通工具
words.ex: He goes to work by public transport.
words.ex_cn: 他乘坐公共交通工具上班。
words.en: By public transport.

words.tr: phrase. 运输费用；运送成本
words.ex: The transport costs are too high for small businesses.
words.ex_cn: 运输成本对小企业来说太高了。
words.en: The expenses associated with the movement of goods or people from one place to another.

words.tr: phrase. 免费的交通；免费运输
words.ex: The hotel offers free transport to the airport.
words.ex_cn: 酒店提供免费的交通服务去机场。
words.en: Transportation provided at no cost, often as an employee benefit or public service.

words.ex: He tried to integrate into the new school community.
words.ex_cn: 他试图融入新的学校群体。
words.en: If someone integrates into a social group, or is integrated into it, they behave in such a way that they become part of the group or are accepted into it.

words.ex: The integration of technology and education improves learning.
words.ex_cn: 技术与教育的结合改善了学习。
words.en: The act or process of combining or adding parts to make a unified whole.

words.tr: n. 运输；运输系统；交通工具；
words.ex: The city improved its transportation system.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市改善了它的运输系统。
words.en: Transportation refers to the movement of people, animals, and goods from one place to another.

words.tr: phrase. 准备好应对；为……做好准备
words.ex: He is prepared for the test.
words.ex_cn: 他为考试做好了准备。
words.en: To make ready or able to deal with something that is expected to happen.

words.ex: He crammed the suitcase with clothes.
words.ex_cn: 他把衣服塞满了行李箱。
words.en: If you cram things or people into a place, you put them into it even though there is hardly enough room for them.

words.ex: The room was in chaos after the party.
words.ex_cn: 派对之后，房间一片混乱。
words.en: A state of complete disorder and confusion.

words.ex: He enjoys recreational activities like swimming and hiking.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢游泳和徒步等娱乐活动。
words.en: Relating to or denoting activity done for enjoyment when one is not working.

words.ex: He follows a systematic approach to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他用一种系统的方法来解决数学问题。
words.en: A systematic approach or method is one that is done according to a fixed plan, in a thorough and efficient way.

words.ex: The garden grows subtropical plants like citrus trees.
words.ex_cn: 这个花园种植了柑橘树等亚热带植物。
words.en: Relating to or characteristic of the regions adjacent to or bordering on the tropics.

words.ex: His rude words detract from the beauty of the speech.
words.ex_cn: 他粗鲁的话贬损了演讲的优美。
words.en: If one thing detracts from another, it makes it seem less good or impressive.

words.ex: He sealed the envelope with glue.
words.ex_cn: 他用胶水把信封封上了。
words.en: A seal is a device or substance that is used to close off or fasten an opening or container, making it airtight or watertight. It can also refer to a marine mammal with flippers for swimming.

words.ex: He put a stamp on the envelope.
words.ex_cn: 他在信封上贴了一张邮票。
words.en: A stamp is a small piece of paper which you stick on an envelope or package before you post it to pay for the cost of the postage. It can also mean to bring down your foot heavily on the ground or to impress a pattern or mark on a surface.

words.tr: v. 压下；降低；使沮丧；使不活泼；使萧条
words.ex: He depresses the button to start the machine.
words.ex_cn: 他按下按钮启动机器。
words.en: If something depresses you, it makes you feel sad and disappointed.

words.tr: adj. 缺乏的；不足的；稀有的；
words.ex: Water is scarce in the desert.
words.ex_cn: 沙漠里水很缺乏。
words.en: If something is scarce, there is not enough of it.

words.tr: n. [医]疤痕；创伤（scar 的复数形式）；冻结物; v. 给……留下伤痕；在……的心灵上留下创...
words.ex: The scars on his face tell a story of a difficult past.
words.ex_cn: 他脸上的伤疤讲述了一个艰难过去的故事。
words.en: Marks left on the skin or surface after a wound has healed, often permanent.

words.ex: The police found evidence at the crime scene.
words.ex_cn: 警察在犯罪现场找到了证据。
words.en: Evidence is anything that you see, experience, read, or are told that causes you to believe that something is true or has really happened.

words.tr: n. 分子混沌；分子无序状态
words.ex: The theory assumes molecular chaos in gas particles.
words.ex_cn: 该理论假设气体粒子中存在分子混沌。

words.ex: The room was chaotic after the party.
words.ex_cn: 派对后房间一片混乱。
words.en: If a situation, place, or system is chaotic, it is in a state of complete disorder and confusion.

words.tr:
adj. 倒退的；退化的；退步的
v. 逆行；倒退；堕落
words.ex: The company's retrograde policies led to a decline in productivity.
words.ex_cn: 公司倒退的政策导致了生产力的下降。
words.en: If you describe an action or idea as retrograde, you disapprove of it because it returns to old ideas or methods and does not take advantage of recent progress.

words.ex: The ship's longitude is 45 degrees west.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船的经度是西经45度。
words.en: Longitude is the distance of a place east or west of the Greenwich meridian, measured in degrees.

words.ex: The city is at a latitude of 40 degrees north.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市位于北纬40度。
words.en: Latitude is the distance of a place north or south of the equator, measured in degrees.

words.ex: The city enjoys a subtropical climate, with mild winters and hot, humid summers.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市享有亚热带气候，冬季温和，夏季炎热潮湿。
words.en: A subtropical climate is characterized by hot, humid summers and mild winters, typically found on the eastern sides of continents between latitudes 23.5° and 35° north and south.

words.tr: v. 使…下火车；从火车上卸下
words.ex: The soldiers will detrain at the next station.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们将在下一站下车。
words.en: To leave or cause to leave a train.

words.tr:
n. 长条；条状；
v. 剥去；剥夺；
words.ex: He cut a strip of paper to wrap the gift.
words.ex_cn: 他剪了一条纸来包装礼物。
words.en: To remove a layer from something, or to take off your clothes.

words.ex: He fastened the strap around his wrist.
words.ex_cn: 他把带子系在手腕上。
words.en: A strap is a narrow piece of leather, cloth, or other material that is used to fasten, secure, or carry something, or to hold onto something.

words.tr:
n. 接缝；缝合处；矿层；煤层
v. 缝合；有裂痕
words.ex: The seam of the shirt came loose.
words.ex_cn: 衬衫的接缝松开了。
words.en: A seam is a line where two pieces of fabric are sewn together in a garment or other article.

words.ex: He put sesame on his bread.
words.ex_cn: 他在面包上撒了芝麻。
words.en: Sesame is a plant grown for its seeds, which are used in cooking and for their oil.

words.ex: Many people lost jobs during the recession.
words.ex_cn: 在经济不景气期间，许多人失去了工作。
words.en: A recession is a period when the economy of a country is not doing well, industrial production and business activity are at a low level, and many people are unemployed.

words.tr: adj. 布满星星的；像星星的；闪闪发光的
words.ex: The night sky is starry and beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 夜空繁星点点，非常美丽。
words.en: A starry sky is one that is full of stars.

words.ex: His nature is kind and patient.
words.ex_cn: 他的本性是善良且有耐心的。
words.en: Nature refers to the physical world and everything in it that is not made by people, including plants, animals, mountains, oceans, stars, etc. It can also refer to the basic or inherent features, character, or qualities of something.

words.ex: The children played in the natural park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在自然公园里玩耍。
words.en: Existing in or caused by nature; not made or caused by humankind.

words.tr: vt. 使……失去人性；改变……的性质; vi. 变性
words.ex: Heat can denature proteins in eggs.
words.ex_cn: 热量会使鸡蛋中的蛋白质变性。
words.en: To modify the molecular structure of (a protein or nucleic acid) so as to alter its original properties, especially its biological activity.

words.tr: n. 星光灿烂的夜晚；繁星满天的夜
words.ex: He painted a starry night with bright dots.
words.ex_cn: 他用明亮的点画了一幅星空夜景。
words.en: A night sky filled with visible stars, often evoking a sense of wonder or peace.

words.ex: Scarce metals are used in smartphones and electric cars.
words.ex_cn: 稀有金属用于智能手机和电动汽车。

words.tr: phrase. 一件证据；一项证明材料
words.ex: The police found a piece of evidence at the scene.
words.ex_cn: 警察在案发现场发现了一件证据。
words.en: A fact or object that helps prove something is true.

words.tr: phrase. 显而易见的；明显的；作为证据的；在场且引人注目的
words.ex: His talent is in evidence during the performance.
words.ex_cn: 他在表演中显而易见地展现了才华。
words.en: If someone or something is in evidence, they are present and can be clearly seen.

words.ex: He is evidently tired after the long walk.
words.ex_cn: 他走完漫长的路后显然很累。
words.en: In a way that is clearly seen or understood; obviously.

words.tr:
prep. 除…以外；
adv. 此外；
words.ex: Besides apples, he likes oranges.
words.ex_cn: 除了苹果，他还喜欢橙子。
words.en: In addition to; apart from.

words.ex: This jacket is waterproof.
words.ex_cn: 这件夹克是防水的。
words.en: Something that is waterproof does not let water pass through it.

words.ex: This brand has an exclusive design.
words.ex_cn: 这个品牌拥有独有的设计。
words.en: Something that is exclusive is available only to particular people, and not to everyone.

words.ex: The majority of students like pizza.
words.ex_cn: 大多数学生喜欢披萨。
words.en: The majority is the greater number or part of something.

words.ex: He went to school despite the rain.
words.ex_cn: 尽管下雨，他还是去上学了。
words.en: Without being affected by; in spite of.

words.ex: He went for a walk regardless of the rain.
words.ex_cn: 尽管下雨，他还是去散步了。
words.en: Without taking into account; without being affected by.

words.ex: He went to school in spite of the rain.
words.ex_cn: 尽管下雨，他还是去上学了。
words.en: You use in spite of to introduce a fact which makes the rest of the statement you are making seem surprising.

words.ex: Sugar dissolves in water.
words.ex_cn: 糖在水中溶解。
words.en: If a substance dissolves in liquid or if you dissolve a substance, it becomes mixed with the liquid and disappears.

words.tr:
n. 释放；发布；
v. 释放；发布；
words.ex: The release of the prisoner made everyone happy.
words.ex_cn: 囚犯的释放让每个人都高兴。
words.en: To release something means to let it go or to allow it to be free, or to make something available to the public.

words.tr:
n. 租契；
v. 出租；
words.ex: He signed a lease for the apartment.
words.ex_cn: 他签了公寓的租契。
words.en: A lease is a legal agreement by which the owner of a building, a piece of land, or something such as a car allows someone else to use it for a period of time in return for money.

words.ex: The company will deploy new software next week.
words.ex_cn: 公司将在下周部署新软件。
words.en: To deploy troops or military resources means to organize or position them so that they are ready to be used.

words.tr:
adj. 原来的；有创造性的；原版的；新颖的；
n. 原件；原稿；
words.ex: This is the original book I bought last year.
words.ex_cn: 这是我去年买的那本原版书。
words.en: An original piece of writing or music was written recently and has not been published or performed before.

words.ex: She wore a floral dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条有花卉图案的裙子去参加派对。
words.en: Relating to flowers; decorated with flowers or a pattern of flowers.

words.ex: Bees collect nectar from flowers.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂从花朵中采集花蜜。
words.en: A sweet liquid secreted by flowers and collected by bees for making honey.

words.ex: The forest is home to a rich fauna.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林是丰富动物群的家园。
words.en: The animals of a particular region, habitat, or geological period.

words.ex: The forest has rich flora with many wild flowers.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林有丰富的植物，有许多野花。
words.en: The plants of a particular region, habitat, or geological period.

words.ex: The poll showed that most people support the new law.
words.ex_cn: 这项民意调查表明，大多数人支持这项新法律。
words.en: A poll is a survey in which people are asked their opinions about something, usually in order to find out how popular something is or what people intend to do in the future.

words.ex: Bees collect pollen from flowers.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂从花朵中采集花粉。
words.en: Pollen is a fine powder produced by flowers, which is carried by the wind or insects to other flowers of the same species, causing them to produce seeds.

words.ex: Bees pollinate flowers in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂给花园里的花授粉。
words.en: To pollinate means to transfer pollen from the male part of a flower to the female part, enabling fertilization and the production of seeds.

words.tr: phrase. 防水织物；防水布料
words.ex: The jacket is made of waterproof fabric.
words.ex_cn: 这件夹克是由防水布料制成的。
words.en: Material treated to resist water penetration, used for outdoor clothing and equipment.

words.tr: n. 织物；（建筑物的）结构；
words.ex: The dress is made of soft fabric.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子是由柔软的织物制成的。
words.en: Fabric refers to cloth or other material produced by weaving together cotton, nylon, wool, silk, or other threads. It can also refer to the basic structure of a building or a system.

words.ex: The store sells many kinds of textile, like cotton and silk.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售多种纺织品，比如棉和丝绸。
words.en: Textiles are types of cloth or fabric, especially ones that have been woven.

words.ex: The texture of the bread is soft and fluffy.
words.ex_cn: 这种面包的质地柔软蓬松。
words.en: The feel, appearance, or consistency of a surface or a substance.

words.tr: phrase. 在某种程度上；部分地
words.ex: He succeeded in part because he worked hard.
words.ex_cn: 他部分成功是因为他努力工作。
words.en: To some extent; not completely.

words.tr: adv. 不由自主地；情不自禁地
words.ex: I laughed despite myself when he told the joke.
words.ex_cn: 当他讲这个笑话时，我不由自主地笑了。

words.ex: I have one apple.
words.ex_cn: 我有一个苹果。
words.en: One is used to refer to the first and lowest whole number, often used to indicate a single person or thing.

words.ex: The blockage in the pipe caused water to stop flowing.
words.ex_cn: 管道中的堵塞导致水停止流动。
words.en: A blockage is a situation in which something is preventing movement or flow in a passage or pipe.

words.ex: Water is a common solvent for salt.
words.ex_cn: 水是盐的常见溶剂。
words.en: A solvent is a substance that can dissolve other substances, or a person or company that has enough money to pay their debts.

words.tr:
adj. 有溶解力的
n. 溶剂；溶媒
words.ex: The dissolvent breaks down the sugar quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这种溶剂迅速溶解了糖。
words.en: A dissolvent is a substance, typically a liquid, that dissolves another substance to form a solution.

words.tr: v. 溶解于；融入；沉浸于
words.ex: Sugar dissolves in water easily.
words.ex_cn: 糖容易溶解于水。

words.tr: phrase. 发布新闻；发布消息
words.ex: The company will release news tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 公司明天将发布新闻。
words.en: To make news or information available to the public.

words.tr:
n. 保释（金）
v. 保释；（往外）舀水
words.ex: He paid bail to get out of jail.
words.ex_cn: 他交了保释金以便出狱。
words.en: Bail is a sum of money that a person who has been accused of a crime pays to a law court so that they can be released until their trial. The payment is a way of making sure that the accused will return to court for trial.

words.ex: He runs with great vigour every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都充满精力地跑步。
words.en: Physical or mental strength and energy.

words.tr: adj. 精力充沛的；茂盛的；
words.ex: He is a vigorous man who runs every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个精力充沛的人，每天早上都跑步。
words.en: A vigorous person does things with great energy and enthusiasm. A vigorous campaign or activity is done with great energy and enthusiasm.

words.tr: adj. 有活力的；精力旺盛的；
words.ex: The energetic boy ran around the park all afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 这个有活力的男孩整个下午都在公园里跑来跑去。
words.en: Someone who is energetic is very active and does not tire easily.

words.ex: Hard work can bring about success.
words.ex_cn: 努力工作可以带来成功。
words.en: To cause something to happen.

words.tr: adj. 严格的；缜密的；严密的；
words.ex: The teacher is rigorous about homework deadlines.
words.ex_cn: 老师对作业截止日期要求严格。
words.en: If you are rigorous in something, you are very thorough and strict in the way you do it.

words.ex: My teacher is strict about homework deadlines.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师对作业截止日期要求很严格。
words.en: If someone is strict, they behave firmly and make sure that rules are obeyed.

words.tr: adj. 刻板的；坚硬的；严格的；
words.ex: He has a rigid attitude toward rules.
words.ex_cn: 他对规则的态度很刻板。
words.en: not able to be changed or adapted; not able to be bent or moved; stiff

words.ex: The sailors cleaned the stern of the boat.
words.ex_cn: 水手们打扫了船尾。
words.en: If you describe someone or their behavior as stern, you mean that they are severe or strict.

words.ex: The ceremony was solemn and quiet.
words.ex_cn: 仪式庄严而安静。
words.en: Solemn means very serious and not cheerful, often because something important or sad is happening or being remembered.

words.ex: The document was authenticated by comparing it with the original handwriting.
words.ex_cn: 通过与原始手写笔迹对比，该文件得到了验证。
words.en: The first or earliest form of a piece of writing, especially a document, before any copies have been made.

words.tr: n. 独特的视角；原创的观点
words.ex: He offered an original viewpoint on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他提出了对气候变化的独特视角。

words.tr: n. 原创戏剧；原创剧本
words.ex: He wrote an original play last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年写了一部原创戏剧。
words.en: A play that is newly created and not derived from a pre-existing source or adaptation.

words.ex: He converts a into b using a simple formula.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个简单的公式把a转换成b。
words.en: Transform or change something from one form, state, or condition into another.

words.ex: The road was diverted around the park.
words.ex_cn: 这条路被改道绕过公园。
words.en: If you divert someone or something, you cause them to change direction or to go somewhere different.

words.ex: He reverted to his old habits after the holiday.
words.ex_cn: 假期后，他恢复了旧习惯。
words.en: To return to a former state, practice, topic, etc.

words.ex: He will restore the old bike.
words.ex_cn: 他将修复这辆旧自行车。
words.en: To restore something means to bring it back to its original condition or to a state of health, efficiency, or good management.

words.ex: He tries to invert the numbers to find the answer.
words.ex_cn: 他试图将数字倒过来以找到答案。
words.en: To invert something means to turn it upside down or to reverse its position, order, or relationship.

words.ex: He lives in a residential college near the campus.
words.ex_cn: 他住在校园附近的一所住宿学院里。
words.en: A residential college is a college that provides accommodation for students, typically on or near the campus of a university.

words.ex: He lives in a boarding school far from home.
words.ex_cn: 他住在离家很远的寄宿学校。
words.en: A boarding school is a school where some or all pupils not only study but also live during term time, with their fellow students and possibly teachers.

words.tr: phrase. 学校董事会；校务委员会
words.ex: The school board decided to close the old building.
words.ex_cn: 校董事会决定关闭那栋旧楼。
words.en: The governing body of a school or school district.

words.ex: The tree has many branches.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树有许多分支。
words.en: A branch of a tree is one of its parts that grows out from its trunk. A branch of a business or organization is one of its offices or shops that are in different places.

words.ex: The chancellor announced a new tax policy.
words.ex_cn: 大臣宣布了一项新的税收政策。
words.en: A chancellor is the head of the government in some countries, or a high-ranking official in a university or other institution.

words.ex: The tree grows in a vertical line.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树垂直生长。
words.en: Something that is vertical stands or points straight up.

words.ex: The deer is a herbivore.
words.ex_cn: 鹿是食草动物。
words.en: An herbivore is an animal that gets its energy from eating plants, and only plants.

words.tr:
n. 公寓；
adj. 平坦的；扁平的；(轮胎)瘪了的；平淡无味的；
adv. 直接地；
words.ex: He lives in a small flat in London.
words.ex_cn: 他住在伦敦的一间小公寓里。
words.en: Something that is flat is level and smooth, with no curved, high, or hollow parts.

words.ex: I occasionally walk my dog in the park.
words.ex_cn: 我偶尔在公园遛狗。
words.en: If something happens occasionally, it happens sometimes, but not regularly or often.

words.tr: n. 住处；膳宿；(交通工具内的)空间；
words.ex: The hotel provided cheap accommodation for travelers.
words.ex_cn: 酒店为旅客提供了便宜的住处。
words.en: Accommodation is a place where someone lives or stays, or the act of providing someone with a place to live or stay.

words.ex: The car remained static at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在红灯前静止不动。
words.en: Something that is static does not move or change.

words.ex: This book has five sections.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有五个部分。
words.en: A section of something is one of the parts into which it is divided or from which it is formed.

words.ex: The chair is stationary and does not move.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子是固定的，不会移动。
words.en: not moving or not intended to be moved

words.tr: adj. 固定的；不能变的； v. 修理；固定；确定；“fix”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He has a fixed schedule every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都有一个固定的日程。
words.en: If something is fixed, it is attached or positioned so that it cannot move, or is arranged in a particular way and cannot be changed.

words.ex: He bought new stationery for school.
words.ex_cn: 他为学校买了新的文具。
words.en: Stationery refers to the materials used for writing, such as paper, pens, and envelopes.

words.ex: The main branch of the company is located in New York.
words.ex_cn: 该公司的主分支机构位于纽约。
words.en: The primary division or part of a tree, organization, or river.

words.tr: n. 分支机构；地方分部
words.ex: The local branch of the bank opened last week.
words.ex_cn: 这家银行的分支机构上周开业了。

words.ex: The deer is herbivorous.
words.ex_cn: 这只鹿是食草的。
words.en: Herbivorous animals are those that feed on plants.

words.tr: adj. 地面生活的；栖息在地面的
words.ex: The rabbit is a ground-dwelling animal.
words.ex_cn: 兔子是一种地面生活的动物。

words.ex: The road sign shows a speed limit of 50 km/h.
words.ex_cn: 路标显示限速50公里/小时。
words.en: A sign by the side of a road giving information or instructions to drivers.

words.ex: His kindness shows his nature inside.
words.ex_cn: 他的善良展现了他内在的本性。

words.tr: phrase. 学生住宿；专为学生提供的居住场所
words.ex: The student lives in student accommodation near the campus.
words.ex_cn: 这名学生住在靠近校园的学生宿舍里。
words.en: Housing provided for students, typically by educational institutions or private landlords, to live in while they are studying.

words.tr: n. 住宿设施；提供住宿的设备和条件
words.ex: The hotel has good accommodation facilities for tourists.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店为游客提供了良好的住宿设施。

words.ex: The balloon sticks to the wall because of static electricity.
words.ex_cn: 气球因为静电贴在墙上。
words.en: Static electricity is an imbalance of electric charges within or on the surface of a material. The charge remains until it is able to move away by means of an electric current or electrical discharge.

words.tr:
n. 规模；等级；比例（尺）；刻度；秤；
v. 改变…大小；
words.ex: The scale of the project surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目的规模让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: A scale is a set of levels or numbers which are used in a particular system of measuring things or are used when comparing things.

words.ex: He is constantly checking his phone.
words.ex_cn: 他不断地查看他的手机。
words.en: If something happens constantly, it happens all the time or very often.

words.ex: He had a minor ailment and stayed home from work.
words.ex_cn: 他得了一点小病，没去上班。
words.en: An ailment is a minor illness or health problem.

words.ex: He adheres to his principles even when it's hard.
words.ex_cn: 即使很难，他仍然坚持自己的原则。
words.en: If you adhere to a rule or agreement, you act in the way that it says you should.

words.ex: He joins extracurricular activities after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后参加课外活动。
words.en: Extracurricular activities are those that fall outside the realm of the normal curriculum of school or university education, performed by students. Extracurricular activities exist at all levels of education, from 4th-6th, junior high/high school, college and university education.

words.ex: The wind propels the sailboat forward.
words.ex_cn: 风推动帆船前进。
words.en: To propel something in a particular direction means to cause it to move in that direction.

words.ex: He sat with good posture at the desk.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在书桌前，姿势端正。
words.en: Your posture is the way in which you hold your body when you are standing or sitting.

words.tr:
adv. 在海外；在国外；
adj. 海外的；
words.ex: He moved overseas for work.
words.ex_cn: 他为了工作搬到了海外。
words.en: If something is overseas, it is in a foreign country, usually separated from your own country by an ocean.

words.ex: The occupancy of the hotel is high during summer.
words.ex_cn: 夏天酒店的占用率很高。
words.en: The act of occupying or the state of being occupied, especially the condition of being occupied by tenants or the period during which a property is occupied.

words.ex: The cat occupies the sofa all day.
words.ex_cn: 这只猫整天占据着沙发。
words.en: If people or things occupy a place, they are in it or fill it.

words.ex: The occupant of the room is sleeping.
words.ex_cn: 房间里的住户正在睡觉。
words.en: An occupant is someone who lives in or uses a particular room, building, or area of land.

words.ex: The occupation of the city by foreign troops lasted for years.
words.ex_cn: 外国军队对这座城市的占领持续了多年。
words.en: An occupation is a job or profession, or a way of spending your time.

words.tr: phrase. 大规模地；大范围地
words.ex: They built houses on a large scale after the earthquake.
words.ex_cn: 地震后，他们大规模地建造房屋。
words.en: Involving a large number of people or things, or covering a large area.

words.ex: The model is built in scale to show the real building.
words.ex_cn: 这个模型按比例制作，以展示真实建筑。
words.en: In relation to size, extent, or proportion; used to describe how something compares to another in magnitude.

words.tr: adj. 不成比例的；与规模不相称的
words.ex: The statue's head is out of scale with its body.
words.ex_cn: 这座雕像的头与身体不成比例。

words.tr: phrase. 按比例缩小；缩减规模
words.ex: He decided to scale down his business to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他决定缩减业务以节省开支。
words.en: To reduce the size, amount, or extent of something.

words.tr: v. 降低规模或档次；adj. 低档次的
words.ex: The company decided to downscale its operations to save money.
words.ex_cn: 公司决定缩减业务规模以节省资金。
words.en: To reduce in size, extent, or scope; to make something less elaborate or less expensive.

words.ex: He chose teaching as his vocation.
words.ex_cn: 他选择了教学作为自己的职业。
words.en: A vocation is a type of work that you feel you are especially suited to do and to which you give much of your time and energy.

words.ex: We went to the beach during our vacation.
words.ex_cn: 我们在假期去了海滩。
words.en: A vacation is a period of time devoted to pleasure, rest, or relaxation, especially one with pay granted to an employee.

words.ex: The cold weather ails his old bones.
words.ex_cn: 寒冷的天气使他的老骨头疼痛。
words.en: If something ails a group or area of activity, it causes problems or difficulties for it.

words.ex: The sticker adheres to the wall.
words.ex_cn: 贴纸粘在墙上。
words.en: If you adhere to a rule or agreement, you act in the way that it says you should.

words.ex: The bright light stimulated her eyes.
words.ex_cn: 强烈的光线刺激了她的眼睛。
words.en: To stimulate something means to encourage it to begin or develop further.

words.ex: The danger impels him to act quickly.
words.ex_cn: 危险驱使他迅速行动。
words.en: If something impels you to do something, it makes you feel very strongly that you must do it.

words.ex: He sat in a comfortable posture to read the book.
words.ex_cn: 他以一种舒适的姿势坐着看书。

words.ex: He sat in a relaxed posture on the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在沙发上，摆出一种放松的姿势。

words.tr: v. 在……问题上采取强硬立场
words.ex: The government adopted an aggressive posture on tax reform.
words.ex_cn: 政府在税收改革问题上采取了强硬立场。

words.ex: He will enroll in the English course next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将注册英语课程。
words.en: To officially register or enlist oneself or someone else in a course, institution, or organization.

words.tr:
v. 注册；登记；
n. 登记簿；
words.ex: He will register for the course next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会注册这门课程。
words.en: If you register something, you officially record it or list it.

words.ex: The country wants to industrialise to create more jobs.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家希望工业化以创造更多就业机会。
words.en: To industrialise means to develop industry on a wide scale in a country or region.

words.ex: The empire ruled many countries long ago.
words.ex_cn: 这个帝国很久以前统治了许多国家。
words.en: An empire is a group of countries or territories that are under the control of a single ruler or government.

words.ex: The mechanic fixed my car quickly.
words.ex_cn: 机修工很快修好了我的车。
words.en: A mechanic is a person whose job is to repair and maintain machines and engines, especially those of vehicles.

words.ex: He fractured his arm during the soccer game.
words.ex_cn: 他在足球比赛中摔断了手臂。
words.en: If something such as a bone fractures or is fractured, it breaks or cracks.

words.ex: The country's industrialisation began in the 1950s.
words.ex_cn: 该国的工业化始于20世纪50年代。
words.en: Industrialisation is the process by which an economy is transformed from primarily agricultural to one based on the manufacturing of goods. Individual manual labor is often replaced by mechanized mass production, and craftsmen are replaced by assembly lines.

words.tr: adj. 史诗的；叙事诗的；宏丽的；
words.ex: The movie tells an epic story of heroes and dragons.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影讲述了一个关于英雄和龙的史诗故事。
words.en: An epic is a long book, poem, or film, whose story extends over a long period of time or tells of great events.

words.ex: The galactic center is very far from Earth.
words.ex_cn: 银河系中心离地球非常远。
words.en: Relating to a galaxy or galaxies, especially the Milky Way galaxy.

words.ex: She wrote a poetic letter to her friend.
words.ex_cn: 她给朋友写了一封诗意的信。
words.en: Something that is poetic is very beautiful and expresses emotions in a sensitive or moving way.

words.tr: phrase. 复合性骨折（指骨折处皮肤破裂，骨头暴露在外的严重骨折）
words.ex: A compound fracture requires immediate medical attention to prevent infection.
words.ex_cn: 复合骨折需要立即就医以防止感染。
words.en: A compound fracture is a break in a bone that is accompanied by a wound on the skin, which allows the bone to be exposed to the outside environment.

words.ex: He defeated his opponent in the chess game.
words.ex_cn: 他在国际象棋比赛中击败了对手。
words.en: An opponent is someone who is competing against you in a contest, game, or argument, or someone who is opposed to an idea or plan.

words.ex: A car has many components, like wheels and engines.
words.ex_cn: 汽车有许多部分，比如轮子和发动机。
words.en: A component is a part of a larger whole, especially a part that can be separated from or attached to a system.

words.tr:
n. 化合物；
adj. 复合的；混合的；
words.ex: Water is a compound of hydrogen and oxygen.
words.ex_cn: 水是由氢和氧组成的化合物。
words.en: A compound is a substance that consists of two or more elements chemically combined in fixed proportions.

words.ex: The apple plummeted from the tree.
words.ex_cn: 苹果从树上垂直落下。
words.en: If an amount, rate, or price plummets, it decreases quickly by a large amount.

words.ex: The glacial landscape was covered in snow.
words.ex_cn: 冰河地貌被雪覆盖着。
words.en: relating to, resulting from, or denoting the presence or agency of ice, especially in the form of glaciers.

words.ex: The ship arrived at the dock at sunrise.
words.ex_cn: 船在日出时到达了码头。
words.en: A dock is an enclosed area of water in a port where ships go to be loaded, unloaded, and repaired.

words.ex: His argument was clear and logical.
words.ex_cn: 他的论点清晰而有逻辑。
words.en: An argument is a discussion or debate in which people express different opinions about something.

words.tr:
v. 追逐；
n. 追逐；
words.ex: The dog chases the cat every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗每天早上追逐猫。
words.en: To chase someone or something means to quickly follow them or it in order to catch them.

words.ex: He picked up a brochure about the city.
words.ex_cn: 他拿了一本关于这座城市的宣传小册子。
words.en: A brochure is a type of small magazine or booklet containing pictures and information about something or advertising something.

words.ex: He read the booklet about the new rules.
words.ex_cn: 他读了那本关于新规则的小册子。
words.en: A booklet is a small, thin book that has a paper cover and that gives you information about something.

words.ex: He handed me a pamphlet about the new park.
words.ex_cn: 他递给我一份关于新公园的小册子。
words.en: A pamphlet is a small book containing information on a particular subject or expressing political or religious views.

words.tr:
n. 梅子；李子；紫红色；青紫色；令人垂涎的东西
adj. 令人垂涎的；吸引人的
words.ex: He ate a ripe plum for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了一个熟透的李子。
words.en: A plum is a sweet, juicy fruit with a smooth, red or purple skin and a stone in the middle.

words.ex: The plumber fixed the leaky pipe.
words.ex_cn: 水管工修好了漏水的管道。
words.en: A plumber is a person whose job is to connect and repair things such as water and drainage pipes, baths, and toilets.

words.tr: phrase. 符合，与……一致；遵守（规定、标准等）
words.ex: He must conform with the school rules.
words.ex_cn: 他必须遵守校规。
words.en: To comply with rules, standards, or laws; to be similar in form or type.

words.ex: He must conform to the school rules.
words.ex_cn: 他必须遵守校规。
words.en: To comply with rules, standards, or laws; to behave according to socially acceptable conventions or standards.

words.ex: You must comply with the rules.
words.ex_cn: 你必须遵守规则。
words.en: To act in accordance with a wish, command, or rule.

words.ex: You must abide by the school rules.
words.ex_cn: 你必须遵守校规。
words.en: To accept or act in accordance with a rule, decision, or recommendation.

words.tr: n. 客户购买；顾客购买行为
words.ex: The store tracks every customer purchase to improve service.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店追踪每一次客户购买以改进服务。

words.ex: The glacial period covered much of Europe in ice.
words.ex_cn: 冰河时期使欧洲大部分地区被冰雪覆盖。

words.ex: The teacher chastised the boy for talking in class.
words.ex_cn: 老师因为男孩在课堂上说话而责备了他。
words.en: To chastise someone means to punish or criticize them severely.

words.ex: The dog runs to chase after the ball every time.
words.ex_cn: 每次狗都跑着去追球。
words.en: If you chase after someone or something, you run after them or follow them quickly in order to catch or reach them.

words.tr:
adv. 向前；前进；
v. 促进；转交；
adj. 向前的；前进的；
words.ex: He walked forward to meet the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他向前走去见老师。
words.en: If you move or look forward, you move or look in a direction that is in front of you. In British English, you can also say that you are looking forward to something that is going to happen.

words.ex: He tried to convince her to stay.
words.ex_cn: 他试图说服她留下。
words.en: If someone or something convinces you of something, they make you believe that it is true or that it exists.

words.ex: The rain teemed down all night.
words.ex_cn: 雨整晚倾泻而下。
words.en: If a place teems with people, animals, or things, it is full of them and they are all moving around.

words.ex: He must confront his fears.
words.ex_cn: 他必须面对自己的恐惧。
words.en: If you confront a difficult situation or issue, you accept the fact that it exists and try to deal with it.

words.ex: The museum held an exhibition of ancient art.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆举办了一场古代艺术展览。
words.en: An exhibition is a public display of works of art or items of interest, often held in a museum or art gallery.

words.ex: He likes coffee, whereas she prefers tea.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢咖啡，然而她更喜欢茶。
words.en: You use whereas to introduce a comment which contrasts with what is said in the main clause.

words.ex: He needs additional time to finish the homework.
words.ex_cn: 他需要额外的时间来完成作业。
words.en: If something is additional, it is extra and is added to what is already there.

words.ex: The two shadows are overlapping on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 两个影子在地板上交叠。
words.en: If one thing overlaps another, or if you overlap them, a part of the first thing occupies the same area as a part of the other thing.

words.ex: He buys poultry at the local market.
words.ex_cn: 他在当地市场买家禽。
words.en: Poultry refers to domesticated birds kept by humans for their eggs, meat, or feathers.

words.ex: My mom convinced me to eat vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 我妈妈说服我吃蔬菜。

words.tr: phrase. 确信的；坚信……的（指对某事有坚定信念或深信不疑）
words.ex_cn: 他深信她是无辜的。
words.en: To be completely certain about something, especially after considering all the evidence or arguments.

words.ex: He is convinced that math is easy.
words.ex_cn: 他确信数学很简单。
words.en: To be certain that something is true or that someone is telling the truth.

words.tr: 短语动词. 使某人相信某事
words.ex: He tried to convince his friend of the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他试图说服他的朋友相信这个事实。
words.en: To make someone believe that something is true or that something should be done.

words.ex: He remained unconvinced by the explanation.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个解释仍不信服。
words.en: If you are unconvinced, you are not sure that something is true or right.

words.tr: n. 群体；殖民地；聚居地；
words.ex: A colony of ants moved quickly across the ground.
words.ex_cn: 一群蚂蚁迅速从地上爬过。
words.en: A colony is a country or area that is under the political control of another country, usually one that is far away, and where people from that country live.

words.ex: She trims her finger nails every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 她每周日修剪指甲。

words.tr:
n. 背心；马甲；汗衫
v. 授予；使穿衣
words.ex: He wears a black vest over his shirt.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着一件黑色背心，上面是衬衫。
words.en: A vest is a piece of clothing without sleeves that you wear over a shirt.

words.tr:
n. 补助金；授予物；
v. 承认；授予；允许；
words.ex: The university received a grant for scientific research.
words.ex_cn: 这所大学收到了一笔用于科学研究的补助金。
words.en: If someone in authority grants you something, or if something is granted to you, you are allowed to have it or do it.

words.ex: The king will bestow a medal on the hero.
words.ex_cn: 国王将把奖章授予这位英雄。
words.en: To bestow something on someone means to give or present it to them.

words.tr:
adj. 法定的；既定的
v. 授予；使穿衣；“vest”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: He has a vested right to the property.
words.ex_cn: 他对该财产拥有法定权利。
words.en: Past participle of vest: legally granted or secured, especially a right or interest.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 面对；使面对（问题、挑战等）；使对质
words.ex: He must confront with his fears.
words.ex_cn: 他必须面对自己的恐惧。
words.en: To face someone or something in a way that is aggressive or challenging.

words.ex: He is confronted with a difficult problem.
words.ex_cn: 他面临一个困难的问题。
words.en: To be faced with or opposed by something or someone, typically in a challenging or hostile manner.

words.ex: The ground began to subside after the heavy rain.
words.ex_cn: 大雨之后，地面开始下陷。
words.en: If a feeling or noise subsides, it becomes less strong or loud.

words.ex: The government gives a subsidy to farmers.
words.ex_cn: 政府向农民提供补贴。
words.en: A subsidy is money that is paid by a government or other authority in order to help an industry or business, or to pay for a public service.

words.ex: The big company owns a subsidiary that makes phones.
words.ex_cn: 这家大公司拥有一家生产手机的附属公司。
words.en: A subsidiary is a company which is part of a larger and more important company.

words.ex: His opinion is subordinate to the manager's.
words.ex_cn: 他的意见比经理的次要。
words.en: If someone is your subordinate, they have a less important position than you in the organization that you both work for.

words.tr: phrase. 教育展览；展示教育成果或教育资源的展览活动
words.ex: There is an education exhibition at the school hall.
words.ex_cn: 学校礼堂有一个教育展览。
words.en: An event where educational institutions and organizations display their programs, achievements, and innovations to the public.

words.ex: The outlay for the new computer was high.
words.ex_cn: 这台新电脑的花费很高。
words.en: An outlay is an amount of money that you have to spend in order to buy something or to start a project.

words.tr: phrase. 额外费用；附加费用
words.ex: There are additional charges for late payment.
words.ex_cn: 迟交会有额外费用。
words.en: Extra fees or costs added to the base price.

words.tr: n. 额外支出；追加费用
words.ex: The project needed an additional outlay for new equipment.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目需要为新设备支付额外支出。

words.tr: phrase. 额外费用；附加成本
words.ex: The additional cost is five dollars.
words.ex_cn: 额外的费用是五美元。
words.en: An additional cost is an extra amount of money that you have to pay on top of the basic price for something.

words.tr: v. 订阅某物；同意接受某物（如服务、杂志等）

words.ex: She is happy about her pregnancy.
words.ex_cn: 她对她的妊娠感到开心。
words.en: The condition of having a developing embryo or fetus in the body, especially in the uterus.

words.ex: He received a confirmation email for his flight.
words.ex_cn: 他收到了航班的确认邮件。
words.en: Confirmation is the act of confirming something or making it more definite.

words.ex: He said, 'I am tired', unquote.
words.ex_cn: 他说，'我累了'，引号结束。
words.en: used in speech to indicate the end of a quotation

words.ex: He was jailed for embezzlement from his company.
words.ex_cn: 他因盗用公司公款而入狱。
words.en: Embezzlement is the act of dishonestly taking or using money that belongs to someone else, especially when it is in your care or belongs to the organization you work for.

words.ex: The children performed an acrobatic routine on the stage.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在舞台上表演了一个杂技节目。
words.en: Acrobatic refers to the performance of extraordinary feats of balance, agility, and motor coordination, often in a performance context.

words.ex: There are numerous books on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书架上有许多书。
words.en: If people or things are numerous, they exist or are present in large numbers.

words.ex: He drinks coffee on the balcony every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都在阳台上喝咖啡。
words.en: A balcony is a platform on the outside of a building, enclosed by walls or balustrades, supported by columns or console brackets. The platform is projected from the wall of a building, usually above the ground floor.

words.tr:
n. 研究生；
adj. 大学毕业后的；
words.ex: He is a postgraduate at Beijing University.
words.ex_cn: 他是北京大学的一名研究生。
words.en: A postgraduate is a student who continues studying after obtaining a first degree, usually in order to obtain a higher qualification.

words.ex: Exercise helps with your well-being.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼有助于你的健康。
words.en: The state of being comfortable, healthy, or happy.

words.ex: He solves algebra problems every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天解代数题。
words.en: Algebra is a branch of mathematics in which letters and symbols are used to represent numbers and quantities in formulae and equations.

words.ex: He does arithmetic every day with his little sister.
words.ex_cn: 他每天和妹妹一起做算术。
words.en: Arithmetic is the part of mathematics that deals with the addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division of numbers.

words.tr: adj. [数] 代数的；关于代数学的
words.ex: He solved the algebraic equation quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快解出了这个代数方程。
words.en: Relating to or involving algebra.

words.ex: He solved a mathematical problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快解决了一个数学问题。
words.en: Relating to or using mathematics; precise and exact.

words.ex: Osteoporosis is a condition characterized by weak and brittle bones.
words.ex_cn: 骨质疏松症是一种以骨骼脆弱和易碎为特征的病症。
words.en: Osteoporosis is a medical condition in which the bones become brittle and fragile from loss of tissue, typically as a result of hormonal changes, or deficiency of calcium or vitamin D.

words.ex: He has arthritis in his hands.
words.ex_cn: 他双手有关节炎。
words.en: Arthritis is a medical condition in which the joints in someone's body are swollen and painful.

words.tr: adj. 关节炎的；患关节炎的
words.ex: He suffered from arthritic pain in his knees.
words.ex_cn: 他患有膝关节炎的疼痛。
words.en: Suffering from or affected by arthritis.

words.ex: The gardener did a graft on the apple tree.
words.ex_cn: 园丁在苹果树上进行了嫁接。
words.en: Graft can refer to the act of joining parts from different plants so that they grow as one plant, or to the act of transferring living tissue from one part of the body to another. It can also refer to the practice of using one's position to gain money or advantages dishonestly.

words.ex: The government punished the official for corruption.
words.ex_cn: 政府因贪污惩罚了那名官员。
words.en: Corruption is dishonest or illegal behavior, especially by people in positions of power.

words.ex: The children practice acrobatics at the circus school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在马戏学校练习杂技。
words.en: Acrobatics is the performance of extraordinary feats of balance, agility, and motor coordination.

words.tr: n. 杂技演员；立场观点善变的人
words.ex: The acrobat jumps high on the tightrope.
words.ex_cn: 杂技演员在钢丝上跳得很高。
words.en: An acrobat is someone who entertains people by performing difficult physical acts such as jumping and balancing, especially in a circus.

words.ex: The dog jumped over the fence.
words.ex_cn: 狗跳过了栅栏。
words.en: A fence is a barrier between two areas of land, made of wood or wire supported by posts. If you fence an area of land, you surround it with a fence.

words.ex: The team's defence was very strong in the match.
words.ex_cn: 这支队伍在比赛中防守非常坚强。
words.en: The action of defending from or resisting attack.

words.ex: He practices fencing every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 他每天下午练习击剑。
words.en: Fencing is the sport of fighting with swords, especially in the context of a competitive match. It can also refer to the structures or barriers made of wood or wire used to enclose an area.

words.ex: He is an undergraduate at Harvard.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的一名本科生。
words.en: An undergraduate is a student at a university or college who is studying for their first degree.

words.tr:
n. 大学毕业生；
v. 毕业；
words.ex: He is a graduate of Harvard University.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的毕业生。
words.en: A graduate is a person who has successfully completed a degree at a university or college and has received a certificate or diploma stating this. To graduate means to successfully complete a degree at a university or college.

words.ex: She is a post graduate student at Harvard University.
words.ex_cn: 她是哈佛大学的一名研究生。
