words.en: To amend something means to make changes to it in order to improve it or make it more accurate.

words.ex: He revised his answer to make it correct.
words.ex_cn: 他修正了他的答案，使其正确。
words.en: To revise something means to alter or amend it, especially in order to correct or improve it.

words.tr:
adj. 正确的；
v. 改正；修正；
words.ex: The answer is correct.
words.ex_cn: 这个答案是正确的。
words.en: If something is correct, it is right and true. If you correct someone, you tell them that they are wrong.

words.ex: He will rectify the mistake tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会纠正这个错误。
words.en: If you rectify something that is wrong, you change it so that it becomes correct or satisfactory.

words.ex: He swallowed the pill with water.
words.ex_cn: 他用水吞下了药片。
words.en: To swallow means to make food or drink go down your throat and towards your stomach. It can also mean to accept something without protest or to believe something too easily.

words.tr: adj. 匆忙的；草率的；急躁的
words.ex: He made a hasty decision and regretted it.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个仓促的决定，后来后悔了。
words.en: If you describe a person or their behavior as hasty, you mean that they are acting too quickly, without thinking carefully, often with unwanted results.

words.ex: He draws triangles in geometry class.
words.ex_cn: 他在几何课上画三角形。
words.en: Geometry is the branch of mathematics concerned with the properties and relations of points, lines, surfaces, solids, and higher dimensional analogs.

words.tr:
n. 东西；原料；
v. 塞；填充；
words.ex: I need to clean up all this stuff.
words.ex_cn: 我需要清理这些东西。
words.en: If you stuff something somewhere, you push it there quickly and roughly. If you stuff a container or space with something, you fill it completely with that thing.

words.tr:
adj. 向陆地的
adv. 向陆地地
words.ex: The wind blows landward from the sea.
words.ex_cn: 风从海面吹向陆地。
words.en: Toward the land; in the direction of the land.

words.tr: adj. 精力充沛的；茂盛的；
words.ex: He is a vigorous man who runs every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个精力充沛的人，每天早上都跑步。
words.en: A vigorous person does things with great energy and enthusiasm. A vigorous campaign or activity is done with great energy and enthusiasm.

words.ex: This phone is superior to the old one.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机比旧的更好。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as superior, you mean that they are better than other people or things.

words.ex: His opinion is subordinate to the manager's.
words.ex_cn: 他的意见比经理的次要。
words.en: If someone is your subordinate, they have a less important position than you in the organization that you both work for.

words.ex: This product is inferior to the other one.
words.ex_cn: 这个产品比另一个差。
words.en: If one person or thing is inferior to another, they are not as good, important, or valuable as the other person or thing.

words.tr: adj. 中等的；次要的；第二的；
words.ex: He attends a secondary school in the city.
words.ex_cn: 他在城里上一所中学。
words.en: If you describe something as secondary, you mean that it is less important than something else.

words.ex: The big company owns a subsidiary that makes phones.
words.ex_cn: 这家大公司拥有一家生产手机的附属公司。
words.en: A subsidiary is a company which is part of a larger and more important company.

words.tr:
adj. 隶属的；附属的；与…有正式关系的；为…工作的
v. 隶属于；并入；联合；“affiliate”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: The hospital is affiliated with a university.
words.ex_cn: 这家医院与一所大学有关联。
words.en: If an organization is affiliated with another larger organization, it is officially connected with the larger organization or is a member of it.

words.tr: v. 收回自己说过的话；认错并撤回先前的言论
words.ex: He had to swallow his words after realizing he was wrong.
words.ex_cn: 他在意识到自己错了之后，不得不收回自己说过的话。

words.ex: He made an impetuous decision to quit his job.
words.ex_cn: 他冲动地决定辞去工作。
words.en: If you describe someone as impetuous, you mean that they are likely to act quickly and suddenly without thinking or being careful.

words.ex: The navy launched a large fleet to protect the coast.
words.ex_cn: 海军派出了一支大型舰队来保护海岸。
words.en: A fleet is a group of ships or vehicles that are controlled by one company or organization and are used for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He made an expeditious decision to leave.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速做出了离开的决定。
words.en: If you describe something as expeditious, you mean that it is done quickly and efficiently.

words.tr:
n. 提示；
v. 促使；
adj. 迅速的；准时的；
words.ex: The teacher gave a prompt to help students start writing.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了一个提示，帮助学生开始写作。
words.en: If you prompt someone when they stop speaking, you encourage or help them to continue. If you are prompt to do something, you do it without delay or you are not late.

words.ex: He solves algebra problems every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天解代数题。
words.en: Algebra is a branch of mathematics in which letters and symbols are used to represent numbers and quantities in formulae and equations.

words.ex: She stuffed the turkey with herbs and onions.
words.ex_cn: 她用香草和洋葱把火鸡塞满。

words.ex: I have a stuffed nose because of the cold.
words.ex_cn: 我因为感冒鼻子堵住了。
words.en: To experience nasal congestion, making it difficult to breathe through the nose.

words.ex: The boat began a landward sailing as the wind changed direction.
words.ex_cn: 当风向改变时，船开始向陆地航行。

words.tr: adj. 至关重要的；批判性的；关键的；危急的；临界的；
words.ex: Water is critical for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命至关重要。
words.en: If you are critical of someone or something, you show that you disapprove of them. In a critical situation, things are very serious and dangerous. A critical time or event is extremely important because it will affect future events.

words.tr: adj. 至关重要的；决定性的；
words.ex: It is crucial to drink water every day.
words.ex_cn: 每天喝水至关重要。
words.en: If you describe something as crucial, you mean it is extremely important.

words.ex: The vigorous students run around the playground every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这些精力充沛的学生每天早上都在操场上跑步。

words.tr:
adj. 肮脏恶臭的；
v. 对…犯规；
words.ex: The foul smell came from the garbage bin.
words.ex_cn: 那股恶臭来自垃圾桶。
words.en: If you describe something as foul, you mean it is dirty and smells or tastes unpleasant. In sports, a foul is an act that is against the rules of the game.

words.tr: adj. 自给自足的；自我维持的
words.ex: The farm is self-sustaining and grows its own food.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场是自给自足的，自己种植食物。
words.en: Capable of continuing to exist or function without outside help.

words.tr: adj. 持续的； v. “sustain”的现在分词；
words.ex: The sustaining effort helped the team win.
words.ex_cn: 持续的努力帮助团队赢得了比赛。
words.en: To sustain means to keep something going or to support it over a period of time. It can also refer to the ability to endure or withstand something.

words.ex: We need sustainable energy to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要可持续的能源来保护环境。
words.en: If something is sustainable, it can be maintained or continued at a certain rate or level without causing damage or depletion of resources.

words.ex: The farmer works hard to sustain his crops.
words.ex_cn: 这位农民努力维持他的庄稼。
words.en: To sustain something means to continue it or maintain it for a period of time.

words.ex: His temperature is normal.
words.ex_cn: 他的体温正常。
words.en: Something that is normal is usual and ordinary, and is what people expect.

words.tr: adj. 普通的；平常的；一般的；
words.ex: He wore an ordinary shirt to school.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了一件普通的衬衫去学校。
words.en: Something that is ordinary is not special or different in any way.

words.tr:
adj. 有规律的；经常的；常见的；
n. 常客；
words.ex: He goes for a run every morning, a regular habit.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上跑步，这是一个有规律的习惯。
words.en: Something that is regular happens or is done at equal intervals or is consistent in pattern or occurrence.

words.ex: The number of apples corresponds to the number of oranges.
words.ex_cn: 苹果的数量与橙子的数量相对应。
words.en: If one thing corresponds to another, there is a close similarity or connection between them, often because one is the cause or the result of the other.

words.ex: He said farewell to his friends before leaving.
words.ex_cn: 他离开前向朋友们道别。
words.en: Farewell is an expression of good wishes at parting, often used to say goodbye.

words.ex: The two houses are adjacent to each other.
words.ex_cn: 这两栋房子彼此相邻。
words.en: If one thing is adjacent to another, it is next to it or adjoining it.

words.tr: adj. 贴邻的；毗连的； v. “adjoin”的现在分词；
words.ex: The two houses are adjoining.
words.ex_cn: 这两所房子是贴邻的。
words.en: Adjoining is used to describe something that is next to or joined with something else.

words.tr: adj. 相接的；相邻的；接壤的
words.ex: The two countries are contiguous.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家是相邻的。
words.en: Being in contact; touching or next to each other.

words.ex: The charity helps poor children get food and education.
words.ex_cn: 这个慈善团体帮助贫困儿童获得食物和教育。
words.en: An organization that helps people in need, or the act of giving money, food, or help to those who need it.

words.ex: He likes to watch comedy on TV.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在电视上看喜剧。
words.en: A comedy is a type of drama or other art form the main object of which, according to modern notions, is to amuse.

words.ex: She wore a gorgeous dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件华丽的裙子去参加派对。
words.en: If you say that something is gorgeous, you mean that it gives you a lot of pleasure or is very attractive.

words.ex: I recommend this book to you.
words.ex_cn: 我向你推荐这本书。
words.en: If someone recommends a person or thing to you, they suggest that you would find them good or useful.

words.tr: v. 幸存；生存；存活；艰难挺过；
words.ex: He survived the accident with minor injuries.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故中幸存下来，只有轻微受伤。
words.en: If you survive in a dangerous situation, you continue to live or exist in spite of it.

words.tr: v. 与某物相对应；与某物一致
words.ex: The numbers correspond to the colors on the map.
words.ex_cn: 这些数字与地图上的颜色相对应。

words.tr: v. 与某事物相符；与某事物一致
words.ex: His answer does not correspond with the question.
words.ex_cn: 他的答案与问题不符。

words.ex: They maintain correspondence through letters.
words.ex_cn: 他们通过信件保持通信联系。
words.en: Communication by exchanging letters with someone; a close similarity, connection, or equivalence.

words.tr: adj. 相应的； v. 符合；“correspond”的现在分词；
words.ex: Each input has a corresponding output.
words.ex_cn: 每个输入都有一个相应的输出。
words.en: If two things are corresponding, they are similar or equivalent in some way, often because they are connected or related in a particular context.

words.ex: The disease afflicted many people in the village.
words.ex_cn: 这种疾病使村子里许多人遭受痛苦。
words.en: If you are afflicted by pain, illness, or misfortune, it causes you great suffering and distress.

words.tr:
n. 痛苦；折磨；令人痛苦的东西
v. 折磨；使痛苦；烦扰；纠缠；戏弄
words.ex: The loss of his dog was a deep torment.
words.ex_cn: 失去他的狗是一种深深的痛苦。
words.en: Torment refers to severe physical or mental suffering, or to cause someone to experience such suffering.

words.tr:
n. 酷刑；拷打
v. 拷打；折磨
words.ex: The prisoner suffered from torture during the war.
words.ex_cn: 这名囚犯在战争期间遭受了酷刑。
words.en: Torture is the act of deliberately inflicting severe physical or psychological pain on someone, typically to extract information or a confession, or as a punishment.

words.tr: phrase. 在…附近；在…周围；在邻近地区
words.ex: The park is in the vicinity of the school.
words.ex_cn: 公园在学校附近。
words.en: in the area near a particular place

words.tr: adj. 休眠的；蛰伏的；暂停活动的
words.ex: The volcano is dormant now.
words.ex_cn: 这座火山现在处于休眠状态。
words.en: Something that is dormant is not active or growing but has the ability to be active at a later time.

words.tr: adj. 分离的； v. 脱离；拆卸；分离；“detach”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The house is detached from the neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子与邻居的房子是分开的。
words.en: If someone is detached, they do not have any emotional interest in a situation and therefore can make fair decisions.

words.tr:
adj. 分开的；分离的；单独的；
v. 分离；隔离；
words.ex: They live in separate houses.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在分开的房子里。
words.en: To cause to move or be apart; to divide or keep apart.

words.tr: n. 慈善捐赠；向慈善机构的捐款
words.ex: He made a charity donation to help the poor.
words.ex_cn: 他捐了一笔慈善捐款来帮助穷人。
words.en: A voluntary gift of money or goods to a non-profit organization.

words.tr: phrase. 慈善医院；由慈善机构资助的医院，通常为贫困人群提供免费或低价医疗服务
words.ex: The charity hospital gives free care to poor people.
words.ex_cn: 这家慈善医院为穷人提供免费治疗。
words.en: A charity hospital is a hospital that provides medical services free of charge or at a reduced cost to those who cannot afford to pay.

words.tr: n. 喜剧演员；滑稽人物；
words.ex: The comedian made everyone laugh with his jokes.
words.ex_cn: 这位喜剧演员用他的笑话逗得大家大笑。
words.en: A comedian is a person whose job is to make people laugh by telling jokes or funny stories.

words.ex: The garden was filled with blooming azaleas.
words.ex_cn: 花园里开满了盛开的杜鹃花。
words.en: An azalea is a woody plant of the genus Rhododendron, with brightly coloured flowers.

words.ex: I recommend you this book.
words.ex_cn: 我推荐你这本书。

words.ex: We recommend that you drink more water.
words.ex_cn: 我们建议你多喝水。

words.ex: The teacher gave me a recommendation for the scholarship.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我写了一封奖学金推荐信。
words.en: A suggestion or proposal as to the best course of action, especially one put forward by an authoritative body.

words.ex: The survival of the animals depends on the weather.
words.ex_cn: 这些动物的生存取决于天气。
words.en: The state or fact of continuing to live or exist, typically in spite of an accident, ordeal, or difficult circumstances.

words.tr: adj. 严厉的；严峻的；冷酷无情的；坚定的；可怕的
words.ex: He had a grim look on his face.
words.ex_cn: 他脸上带着严峻的表情。
words.en: If a situation or piece of news is grim, it is very serious, unpleasant, and depressing.

words.ex: The lab has a new apparatus for measuring temperature.
words.ex_cn: 实验室有一台新的温度测量装置。
words.en: The complex structure of a particular system or organization, or the equipment used for a specific purpose.

words.ex: The church has a big dome above the altar.
words.ex_cn: 教堂的祭坛上方有一个大穹顶。
words.en: A dome is a rounded vault made of either curved segments or a shell of revolution, meaning an arch rotated around its central vertical axis.

words.ex: He wore a formal suit to the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了一套正式的西装去参加婚礼。
words.en: Something that is formal is done or said according to an established or conventional way, especially in an official or serious situation.

words.ex: They explore the forest to find hidden caves.
words.ex_cn: 他们探索森林以寻找隐藏的洞穴。
words.en: To explore means to travel over or through an unfamiliar area in order to learn about it or to search for something valuable.

words.tr: n. 扩展；延长期；延伸；电话分机；
words.ex: The company added an extension to its office building.
words.ex_cn: 公司为办公楼加了一个扩建部分。
words.en: An extension is a part that is added to something to make it longer or larger, or the act of adding this part.

words.ex: The team consists of five players.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队由五名球员组成。
words.en: If something consists of particular things or people, it is made up of them.

words.tr:
v. 酿造；沏；酝酿
n. 酿造的饮料；啤酒
words.ex: He brews coffee every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上冲咖啡。
words.en: If you brew tea or coffee, you make it by pouring hot water over tea leaves or ground coffee. If you brew beer, you make it by soaking grain in water and then fermenting it.

words.ex: He always keeps his garden trim and neat.
words.ex_cn: 他总是把花园打理得整洁有序。
words.en: To trim something means to make it tidier or more level by cutting a small amount off it.

words.ex: He wore jeans to the informal party.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着牛仔裤去参加非正式的聚会。
words.en: If you describe something as informal, you mean that it is not done or said in a formal or official way.

words.ex: He did an exploratory trip to find new places.
words.ex_cn: 他进行了一次探索性的旅行来寻找新地方。
words.en: relating to or involving exploration or investigation

words.ex: The exploration of space takes many years.
words.ex_cn: 太空探索需要很多年。
words.en: The act of searching for the purpose of discovery of information or resources.

words.ex: The teacher gave me a one month extension for my project.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我一个月的延期来完成我的项目。

words.ex: Reading books helps the extension of vocabulary.
words.ex_cn: 读书有助于词汇的扩展。

words.tr: n. 对某物的延伸；对某物的扩展
words.ex: The extension to the house took two months.
words.ex_cn: 对房子的延伸部分花了两个月时间。

words.ex: The team comprises five players and one coach.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队包括五名球员和一名教练。
words.en: If you say that something comprises or is comprised of a number of things or people, you mean it has them as its parts or members.

words.tr:
n. 框架；结构；骨架；模式；
v. 表达；陷害；
words.ex: The picture is in a wooden frame.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画在一个木制框架里。
words.en: A frame is a structure that forms a border or support for something, such as a picture or a window. It can also refer to the process of making or constructing something, or the act of falsely incriminating someone.

words.ex: The team consists of five players.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队由五名球员组成。
words.en: If something consists of particular things or people, it is made up of them.

words.ex: Happiness consists in simple moments.
words.ex_cn: 幸福在于简单的时刻。
words.en: If you say that something consists in a particular thing, you mean that the thing mentioned is the main or essential feature of it.

words.ex: The tuition for this course is $500.
words.ex_cn: 这门课程的学费是500美元。
words.en: Tuition is the fee charged for instruction, especially at a college, university, or private school.

words.tr: n. 始终一贯；前后一致；
words.ex: His consistency in studying every day helped him pass the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他每天学习的一贯坚持帮助他通过了考试。
words.en: Consistency is the quality or condition of being consistent, especially in achieving a level of performance or behavior that does not vary greatly in quality over time.

words.ex: He consistently arrives at school on time.
words.ex_cn: 他一贯准时到校。
words.en: In a way that does not vary; in the same way over time.

words.ex: She weaves a basket from reeds.
words.ex_cn: 她用芦苇编织一个篮子。
words.en: If you weave cloth or a carpet, you make it by crossing threads over and under each other using a machine or a frame called a loom.

words.ex: He pays tuition fee every semester.
words.ex_cn: 他每学期支付学费。
words.en: A tuition fee is the amount of money that you have to pay for being taught in a school, college, or university.

words.ex: The university offers a tuition waiver for students with exceptional academic records.
words.ex_cn: 这所大学为学术成绩优异的学生提供学费减免。
words.en: A tuition waiver is a financial aid award that allows a student to attend a college or university without paying tuition fees.

words.ex: He signed a waiver before the ride.
words.ex_cn: 他在坐过山车前签了免责协议。
words.en: A waiver is an official document or statement that gives up a right or claim, especially in legal contexts.

words.ex: The brewery makes fresh beer every day.
words.ex_cn: 这家啤酒厂每天生产新鲜的啤酒。
words.en: A brewery is a place where beer is made commercially.

words.ex: The old brewhouse has been turned into a museum.
words.ex_cn: n. 那个古老的啤酒厂已被改造成博物馆。
words.en: A brewhouse is a building or establishment where beer is brewed.

words.ex: He is irritable when he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 他累了的时候容易烦躁。
words.en: If someone is irritable, they are easily annoyed.

words.tr: v. 激怒；使急躁；使疼痛
words.ex: Loud noises irritate my baby.
words.ex_cn: 噪音会激怒我的宝宝。
words.en: If something irritates you, it keeps annoying you.

words.tr:
v. 牺牲；
n. 牺牲（品）；
words.ex: He sacrificed his time to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他牺牲了自己的时间来帮助朋友。
words.en: If you sacrifice something that is valuable or important, you give it up, usually to obtain something else for yourself or for other people.

words.tr:
adj. 退步的；堕落的；腐化的
v. 退化；堕落
n. 堕落的人
words.ex: The old machine became degenerate and stopped working.
words.ex_cn: 这台旧机器退步了，停止工作了。
words.en: If you say that someone or something degenerates, you mean that they become worse in some way, for example, poorer, weaker, or less respectable.

words.tr: adj. 有才智的；聪明的；明智的；
words.ex: The intelligent boy solved the math problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这个有才智的男孩很快解出了这道数学题。
words.en: Someone who is intelligent has the ability to think, understand, and learn things quickly and well.

words.ex: The ancient ritual included a sacrificial offering to the gods.
words.ex_cn: 这个古老仪式包括对神灵的献祭供品。
words.en: Relating to or involving the act of offering something to a deity, especially by killing an animal or person in a religious ceremony.

words.ex: The bird evolved from a small dinosaur.
words.ex_cn: 这种鸟由一种小型恐龙演变而来。
words.en: If something evolves or you evolve it, it gradually develops over a period of time into something different and usually more advanced.

words.tr: n. 衰落；退化；恶化；变质
words.ex: The degeneration of the old building worried the town.
words.ex_cn: 这座老建筑的衰落让小镇居民感到担忧。
words.en: The process by which something declines or deteriorates, often in terms of quality, function, or moral standards.

words.ex: The country is developing its economy.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正在发展它的经济。
words.en: To develop means to grow or cause to grow and become more mature, advanced, or elaborate.

words.tr: phrase. 一个有智慧的读者；指具有理解力和判断力的阅读者
words.ex: An intelligent reader understands the story quickly.
words.ex_cn: 一个聪明的读者能很快理解这个故事。
words.en: A reader who understands and analyzes texts critically and perceptively.

words.tr:
v. 补充；
n. 补充物；附加费；
words.ex: He supplements his income by teaching part-time.
words.ex_cn: 他通过兼职教学来补充收入。
words.en: A supplement is something that is added to something else in order to make it complete or better.

words.ex: He shows high intelligence in solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他在解决数学问题时表现出很高的智力。
words.en: The ability to acquire and apply knowledge and skills.

words.tr:
adj. 智力的；
n. 知识分子；
words.ex: He is an intellectual person who loves solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个热爱解决数学问题的智力型人。
words.en: An intellectual is someone who spends a lot of time studying and thinking about complicated ideas.

words.ex: The cetacean jumped out of the water.
words.ex_cn: 这只鲸类动物跃出了水面。
words.en: A cetacean is a marine mammal of the order Cetacea, which includes whales, dolphins, and porpoises.

words.ex: The whale swims deep in the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 鲸在海洋深处游动。
words.en: A whale is a very large mammal that lives in the sea.

words.ex: The trees bud in spring.
words.ex_cn: 树木在春天发芽。
words.en: A bud is a small pointed lump that appears on a tree or plant and develops into a leaf or flower.

words.ex: The taste bud detects sweet food.
words.ex_cn: 味蕾能尝出甜食。
words.en: A taste bud is a small organ on the tongue that allows you to recognize the flavors of food and drink.

words.tr: adj. 未充分发展的；初步的；基本的；
words.ex: His knowledge of math is rudimentary.
words.ex_cn: 他对数学的了解是初步的。
words.en: Rudimentary means relating to the basic or simplest aspects of a subject, or being in the earliest stages of development.

words.ex: He did a preliminary test before the main experiment.
words.ex_cn: 他在主要实验之前做了一个初步测试。
words.en: Preliminary means something that is done or happens before the main part or event, especially as an introduction or preparation.

words.ex: He is learning elementary math at school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校学习初级数学。
words.en: Elementary means relating to the simplest and most basic aspects of a subject.

words.ex: His aspiration is to become a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他的渴望是成为一名医生。
words.en: A strong desire to achieve something high or great.

words.ex: He has a considerable amount of money.
words.ex_cn: 他有相当多的钱。
words.en: Considerable means large in size, amount, or extent.

words.ex: He is clumsy and dropped the glass.
words.ex_cn: 他很笨拙，把玻璃杯打翻了。
words.en: A clumsy person moves or handles things in a careless, awkward way, often so that things are knocked over or broken.

words.tr:
v. 闪烁；隐约闪现
n. 亮光；闪光
words.ex: The sun gleams on the water.
words.ex_cn: 阳光照在水面上，闪闪发亮。
words.en: A gleam is a small, bright light, especially one that shines for a short time.

words.tr: v. 强烈吸引住；使着迷；
words.ex: The magic show fascinated the children.
words.ex_cn: 魔术表演深深吸引了孩子们。
words.en: If something fascinates you, it interests and delights you so much that your thoughts tend to concentrate on it.

words.ex: He obsesses over small mistakes.
words.ex_cn: 他 obsesses 于微小的错误。
words.en: If something or someone obsesses you, you think or worry about them all the time and you cannot think about anything else.

words.tr:
v. 记录；准确地描述；俘虏；吸引；
n. 抓捕；
words.ex: The camera can capture the moment clearly.
words.ex_cn: 相机可以清晰地记录下这一瞬间。
words.en: To capture someone or something means to catch them, especially after a chase.

words.ex: The magic show captivates the children.
words.ex_cn: 魔术表演吸引了孩子们。
words.en: If you are captivated by someone or something, you find them fascinating and attractive.

words.tr: v. 诱骗；消遣；迷住；消磨
words.ex: He beguiles her with sweet words.
words.ex_cn: 他用甜言蜜语哄骗她。
words.en: If someone beguiles you, they charm you in a way that makes you trust them or like them, often so that they can deceive you.

words.ex: The teacher supervises the students during the experiment.
words.ex_cn: 老师在实验期间指导学生。
words.en: If you supervise an activity or a person, you make sure that the activity is done correctly or that the person is doing a task or behaving correctly.

words.tr: adj. 有抱负的；梦寐以求的
words.ex: He has an aspirational goal to become a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他有一个成为医生的志向。
words.en: If you describe someone as aspirational, you mean that they have strong hopes of moving to a higher social status or standard of living.

words.ex: Hiking up the mountain was a strenuous task.
words.ex_cn: 爬山是一项艰苦的任务。
words.en: Requiring or using great effort or exertion.

words.tr: v. 向往；渴望；追求；立志
words.ex: He aspires to be a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他向往成为一名医生。
words.en: If you aspire to something, you have a strong desire to achieve it or attain it.

words.ex: The church's steeple was visible from miles away.
words.ex_cn: 教堂的尖塔在数英里外就能看到。
words.en: A steeple is a tall pointed structure on the top of a building, especially a church.

words.tr:
n. 尖塔；尖顶
v. 给 ... 装尖顶；塔状矗立
words.ex: The church has a tall spire.
words.ex_cn: 这座教堂有一个高高的尖顶。
words.en: A spire is a tall, pointed structure on top of a building, especially a church.

words.ex: The obelisk stands in the center of the square.
words.ex_cn: 方尖碑矗立在广场中央。
words.en: An obelisk is a tall, four-sided, narrow tapering monument which ends in a pyramid-like shape at the top, originally erected in pairs at the entrances of ancient Egyptian temples.

words.ex: My passport will expire next month.
words.ex_cn: 我的护照下个月到期。
words.en: If something such as a contract or a visa expires, it comes to an end or is no longer valid.

words.ex: He exhale slowly after running.
words.ex_cn: 他跑步后慢慢呼出气。
words.en: To exhale means to breathe out air from your lungs.

words.ex: The road was closed, so we took detours to get home.
words.ex_cn: 路被封了，所以我们绕道回家。
words.en: If you make a detour on a journey, you go by a route which is not the shortest way, because you want to avoid something such as a traffic jam, or because there is something you want to do on the way.

words.ex: The candle's flicker lit up the dark room.
words.ex_cn: 蜡烛的闪现照亮了黑暗的房间。
words.en: If a light or flame flickers, it shines unsteadily.

words.tr:
v. 轻弹；轻击；轻拂；忽然摇动
n. 轻弹；轻拂；快速的轻打
words.ex: He flicked the light switch on.
words.ex_cn: 他 flick 了一下电灯开关。
words.en: To move or hit something with a quick, sharp movement.

words.tr:
adj. 闪闪发光的；明晃晃；闪亮的
v. 闪烁；隐约闪现；“gleam”的现在分词
words.ex: The gleaming sword caught the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 闪亮的剑捕捉到了阳光。
words.en: A gleaming object is shining brightly.

words.tr:
adj. 辉煌的；成功的；盛大的；华丽的
v. 闪耀；闪亮；流露（感情）；“glitter”的现在分词
words.ex: The sky was filled with glittering stars.
words.ex_cn: 天空中满是闪闪发光的星星。
words.en: Something that is glittering shines brightly with little flashes of light.

words.ex: He is fascinated by stars.
words.ex_cn: 他被星星深深吸引。
words.en: To be extremely interested in something, so that you want to look at it, learn about it etc.

words.ex: The supervisor checked the workers' progress.
words.ex_cn: 主管检查了工人们的进展。
words.en: A supervisor is a person who oversees and directs the work of others.

words.ex: The teacher gave supervision to the students during the exam.
words.ex_cn: 老师在考试期间监督学生。
words.en: The act of overseeing or directing a project, activity, or person.

words.ex: The supervisory team checks the workers every day.
words.ex_cn: 监督团队每天检查工人们。
words.en: Relating to the supervision or management of something or someone.

words.tr: v. 给予（药物或治疗）；管理；实施；
words.ex: The nurse will administer the medicine to the patient.
words.ex_cn: 护士会给病人服药。
words.en: To administer means to manage or oversee the execution, use, or conduct of something; to dispense or apply (a remedy or drug).

words.tr: v. 监督；管理；主管；指挥
words.ex: He superintends the construction site every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天监督建筑工地。
words.en: To be in charge of something and make sure that it is working as it should.

words.ex: The superintendent of the school is very strict.
words.ex_cn: 学校的主管非常严格。
words.en: A superintendent is a person who is in charge of a particular department or activity, especially within a school, housing project, or police force.

words.ex: The shopkeeper will evaluate the old watch.
words.ex_cn: 店主将估价这块旧手表。
words.en: If you evaluate something or someone, you consider them in order to make a judgment about them, for example about how good or bad they are.

words.tr:
n. 接触（的机会或权利）；进入；通道；
v. 获取；使用；接近；
words.ex: Students need access to the library.
words.ex_cn: 学生需要有接触图书馆的机会。
words.en: If you have access to a building or other place, you are able to enter it or use it.

words.ex: The teacher will assess your homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 老师明天会评估你的作业。
words.en: to judge or decide the amount, value, quality, or importance of something

words.ex: The child's curiosity made him ask many questions.
words.ex_cn: 孩子的好奇心让他问了很多问题。
words.en: A desire to know or learn about something; something that is interesting because it is unusual or strange.

words.ex: He lives in a residential area near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他住在公园附近的一个住宅区。
words.en: Relating to or suitable for residence.

words.tr:
adj. 唯一的；
n. 鞋底；
words.ex: He is the sole owner of the shop.
words.ex_cn: 他是这家商店唯一的主人。
words.en: If you describe something as the sole thing of a particular kind, you mean that it is the only one of that kind.

words.ex: He lived in Paris for a decade.
words.ex_cn: 他在巴黎生活了十年。
words.en: A decade is a period of ten years, especially one that begins with a year ending in 0, for example 1980 to 1989.

words.tr:
n. 调查；勘测；
v. 调查；勘测；
words.ex: The school did a survey about student lunch preferences.
words.ex_cn: 学校做了一项关于学生午餐偏好的调查。
words.en: A survey is a detailed study or inspection, especially as a means of collecting information about people's opinions or behavior.

words.tr: v. 符合；“fit”的现在分词； adj. 恰当的；适合的；
words.ex: This shoe fits my foot perfectly.
words.ex_cn: 这双鞋很合我的脚。
words.en: Appropriate or suitable for a particular purpose, person, occasion, etc.

words.tr: adj. 未充分发展的；初步的；基本的；
words.ex: His knowledge of math is rudimentary.
words.ex_cn: 他对数学的了解是初步的。
words.en: Rudimentary means relating to the basic or simplest aspects of a subject, or being in the earliest stages of development.

words.ex: He is learning elementary math at school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校学习初级数学。
words.en: Elementary means relating to the simplest and most basic aspects of a subject.

words.ex: He did a preliminary test before the main experiment.
words.ex_cn: 他在主要实验之前做了一个初步测试。
words.en: Preliminary means something that is done or happens before the main part or event, especially as an introduction or preparation.

words.tr: v. 发慈悲；动怜悯心；缓和
words.ex: The teacher finally relented and gave the students more time.
words.ex_cn: 老师终于发慈悲，给了学生们更多时间。
words.en: If you relent, you allow someone to do something that you had previously refused to allow them to do.

words.ex: The relentless rain flooded the streets.
words.ex_cn: 无情的雨水淹没了街道。
words.en: Someone who is relentless is determined to do something and refuses to give up, even if what they are doing is unpleasant or cruel.

words.ex: His residence is near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他的住所靠近公园。
words.en: A residence is a house or place where someone lives.

words.tr:
adj. 居住的；常驻的；
n. 常住居民；
words.ex: The resident population grew last year.
words.ex_cn: 居住人口去年增加了。
words.en: A resident is someone who lives in a particular place or a person who has their home in a place.

words.tr: n. 住宅物业；住宅地产
words.ex: He bought a residential property near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他在公园附近买了一处住宅物业。

words.tr: n. 寄宿学校；指为学生提供住宿和教育的学校，尤其指历史上一些国家为原住民儿童设立的强制性寄宿教育机构
words.ex: He went to a residential school when he was ten.
words.ex_cn: 他十岁时去了寄宿学校。

words.ex: The asian residential area has many small restaurants.
words.ex_cn: 亚洲人居住区有许多小餐馆。

words.ex: The workers live in residential quarters near the factory.
words.ex_cn: 工人们住在工厂附近的住宅区。

words.ex: He put a new shoe pad in his running shoe.
words.ex_cn: 他在跑鞋里放了一块新的鞋垫。

words.ex: The insole of his shoe is worn out.
words.ex_cn: 他的鞋垫已经磨坏了。
words.en: A piece of material that is placed inside a shoe to make it more comfortable or to improve the fit.

words.tr: n. 唯一的家长；单亲（通常指独自抚养孩子的父亲或母亲）
words.ex: She is a sole parent and works two jobs.
words.ex_cn: 她是一位单亲父母，同时做两份工作。
words.en: A parent who raises a child alone, without a partner or spouse.

words.ex: He solely depends on his bike to go to work.
words.ex_cn: 他只靠自行车去上班。
words.en: If something is solely the case, it is the only thing that is the case.

words.tr: phrase. 抽样调查；样本调查
words.ex: A sample survey was conducted to assess public opinion on the new policy.
words.ex_cn: 进行了一项抽样调查，以评估公众对新政策的意见。
words.en: A study in which data is collected from a subset of a population to infer characteristics of the whole.

words.ex: He does land survey for the new road.
words.ex_cn: 他为新道路进行土地测量。
words.en: The process of measuring and mapping land to determine its boundaries, features, and value.

words.ex: The school did a survey of reading habits among students.
words.ex_cn: 学校对学生进行了阅读习惯调查。

words.tr: phrase. 地质调查；对地壳结构、岩石组成及矿产资源等进行的系统性勘察与研究
words.ex: The team did a geological survey in the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 团队在山里进行了地质调查。
words.en: A geological survey is the systematic investigation of the geology beneath a piece of ground for the purpose of creating a geological map or model.

words.ex: The birds perform a dance during courtship.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类在求偶时会跳舞。
words.en: The period during which a couple develop a romantic relationship, especially with a view to marriage.

words.tr: n. （宗教等的）仪式；例行习惯；
words.ex: The village holds a ritual every spring to pray for good weather.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄每年春天都举行一个仪式，祈求好天气。
words.en: A ritual is a religious service or other ceremony which involves a series of actions performed in a fixed order.

words.ex: He uses stereoscopic glasses to see the 3D picture.
words.ex_cn: 他戴立体眼镜来看三维图片。
words.en: Relating to or denoting a process by which two photographs of the same object taken at slightly different angles are viewed together, creating an impression of depth and solidity.

words.tr: adj. 立体声的；三度空间的
words.ex: The speakers play stereophonic sound.
words.ex_cn: 扬声器播放立体声。
words.en: Relating to or producing sound from two or more sources or channels, creating a sense of spatial depth.

words.ex: The phone has a simple interface.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机有一个简单的界面。
words.en: An interface is a point where two systems, subjects, organizations, etc. meet and interact.

words.tr: adj. 浑浊的；污浊不清的；
words.ex: The river water looks turbid after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后河水看起来浑浊。
words.en: If you describe something as turbid, you mean that it is cloudy, dirty, or muddy.

words.ex: The book has a thick cover.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有厚厚的封面。
words.en: Having a large distance between the top and bottom or front and back surfaces; not thin.

words.ex: His repertoire includes singing, dancing, and acting.
words.ex_cn: 他的全部才能包括唱歌、跳舞和表演。
words.en: A repertoire is all the plays, songs, pieces of music, etc. that a performer or group knows and can perform.

words.ex: The theater's repertory includes classic plays and modern dramas.
words.ex_cn: 这家剧院的全部剧目包括经典戏剧和现代戏剧。
words.en: A repertory is a collection of pieces of music or plays that a company or performer knows or is prepared to perform.

words.tr: adj. 单调乏味的；毫无变化的；
words.ex: The work is monotonous and boring.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作单调乏味。
words.en: Something that is monotonous is very boring because it has a regular, repeated pattern which never changes.

words.ex: The long meeting was tedious.
words.ex_cn: 这场漫长的会议很沉闷。
words.en: If you describe something such as a job, task, or situation as tedious, you mean it is boring and rather frustrating.

words.tr: adj. 阴暗的；枯燥的；无趣的；
words.ex: The room was dull because the windows were covered.
words.ex_cn: 房间很阴暗，因为窗户被遮住了。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as dull, you mean they are not interesting or exciting.

words.tr:
n. 袭击；罢工；
v. 击打；侵袭；突然想到；
words.ex: The strike on the base happened at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 对基地的袭击发生在黎明时分。
words.en: To hit someone or something forcefully; to stop work as a form of protest.

words.tr: n. 中风；划水动作；一击；
words.ex: He had a stroke last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年中风了。
words.en: A stroke is a medical condition in which poor blood flow to the brain results in cell death. It can also refer to an act of hitting or striking someone or something, or a gentle movement of the hand over a surface.

words.tr:
n. 顺序；条理；命令；订单；(生物学的)目；
v. 订购；命令；点餐；整理；
words.ex: The books are in alphabetical order.
words.ex_cn: 这些书是按字母顺序排列的。
words.en: If you order someone to do something, you tell them to do it in a way that they have to obey. Order can also refer to the way things are arranged or a request to make or supply something.

words.ex: She was stroking the cat gently.
words.ex_cn: 她轻轻地抚摸着猫咪。
words.en: The act of moving one's hand or an object gently over a surface or someone's body in a tender or loving manner.

words.tr: phrase. 婚礼仪式；结婚典礼
words.ex: They had a small wedding ceremony in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们在公园举行了简单的婚礼仪式。
words.en: A wedding ceremony is a formal event at which two people are married to each other.

words.ex: The wedding ritual includes exchanging rings and vows.
words.ex_cn: 婚礼仪式包括交换戒指和誓言。

words.tr:
v. 焊接
n. 焊接
words.ex: He welds metal pieces together with a torch.
words.ex_cn: 他用焊枪把金属片焊接在一起。
words.en: To join pieces of metal together by heating the surfaces until they melt and pressing them together.

words.tr: n. 对婚姻仪式重视程度的某种下降
words.uk: sʌm dɪˈklaɪn ɪn ðə ˈɛmfəsɪs ɡɪvən tu ˈmærɪdʒ ˈrɪtʃuːəlz
words.us: sʌm dɪˈklaɪn ɪn ðə ˈɛmfəsɪs ɡɪvən tu ˈmɛrɪdʒ ˈrɪtʃuəlz
words.ex: There is some decline in the emphasis given to marriage rituals.
words.ex_cn: 对婚姻仪式的重视程度有所下降。

words.ex: He showed courtesy by holding the door open.
words.ex_cn: 他为别人扶着门，表现得很礼貌。
words.en: Courtesy is polite behavior, or a polite action or remark.

words.ex: His politeness made everyone feel welcome.
words.ex_cn: 他的礼貌让每个人都感到受欢迎。
words.en: Politeness is the practical application of good manners or etiquette so as not to offend others.

words.ex: The argument was pointless.
words.ex_cn: 这个争论毫无意义。
words.en: If you describe something as pointless, you are emphasizing that it has no purpose or is not worth doing.

words.tr:
n. 立体声；立体声音响
adj. 立体声的
words.ex: He plays music on the stereo.
words.ex_cn: 他通过立体声收音机播放音乐。
words.en: A stereo is a sound system that uses two or more separate microphones to record sound and two or more loudspeakers to play it back, so that you hear different parts of the sound coming from different directions.

words.ex: The visa application requires a lot of formality.
words.ex_cn: 签证申请需要很多正式手续。
words.en: A formality is something that is done as part of a formal process or procedure, often without much thought or feeling because it is expected.

words.ex: The wedding ceremony was beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 婚礼仪式很美丽。
words.en: A ceremony is a formal event held on special occasions such as weddings, graduations, or official functions, often involving traditional or religious rituals.

words.ex: The macroscopic view shows the whole tree.
words.ex_cn: 宏观视角展示了整棵树。
words.en: Large enough to be seen or examined without the use of a microscope.

words.ex: The bacteria are microscopic.
words.ex_cn: 这些细菌极小。
words.en: So small as to be visible only with a microscope; of or relating to a microscope.

words.ex: He looks at the bug through a microscope.
words.ex_cn: 他通过显微镜观察这只虫子。
words.en: An instrument used for viewing objects that are too small to be seen by the naked eye, especially one that uses a combination of lenses to produce a magnified image.

words.ex: He uses binoculars to watch birds in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他用望远镜在公园里看鸟。
words.en: Binoculars are an instrument that you hold up to your eyes to look at objects that are far away. It consists of two small telescopes joined together.

words.tr:
adj. 双眼的；两眼用的
n. （通常用复数）双筒望远镜
words.ex: He uses binocular to watch birds in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他用双筒望远镜在公园里看鸟。
words.en: An optical instrument, such as a pair of field glasses or opera glasses, designed for simultaneous use by both eyes and consisting of two small telescopes joined together.

words.ex: He used a monocular to observe the distant stars.
words.ex_cn: 他用单筒望远镜观察遥远的星星。
words.en: Relating to, involving, or used by one eye only.

words.ex: The law restricts driving after drinking.
words.ex_cn: 法律限制酒后驾驶。
words.en: to limit the movements or actions of someone, or to limit something and reduce its size or prevent it from increasing

words.ex: He is confined to his room because he is sick.
words.ex_cn: 他因为生病被限制在房间里。
words.en: If you confine something or someone, you limit them to a particular place or situation.

words.tr:
n. 限制；
v. 限制；
words.ex: The teacher set a limit on homework time.
words.ex_cn: 老师对作业时间设定了限制。
words.en: A limit is the greatest amount, extent, or degree of something that is possible.

words.tr: phrase. 须鲸（一类大型鲸鱼，以鲸须滤食浮游生物和小鱼）
words.ex: The baleen whale eats small fish in the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 须鲸在海洋中吃小鱼。
words.en: A baleen whale is a type of whale that has baleen plates in the mouth for filtering food from water, instead of teeth.

words.tr: adv. 不加预备；直截了当地；不经过 preliminaries（初步步骤）地
words.ex: He started the meeting without preliminaries.
words.ex_cn: 他没有做任何铺垫就直接开始了会议。

words.ex: The court held a preliminary trial to decide if there is enough evidence.
words.ex_cn: 法院举行了初步审判，以决定是否有足够的证据。

words.ex: The doctor ran a trial to test the new medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生进行了试验来测试这种新药。
words.en: A trial is a formal meeting in a law court, at which a judge and jury listen to evidence and decide whether a person is guilty of a crime.

words.tr:
n. 小径；路径；踪迹；
v. 跟踪；尾随；落后于；
words.ex: We walked along the forest trail.
words.ex_cn: 我们沿着森林小径散步。
words.en: A trail is a path through the countryside or through a forest, often made or used by people walking. As a verb, to trail means to follow someone or something secretly or to be behind in a race or competition.

words.tr: n. 初步 remarks；开场白；初步评论
words.ex: He made some preliminary remarks before the meeting started.
words.ex_cn: 会议开始前，他做了一些初步 remarks。

words.ex: He made up a story out of thin air.
words.ex_cn: 他凭空编了一个故事。

words.ex: The drone uses in-air vision to avoid trees.
words.ex_cn: 无人机使用空中视觉来避开树木。

words.tr:
n. 跳跃；
v. 跳跃；
words.ex: The cat made a big leap over the fence.
words.ex_cn: 猫跳过了篱笆。
words.en: To leap means to jump high or a long way, or to move quickly and with a lot of energy.

words.tr: n. 洪泛平原；被洪水淹没的平原
words.ex: The flooded plain is rich in soil after the river overflows.
words.ex_cn: 河流泛滥后，洪泛平原的土壤非常肥沃。

words.tr: adj. 单调的饮食；乏味的饮食
words.ex: He lost interest in his monotonous diet of rice and beans.
words.ex_cn: 他对这种只有米饭和豆子的单调饮食失去了兴趣。

words.ex: His guess about the winner was just speculation.
words.ex_cn: 他对获胜者的猜测只是推测。
words.en: The act of forming opinions about what has happened or what might happen without knowing all the facts.

words.ex: The boy resembles his father.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩长得像他父亲。
words.en: If one thing or person resembles another, they are similar to each other.

words.tr: n. 视角；观点；（对事物的）合理判断；
words.ex: His perspective on life is very positive.
words.ex_cn: 他对生活的看法非常积极。
words.en: A particular attitude towards or way of regarding something; a point of view.

words.ex: The rendition of the song by the singer moved everyone.
words.ex_cn: 歌手对这首歌的演出打动了所有人。
words.en: A rendition of a play, poem, or piece of music is a performance of it.

words.ex: The poem uses metaphorical language to express love.
words.ex_cn: 这首诗使用隐喻的语言来表达爱。
words.en: Using or containing metaphor; figurative.

words.ex: He interprets the poem as a love story.
words.ex_cn: 他把这首诗解释为一个爱情故事。
words.en: If you interpret something in a particular way, you decide that this is its meaning or significance.

words.ex: The fence marks the perimeter of the garden.
words.ex_cn: 围栏标出了花园的边界。
words.en: The perimeter of an area or object is the total length of its sides or outer boundary.

words.ex: He gave the rope a sudden jerk to pull it up.
words.ex_cn: 他猛地一拉绳子，把它拉了上来。
words.en: If you jerk something or someone in a particular direction, or they jerk in a particular direction, they move a short distance very suddenly and quickly.

words.ex: The children learned through visual aids like pictures.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们通过图片等视觉辅助工具学习。
words.en: relating to seeing or to the eyes

words.ex: He uses optical lenses to see small objects.
words.ex_cn: 他使用光学镜片来看小物体。
words.en: Relating to sight, especially in relation to the physical action of light.

words.ex: The horror of the dark made her scream.
words.ex_cn: 对黑暗的恐惧让她尖叫。
words.en: A feeling of great fear, shock, or disgust.

words.ex: He speculates that it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他推测明天会下雨。
words.en: If you speculate about something, you make guesses about its nature or identity, or about what might happen.

words.ex: He dismissed her advice and walked away.
words.ex_cn: 他不理会她的建议，走开了。
words.en: If you dismiss someone, you send them away or allow them to leave.

words.tr: adj. 有视力的； v. 看到；观测；“sight”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The sighted children can see the board clearly.
words.ex_cn: 有视力的孩子们能清楚地看到黑板。
words.en: Having the ability to see; not blind.

words.ex: The scientists studied the sighted objects in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 科学家们研究了夜空中被观察到的物体。

words.ex: The teacher changed the parameter to make the test easier.
words.ex_cn: 老师更改了参数，使测试更容易。
words.en: A parameter is a limit or boundary which defines the scope of a particular process or activity.

words.ex: The diameter of the circle is 10 cm.
words.ex_cn: 这个圆的直径是10厘米。
words.en: A straight line passing from side to side through the center of a body or figure, especially a circle or sphere.

words.ex: The new policy has a wide radius of influence.
words.ex_cn: 这项新政策的影响范围很广。
words.en: A straight line from the center to the circumference of a circle or sphere.

words.w: with a jerk of his head
words.tr: adv. 用他头猛地一甩（表示突然的动作）
words.uk: wɪð ə dʒɜːk əv hɪz hɛd
words.us: wɪð ə dʒɜːrk əv hɪz hɛd
words.ex: He stopped talking with a jerk of his head.
words.ex_cn: 他猛地一甩头，停止了说话。

words.ex: He is an eccentric man who wears socks with sandals.
words.ex_cn: 他是个古怪的人，穿着袜子配凉鞋。
words.en: If you say that someone is eccentric, you mean that they behave in a strange way, and have habits or opinions that are different from those of most people.

words.ex: The dark clouds indicate rain.
words.ex_cn: 乌云表明要下雨了。
words.en: If one thing indicates another, the first thing shows that the second is true or exists.

words.tr: adj. 敏锐的；急性的；严重的；
words.ex: He has an acute mind and solves problems quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他思维敏锐，能快速解决问题。
words.en: An acute problem or negative feeling is very severe.

words.ex: The clock shows accurate time.
words.ex_cn: 这个钟显示的时间很精确。
words.en: Correct in all details; exact.

words.ex: Her visual acuity is remarkable for someone her age.
words.ex_cn: 对于她这个年龄的人来说，她的视力敏锐度非常出色。
words.en: Acuity refers to the ability to see, hear, or think accurately and clearly.

words.ex: His speech was full of vacuity.
words.ex_cn: 他的演讲充满空洞。
words.en: If you refer to the vacuity of something or someone, you are critical of them because they lack intelligent thought or ideas.

words.tr:
adj. 空白的；
n. 空白处；
words.ex: The paper had a blank space at the top.
words.ex_cn: 这张纸的顶部有一个空白区域。
words.en: If something is blank, it has nothing on it.

words.tr:
n. 真空；空虚；
v. 用真空吸尘器打扫；
words.ex: The vacuum in space keeps no air.
words.ex_cn: 太空中的真空没有空气。
words.en: A vacuum is a space that contains no air or other gas, or a space from which most of the air or gas has been removed. It can also refer to a device that cleans floors and surfaces by sucking up dirt and dust.

words.tr: phrase. 视力敏锐度；视觉清晰度
words.ex: The doctor tested the patient's visual acuity using an eye chart.
words.ex_cn: 医生使用视力表测试了患者的视力。
words.en: Visual acuity refers to the clarity or sharpness of vision, measured by the ability to discern letters or numbers at a given distance according to a fixed standard.

words.tr: phrase. 视觉辅助工具；教学或演示中用于增强视觉效果的物品，如图表、幻灯片或模型
words.ex: The teacher used a chart as a visual aid.
words.ex_cn: 老师用了一张图表作为视觉辅助工具。
words.en: A visual element, such as a diagram, chart, or image, used to clarify or support information.

words.tr: phrase. 视觉艺术（包括绘画、雕塑、摄影、版画等以视觉形式表现的艺术）
words.ex: He loves visual arts and draws every day.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢视觉艺术，每天画画。
words.en: Visual arts are art forms that create works which are primarily visual in nature, such as painting, sculpture, photography, printmaking, and filmmaking.

words.tr: n. 视觉细胞；视网膜中对视觉刺激作出反应的神经细胞
words.ex: The visual cell detects light in the eye.
words.ex_cn: 视觉细胞在眼睛中感知光线。

words.ex: Long hours on the screen cause visual fatigue.
words.ex_cn: 长时间盯着屏幕会导致视觉疲劳。

words.ex: The mirror distorts my face.
words.ex_cn: 这面镜子扭曲了我的脸。
words.en: If you distort a statement, fact, or idea, you report or represent it in an untrue way.

words.ex: The children were exposed to cold weather without coats.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在没有外套的情况下遭受了寒冷天气。
words.en: To expose something means to uncover it so that it can be seen, or to make it known or public.

words.ex: The sponge lives in the ocean and filters water for food.
words.ex_cn: 这种海绵动物生活在海洋中，通过过滤水来获取食物。
words.en: A sponge is a piece of a soft, light, porous substance originally from the skeletons of marine creatures, used for washing, cleaning, or padding. As a verb, it means to wipe, rub, or clean with a sponge or to absorb something.

words.tr:
n. 试听；试唱；试演；听力
v. 试听；试音；试镜；让…试演
words.ex: He went to an audition for the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他去参加学校话剧的试听。
words.en: An audition is a short performance given by an actor, dancer, or musician so that someone can decide if they are good enough to be in a play, film, or orchestra.

words.ex: He is a reliable friend who always helps.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个可靠的朋友，总是帮忙。
words.en: Able to be trusted to do or provide what is needed or right.

words.tr: n. 出神；心不在焉；抽象
words.ex: He sat by the window in abstraction, staring at the clouds.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在窗边出神，凝视着云朵。
words.en: An abstraction is a general idea rather than one that is based on a specific real thing or event.

words.tr:
n. 山；
v. 逐渐增加；
words.ex: He climbed the mount early in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 他一大早爬了那座山。
words.en: To mount something means to go up it or to get on it. It can also refer to the act of organizing and beginning something, such as an event or an exhibition.

words.ex: The teacher will announce the results tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 老师明天将宣布结果。
words.en: To announce something means to make it known publicly or officially.

words.ex: The newspaper's headline said 'City Wins Championship'.
words.ex_cn: 报纸的大字标题写着‘城市赢得冠军’。
words.en: A headline is the title of a newspaper story, printed in large letters at the top of the story, especially on the front page.

words.tr: v. 使自己接触（某事物）；使自己置身于（某种环境或影响中）
words.ex: Children should expose themselves to different cultures.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们应该让自己接触不同的文化。

words.ex: The worker had long exposure to loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 这名工人长期暴露在噪音中。
words.en: The condition of being exposed to something, especially to something harmful or unpleasant.

words.ex: Rinse the dishes with water before drying them.
words.ex_cn: 在晾干盘子之前用清水冲洗。
words.en: To rinse something means to wash it in clean water in order to remove soap or dirt.

words.ex: His decision shows clear rationality.
words.ex_cn: 他的决定显示出清晰的理性。
words.en: Rationality is the quality or state of being rational, based on or in accordance with reason or logic.

words.ex: From the clues, he made a logical inference.
words.ex_cn: 从线索中，他做出了一个合理的推论。
words.en: An inference is a conclusion that you draw about something by using information that you already have about it.

words.tr: n. 推理；推论； v. “reason”的现在分词；
words.ex: His reasoning helped solve the puzzle.
words.ex_cn: 他的推理帮助解决了这个谜题。
words.en: the process of thinking about something in a logical way in order to form a conclusion or judgment

words.ex: The magic trick astounded the children.
words.ex_cn: 这个魔术让孩子们惊呆了。
words.en: If something astounds you, it surprises or shocks you very much.

words.ex: The magic trick will astonish you.
words.ex_cn: 这个魔术会让你惊讶。
words.en: If something or someone astonishes you, they surprise you very much.

words.ex: The archaeologist found an old pot in the ground.
words.ex_cn: 这位考古学家在地下发现了一个旧陶罐。
words.en: An archaeologist is someone who studies the societies and cultures of the past by examining the remains of their buildings, tools, and other objects.

words.ex: The school made an announcement about the holiday.
words.ex_cn: 学校发布了关于假期的通告。
words.en: A public or formal notice about something that has happened or is going to happen.

words.ex: The announcer said the train will arrive soon.
words.ex_cn: 广播员说火车很快就会到达。
words.en: A person who announces something, especially someone who introduces or gives information about programs on radio or television.

words.tr: v. 表示计划、安排或义务要做某事；注定要发生某事

words.ex: The country provided military assistance to its neighbor.
words.ex_cn: 该国向其邻国提供了军事援助。

words.tr:
n. 倒塌；崩溃；暴跌；
v. 倒塌；崩溃；
words.ex: The collapse of the old bridge caused many problems.
words.ex_cn: 这座旧桥的倒塌引起了诸多问题。
words.en: If a building or other structure collapses, it falls down very suddenly.

words.ex: He asked for assistance with his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他请求帮助做作业。
words.en: The act of helping or supporting someone or something.

words.ex: They discriminate against people because of their race.
words.ex_cn: 他们因为种族而歧视他人。
words.en: To discriminate means to recognize a distinction; differentiate. It can also mean to make an unjust or prejudicial distinction in the treatment of different categories of people, especially on the grounds of race, sex, or age.

words.ex: He could discern a small bird in the trees.
words.ex_cn: 他能辨明树上有一只小鸟。
words.en: If you can discern something, you are aware of it and know what it is.

words.ex: The two colors distinguish the two teams.
words.ex_cn: 这两种颜色使两个队伍有所不同。
words.en: If you can distinguish one thing from another, you can see or understand how they are different.

words.ex: The storm was destructive and broke many houses.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴具有破坏性，摧毁了许多房屋。
words.en: Causing great and irreparable harm or damage.

words.tr: n. 权威；官方机构；权力；权威人士；当局；
words.ex: The teacher is an authority on ancient history.
words.ex_cn: 这位老师是古代史方面的权威。
words.en: The power to make decisions or enforce rules.

words.ex: The weather is mild today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天气温和。
words.en: Mild is used to describe something that is not extreme, severe, or strong, such as weather, taste, or behavior.

words.ex: He has the capacity to solve hard math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他有能力解决复杂的数学问题。
words.en: The capacity of a place or container is the amount of things or people that it can hold.

words.ex: The city is at a latitude of 40 degrees north.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市位于北纬40度。
words.en: Latitude is the distance of a place north or south of the equator, measured in degrees.

words.ex: The children loved the circus with clowns and elephants.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢有小丑和大象的马戏团。
words.en: A circus is a group of performers that include clowns, acrobats, and trained animals, who travel to different places to entertain people.

words.ex: The old house has a mysterious aura.
words.ex_cn: 这所老房子有一种神秘的氛围。
words.en: An aura is a distinctive atmosphere or quality that seems to surround and be generated by a person, thing, or place.

words.ex: He drew a flower with pastel.
words.ex_cn: 他用彩色粉笔画了一朵花。
words.en: Pastel can refer to a type of soft, colored chalk used for drawing, or to a drawing made with such chalks. It can also describe colors that are pale and soft.

words.tr:
n. 荫；阴影；
v. 遮蔽；
words.ex: The tree provides shade on a hot day.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树在炎热的日子提供荫凉。
words.en: Shade is an area where there is no direct sunlight, or something that provides protection from the sun. It can also refer to a slight difference in color, or to gradually change from one color or tone to another.

words.tr: phrase. 拥有权力的；当权的；主管的
words.ex: The teacher is in authority in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 老师在教室里拥有权力。
words.en: Having official power or control over others; in a position of command.

words.ex: He is one leading authority on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他是气候变化领域的一位权威人士。

words.ex: She chose lighter pastel shades for her bedroom walls.
words.ex_cn: 她为卧室墙壁选择了更浅的淡彩色调。

words.tr:
n. 方法；接近；靠近；路径；
v. 接近；靠近；临近；处理；
words.ex: He used a new approach to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一种新方法来解决问题。
words.en: To come near or nearer to something or someone in distance or time.

words.ex: The approachability of the CEO made employees feel valued.
words.ex_cn: 这位首席执行官的平易近人让员工感到被重视。
words.en: The quality of being easy to approach or talk to; friendliness.

words.tr: adj. 温和的；文雅的；温柔的；
words.ex: The mother gave a gentle hug to her child.
words.ex_cn: 母亲给了孩子一个温和的拥抱。
words.en: Someone who is gentle is kind and calm, and does not behave in a violent or harsh way.

words.ex: The pillow is soft and comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 这个枕头很软，很舒服。
words.en: Something that is soft is pleasant to touch, and not rough or hard.

words.ex: He is a temperate person who never shouts.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个温和的人，从不大喊大叫。
words.en: If you describe someone's behavior as temperate, you mean that it is calm and reasonable, not extreme or emotional.

words.ex: She sifts flour through a fine mesh.
words.ex_cn: 她用细网筛面粉。
words.en: To sift means to put a fine, loose, or powdery substance through a sieve so as to remove lumps or large particles. It can also mean to examine something thoroughly so as to isolate that which is most important or useful.

words.tr: n. （用于筛撒粉状食物的）筛具，撒粉器; 滤器; 罗圈; 罗
words.ex: She used a sifter to evenly distribute the flour.
words.ex_cn: 她用筛子均匀地撒粉。
words.en: A sifter is a tool used to separate wanted elements from unwanted material or to break up clumps in dry ingredients such as flour.

words.ex: Water can penetrate the soil slowly.
words.ex_cn: 水可以慢慢渗透进土壤。
words.en: To penetrate means to enter or pass through something, especially when this is difficult or when it is not obvious how to do it.

words.ex: The smell of bread permeate the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 面包的香味弥漫了整个厨房。
words.en: If something permeates a place, it spreads throughout it.

words.ex: He got a penalty for breaking the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他因违反规则而受到惩罚。
words.en: A penalty is a punishment that is imposed on someone for doing something that is against the rules or the law.

words.ex: The temperature today is very high.
words.ex_cn: 今天的温度很高。
words.en: The degree or intensity of heat present in a substance or object, especially as expressed according to a comparative scale and shown by a thermometer or perceived by touch.

words.ex: He has the ability to solve math problems quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他有能力快速解决数学问题。
words.en: The capacity to do something or the possession of the means or skill to do something.

words.ex: He showed great capability in solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他在解决数学问题上展现了很强的能力。
words.en: The ability or qualities necessary to do something.

words.tr: n. 某物的容量；能力；容积
words.ex: The capacity of this bottle is one liter.
words.ex_cn: 这个瓶子的容量是一升。

words.ex: He showed the capacity to do something difficult by solving the math problem alone.
words.ex_cn: 他通过独自解决这个数学问题，展现了做某件困难事情的能力。

words.tr: n. 做某事的能力；容量；潜力
words.ex: He showed the capacity for learning new languages quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他展示了快速学习新语言的能力。

words.tr:
n. 鞭子
v. 鞭打；抽打；突然移动
words.ex: The farmer used a whip to guide the horse.
words.ex_cn: 农夫用鞭子赶马。
words.en: To whip means to hit a person or animal with a whip, or to move something quickly and suddenly.

words.tr:
n. 快照；
v. 突然断裂；猛然咬；
adj. 突然的；匆忙的；
words.ex: He took a snap of the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 他拍了一张日落的快照。
words.en: If something snaps or if you snap it, it breaks suddenly, usually with a sharp cracking noise. | A snap is a photograph. | If someone snaps, or if something snaps inside them, they suddenly stop being calm and become very angry.

words.tr: v. 抽打鞭子；突然甩动鞭子
words.ex: He snapped the whip to make the horse run faster.
words.ex_cn: 他抽打鞭子让马跑得更快。

words.ex: He wants freedom to speak his mind.
words.ex_cn: 他想要自由地表达自己的想法。
words.en: The condition of being free; the power to act or speak or think without externally imposed restraints.

words.ex: The address is 720 liberty street.
words.ex_cn: 地址是自由大街720号。
words.en: The state of being free within society from oppressive restrictions imposed by authority on one's way of life, behavior, or political views.

words.ex: He snaps his whip to make the horse move.
words.ex_cn: 他甩动他的鞭子让马前进。

words.ex: He wore a big grin after winning the game.
words.ex_cn: 他赢得比赛后露出了灿烂的咧嘴笑容。
words.en: If you grin, you smile broadly, usually showing your teeth.

words.ex: He votes in a democratic election.
words.ex_cn: 他在民主选举中投票。
words.en: A democratic country, government, or political system is governed by representatives who are elected by the people.

words.ex: He will install the new software on his computer.
words.ex_cn: 他将在他的电脑上安装新软件。
words.en: To set up or fix in position for use or service.

words.ex: The faculty of engineering has many labs.
words.ex_cn: 工程学院有许多实验室。
words.en: A faculty is a group of departments in a university or college that specialize in a particular subject or group of subjects, or the teachers in such a group.

words.ex: The hospital is a public institution.
words.ex_cn: 这家医院是一家公共机构。
words.en: An institution is a large important organization such as a university, church, or bank.

words.ex: The probability of rain tomorrow is high.
words.ex_cn: 明天下雨的概率很高。
words.en: A probability is a measure of how likely it is that some event will occur.

words.tr: adj. 离奇的；奇特的；奇怪的；
words.ex: The clown wore a bizarre hat with three eyes.
words.ex_cn: 小丑戴着一顶有三只眼睛的离奇帽子。
words.en: Something that is bizarre is very odd and strange.

words.ex: This town has a peculiar custom of dancing at midnight.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇有一个独特的午夜跳舞习俗。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as peculiar, you think that they are strange or unusual, sometimes in an unpleasant way.

words.tr: adj. 奇怪的；奇数的；余的；
words.ex: He wore an odd hat to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他戴了一顶奇怪的帽子去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as odd, you mean that they are strange or unusual.

words.ex: He wore an outlandish hat to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他戴了一顶奇异的帽子去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe something as outlandish, you mean that it is very unusual, strange, or exaggerated.

words.ex: The gravity of Earth pulls objects down.
words.ex_cn: 地球的重力把物体往下拉。
words.en: Gravity is the force that causes things to fall towards the Earth or towards any other physical body having mass.

words.tr: 短语动词. 形容某人非常高兴，笑容满面，从一个耳朵笑到另一个耳朵
words.ex: He grinned from ear to ear when he won the prize.
words.ex_cn: 当他赢得奖品时，他笑得合不拢嘴。

words.tr: phrase. 民主党（美国主要政党之一）
words.ex: He votes for the democratic party in every election.
words.ex_cn: 他在每次选举中都投票给民主党。
words.en: The Democratic Party is one of the two major contemporary political parties in the United States, alongside the Republican Party. It is known for its support of social justice, progressive policies, and a strong government role in the economy.

words.ex: The country is trying to achieve democratic reform through peaceful talks.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正试图通过和平谈判实现民主改革。

words.ex: The smoke came out of the vent.
words.ex_cn: 烟从排气口飘了出来。
words.en: A vent is a hole or opening that allows air, gas, or liquid to pass out of or into a confined space.

words.tr: n. 通风设备；气窗；人工呼吸器
words.ex: The hospital is equipped with advanced ventilators to assist patients with breathing difficulties.
words.ex_cn: 医院配备了先进的呼吸机，以帮助呼吸困难的病人。
words.en: A ventilator is a machine that helps people breathe when they cannot breathe adequately on their own.

words.ex: Open the window to ventilate the room.
words.ex_cn: 打开窗户给房间通风。
words.en: To ventilate means to cause fresh air to enter and move around a room, building, etc., or to express your opinions or feelings about something openly.

words.ex: The room has good ventilation through the windows.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间通过窗户有良好的通风。
words.en: The provision of fresh air to a room, building, etc., or the system that does this.

words.ex: They will install a drinking machine in the office.
words.ex_cn: 他们将在办公室安装一台饮水机。

words.tr: phrase. 心智能力；智力官能；精神机能
words.ex: Memory is an important mental faculty.
words.ex_cn: 记忆是一种重要的心智能力。
words.en: The mental faculties refer to the various capacities of the mind, such as perception, memory, and reasoning, which enable a person to process information and make decisions.

words.tr: n. 智力能力；心智功能
words.ex: His intellectual faculty helps him solve complex problems quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他的智力能力帮助他快速解决复杂问题。

words.ex: He is a professor at the Faculty of Law.
words.ex_cn: 他是法学院的教授。
words.en: The faculty of law refers to a division within a university or college that is dedicated to the study of law and legal education.

words.ex: Five apples constitute a basket.
words.ex_cn: 五个苹果构成一篮子。
words.en: If something constitutes a particular thing, it can be regarded as being that thing.

words.ex: The constitution protects the rights of all citizens.
words.ex_cn: 宪法保护所有公民的权利。
words.en: The constitution of a country or organization is the system of laws which formally states people's rights and duties.

words.tr:
n. 研究所；学院；协会；
v. 建立；制定；
words.ex: He works at a research institute.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家研究所工作。
words.en: An institute is an organization set up to do a particular type of work, especially research or teaching. It can also refer to the act of starting something such as a system or an official process.

words.ex: He enrolled in an institution of higher learning after high school.
words.ex_cn: 他高中毕业后进入了一所高等教育机构。

words.tr: phrase. 教育机构；教育组织
words.ex: The educational institution is committed to fostering academic excellence.
words.ex_cn: 这所教育机构致力于培养学术卓越。
words.en: An educational institution is a place where people of different ages gain an education, including preschools, childcare, elementary schools, and universities.

words.tr: n. 监管机构；监督机构
words.ex: The supervisory institution checks banks to make sure they follow the law.
words.ex_cn: 监管机构检查银行，以确保它们遵守法律。

words.tr: n. 证明书；资格证书；证件
words.ex: He showed his credential to enter the building.
words.ex_cn: 他出示了证件以进入大楼。
words.en: A credential is a document that proves your identity or qualifications.

words.ex: The document is confidential and cannot be shared.
words.ex_cn: 这份文件是机密的，不能分享。
words.en: If you talk to someone in a confidential way, you talk to them quietly because what you are saying is secret or private.

words.tr: n. 一个古怪离奇的故事
words.ex: He told me a bizarre story about a talking cat.
words.ex_cn: 他给我讲了一个关于会说话的猫的古怪离奇的故事。

words.ex: The movie was fantastic!
words.ex_cn: 这部电影极好！
words.en: If you describe something as fantastic, you are emphasizing that you think it is very good or that you like it a lot.

words.tr:
n. 帽子；
v. 覆盖…的顶部；
words.ex: He wore a blue cap to the park.
words.ex_cn: 他戴着一顶蓝色的帽子去公园。
words.en: A cap is a soft, flat hat with a peak at the front. Caps are usually worn by men and boys. A cap is also a protective lid or cover for a bottle, jar, or other container.

words.ex: The external wall of the house is painted blue.
words.ex_cn: 房子的外墙被刷成了蓝色。
words.en: External is used to indicate that something is on the outside of a surface or body, or that it exists, happens, or comes from outside.

words.tr: adj. 荒唐的；荒唐可笑的；
words.ex: It's absurd to wear a coat in summer.
words.ex_cn: 夏天穿外套是荒唐的。
words.en: If you say that something is absurd, you are criticizing it because you think that it is ridiculous or that it does not make sense.

words.tr:
adj. 分开的；分离的；单独的；
v. 分离；隔离；
words.ex: They live in separate houses.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在分开的房子里。
words.en: To cause to move or be apart; to divide or keep apart.

words.ex: He has an inclination to help others.
words.ex_cn: 他有帮助他人的倾向。
words.en: An inclination is a feeling that makes you want to act in a particular way, or a tendency to do something.

words.tr:
v. 疏浚；挖掘
n. 挖泥船；疏浚机
words.ex: They dredge the river to remove mud.
words.ex_cn: 他们疏浚河流以清除淤泥。
words.en: To dredge means to remove mud, sand, or other material from the bottom of a river, lake, etc., in order to make it deeper or to search for something.

words.tr:
v. 洒；撒；下小雨
n. 洒；撒；小雨；少量
words.ex: She sprinkles sugar on her cereal.
words.ex_cn: 她在麦片上撒糖。
words.en: To scatter or pour small drops or particles of a substance over an object or surface.

words.tr: n. 审计员；（大学课程的）旁听生；（一名）听众
words.ex: The auditor checked the company's money records.
words.ex_cn: 审计员检查了公司的财务记录。
words.en: An auditor is a person whose job is to carry out an official examination of the accounts of a business and to produce a report.

words.ex: The doctor cleaned his external wound with antiseptic.
words.ex_cn: 医生用消毒剂清洁了他的外伤。

words.ex: The company faced external pressure to lower prices.
words.ex_cn: 该公司面临着降价的外部压力。
words.en: External pressure refers to forces or influences from outside a person or system that affect behavior or decisions.

words.tr: n. 外交事务；对外事务
words.ex: The ministry handles external affairs with other countries.
words.ex_cn: 该部门处理与其他国家的外交事务。

words.tr: phrase. 外部成员；指不属于某个组织或团体内部，但参与其工作的成员
words.ex: He is an external member of the committee.
words.ex_cn: 他是委员会的外部成员。
words.en: A person who is part of a group but not a permanent member.

words.tr: n. 外部审计师；独立审计师
words.ex: The company hired an external auditor to check its financial records.
words.ex_cn: 公司聘请了一名外部审计师来检查其财务记录。

words.ex: It's ridiculous to think he can run a mile in one minute.
words.ex_cn: 认为他能在一分钟内跑完一英里是荒谬的。
words.en: If you say that something or someone is ridiculous, you mean that they are very foolish.

words.tr: n. 分开的卧室；各自独立的卧室
words.ex: They sleep in separate bedrooms to get better rest.
words.ex_cn: 他们睡在分开的卧室里，以便更好地休息。

words.tr: v. 冲洗照片；显影照片
words.ex: He developed a photo in the darkroom.
words.ex_cn: 他在暗室里冲洗了一张照片。

words.tr:
n. 压力；压强；
v. 对…施加压力；
words.ex: He feels pressure from his parents to get good grades.
words.ex_cn: 他感受到来自父母要取得好成绩的压力。
words.en: Pressure is the force that you produce when you press hard on something, or the force that is produced by a particular amount of gas or liquid in a confined space.

words.ex: His conviction that honesty is important never changed.
words.ex_cn: 他坚信诚实很重要，从未改变。
words.en: A conviction is a strong belief or opinion, or the state of being found guilty of a crime in a court of law.

words.ex: The lake at dawn offers perfect tranquility.
words.ex_cn: 黎明时分的湖泊带来完全的宁静。
words.en: A state of peace and quiet.

words.tr: n. 设施；特色功能；特定场所；资质；
words.ex: The school has a new sports facility.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校有一个新的体育设施。
words.en: A facility is a place, building, or service that is designed for a particular purpose.

words.tr:
adj. 壮丽的；堂皇的；重大的；总的；
n. 大钢琴；
words.ex: The grand castle stood on the hill.
words.ex_cn: 壮丽的城堡矗立在山上。
words.en: If you describe a building or a piece of scenery as grand, you mean that its size or appearance is very impressive.

words.ex: He paid the first installment last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周支付了第一期分期付款。
words.en: An installment is one of the amounts, usually equal, into which a debt is divided for payment at stated intervals over a fixed period.

words.tr: v. 辞职；使…顺从于（做）某事；
words.ex: He decided to resign from his job.
words.ex_cn: 他决定辞去工作。
words.en: If you resign from a job or position, you formally announce that you are leaving it.

words.ex: Rinse the dishes with water before drying them.
words.ex_cn: 在晾干盘子之前用清水冲洗。
words.en: To rinse something means to wash it in clean water in order to remove soap or dirt.

words.tr: v. 弹回；恢复原状；撤回
words.ex: The rubber band resiled back to its original shape after being stretched.
words.ex_cn: 橡皮筋在被拉伸后弹回了原来的形状。
words.en: To resile means to spring back or rebound; to withdraw from a position or agreement.

words.ex: He works well under pressure.
words.ex_cn: 他在压力下工作得很好。
words.en: Being subjected to stress or coercion.

words.ex: The boss put pressure on the team to finish the project early.
words.ex_cn: 老板对团队施加压力，要求提前完成项目。

words.ex: Atmospheric pressure affects weather patterns.
words.ex_cn: 大气压影响天气模式。
words.en: Atmospheric pressure is the pressure exerted by the weight of air in the atmosphere of Earth (or that of another planet).

words.ex: The nurse will take your blood pressure.
words.ex_cn: 护士会给你量血压。
words.en: To measure the pressure of the blood in someone's arteries, especially as a way of checking their health.

words.ex: He was punished for treason against the king.
words.ex_cn: 他因对国王叛国而受到惩罚。
words.en: Treason is the crime of betraying your country, for example by helping its enemies or by trying to remove its government using violence.

words.tr:
v. 定罪；宣判有罪
n. 罪犯；囚犯
words.ex: The court convicted him of theft.
words.ex_cn: 法院判定他犯有盗窃罪。
words.en: If someone is convicted of a crime, they are found guilty of that crime in a court of law.

words.tr: adj. 安静的；平静的；宁静的；
words.ex: The lake was tranquil in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 早晨的湖面很安静。
words.en: If a place or situation is tranquil, it is calm, peaceful, and quiet, with no disturbance or agitation.

words.tr: n. 镇静剂；镇定剂；止痛药
words.ex: The doctor gave him a tranquilizer to calm down.
words.ex_cn: 医生给了他一种镇静剂来让他平静下来。
words.en: A tranquilizer is a drug used to reduce anxiety or tension.

words.tr: n. 宏伟的礼仪建筑群
words.ex: The grand ceremonial buildings stand in the center of the ancient city.
words.ex_cn: 宏伟的礼仪建筑群坐落在古城的中心。

words.tr: phrase. 分期地；以分期付款的方式
words.ex: He pays for the phone in installments.
words.ex_cn: 他分期付款买手机。
words.en: Paid or done in several parts over a period of time.

words.ex: He pays monthly installments for his car.
words.ex_cn: 他每月分期付款购买汽车。

words.ex: His initial pay was $3,000 per month.
words.ex_cn: 他的初始薪酬是每月3000美元。

words.ex: The installation of the new machine took two days.
words.ex_cn: 新机器的安置花了两天时间。
words.en: The act of installing or the state of being installed.

words.ex: He has business acumen and makes smart decisions.
words.ex_cn: 他有商业洞察力，能做出明智的决定。
words.en: The ability to make good judgments and quick decisions, typically in a particular domain.

words.ex: He wrote his dissertation on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于气候变化的学位论文。
words.en: A dissertation is a long piece of writing on a particular subject, especially one written for a university degree.

words.ex: He left a heap of clothes on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他把一堆衣服扔在地上。
words.en: A heap of things is a pile of them, especially a pile arranged in a rather untidy way.

words.tr:
n. 责任；责备；
v. 责怪；归咎于；
words.ex: He took the blame for the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他承担了这个错误的责任。
words.en: If you blame a person or thing for something bad, you believe or say that they are responsible for it or that they caused it.

words.tr:
n. 框架；结构；骨架；模式；
v. 表达；陷害；
words.ex: The picture is in a wooden frame.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画在一个木制框架里。
words.en: A frame is a structure that forms a border or support for something, such as a picture or a window. It can also refer to the process of making or constructing something, or the act of falsely incriminating someone.

words.ex: The poem uses symbolism to show love and loss.
words.ex_cn: 这首诗使用象征手法来表现爱与失去。
words.en: Symbolism is the use of symbols to represent ideas or qualities.

words.ex: They ascribe his success to hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他们把他的成功归因于努力工作。
words.en: If you ascribe an event or condition to a particular cause, you say or consider that it was caused by that thing.

words.tr:
adj. 抽象的；非具体的；
n. 摘要；概要；抽象派艺术作品；
words.ex: The painting shows an abstract shape.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画展示了一个抽象的形状。
words.en: An abstract idea or way of thinking is based on general ideas rather than on real things and events.

words.tr: v. （股票等）运作差于（一般市场价格）；表现不佳
words.ex: The stock underperformed the market last quarter.
words.ex_cn: 这只股票上个季度的表现低于市场水平。
words.en: To perform less well than expected or to achieve less than expected.

words.tr: phrase. 商业敏锐度；商业头脑；指对商业环境、市场动态和经营决策的深刻理解与快速判断能力
words.ex: He has strong business acumen and makes smart decisions.
words.ex_cn: 他有很强的商业敏锐度，能做出明智的决定。
words.en: Business acumen refers to the ability to make good judgments and quick decisions in the context of business, demonstrating keen insight and understanding of business situations.

words.tr:
n. 声音；声响；
v. 听起来；
adj. 健全的；合理的；可靠的；
words.ex: I heard a strange sound at night.
words.ex_cn: 我半夜听到了一个奇怪的声音。
words.en: Sound is a vibration that propagates as an acoustic wave, through a transmission medium such as a gas, liquid or solid. In human physiology and psychology, sound is the reception of such waves and their perception by the brain.

words.tr: n. 一段时间；会议；会期；开庭；学年；
words.ex: We had a long session of studying together.
words.ex_cn: 我们一起学习了一段时间。
words.en: A session is a meeting of a court, parliament, or other official group, or a period of time used for a particular activity, especially by a group of people.

words.ex: He climbed a big boulder near the river.
words.ex_cn: 他爬上了河边的一块大岩石。
words.en: A boulder is a large rounded rock.

words.tr: phrase. 大量的；许多的（表示数量非常多，相当于 a lot of 或 plenty of）
words.ex: There are heaps of books on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书架上有大量的书。
words.en: A large amount or number of something.

words.tr: v. 将大量东西堆在……上；过分给予（某物）
words.ex: He heaped snow on the car.
words.ex_cn: 他把大量雪堆在车上。

words.tr: 短语动词. 把某事归咎于某人
words.ex: He blames his failure on his teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的失败归咎于他的老师。
words.en: To say or think that someone or something is responsible for something bad that has happened.

words.ex: You missed the bus again? You only have yourself to blame.
words.ex_cn: 你又错过了公交车？只能怪你自己。

words.tr: phrase. 画框；相框；用于装裱或展示图片的框架
words.ex: She bought a beautiful picture frame for her wedding photo.
words.ex_cn: n. 她为她的结婚照买了一个漂亮的相框。
words.en: A picture frame is a container that borders a picture, such as a painting or photograph, and is used to enhance or protect it.

words.tr: phrase. 心态；心情；精神状态
words.ex: He is in a good frame of mind today.
words.ex_cn: 他今天心情很好。
words.en: A particular mood that influences your attitudes or behaviour.

words.ex: His mindset helps him stay positive during hard times.
words.ex_cn: 他的心态让他在困难时期保持积极。
words.en: A mindset is a set of attitudes or fixed ideas that someone has and that are often difficult to change.

words.ex: The framework of the house is made of wood.
words.ex_cn: 房子的骨架是木制的。
words.en: A framework is a particular set of rules, ideas, or beliefs which you use in order to deal with problems or to decide what to do.

words.tr: phrase. 抽象名词：表示抽象概念、状态、品质或情感的名词，如“love”（爱）、“freedom”（自由）、“happiness”（幸福）等，不能通过感官直接感知
words.ex: Love is an abstract noun that represents a deep emotional connection.
words.ex_cn: 爱是一个代表深厚情感连接的抽象名词。
words.en: An abstract noun is a noun that refers to an idea, quality, or state rather than a physical object.

words.tr: n. 抽象科学；指以理论和逻辑推理为主的科学领域，如数学、理论物理等
words.ex: Mathematics is an abstract science.
words.ex_cn: 数学是一门抽象科学。

words.ex: The storm caused a disruption in the train service.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴扰乱了火车服务。
words.en: Disruption is a situation in which something is prevented from continuing in its usual way because of problems or difficulties.

words.ex: He has high self-esteem after passing the test.
words.ex_cn: 通过考试后，他自尊心很强。
words.en: Self-esteem is the opinion you have of yourself and your abilities.

words.ex: He is literate and can read simple books.
words.ex_cn: 他有读写能力，能读简单的书。
words.en: A literate person is able to read and write, and has a good education.

words.ex: The extinction of dinosaurs happened millions of years ago.
words.ex_cn: 恐龙的灭绝发生在数百万年前。
