words.ex: The new law gave impetus to environmental protection.
words.ex_cn: 新法律为环境保护提供了推动力。
words.en: Something that gives a process impetus or an impetus makes it happen or progress more quickly.

words.ex: The wind propels the sailboat forward.
words.ex_cn: 风推动帆船前进。
words.en: To propel something in a particular direction means to cause it to move in that direction.

words.tr: phrase. 技术支持；为用户提供的技术帮助与服务
words.ex: The technician gave me technical support for my computer.
words.ex_cn: 技术人员为我的电脑提供了技术支持。
words.en: Technical support refers to a range of services providing assistance with technology products such as mobile phones, televisions, computers, software products or other electronic or mechanical goods. In general, technical support services attempt to help the user solve specific problems with a product—rather than providing training, customization, or other support services.

words.tr: n. 技术教育；职业教育
words.ex: He chose technical education to learn how to fix machines.
words.ex_cn: 他选择了技术教育来学习如何修理机器。

words.tr: phrase. 技术学院；理工学院
words.ex: He went to a technical college to learn engineering.
words.ex_cn: 他去了一所技术学院学习工程。

words.tr: n. 技术故障；技术性障碍
words.ex: The presentation stopped because of a technical hitch.
words.ex_cn: 演示因为技术故障而停止了。

words.tr:
v. 钩住；拴住；急拉；搭便车
n. 故障；障碍；勾住；急拉
words.ex: The hook hitched the rope to the tree.
words.ex_cn: 钩子钩住了系在树上的绳子。
words.en: If you hitch, or hitch a ride, you hitchhike. If you hitch something to something else, you fasten it there.

words.tr: phrase. 齐声地；异口同声地
words.ex: The children sang in chorus.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们齐声歌唱。
words.en: Together and at the same time, as in singing or speaking in unison.

words.ex: The female chorus sang a beautiful song at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 女声合唱团在音乐会上演唱了一首美妙的歌。

words.ex: The male chorus sang a traditional folk song.
words.ex_cn: 男声合唱团演唱了一首传统民歌。

words.tr: n. 混声合唱团；由男女声共同组成的合唱团
words.ex: The mixed chorus sang a beautiful song at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 混声合唱团在音乐会上演唱了一首美妙的歌曲。

words.ex: The chorus master led the choir in a beautiful rendition of the classic piece.
words.ex_cn: 合唱队指挥带领合唱团完美演绎了这部经典作品。
words.en: A chorus master is a person who trains and conducts a choir, ensuring that the choir performs to the best of its ability.

words.tr: n. 香味；香水；气息；察觉；
words.ex: The flower has a sweet scent.
words.ex_cn: 这朵花有甜美的香味。
words.en: A scent is a pleasant smell, especially one that is characteristic of a particular thing. It can also refer to the ability to detect smells or a clue or indication of something.

words.ex: Hitherto, no one has solved the problem.
words.ex_cn: 迄今为止，没有人解决过这个问题。
words.en: Until now or until the point in time under discussion.

words.ex: He worked hard to accomplish his goal.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以实现自己的目标。
words.en: To accomplish something means to succeed in doing it, especially after a lot of effort.

words.ex: The soldier picked up a bullet from the ground.
words.ex_cn: 士兵从地上捡起一颗子弹。
words.en: A bullet is a small piece of metal with a pointed or rounded end, which is fired from a gun.

words.tr: n. 公告；布告；公报；新闻简报；
words.ex: The school posted a bulletin about the holiday schedule.
words.ex_cn: 学校张贴了一份关于假期安排的公告。
words.en: A bulletin is a short news report on the radio or television. A bulletin is also a short printed newspaper or leaflet that gives information about a particular group or organization.

words.ex: He lives in a rural village with no big shops.
words.ex_cn: 他住在没有大商店的农村村庄里。
words.en: Rural areas are areas which are not towns or cities. They are often farming or agricultural areas.

words.tr:
adj. 乡村的；纯朴的；土气的
n. 乡下人；乡巴佬
words.ex: They live in a rustic cabin near the woods.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在森林附近的一间乡村小屋里。
words.en: Rustic is used to describe things that are typical of the countryside rather than the town, or things that are simple and old-fashioned in a way that is considered typical of the countryside.

words.ex: He is virtually always on time.
words.ex_cn: 他几乎总是准时。
words.en: In effect though not formally recognized; practically.

words.tr: adj. 虚拟的；几乎的；实际上的；事实上的；
words.ex: He played a virtual game on his computer.
words.ex_cn: 他在电脑上玩了一个虚拟游戏。
words.en: If you describe something as virtual, you mean that it is so nearly true that for most purposes it can be regarded as true.

words.tr: v. 达成目标；实现目的
words.ex: He worked hard to accomplish his object of becoming a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以达成成为医生的目标。

words.ex: The soldier accomplished his mission without help.
words.ex_cn: 这名士兵在没有帮助的情况下完成了他的使命。

words.ex: He smiled in reaction to something funny she said.
words.ex_cn: 他对她说的某件有趣的事笑了。

words.tr:
v. 放电；放出；
n. 排放；
words.ex: The battery will discharge if left unused for a long time.
words.ex_cn: 如果长时间不使用，电池会放电。
words.en: If someone is discharged from a hospital, prison, or the armed forces, they are officially allowed to leave, or told that they must leave. If something is discharged from inside a place, it comes out.

words.ex: The cows graze in the enclosure.
words.ex_cn: 奶牛在围场里吃草。
words.en: An enclosure is an area that is surrounded by a barrier or fence, often used to keep animals in or to protect something.

words.ex: The company will discontinue the old model.
words.ex_cn: 公司将会停止生产这款旧型号。
words.en: If you discontinue something that you have been doing regularly, you stop doing it.

words.ex: The land will revegetate after the fire.
words.ex_cn: 火灾之后，这片土地会重新长出植被。
words.en: To revegetate means to plant new vegetation in an area where the vegetation has been lost or removed, often as part of environmental restoration efforts.

words.ex: We need sustainable energy to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要可持续的能源来保护环境。
words.en: If something is sustainable, it can be maintained or continued at a certain rate or level without causing damage or depletion of resources.

words.ex: The dispersal of seeds helps plants grow in new places.
words.ex_cn: 种子的分散有助于植物在新地方生长。
words.en: The act of spreading things or people over a wide area.

words.ex: The concert was fabulous!
words.ex_cn: 这场音乐会太棒了！
words.en: If you describe something as fabulous, you are emphasizing that you like it a lot or think that it is very good.

words.tr: n. 零售业； v. “retail”的现在分词；
words.ex: Retailing is a big part of the economy.
words.ex_cn: 零售业是经济的重要组成部分。
words.en: Retailing is the activity of selling goods to the public, usually in shops.

words.ex: The rental of the apartment costs $800 per month.
words.ex_cn: 这套公寓的租赁费用是每月800美元。
words.en: The act of paying for the use of something, such as property, a vehicle, or equipment, or the amount paid for such use.

words.tr: adj. 充满（不愉快事物）的；
words.ex: The journey was fraught with delays.
words.ex_cn: 这次旅程充满了延误。
words.en: If a situation or activity is fraught with problems or risks, it is full of them.

words.ex: They enclose the garden with a wooden fence.
words.ex_cn: 他们用木栅栏把花园围起来。
words.en: If you enclose something with a letter, you put it in the same envelope as the letter.

words.ex: The army besiege the small town.
words.ex_cn: 军队围攻这座小镇。
words.en: To surround a place with armed forces in order to capture it or force its surrender; to overwhelm someone with requests or complaints.

words.tr:
v. 掠夺；抢劫
n. 掠夺物；掠夺；赃物
words.ex: The pirates plundered the ship.
words.ex_cn: 海盗劫掠了那艘船。
words.en: If someone plunders a place or plunders things from a place, they steal things from it.

words.ex: The plunderer stole gold from the old temple.
words.ex_cn: 掠夺者从古庙里偷走了黄金。
words.en: A plunderer is someone who steals goods or property, often by force, especially in times of war or chaos.

words.ex: Please don't disturb me while I'm reading.
words.ex_cn: 我读书时请不要打扰我。
words.en: To disturb someone means to interrupt what they are doing and cause them inconvenience or annoyance.

words.ex: The town uses solar power for sustainable development.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇使用太阳能来实现可持续发展。
words.en: Sustainable development refers to development that meets the needs of the present without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own needs.

words.ex: The police dispersed the crowd.
words.ex_cn: 警察驱散了人群。
words.en: If a crowd of people disperses or is dispersed, it breaks up and the people go in different directions.

words.tr:
n. 寓言；神话传说；无稽之谈
v. 虚构
words.ex: The old man told a fable about a fox and a crow.
words.ex_cn: 老人讲了一个关于狐狸和乌鸦的寓言。
words.en: A fable is a short story that typically features animals as characters and conveys a moral lesson.

words.tr: adj. 极好的；惊人的 n. 英雄们；了不起的英雄们
words.ex: The children cheered for the fabulous heroes in the movie.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们为电影中极好的英雄们欢呼。

words.ex: The lessor provided the tenant with a detailed lease agreement.
words.ex_cn: 出租人向租户提供了一份详细的租赁协议。
words.en: A lessor is a person or entity that leases or rents property to another party, known as the lessee.

words.ex: The tenant pays rent every month.
words.ex_cn: 房客每个月支付租金。
words.en: A tenant is a person who rents land or property from a landlord.

words.ex: He signed a rental agreement for the apartment.
words.ex_cn: 他签了公寓的租赁协议。
words.en: A rental agreement is a contract between a landlord and a tenant that outlines the terms and conditions of renting a property.

words.tr: adj. 充满（某种不好的事物）的；充满危险或困难的

words.ex: The freight train carried boxes to the city.
words.ex_cn: 货运列车把箱子运到了城市。
words.en: Freight refers to goods transported in bulk by truck, train, ship, or aircraft. It can also mean the charge for such transportation.

words.ex: The ship carries a large cargo of rice.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船运载了大量大米货物。
words.en: Cargo refers to the goods carried by a ship, aircraft, or other large vehicle.

words.tr: n. 痴迷；困扰；着魔；强迫观念；
words.ex: His obsession with video games made him ignore his studies.
words.ex_cn: 他对电子游戏的痴迷让他忽略了学业。
words.en: An obsession is an idea or thought that continually preoccupies or intrudes on a person's mind.

words.tr: adj. 轻飘的；缥缈的；虚空的；精致的；
words.ex: The ethereal scarf floated gently in the wind.
words.ex_cn: 那条轻飘的围巾在风中轻轻飘动。
words.en: Something that is ethereal is extremely delicate and light in a way that seems not to be of this world.

words.ex: The door handle was unobtrusive and blended with the wall.
words.ex_cn: 门把手不显眼，与墙壁融为一体。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as unobtrusive, you mean that they are not easily noticed or do not draw attention to themselves.

words.ex: It is obvious that he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 很明显他很累。
words.en: If something is obvious, it is easy to see or understand.

words.ex: Strong foundations underpin the building.
words.ex_cn: 坚固的地基支撑着这栋建筑。
words.en: To support, strengthen, or provide a foundation for something.

words.ex: This food has good nutritional value.
words.ex_cn: 这种食物有很好的营养价值。
words.en: Relating to the process of providing or obtaining the food necessary for health and growth.

words.ex: The car's velocity increased on the highway.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车在高速公路上的速度增加了。
words.en: Velocity is the speed at which something moves in a particular direction.

words.tr: v. 摘下面纱；揭幕；揭露
words.ex: They will unveil the statue tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们明天将摘下雕像的面纱。
words.en: If someone unveils something such as a new statue or painting, they show it to the public for the first time.

words.ex: He unraveled the knotted string.
words.ex_cn: 他把打结的绳子拆散了。
words.en: To unravel means to separate or disentangle the threads of a fabric or a rope, or to solve or explain something that is complicated or mysterious.

words.ex: He worked hard to attain his goals.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以达到他的目标。
words.en: If you attain something, you gain it or achieve it, often after a lot of effort.

words.ex: He obtained a new job last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周获得了一份新工作。
words.en: If you obtain something, you get it or achieve it.

words.tr: adj. 无法实现的；难以得到的
words.ex: The prize was unattainable for him.
words.ex_cn: 这个奖对他来说是无法获得的。
words.en: If you say that something is unattainable, you mean that it cannot be achieved or is not available.

words.tr: adj. 无法获得的；无法得到的
words.ex: The prize was unobtainable because it was too expensive.
words.ex_cn: 这个奖品无法获得，因为它太贵了。
words.en: If something is unobtainable, it cannot be obtained or achieved because it is not available or possible.

words.tr: adj. 过分关注的；着迷的
words.ex: He is obsessional about cleaning his room.
words.ex_cn: 他对打扫房间着迷。
words.en: Characterized by an obsessive attachment or fixation.

words.ex: He has an obsessive need to clean everything.
words.ex_cn: 他有一种强迫性的需求，要把一切都打扫干净。
words.en: If someone's behaviour is obsessive, they cannot stop doing a particular thing or behaving in a particular way.

words.tr:
n. 度假胜地；手段；
v. 求助于；
words.ex: They went to a beach resort for their vacation.
words.ex_cn: 他们去一个海滨度假胜地度假。
words.en: If you resort to a particular course of action, you do it because you cannot see any other way of achieving what you want.

words.ex: Ethanol is used as a fuel in some cars.
words.ex_cn: 乙醇被用作一些汽车的燃料。
words.en: Ethanol is a clear, colorless liquid that is used as a solvent, in the manufacture of other chemicals, and as a fuel additive.

words.tr:
v. 闲逛；散步；漫步；
n. 闲逛；散步；漫步；
words.ex: They stroll in the park after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他们晚饭后在公园里闲逛。
words.en: If you stroll somewhere, you walk there in a slow, relaxed way.

words.tr:
v. 闲逛；漫步
n. 闲逛；漫步
words.ex: We decided to saunter along the beach.
words.ex_cn: 我们决定沿着海滩漫步。
words.en: If you saunter somewhere, you walk there in a slow, relaxed way.

words.tr: n. 超凡脱俗的美；空灵的美丽
words.ex: The dancer had an ethereal beauty that made everyone stop and stare.
words.ex_cn: 这位舞者有着超凡脱俗的美，让所有人都停下来看她。

words.ex: The salient point in the report is the cost increase.
words.ex_cn: 报告中最显著的要点是成本上升。
words.en: The most noticeable or important.

words.ex: The loud speaker is too obtrusive.
words.ex_cn: 这个扬声器太突兀了。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is obtrusive, you mean they are noticeable in an unwelcome or inappropriate way.

words.ex: The lake at dawn offers perfect tranquility.
words.ex_cn: 黎明时分的湖泊带来完全的宁静。
words.en: A state of peace and quiet.

words.ex: The glass is transparent.
words.ex_cn: 这玻璃是透明的。
words.en: If something is transparent, you can see through it.

words.tr: adj. 安静的；平静的；宁静的；
words.ex: The lake was tranquil in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 早晨的湖面很安静。
words.en: If a place or situation is tranquil, it is calm, peaceful, and quiet, with no disturbance or agitation.

words.tr: n. 镇静剂；镇定剂；止痛药
words.ex: The doctor gave him a tranquilizer to calm down.
words.ex_cn: 医生给了他一种镇静剂来让他平静下来。
words.en: A tranquilizer is a drug used to reduce anxiety or tension.

words.ex: The mid-term trend shows a steady increase in sales.
words.ex_cn: 中期趋势显示销售额稳步上升。

words.tr: adj. 可比较的；比得上的；类似的；
words.ex: The prices of these two phones are comparable.
words.ex_cn: 这两部手机的价格是可比较的。
words.en: Something that is comparable to something else is similar in size, amount, or quality.

words.tr: adj. 较合意的；更可取的；
words.ex: Tea is preferable to coffee in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 早上喝茶比喝咖啡更合意。
words.en: If you say that one thing is preferable to another, you mean that it is more desirable or suitable.

words.tr: adj. 有竞争力的；竞争的；
words.ex: She is a competitive runner who wins many races.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个有竞争力的跑步者，赢得了许多比赛。
words.en: Competitive is used to describe situations or activities in which people or firms compete with each other.

words.ex: The car gains velocity as it goes downhill.
words.ex_cn: 汽车下坡时速度增加。
words.en: To increase speed, especially in a physical context such as a moving object or vehicle.

words.ex: The car loses velocity on the hill.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在山坡上减速。
words.en: To decrease in speed or momentum, often due to resistance or lack of propulsion.

words.tr:
n. 速度；速率；
v. 加速；加快；
words.ex: The car's speed was too high on the wet road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在湿滑路面上的速度太快了。
words.en: Speed is the rate at which something moves or happens.

words.tr:
n. 纺锤；锭子；心轴
v. 装锭子于
words.ex: The spinner turns the spindle quickly.
words.ex_cn: 纺纱工快速转动纺锤。
words.en: A spindle is a rod or pin, tapered at one end and usually weighted at the other, on which fibers are spun by hand into thread and then wound.

words.ex: The rod is a long shaft made of metal.
words.ex_cn: 这根杆是一根长金属杆。
words.en: A shaft is a long, narrow part or section forming the handle of a tool or club, the body of a spear or arrow, or a long, narrow, typically vertical hole that gives access to a mine, accommodates a lift, or provides ventilation.

words.tr:
n. 影响力；冲击（力）；
v. 对…产生影响；
words.ex: The new law had a big impact on education.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法律对教育产生了重大影响。
words.en: The effect or influence of one person, thing, or action, on another.

words.ex: The car moved with rapidity.
words.ex_cn: 汽车以迅速的速度行驶。
words.en: the quality of moving or reacting with great speed

words.ex: The municipality cleaned the streets last week.
words.ex_cn: 这个自治市上周清理了街道。
words.en: A municipality is a city or town that has its own government to manage local affairs.

words.ex: The lawmaker wrote a new bill for schools.
words.ex_cn: 这位立法者为学校写了一项新法案。
words.en: A lawmaker is a person who makes laws; a legislator.

words.ex: The municipal library is open every day.
words.ex_cn: 这座市政图书馆每天都开放。
words.en: Relating to a city or town or its governing body.

words.ex: The engineer built a prototype of the new car.
words.ex_cn: 工程师制作了这辆新车的原型。
words.en: A prototype is the first or original example of something that has been or will be copied or developed; it is a model or preliminary version.

words.tr:
v. （使）旋转
n. 转环；旋轴
words.ex: The chair can swivel easily.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子可以轻松旋转。
words.en: A swivel is a device that allows something to turn around freely, or to turn something around freely.

words.ex: The scientist tried to replicate the experiment.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家试图复制这个实验。
words.en: To replicate something means to do or make something again in exactly the same way.

words.ex: The small boat capsize in the storm.
words.ex_cn: 小船在风暴中倾覆了。
words.en: If a boat capsizes or if you capsize it, it turns over in the water.

words.tr:
n. 计划；方案；项目；课题；
v. 投射；预计；
words.ex: He presented his school project to the class.
words.ex_cn: 他向全班展示了他的学校计划。
words.en: A project is a piece of work that is planned or intended, or a large piece of work that is done by a group of people.

words.ex: The political issue is thorny and hard to solve.
words.ex_cn: 这个政治问题很棘手，难以解决。
words.en: A thorny problem or subject is difficult to deal with because it is complex and involves many different aspects.

words.tr: adj. 有资格的；合格的；合意的；
words.ex: He is eligible to vote because he is 18 years old.
words.ex_cn: 他年满18岁，有资格投票。
words.en: Someone who is eligible for something is qualified or allowed to do it.

words.ex: He finally admit his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他终于承认了自己的错误。
words.en: If you admit that something bad, unpleasant, or embarrassing is true, you agree, often unwillingly, that it is true.

words.ex: The architect showed us the blueprint of the new house.
words.ex_cn: 建筑师给我们看了新房子的蓝图。
words.en: A blueprint is a detailed plan or design of something, often used in the context of buildings or machinery, which shows how it is to be made or how it will work.

words.ex: The hero in the story is an archetype of courage.
words.ex_cn: 故事中的英雄是勇气的原型。
words.en: An archetype is a very typical example of a certain person or thing.

words.ex: The bridge has a stone arch.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥有一个石拱。
words.en: An arch is a structure that is curved at the top and is usually made of stone or brick. Arches are often used to support the weight of a bridge or the roof of a building.

words.tr:
adj. 原来的；有创造性的；原版的；新颖的；
n. 原件；原稿；
words.ex: This is the original book I bought last year.
words.ex_cn: 这是我去年买的那本原版书。
words.en: An original piece of writing or music was written recently and has not been published or performed before.

words.tr: adj. 断断续续的；一阵阵的
words.ex: He had fitful sleep last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚睡得断断续续。
words.en: Something that is fitful happens for irregular periods of time or occurs at irregular times, rather than being continuous.

words.tr:
n. 吱吱声；尖叫声
v. 短促而尖厉地叫；吱吱叫
words.ex: The mouse makes a small squeak.
words.ex_cn: 老鼠发出一声小小的吱吱声。
words.en: If something or someone squeaks, they make a short, high-pitched sound.

words.tr:
n. 长声尖叫；长而尖的声音
v. 尖声长叫
words.ex: The child let out a loud squeal when she saw the spider.
words.ex_cn: 当孩子看到蜘蛛时，发出了一声长长的尖叫。
words.en: If someone or something squeals, they make a long, high-pitched sound.

words.tr: adj. 吱嘎作响的；发出刺耳声音的
words.ex: The door makes a squeaky sound when it opens.
words.ex_cn: 门打开时发出吱吱的声音。
words.en: Something that is squeaky makes high-pitched sounds.

words.ex: He dozed off during the boring meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在无聊的会议上打起了瞌睡。
words.en: To doze means to sleep lightly or for a short period.

words.ex: The doctor gave him a small dose of medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生给了他一小剂量的药。
words.en: A dose of a medicine or a drug is the amount of it that you take at one time, or the amount that is recommended for you to take.

words.ex: His words were contradictory.
words.ex_cn: 他的话是矛盾的。
words.en: If two or more facts, ideas, or statements are contradictory, they state or imply that opposite things are true.

words.tr: adj. 互相依赖的；相倚的；
words.ex: The two countries are interdependent in trade.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家在贸易上互相依赖。
words.en: If two or more things are interdependent, they depend on each other.

words.ex: He lives independently and makes his own decisions.
words.ex_cn: 他独立生活，并自己做决定。
words.en: If one thing or person is independent of another, they are separate and not connected, so that the first one is not affected or influenced by the second.

words.tr: v. 起草一个项目；制定一个项目计划
words.ex: The team will draw up a project for the new school.
words.ex_cn: 团队将为新学校起草一个项目。

words.tr: v. 执行一个项目；实施一个计划
words.ex: The team will carry out a project next month.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队下个月将执行一个项目。

words.ex: My room is on the third floor.
words.ex_cn: 我的房间在三楼。
words.en: The floor is the surface of a room on which you stand.

words.tr: 棘手的问题难倒了某人
words.ex: The thorny problem floors the CEO.
words.ex_cn: 这个棘手的问题难倒了首席执行官。

words.tr: adj. 有资格做某事；符合条件做某事
adj. 值得拥有的；令人渴望的；称心如意的；
words.ex: A quiet neighborhood is desirable for families.
words.ex_cn: 安静的社区对家庭来说是值得拥有的。
words.en: Something that is desirable is worth having or doing because it is useful, necessary, or popular.

words.tr: adj. 有资格的；合格的； v. 取得资格；“qualify”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is a qualified teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有资格的老师。
words.en: Having the necessary qualifications for a particular job or task.

words.ex: This shirt is suitable for the party.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫适合这场派对。
words.en: Something that is suitable for a particular person or thing is right or acceptable for them.

words.ex: The ticket is your admission to the concert.
words.ex_cn: 这张票是进入音乐会的许可。
words.en: An admission is a statement in which you admit that something bad, unpleasant, or embarrassing is true, or the act of allowing someone to enter a place or organization.

words.ex: The bacterial infection made him very sick.
words.ex_cn: 细菌感染让他病得很重。
words.en: Relating to or caused by bacteria.

words.ex: Good management helps a company grow.
words.ex_cn: 良好的管理有助于公司发展。
words.en: The control and organization of something, especially a business and its employees.

words.ex: His enrolment at the university starts next month.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学的入学时间是下个月。
words.en: Enrolment refers to the process of signing up or registering for something, such as a school, course, or program.

words.ex: The team made a smart strategy to win the game.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队制定了一项聪明的策略来赢得比赛。
words.en: A strategy is a plan that you use in order to achieve something.

words.ex: A bird emerged from the trees.
words.ex_cn: 一只鸟从树中浮现出来。
words.en: If something or someone emerges, they come out of or move out of something and become visible.

words.ex: The diver submerge to explore the coral reef.
words.ex_cn: 潜水员潜水去探索珊瑚礁。
words.en: To submerge something means to put it below the surface of a liquid, especially water. If something submerges, it goes below the surface of a liquid.

words.ex: The mantle lies below the Earth's crust.
words.ex_cn: 地幔位于地球地壳之下。
words.en: The mantle is the part of the earth between the crust and the core. It can also refer to a cloak or covering.

words.tr:
adj. 总的；全面的；总体的；
adv. 总计；大致上；
words.ex: The overall cost is too high.
words.ex_cn: 总成本太高了。
words.en: You use overall to indicate that you are talking about a situation in general or about the whole of something.

words.tr: adj. 无法生存的；不可行的
words.ex: The non-viable seed never grew into a plant.
words.ex_cn: 那个无法生存的种子从未长成植物。

words.tr: adj. 不能生长发育的；不可行的
words.ex: The embryo was deemed nonviable after the first trimester.
words.ex_cn: 胚胎在第一孕期后被认为不能存活。
words.en: If something is nonviable, it is not capable of succeeding or continuing, especially because it is not practical or it is too expensive.

words.ex: How did this mistake come about?
words.ex_cn: 这个错误是怎么发生的？
words.en: If you ask how something came about, you want to know how it happened or started.

words.tr: phrase. 注册表；入学申请表；登记表格
words.ex: Please fill out the enrolment form to register for the course.
words.ex_cn: 请填写注册表以报名参加课程。
words.en: A document used to register for a course, program, or event.

words.ex: The car remained static at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在红灯前静止不动。
words.en: Something that is static does not move or change.

words.tr: phrase. 营销策略；市场推广策略
words.ex: The company uses simple marketing strategies to sell more products.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司使用简单的营销策略来销售更多产品。
words.en: Marketing strategies refer to the plans and methods used to promote and sell products or services, including market research, advertising, and distribution.

words.tr: phrase. 阅读策略；阅读方法；用于提高阅读理解与效率的一系列技巧与计划
words.ex: He uses a reading strategy to understand books faster.
words.ex_cn: 他使用一种阅读策略来更快地理解书籍。
words.en: A method or plan chosen to bring about a desired future, such as achievement of a goal or solution to a problem, specifically in the context of reading.

words.tr: phrase. 研究策略；研究方案；为达成研究目标而制定的系统性计划与方法
words.ex: He developed a new research strategy for his science project.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的科学项目制定了一种新的研究策略。
words.en: A planned approach to conducting research, including methods for data collection and analysis.

words.ex: He has a clear notion of right and wrong.
words.ex_cn: 他对对错有清晰的概念。
words.en: A notion is an idea or belief about something.

words.ex: The volcano spewed hot magma into the air.
words.ex_cn: 火山喷出了炽热的岩浆。
words.en: Magma is molten rock that is found beneath the surface of the Earth, and which may erupt from a volcano as lava.

words.ex: There was a surge in sales during the holiday season.
words.ex_cn: 假期期间销量激增。
words.en: If something surges, it increases suddenly and greatly, after having been steady or only small in size or amount.

words.ex: The volcano spilled hot lava down the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 火山喷出炽热的岩浆流下山。
words.en: Lava is the molten rock that comes out of a volcano during an eruption.

words.ex: The butterfly starts as a larva.
words.ex_cn: 蝴蝶从幼虫开始。
words.en: An insect in the stage of development when it has just come out of an egg and before it changes into its adult form.

words.tr: v. 突然涌入；猛烈冲入
words.ex: People surged into the stadium when the gates opened.
words.ex_cn: 当大门打开时，人们突然涌入体育场。

words.ex: He had an overall checkup at the hospital last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周在医院做了全面体检。

words.ex: The table is made of granite.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是花岗岩做的。
words.en: Granite is a very hard rock that is often used in building.

words.tr:
adj. 近似的；大约的；
v. 接近；
words.ex: The approximate cost is $50.
words.ex_cn: 费用大约是50美元。
words.en: An approximate number, time, or position is close to the correct number, time, or position, but is not exact.

words.ex: We visited an art gallery on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们周日参观了一家艺术画廊。
words.en: A gallery is a place where works of art are shown to the public.

words.ex: The community cleaned the park together.
words.ex_cn: 社区居民一起清理了公园。
words.en: A community is a group of people who live in the same area or who have the same interests, religion, or nationality.

words.tr:
n. 摇摆；
v. 摇摆；
words.ex: The child enjoyed the swing at the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子喜欢在公园里荡秋千。
words.en: If something swings or if you swing it, it moves repeatedly backwards and forwards or from side to side from a fixed point. If you swing somewhere, you move there by holding onto something and moving your body through the air.

words.ex: He cited a book in his essay.
words.ex_cn: 他在文章中引用了一本书。
words.en: To cite something means to quote it or mention it as evidence or proof of what you are saying.

words.ex: The colors in the rainbow cover a wide spectrum.
words.ex_cn: 彩虹中的颜色覆盖了广泛的范围。
words.en: A spectrum is a range of a particular type of thing, often a range of colors, ideas, or opinions.

words.ex: The drawback of this phone is its short battery life.
words.ex_cn: 这款手机的缺点是电池续航时间短。
words.en: A drawback is a feature of something that makes it less useful or desirable than it could be.

words.ex: He can identify the bird by its song.
words.ex_cn: 他能通过鸟的叫声识别它。
words.en: If you can identify someone or something, you are able to recognize them or distinguish them from others.

words.ex: The proximate cause of the accident was bad weather.
words.ex_cn: 事故的直接原因是恶劣天气。
words.en: If something is proximate, it is nearest in space, time, or relationship.

words.ex: The trip takes approximately 30 minutes.
words.ex_cn: 这段旅程大约需要30分钟。
words.en: Used to indicate that something is close to the actual, but not completely accurate or exact.

words.ex: The asian community celebrates Lunar New Year together.
words.ex_cn: 亚裔社区一起庆祝农历新年。

words.tr: phrase. 社区意识；群体意识；归属感
words.ex: The small town has a strong sense of community.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇有着强烈的社区归属感。
words.en: The feeling of belonging to a group and being involved in a community.

words.tr: phrase. 社区精神；集体意识；指社区成员之间的团结、互助和共同参与的精神
words.ex: The community spirit helped everyone clean the park together.
words.ex_cn: 社区精神让大家一起清理了公园。
words.en: The feeling of belonging to a community and the willingness to help and support others within it.

words.ex: The electromagnetic wave travels through space.
words.ex_cn: 电磁波在太空中传播。
words.en: Relating to the interrelation of electric currents or fields and magnetic fields.

words.tr: n. 电磁谱；包括无线电波、微波、红外线、可见光、紫外线、X射线和伽马射线在内的所有电磁波按波长或频率排列的连续谱
words.ex: Visible light is part of the electromagnetic spectrum.
words.ex_cn: 可见光是电磁谱的一部分。

words.ex: She turned on the lamp to read a book.
words.ex_cn: 她打开灯来读书。
words.en: A lamp is a device that produces light by the flow of electric current, or by burning oil or gas.

words.tr:
adj. 瘸的；跛的；站不住脚的；无说服力的
v. 变跛；瘸行
words.ex: The lame dog walked slowly on three legs.
words.ex_cn: 那只瘸狗用三条腿慢慢走。
words.en: If someone is lame, they are unable to walk properly because of damage to one or both of their legs. A lame excuse, explanation, etc. is one that is weak and difficult to believe.

words.tr: n. 小路；小巷；航道；车道；航线；
words.ex: The children walked down the narrow lane to school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们沿着狭窄的小路去上学。
words.en: A lane is a narrow road, especially in the country. It can also refer to a division of a road intended to separate lines of traffic moving in the same or opposite directions.

words.ex: The cat ran down the alley.
words.ex_cn: 猫跑进了小巷。
words.en: An alley is a narrow passage between buildings or other structures.

words.ex: The farmer feeds the lamb every morning.
words.ex_cn: 农夫每天早上喂羔羊。
words.en: A lamb is a young sheep.

words.tr:
n. 一系列；（变化）范围；山脉；
v. （在某范围内）变化；包括（各种不同的人或物）；
words.ex: The store offers a range of colors.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店提供一系列颜色。
words.en: A range of things is a number of different things of the same general kind.

words.tr: phrase. 文化认同；文化身份；文化特性
words.ex: He is proud of his cultural identity.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己的文化身份感到自豪。
words.en: Cultural identity is the identity or feeling of belonging to a group. It is part of a person's self-conception and self-perception and is related to nationality, ethnicity, religion, social class, generation, locality or any kind of social group that has its own distinct culture.

words.ex: The two shirts are identical.
words.ex_cn: 这两件衬衫是一样的。
words.en: Exactly the same, or very similar.

words.ex: He has the same book as me.
words.ex_cn: 他有一本和我一样的书。
words.en: If two or more things, actions, or qualities are the same, or if one is the same as another, they are very like each other in some way.

words.ex: The trend shows more people are using electric cars.
words.ex_cn: 这个趋势表明越来越多的人在使用电动汽车。
words.en: A trend is a general development or change in a situation or in the way that people are behaving.

words.tr:
adj. 极度的；
n. 极端；极端的事物；
words.ex: He felt extreme pain after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故后感到极度疼痛。
words.en: If you describe something as extreme, you mean that it is very great in degree or intensity.

words.ex: He skipped the hard question and moved to the next one.
words.ex_cn: 他略过了难题，继续做下一题。
words.en: To move lightly and quickly, making a small jump after each step.

words.tr:
adj. 军事的；军用的；
n. 军队；武装力量；
words.ex: The military base is near the border.
words.ex_cn: 军事基地靠近边境。
words.en: relating to or characteristic of soldiers or armed forces

words.tr:
adj. 法定的；既定的
v. 授予；使穿衣；“vest”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: He has a vested right to the property.
words.ex_cn: 他对该财产拥有法定权利。
words.en: Past participle of vest: legally granted or secured, especially a right or interest.

words.ex: He listened to a beautiful symphony last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚听了一首美妙的交响乐。
words.en: A symphony is a long piece of music that is usually in four parts and is performed by an orchestra.

words.tr: v. 确定…的位置；使坐落于；查找…的地点；
words.ex: Can you locate the hotel on the map?
words.ex_cn: 你能在地图上找到酒店的位置吗？
words.en: To locate something means to find out exactly where it is, or to establish something in a particular place.

words.ex: The teacher will classify the students by age.
words.ex_cn: 老师将按年龄对学生进行分类。
words.en: To classify things means to divide them into groups or types so that things with similar characteristics are in the same group.

words.tr: v. 证明…是真实的；鉴别
words.ex: He must authenticate his identity with a password.
words.ex_cn: 他必须用密码验证自己的身份。
words.en: To authenticate something means to prove or confirm that it is genuine or true.

words.ex: The authenticity of the ancient painting was confirmed by experts.
words.ex_cn: 这幅古画的真实性得到了专家的确认。
words.en: The quality of being genuine or not corrupted from the original.

words.tr: adj. 真正的；真实的；真迹的；可靠的；
words.ex: This is an authentic painting by Picasso.
words.ex_cn: 这是一幅毕加索的真迹。
words.en: If something is authentic, it is real, true, or what people say it is.

words.tr: phrase. 下降趋势；下行走势
words.ex: The temperature shows a downward trend this week.
words.ex_cn: 这周气温呈下降趋势。
words.en: A downward trend refers to a situation in which something is decreasing or getting worse over a period of time.

words.tr: phrase. 上升趋势；向上的趋势
words.ex: The temperature shows an upward trend this week.
words.ex_cn: 这周温度呈上升趋势。
words.en: An upward trend refers to a general increase or improvement in something over time.

words.tr: phrase. 经济趋势；指经济活动在一段时间内的发展方向或变化模式
words.ex: The economic trend is rising this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年的经济趋势正在上升。
words.en: An economic trend refers to the general direction in which the economy of a country or region is moving over a period of time. It can indicate growth, decline, or stability in economic activities.

words.tr: phrase. 近期趋势；最新动向
words.ex: The recent trend is to use phones for learning.
words.ex_cn: 最近的趋势是用手机学习。
words.en: A new and recent development or fashion.

words.tr: phrase. 影响广泛的趋势；席卷性的潮流
words.ex: The sweeping trends in technology are changing the way we live.
words.ex_cn: n. 技术领域的广泛趋势正在改变我们的生活方式。
words.en: Sweeping trends refer to widespread and influential movements or patterns that affect a large area or group.

words.ex: The car exceeded the speed limit.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车超过了限速。
words.en: To be greater in quantity, degree, or intensity than something else.

words.ex: The weather is exceedingly cold today.
words.ex_cn: 今天的天气极其寒冷。
words.en: To a very great degree; extremely.

words.ex: He was tired in the extreme after running for hours.
words.ex_cn: 他跑了几个小时后累到了极点。
words.en: To an extreme degree; very great or intense.

words.ex: He eats excessively sweets.
words.ex_cn: 他吃太多甜食。
words.en: To an excessive degree; more than is necessary, normal, or desirable; inordinately.

words.ex: He ate excessive amounts of candy.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了过多的糖果。
words.en: If you describe the amount or level of something as excessive, you disapprove of it because it is more or higher than is necessary or reasonable.

words.tr: adv. 非常地；极其地；极端地；
words.ex: The weather is extremely cold today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天气非常冷。
words.en: To an extreme degree; very.

words.tr:
n. 跳跃；
v. 跳跃；
words.ex: The cat made a big leap over the fence.
words.ex_cn: 猫跳过了篱笆。
words.en: To leap means to jump high or a long way, or to move quickly and with a lot of energy.

words.ex: He overlooked the mistake in the report.
words.ex_cn: 他忽略了报告中的错误。
words.en: If you overlook a fact or problem, you do not notice it, or do not realize how important it is.

words.ex: He bought a new gizmo to fix his phone.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一个新小装置来修他的手机。
words.en: A gizmo is a small device or tool, especially one whose name you do not know or cannot remember.

words.ex: The government gives a subsidy to farmers.
words.ex_cn: 政府向农民提供补贴。
words.en: A subsidy is money that is paid by a government or other authority in order to help an industry or business, or to pay for a public service.

words.tr: v. 使着迷；使陶醉；对…施魔法
words.ex: The magic show enchants the children.
words.ex_cn: 魔术表演让孩子们着迷。
words.en: If you are enchanted by someone or something, they cause you to have feelings of great delight or pleasure.

words.tr: v. 使全神贯注；独占；垄断
words.ex: He is engrossed in reading a novel.
words.ex_cn: 他正全神贯注地读一本小说。
words.en: If something engrosses you, it interests you so much that you do not notice anything else.

words.tr: v. 加浮雕花纹于；饰以浮饰；使凸出
words.ex: He embosses the card with his name.
words.ex_cn: 他把名字压印在卡片上。
words.en: To decorate a surface by making raised designs or patterns on it.

words.tr: adj. 使人全神贯注的；极有趣味的；引人入胜的； v. “engross”的现在分词；
words.ex: The movie was so engrossing that I forgot to eat.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影如此引人入胜，我都忘了吃饭。
words.en: If something is engrossing, it holds your attention completely because it is extremely interesting or exciting.

words.ex: The two countries reached a concord on trade.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家在贸易上达成了一致。
words.en: Concord is a state of agreement or harmony between people or groups.

words.ex: The team works in harmony.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队合作得很和谐。
words.en: Harmony is the pleasant combination of different notes of music played at the same time. It can also refer to a situation in which people are peaceful and agree with each other, or when things seem right or suitable together.

words.ex: They had a discord about the movie ending.
words.ex_cn: 他们对电影的结局有分歧。
words.en: Disagreement or strife between people or groups.

words.tr: n. 远离的工厂；位于远方的工厂
words.ex: The factory located far away produces cars.
words.ex_cn: 那个远离的工厂生产汽车。

words.tr: adj. 充满热情的；热心的；
words.ex: He is enthusiastic about playing basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他对打篮球充满热情。
words.en: If you are enthusiastic about something, you show how much you like or enjoy it by the way that you behave and talk.

words.ex: He will alter the plan tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会改动计划。
words.en: To alter something means to change it, usually slightly, or to cause the characteristics of something to change.

words.tr: v. 使不合格；剥夺资格
words.ex: He was disqualified for breaking the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他因为违反规则而被取消资格。
words.en: If someone is disqualified from something, they are officially stopped from doing it, usually because they have done something wrong or broken a rule.

words.tr:
n. 最大限度；最大量；
adj. 最大极限的；最多的；
words.ex: The maximum of the crowd is 100 people.
words.ex_cn: 人群的上限是100人。
words.en: The greatest or highest amount possible or attained.

words.ex: The delivery of the package took three days.
words.ex_cn: 这个包裹的交付花了三天时间。
words.en: The act of delivering letters, parcels, or goods.

words.tr:
adj. 地下的；
n. 地铁；地下；
adv. 在地下；
words.ex: The underground tunnel connects two buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这条地下的隧道连接了两座建筑。
words.en: Something that is underground is below the surface of the ground. It can also refer to secret activities or organizations.

words.ex: He is an undergraduate at Harvard.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的一名本科生。
words.en: An undergraduate is a student at a university or college who is studying for their first degree.

words.tr:
v. 集中；聚焦；
n. 中心点；焦点；
words.ex: He needs to focus on his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他需要集中精力做作业。
words.en: If you focus on a particular topic or if your attention is focused on it, you concentrate on it and think about it, discuss it, or deal with it, rather than dealing with other topics.

words.tr: v. 给予（药物或治疗）；管理；实施；
words.ex: The nurse will administer the medicine to the patient.
words.ex_cn: 护士会给病人服药。
words.en: To administer means to manage or oversee the execution, use, or conduct of something; to dispense or apply (a remedy or drug).

words.ex: I managed to finish my homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我设法在晚饭前完成了作业。
words.en: To manage means to be in charge of or control something, especially a business or a group of people.

words.ex: The cow has two long horns.
words.ex_cn: 这头牛有两只长角。
words.en: A horn is a pointed projection on the head of various animals, consisting of a core of bone surrounded by a sheath of keratin, or a device for making a loud warning noise.

words.tr: adj. 角状的；角质的；坚硬的；粗糙的；好色的；性饥渴的
words.ex: The deer has a large horny antler.
words.ex_cn: 这只鹿有一只巨大的角状鹿角。
words.en: If you describe someone as horny, you mean that they are sexually aroused or that they easily become sexually aroused. It can also describe something that is made of horn or is hard like horn.

words.tr:
n. 雁叫声；汽车喇叭声
v. （使汽车喇叭）鸣响；（雁）叫
words.ex: The honk of the geese echoed over the lake.
words.ex_cn: 大雁的叫声在湖面上回荡。
words.en: 1. The sound made by a car horn. 2. The cry of a goose. 3. To make a sound like a car horn or a goose.

words.ex: The audience gave enthusiastic applause after the performance.
words.ex_cn: 演出结束后，观众报以热烈的掌声。

words.ex: The crowd gave the singer an enthusiastic reception.
words.ex_cn: 观众热情地欢迎了这位歌手。
words.en: An enthusiastic reception refers to a warm and eager welcome or response to someone or something.

words.ex: The horns honking made it hard to sleep.
words.ex_cn: 汽车喇叭鸣响让人难以入睡。

words.ex: The children are eager to open their presents.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们渴望打开他们的礼物。
words.en: If you are eager to do or have something, you want to do or have it very much.

words.tr: adj. 热情的；充满热情的；
words.ex: She is passionate about teaching children.
words.ex_cn: 她对教孩子充满热情。
words.en: Having, showing, or caused by strong feelings or beliefs.

words.tr: v. 取消某人做某事的资格
words.ex: He was disqualified from racing after breaking the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他因违反规则而被取消了参赛资格。

words.tr: v. 将某物集中在某物上；使注意力集中于某事物
words.ex: Focus your eyes on the screen.
words.ex_cn: 把你的注意力集中在屏幕上。

words.tr: v. 对某事进行管理或处理；向某物提供（如药物、援助等）
words.ex: He administers to the project every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天管理这个项目。

words.ex: The school has a strict attendance policy.
words.ex_cn: 学校有一个严格的出勤政策。
words.en: A set of rules or guidelines established by an organization to regulate the presence or absence of its members, especially employees or students.

words.ex: He was an absentee from class yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天缺席了课程。
words.en: A person who is expected or required to be present at a place or event but is not.

words.ex: His absenteeism caused the team to lose points.
words.ex_cn: 他的缺勤导致团队丢了分数。
words.en: Absenteeism is the habitual non-presence of an employee at their job.

words.ex: The fire left ash on the ground.
words.ex_cn: 火在地面上留下了灰烬。
words.en: the powdery residue left after the burning of a substance

words.ex: The storm will intensify tonight.
words.ex_cn: 风暴今晚会加强。
words.en: To make or become more intense or intensive.

words.ex: The store made an inventory of all the products.
words.ex_cn: 商店对所有商品做了一份清单。
words.en: An inventory is a detailed list of all the items in a place.

words.tr: n. 事件；大事；比赛项目；
words.ex: The school event was fun for everyone.
words.ex_cn: 学校的活动对每个人都很有趣。
words.en: An event is something that happens, especially when it is unusual or important.

words.tr: adj. 至关重要的；决定性的；
words.ex: It is crucial to drink water every day.
words.ex_cn: 每天喝水至关重要。
words.en: If you describe something as crucial, you mean it is extremely important.

words.tr:
n. 阶段；时期；舞台；
v. 举行；上演；
words.ex: This is a critical stage in his recovery.
words.ex_cn: 这是他康复过程中的一个关键阶段。
words.en: A stage is a raised area in a theatre or hall where performers, speakers, or entertainers stand. It can also refer to a particular point or period in the development or progress of something.

words.ex: The farmer uses aeration to help plants grow.
words.ex_cn: 农民使用通气来帮助植物生长。
words.en: The process of exposing to air, or of causing air to circulate through a substance.

words.ex: The room has good ventilation through the windows.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间通过窗户有良好的通风。
words.en: The provision of fresh air to a room, building, etc., or the system that does this.

words.ex: This small business is profitable.
words.ex_cn: 这家小企业有利可图的。
words.en: If something is profitable, it makes a profit or is beneficial.

words.ex: The property managing agent collects rent and fixes broken pipes.
words.ex_cn: 物业管理代理收取租金并修理破损的管道。

words.tr: n. 管理代理人；经理人
words.ex: The managing agent handles the rent and repairs for the apartment building.
words.ex_cn: 管理代理人负责处理公寓大楼的租金和维修。

words.tr: phrase. 如果发生某事；在……的情况下；倘若
words.ex: In the event of fire, leave the building quickly.
words.ex_cn: 如果发生火灾，迅速离开大楼。
words.en: If something happens; in case something happens.

words.tr: adj. 对某事至关重要的
words.ex: Sleep is crucial for your health.
words.ex_cn: 睡眠对你的健康至关重要。

words.ex: He helped me at a crucial time.
words.ex_cn: 他在关键时刻帮助了我。

words.tr: phrase. 关键的问题；至关重要的疑问
words.ex: Is this a crucial question for the test?
words.ex_cn: 这是考试中的一个关键问题吗？
words.en: A crucial question is one that is extremely important because it will have a major effect on the result of something.

words.tr: phrase. 在舞台上；当众表演；处于公众视线中
words.ex: The actor performed on stage with great confidence.
words.ex_cn: 这位演员在舞台上表演得非常自信。
words.en: When someone is on stage, they are performing in front of an audience.

words.tr: adv. 在舞台外；非公开地；不在表演时
words.ex: The actor walked off stage after the play ended.
words.ex_cn: 演出结束后，演员走下了舞台。
words.en: In a location not visible to the audience; behind the scenes.

words.ex: He gets stage fright before speaking in front of people.
words.ex_cn: 他在众人面前讲话前会感到怯场。
words.en: Stage fright is the nervousness felt by performers or speakers when facing an audience.

words.tr: adv. 在人生的这个阶段
words.ex: At this stage of life, he wants to travel more.
words.ex_cn: 在人生的这个阶段，他想多旅行。

words.w: over the course of your life
words.tr: 在你的一生中；在你整个生命的过程中
words.uk: ˌəʊvə ðə ˈkɔːs əv jɔː laɪf
words.us: ˌoʊvər ðə ˈkɔːrs əv jɔːr laɪf
words.ex: You will change over the course of your life.
words.ex_cn: 在你的一生中，你会改变。

words.ex: The farmer aerates the soil to help plants grow.
words.ex_cn: 农民给土壤通气以帮助植物生长。
words.en: To aerate something means to expose it to air or to cause air to circulate through it, often to keep it fresh or to improve its quality.

words.ex: Open the window to ventilate the room.
words.ex_cn: 打开窗户给房间通风。
words.en: To ventilate means to cause fresh air to enter and move around a room, building, etc., or to express your opinions or feelings about something openly.

words.ex: He runs a highly profitable business selling online courses.
words.ex_cn: 他经营着一个销售在线课程的高利润生意。
words.en: A commercial activity that generates substantial financial returns.

words.ex: Eating vegetables is beneficial to your health.
words.ex_cn: 吃蔬菜对你的健康有益。
words.en: Promoting or enhancing well-being; advantageous.

words.tr: adj. 赚大钱的；获利多的；
words.ex: He took a lucrative job at a tech company.
words.ex_cn: 他去了一家科技公司做一份赚大钱的工作。
words.en: A lucrative activity or job is one that you can earn a lot of money from.

words.tr: adj. 不盈利的；无利可图的；没有用的
words.ex: The small shop is unprofitable because few customers come.
words.ex_cn: 这家小店不赚钱，因为顾客很少。
words.en: If an activity or business is unprofitable, it does not make a profit.

words.ex: The old toy is worthless now.
words.ex_cn: 这个旧玩具现在毫无价值。
words.en: If something is worthless, it has no use or value.

words.tr: adj. 无价值的；不值钱的；微不足道的
words.ex: The old toy is valueless now.
words.ex_cn: 这个旧玩具现在没有价值。
words.en: Having no value; worthless.

words.ex: The painting is priceless.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画是无价的。
words.en: If you say that something is priceless, you are emphasizing that it is worth a very large amount of money, or that it is very important to you and you could not replace it.

words.ex: He has faith in his ability to win.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己赢得比赛有信心。
words.en: Strong belief in the doctrines of a religion, based on spiritual conviction rather than proof.

words.tr: n. 自助餐厅；自助食堂；
words.ex: We ate lunch in the school cafeteria.
words.ex_cn: 我们在学校自助餐厅吃午饭。
words.en: A cafeteria is a type of food service location within an institution in which there is little or no waiting staff table service, whether a restaurant or within an institution such as a large office building or school; a school dining location is also referred to as a dining hall or canteen (in British English).

words.tr: v. 相信；对某事有信心
words.ex: I have faith in this plan.
words.ex_cn: 我相信这个计划。

words.ex: He lost faith in the system after the unfair trial.
words.ex_cn: 在不公平的审判后，他对这个制度失去了信心。

words.tr: phrase. 宗教信仰；对宗教的虔诚信念
words.ex: He was deeply devoted to his religious faith.
words.ex_cn: 他深深地忠于他的宗教信仰。
words.en: Religious faith refers to a strong belief in the doctrines of a religion, based on spiritual conviction rather than proof.

words.ex: The project involves simple math and writing.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目包括简单的数学和写作。
words.en: If a situation or activity involves something, that thing is a necessary part or consequence of it.

words.tr:
adj. 牛奶的；乳品的；
n. 乳品店；
words.ex: She bought dairy products from the local farm.
words.ex_cn: 她从当地农场买了乳制品。
words.en: A dairy is a place where milk and cream are kept or where butter and cheese are made.

words.ex: The test results confirm he has the disease.
words.ex_cn: 检测结果证实他患有这种疾病。
words.en: To confirm something means to establish its truth or validity by providing evidence or proof.

words.ex: The door opens on a metal hinge.
words.ex_cn: 这扇门装在一个金属枢纽上。
words.en: A hinge is a piece of metal, wood, or plastic that is used to join two things together so that one of them can swing or move freely.

words.ex: The government helps to subsidise farmers.
words.ex_cn: 政府帮助补贴农民。
words.en: To subsidise means to support financially, typically by a government or public body, to help keep the price of a product or service low or to support a business or industry.

words.tr: v. 使某人参与某事；牵涉某人于某事中
words.ex: The teacher involved the students in the science project.
words.ex_cn: 老师让学生们参与了这个科学项目。

words.ex: His involvement in the project helped it succeed.
words.ex_cn: 他参与这个项目帮助它取得了成功。
words.en: The act of taking part in something or the state of being connected with something.

words.ex: The farmer feeds dairy cattle every morning.
words.ex_cn: 农夫每天早上喂奶牛。
words.en: Dairy cattle are cows bred for the ability to produce large quantities of milk, from which dairy products are made.

words.tr: phrase. 乳牛场；奶牛养殖场
words.ex: The dairy farm produces fresh milk daily.
words.ex_cn: 这家奶牛场每天生产新鲜牛奶。
words.en: A dairy farm is a place where cows are raised for the production of milk and milk products.

words.ex: This low-lactose milk is good for people who have trouble digesting dairy.
words.ex_cn: 这种低乳糖牛奶适合那些难以消化乳制品的人。

words.ex: He cannot drink milk because he is lactose intolerant.
words.ex_cn: 他不能喝牛奶，因为他乳糖不耐受。
words.en: Lactose is a sugar that is found in milk and milk products.

words.ex: He eats low-fat yogurt every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃低脂酸奶。
words.en: Containing only a small amount of fat.

words.ex: He received a confirmation email for his flight.
words.ex_cn: 他收到了航班的确认邮件。
words.en: Confirmation is the act of confirming something or making it more definite.

words.tr:
n. 污点；
v. 玷污；
words.ex: There is a coffee stain on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌子上有一个咖啡污点。
words.en: A stain is a mark on something that is difficult to remove, especially one made by a liquid such as blood or coffee. To stain something means to leave a mark on it that is difficult to remove.

words.ex: The workers unload the boxes from the truck.
words.ex_cn: 工人们从卡车上卸下箱子。
words.en: To remove goods from a vehicle, ship, container, etc.

words.ex: The conversion of water into steam takes heat.
words.ex_cn: 水变成蒸汽需要热量。
words.en: The process of changing or causing something to change from one form to another.

words.tr: adj. 无关紧要的；不相关的；
words.ex: His opinion is irrelevant to the decision.
words.ex_cn: 他的意见与这个决定无关紧要。
words.en: If you describe something as irrelevant, you mean that it is not important to or not connected with the present situation or discussion.

words.ex: The roller coaster gave her a thrill.
words.ex_cn: 过山车让她感到兴奋。
words.en: A thrill is a sudden feeling of great excitement, pleasure, or fear.

words.ex: The doctor ran a trial to test the new medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生进行了试验来测试这种新药。
words.en: A trial is a formal meeting in a law court, at which a judge and jury listen to evidence and decide whether a person is guilty of a crime.

words.ex: He extols the beauty of nature every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天赞美大自然的美。
words.en: If you extol something or someone, you praise them enthusiastically.

words.ex: He passed the test, albeit with a low score.
words.ex_cn: 他通过了考试，尽管分数很低。
words.en: You use albeit to introduce a fact or comment which reduces the force or significance of what you have just said.

words.ex: The big rock was an obstacle on the road.
words.ex_cn: 那块大石头是路上的障碍。
words.en: An obstacle is something which makes it difficult for you to go forward or to achieve something.

words.ex: The noise will diminish after midnight.
words.ex_cn: 午夜后噪音会减少。
words.en: If something diminishes, or if something diminishes it, it becomes reduced in size, importance, or intensity.

words.tr: v. 减到最少；使最小化；
words.ex: Try to minimize waste in the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 尽量减少厨房里的浪费。
words.en: To minimize something means to reduce it to the smallest possible amount or degree.

words.ex: His converse was the opposite of what he said earlier.
words.ex_cn: 他的相反言论与他之前说的话相反。
words.en: To engage in conversation; to talk informally with someone.

words.ex: The kids get excited when they see the clown.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们看到小丑时会兴奋起来。
words.en: To excite someone means to cause them to feel very enthusiastic and eager.

words.ex: The children felt delight when they saw the toys.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们看到玩具时感到高兴。
words.en: Delight is a feeling of very great pleasure.

words.tr:
n. 小径；路径；踪迹；
v. 跟踪；尾随；落后于；
words.ex: We walked along the forest trail.
words.ex_cn: 我们沿着森林小径散步。
words.en: A trail is a path through the countryside or through a forest, often made or used by people walking. As a verb, to trail means to follow someone or something secretly or to be behind in a race or competition.

words.ex: The new medicine went through a clinical trial last year.
words.ex_cn: 这种新药去年进行了临床试验。
words.en: A clinical trial is a research study that tests how well new medical approaches work in people. These studies test new methods of screening, prevention, diagnosis, or treatment of a disease.

words.ex: She was offered a job with a three-month trial period.
words.ex_cn: 她被提供了一份为期三个月的试用期工作。
words.en: A trial period is a length of time during which someone is tested or tried out in a new job or situation.

words.ex: He won the time trial by finishing fastest.
words.ex_cn: 他以最快的成绩赢得了计时赛。

words.tr: phrase. 在受审中；在试用中；试验性地
words.ex: He is on trial for stealing money.
words.ex_cn: 他因偷钱而受审。
words.en: If someone is on trial, they are being tried in a court of law.

words.tr: phrase. 试运行；试验性运行
words.ex: We need to do a trial run of the new software before the official launch.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要在正式发布前对新软件进行一次试运行。
words.en: A test or rehearsal of a performance or procedure before it is carried out in earnest.

words.ex: The welt on his arm hurt after the burn.
words.ex_cn: 他手臂上的烧伤疤痕很疼。
words.en: A welt is a raised mark on the skin caused by a blow, especially from a whip or stick.

words.tr:
v. 焊接
n. 焊接
words.ex: He welds metal pieces together with a torch.
words.ex_cn: 他用焊枪把金属片焊接在一起。
words.en: To join pieces of metal together by heating the surfaces until they melt and pressing them together.

words.tr: n. （拳击或其他运动的）次中量级；次中量级拳击手，次中量级运动员；次中量级业余拳击手
words.ex: He fights as a welterweight in the boxing ring.
words.ex_cn: 他在拳击场上以次中量级参赛。
words.en: A weight class in boxing and other combat sports, typically for competitors weighing 135–147 pounds (61–67 kg).

words.tr: adj. 大量的；重大的；实质性的；
words.ex: He made a substantial profit from the sale.
words.ex_cn: 他从这次销售中获得了大量的利润。
words.en: Something that is substantial is large in size, amount, or importance.

words.tr: v. 缩小规模；降低程度；将某物按比例缩小
words.ex: The company decided to scale down its operations to save money.
words.ex_cn: 公司决定缩小业务规模以节省资金。

words.tr: phrase. 障碍赛道；障碍训练场；重重困难的考验
words.ex: The children ran through the obstacle course at the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在公园里跑过了障碍赛道。
words.en: A physical training course with obstacles designed to test strength, agility, and problem-solving under pressure.

words.ex: The family had a meagre meal with just bread and water.
words.ex_cn: 这个家庭只吃了一顿贫乏的饭，只有面包和水。
words.en: If you describe an amount or quantity of something as meagre, you are critical of it because it is very small or not enough.

words.ex: He had a meager meal after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后吃了一顿很少的饭。
words.en: If you describe an amount or quantity of something as meager, you are critical of it because it is very small or not enough.

words.ex: The precipitation increased last week.
words.ex_cn: 上周降水增加了。
words.en: Precipitation is rain, snow, sleet, or hail — any kind of weather condition where something's falling from the sky.

words.tr: adj. 不安全的；危险的；不稳当的；
words.ex: The ladder was precarious and might fall.
words.ex_cn: 梯子不安全，可能会倒。
words.en: If a situation is precarious, it is uncertain or dangerous, and could get worse or fail.

words.tr: n. 自主权；自治权；自治；
words.ex: The region demands autonomy from the central government.
words.ex_cn: 该地区要求从中央政府获得自主权。
words.en: Autonomy is the ability or condition of being self-governing; independence in one's thoughts or actions.

words.ex: The witness lost credibility after lying.
words.ex_cn: 证人因撒谎而失去了可信性。
words.en: The quality of being trusted and believed in.

words.ex: The onslaught of rain flooded the streets.
words.ex_cn: 大量倾泻的雨水淹没了街道。
words.en: An onslaught is a very powerful, often violent, attack against someone or something.

words.ex: The school will curtail recess time during exams.
words.ex_cn: 学校在考试期间将缩短课间休息时间。
words.en: If you curtail something, you reduce or limit it.

words.ex: We need to shorten the meeting to one hour.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要把会议缩短到一小时。
words.en: To make something shorter in length, duration, or extent.

words.ex: The editor abridged the long story for children.
words.ex_cn: 编辑删节了这个长故事，以便适合儿童阅读。
words.en: To abridge a book, play, or other text means to make it shorter by leaving parts out.

words.ex: There is a correlation between exercise and good health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼与健康之间存在相关性。
words.en: A correlation between things is a connection or link between them.

words.tr: v. 使痛苦；“afflict”的现在分词；
words.ex: The illness is afflicting many old people.
words.ex_cn: 这种疾病正在使许多老人受苦。
words.en: If something afflicts you, it causes you physical or mental suffering.

words.tr: adj. 带给人痛苦的，苦恼的，难受的
words.ex: The afflictive news of his death left the family in deep sorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他去世的痛苦消息让家人陷入了深深的悲伤。
words.en: Causing pain or suffering; distressing.

words.tr:
v. 加速（坏事的发生）
n. 沉淀物；冷凝物
adj. 轻率的；仓促的
words.ex: The scandal precipitated the politician's resignation.
words.ex_cn: 这起丑闻加速了这位政治家的辞职。
words.en: To cause something to happen suddenly or unexpectedly; to cause a substance to be deposited in solid form from a solution.

words.ex: The peninsula is surrounded by water on three sides.
words.ex_cn: 这个半岛三面环水。
words.en: A peninsula is a piece of land that is almost entirely surrounded by water but is connected to the mainland on one side.

words.ex: The peninsular town has narrow streets and old houses.
words.ex_cn: 这个半岛上的小镇有狭窄的街道和古老的房屋。
words.en: Relating to or characteristic of a peninsula; resembling a peninsula.

words.tr: adj. 自治的；有自治权的；自主的；
words.ex: The region has autonomous control over its education system.
words.ex_cn: 这个地区对其教育系统拥有自治权。
words.en: An autonomous organization, country, or region is independent and has the freedom to govern itself.

words.tr: n. 不能相信；不可信的事物
words.ex: The incredibility of his story made everyone laugh.
words.ex_cn: 他故事的不可信让大家都笑了。
words.en: The quality of being impossible to believe or not believable.

words.ex: The veracity of his story was questioned by the police.
words.ex_cn: 他的故事的真实性受到了警方的质疑。
words.en: Veracity refers to the quality of being true or accurate.

words.ex: Honesty is important in friendship.
words.ex_cn: 诚实在友谊中很重要。
words.en: The quality of being honest, which involves being truthful, sincere, and free from deceit or fraud.

words.ex: He lost his job because of his integrity.
words.ex_cn: 他因为正直而失去了工作。
words.en: Integrity is the quality of being honest and having strong moral principles.

words.ex: He is a competent teacher who helps students easily.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有能力的老师，能轻松帮助学生。
words.en: If you are competent to do something, you have the skills, abilities, or experience necessary to do it well.

words.tr: adj. 无能力的；不称职的；不能胜任的；
words.ex: He is incompetent at managing simple tasks.
words.ex_cn: 他无法胜任简单的任务。
words.en: If you describe someone as incompetent, you are criticizing them because they are unable to do their job or a task properly.

words.ex: Two companies compete for the same customers.
words.ex_cn: 两家公司为争夺相同的客户而竞争。
words.en: If you compete with someone for something, you try to get it for yourself and stop the other person getting it. You can also say that two people compete for something that they both want.

words.ex: There is strong competition between the two companies.
words.ex_cn: 这两家公司之间竞争激烈。
words.en: Competition is a situation in which two or more people or groups are trying to get something which not everyone can have.

words.tr:
v. 承诺；答应；
n. 许诺；希望；成功的征兆（或理由）；
words.ex: He promised to help me with my homework.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺帮我做作业。
words.en: A promise is a statement that you will definitely do something or that something will definitely happen.

words.ex: He made a commitment to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺按时完成这个项目。
words.en: A commitment is something that regularly takes up some of your time because of an agreement you have made or because of responsibilities that you have.

words.ex: The government imposed a new tax on sugar.
words.ex_cn: 政府对糖征收了一项新税。
words.en: To impose means to officially force a rule, tax, punishment, etc. to be obeyed or received.

words.tr: adj. 教条的；武断的；固执己见的
words.ex: He is dogmatic about his beliefs.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己信念非常固执。
words.en: If you say that someone is dogmatic, you are critical of them because they are convinced that they are right, and refuse to consider that other opinions might also be justified.

words.ex: The teacher chose an arbitrary number to start the game.
words.ex_cn: 老师随意选了一个数字来开始游戏。
words.en: If you describe an action, rule, or decision as arbitrary, you think that it is not based on any principle, plan, or system. It often seems unfair because of this.

words.tr:
n. 痕迹；轨迹；微量；
v. 追踪；追溯；仔细查找；
words.ex: There was no trace of blood on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 地板上没有血迹。
words.en: If you trace something such as a pattern or a shape, you draw it carefully over a piece of thin paper. You can also trace someone or something that is missing or has disappeared, by following their movements or actions.

words.ex: The data points correlate with each other.
words.ex_cn: 这些数据点相互关联。
words.en: If one thing correlates with another, there is a close similarity or connection between them, often because one thing causes the other.

words.tr: phrase. 微量元素；痕量元素（指生物体或物质中含量极微但具有重要生理或化学作用的元素）
words.ex: Bananas contain a trace element called potassium.
words.ex_cn: 香蕉含有被称为钾的微量元素。
words.en: A chemical element present in extremely small amounts in a living organism or environment.

words.ex: Selenium is often used in solar cells.
words.ex_cn: 硒常用于太阳能电池中。
words.en: Selenium is a nonmetal with properties that are intermediate between those of its periodic table column-adjacent chalcogen elements sulfur and tellurium.

words.ex: He has a rare malady that doctors are trying to cure.
words.ex_cn: 他患有一种罕见的疾病，医生们正在努力治疗。
words.en: A malady is a disease or illness.

words.ex: The disease afflicted many people in the village.
words.ex_cn: 这种疾病使村子里许多人遭受痛苦。
words.en: If you are afflicted by pain, illness, or misfortune, it causes you great suffering and distress.

words.ex: The game uses a simulation of weather changes.
words.ex_cn: 这个游戏使用了天气变化的模拟。
words.en: A simulation is an imitation of a situation or process.

words.tr: adj. 不合适的；不相称的；不协调的；
words.ex: His funny hat was incongruous with the formal suit.
words.ex_cn: 他的滑稽帽子与正式西装不搭配。
words.en: Something that is incongruous is strange when considered together with other aspects of a situation.

words.ex: He received fair remuneration for his work.
words.ex_cn: 他因工作获得了公平的报酬。
words.en: Remuneration refers to the money that is paid to someone for the work that they have done.

words.ex: He intermixes blue and yellow to make green.
words.ex_cn: 他把蓝色和黄色混合在一起变成绿色。
words.en: To mix together; blend.

words.tr: v. 使相混；使联结；交际
words.ex: He mingled the two colors to make a new one.
words.ex_cn: 他把两种颜色混合在一起，创造出一种新颜色。
words.en: If things such as sounds, smells, or feelings mingle, they mix or combine with each other, or if people mingle, they talk to each other at a social event.

words.tr: adj. 最高的；至上的；最重要的；
words.ex: His safety is paramount.
words.ex_cn: 他的安全是最重要的。
words.en: Something that is paramount or of paramount importance is more important than anything else.

words.tr:
adj. 最重要的；
adv. 首要地；
words.ex: He is the foremost expert in this field.
words.ex_cn: 他是这个领域最重要的专家。
words.en: Most important or prominent; leading.

words.tr: adj. 催眠的；引起睡眠的；
words.ex: The soft music had a hypnotic effect.
words.ex_cn: 柔和的音乐有催眠效果。
words.en: Something that is hypnotic holds your attention or makes you feel very relaxed, often in a way that is similar to being hypnotized.

words.ex: One apple will suffice for now.
words.ex_cn: 一个苹果现在就足够了。
words.en: If something suffices, it is enough to achieve a purpose or to fulfill a need.

words.ex: The technician fixed the broken machine.
words.ex_cn: 技术员修好了坏掉的机器。
words.en: A technician is a worker trained with special skills, especially in science or engineering.

words.ex: Please tell me beforehand if you can't come.
words.ex_cn: 如果你不能来，请提前告诉我。
words.en: If you do something beforehand, you do it earlier than a particular event.

words.tr: adj. 适当的；合适的；恰当的；
words.ex: This dress is appropriate for a wedding.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子适合参加婚礼。
words.en: Something that is appropriate is suitable or acceptable for a particular situation.

words.ex: The colors are congruous with the room's design.
words.ex_cn: 这些颜色与房间的设计相协调。
words.en: If one thing is congruous with another, there is a harmonious agreement or consistency between them.

words.ex: The company will remunerate you for your extra work.
words.ex_cn: 公司会为你的额外工作支付报酬。
words.en: To remunerate someone means to pay them for work that they have done.

words.ex: The government will expropriate the land for the new road.
words.ex_cn: 政府将征用这块土地用于新建道路。
words.en: If a government or other authority expropriates someone's property, they take it away from them for public use or benefit.

words.ex: You must comply with the school rules.
words.ex_cn: 你必须遵守校规。

words.ex: The pink hat on the man looked like an incongruity.
words.ex_cn: 男人头上的粉红色帽子显得很不协调。
words.en: The state of being incongruous; incompatibility.

words.tr: adj. 不调和的；不一致的；不和谐的
words.ex: The two voices sounded discordant.
words.ex_cn: 这两声音听起来不和谐。
words.en: Something that is discordant is strange or unpleasant because it does not fit in with other things.

words.ex: The discordance between their opinions made the meeting very tense.
words.ex_cn: 他们意见之间的不一致使会议变得非常紧张。
words.en: Lack of agreement or harmony between people or things.

words.ex: The teacher changed the parameter to make the test easier.
words.ex_cn: 老师更改了参数，使测试更容易。
words.en: A parameter is a limit or boundary which defines the scope of a particular process or activity.

words.ex: The news will disseminate quickly through social media.
words.ex_cn: 这条新闻会通过社交媒体迅速传播。
words.en: To disseminate means to spread or distribute something, especially information, widely.

words.tr: 短语 说到底，不妨说某事；言简意赅地说某事
words.ex: Suffice it to say, the project was a success.
words.ex_cn: 说到底，不妨说这个项目成功了。

words.ex: The sufficiency of food was confirmed by the survey.
words.ex_cn: 调查显示食物的足量得到了确认。
words.en: Sufficiency is the state of having enough of something.

words.ex: We have sufficient food for the trip.
words.ex_cn: 我们有足够的食物用于这次旅行。
words.en: If something is sufficient for a particular purpose, there is enough of it for the purpose.

words.ex: The water is sufficiently warm to swim.
words.ex_cn: 水温足够暖和，可以游泳。
words.en: To an adequate degree; enough.

words.tr:
n. 缺乏；短缺；
v. 缺乏；短缺；
words.ex: There is a lack of clean water in the village.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄缺乏干净的水。
words.en: If there is a lack of something, there is not enough of it or it does not exist at all.

words.ex: The two houses are apart by fifty meters.
words.ex_cn: 这两所房子相隔五十米。
words.en: If people or things are apart, they are separated by a distance.

words.ex: Pop music is part of the mainstream.
words.ex_cn: 流行音乐是主流的一部分。
words.en: The ideas, attitudes, or activities that are shared by most people and regarded as normal or conventional.

words.ex: He flushes the toilet after using it.
words.ex_cn: 他用完厕所后冲水。
words.en: If you flush, your face goes red because you are hot or ill, or because you are feeling a strong emotion such as embarrassment or anger. To flush a toilet means to cause water to pass through it in order to clean it.

words.ex: Please stir the soup before serving.
words.ex_cn: 请在上菜前搅拌一下汤。
words.en: To mix a substance or move it around using a spoon or other object; to cause to move or act; to arouse or excite.

words.tr: adj. 奇怪的；奇数的；余的；
words.ex: He wore an odd hat to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他戴了一顶奇怪的帽子去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as odd, you mean that they are strange or unusual.

words.ex: The nurse will inject medicine into his arm.
words.ex_cn: 护士将把药水注入他的手臂。
words.en: To inject a substance such as a medicine or drug means to put it into someone's body using a needle and a syringe.

words.tr:
n. 需求；要求；
v. 要求；需求；
words.ex: The demand for clean water is increasing.
words.ex_cn: 对清洁水的需求正在增加。
words.en: If you demand something, you ask for it very forcefully, often because you think you have a right to do so.

words.tr: adj. 不够好的；不能令人满意的；
words.ex: The food was unsatisfactory.
words.ex_cn: 食物不够好。
words.en: If you describe something as unsatisfactory, you mean that it is not as good as it should be, and cannot be considered acceptable.

words.tr: adj. 不满意的；未被满足的
words.ex: She was unsatisfied with the service at the restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 她对餐厅的服务不满意。
words.en: If you are unsatisfied, you are not happy with something because it is not as good as you had expected or needed.

words.ex: We went on an excursion to the mountains last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们去山区进行了短途旅行。
words.en: An excursion is a short journey or trip, especially one taken as a leisure activity.

words.tr:
n. 远足；
v. 远足；
words.ex: We went on a long hike in the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 我们去山里进行了一次长途远足。
words.en: A hike is a long walk in the country, especially one that you go on for pleasure. It can also refer to an increase in the cost or amount of something.

words.ex: Apart from the rain, we had a great day.
words.ex_cn: 除了下雨之外，我们度过了美好的一天。

words.tr:
n. 脸红；羞愧
v. 泛红；羞愧
words.ex: He felt shy and got a blush when she praised him.
words.ex_cn: 当他被她夸奖时，他感到害羞，脸红了。
words.en: If you blush, your face turns red because you are embarrassed or ashamed.

words.ex: The rain flushed away the dirt from the road.
words.ex_cn: 雨水把路上的泥土冲走了。
words.en: To remove or dispose of something completely, especially by washing it down a drain.

words.ex: He took iodine to help his thyroid.
words.ex_cn: 他服用碘来帮助他的甲状腺。
words.en: A chemical element of the halogen group, essential for the production of thyroid hormones.

words.tr:
n. 瑕疵；污点；缺点
v. 玷污；损害
words.ex: The apple has a small blemish on its skin.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果的表皮上有一个小瑕疵。
words.en: A blemish is a small mark or flaw that spoils the appearance of something.

words.ex: The flaw in the glass made it break easily.
words.ex_cn: 玻璃上的瑕疵让它很容易碎。
words.en: A flaw is a mistake or weakness in something that makes it less effective or valuable.

words.ex: The defect in the phone made it hard to use.
words.ex_cn: 手机的缺陷让它很难使用。
words.en: A defect is a fault or imperfection in a person or thing.

words.tr: n. 过错；故障；缺陷；断层；
words.ex: It was his fault that the car crashed.
words.ex_cn: 汽车撞车是他的过错。
words.en: A fault is a mistake or a weakness in something or someone.

words.ex: The sky began to redden as the sun set.
words.ex_cn: 太阳落山时，天空开始变红。
words.en: To make or become red; to blush.

words.ex: He used a douche to clean himself.
words.ex_cn: 他用冲洗器清洁自己。
words.en: A cleansing device, often for personal hygiene.

words.ex: Rinse the dishes with water before drying them.
words.ex_cn: 在晾干盘子之前用清水冲洗。
words.en: To rinse something means to wash it in clean water in order to remove soap or dirt.

words.tr: adv. 古怪地；怪异地；反常地；
words.ex: He dressed oddly for the party.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着古怪地去参加派对。
words.en: In a manner that is strange or unusual.

words.tr: v. 使中立；中和；使无效
words.ex: The government tried to neutralize the conflict by talking to both sides.
words.ex_cn: 政府试图通过与双方交谈来使冲突中立化。
words.en: To neutralize something means to stop it from having any effect or to make it ineffective.

words.ex: The teacher tried to infuse confidence into the students.
words.ex_cn: 老师试图向学生注入信心。
words.en: If you infuse a quality into someone or something, you fill them with it. If a quality infuses something, it is present throughout it.

words.ex: The dentist placed a dental implant to replace the missing tooth.
words.ex_cn: 牙医植入了一个牙科植入物来替代缺失的牙齿。
words.en: To implant something means to put it firmly into something else, especially into a person's body.

words.ex: The doctor gave him an injection for the pain.
words.ex_cn: 医生给他打了一针来缓解疼痛。
words.en: An injection is the act of putting a liquid, especially a drug, into a person's body using a needle and a syringe.

words.ex: Good teachers are in great demand.
words.ex_cn: 好老师非常紧缺。
words.en: If something is in great demand, it is wanted or needed by a lot of people.

words.ex: There is a high demand for clean water in this region.
words.ex_cn: 这个地区对清洁水的需求很高。

words.tr:
n. 流动；
v. 漂移；
words.ex: The drift of the river carries leaves downstream.
words.ex_cn: 河流的流动将树叶冲向下游。
words.en: If something or someone drifts somewhere, they move there slowly or gradually. As a noun, drift can refer to a slow, gradual movement or change, or the general meaning or intent of something.

words.tr: n. 法定的外出；法律规定的外出活动
words.ex: The workers took a statutory excursion on public holiday.
words.ex_cn: 工人们在公共假日进行了法定的外出。

words.ex: The city improved its power grid to handle more electricity.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市改进了其电力输送网，以承载更多的电力。
words.en: A grid is a pattern of straight lines that cross each other to form squares. It is used to help you draw or to help you find places on a map.

words.ex: The movie is controversial because it shows violence.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影因为展示暴力而有争议。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as controversial, you mean that they are the subject of intense public argument, disagreement, or disapproval.

words.tr: n. 四轮运货马车；敞篷货车；
words.ex: The farmer used a wooden wagon to carry crops.
words.ex_cn: 农夫用一辆木制四轮运货马车运送庄稼。
words.en: A wagon is a vehicle with four wheels, usually pulled by horses or oxen, used for transporting goods.

words.ex: He has a good reputation for honesty.
words.ex_cn: 他以诚实著称。
words.en: The opinion that people have about someone or something because of what has happened in the past.

words.tr:
n. 标签；标记；
v. 加标签于；
words.ex: The tag on the shirt says 'wash cold'.
words.ex_cn: 衬衫上的标签写着‘冷水洗涤’。
words.en: A tag is a small piece of card, cloth, or plastic which is attached to an object or person and has information about that object or person on it. A tag can also be a word or phrase that is used to describe or identify something, especially in a computer file or on a website.

words.tr: adj. 头晕目眩的；头昏眼花的；
words.ex: He felt dizzy after spinning around quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他快速转圈后感到头晕目眩。
words.en: If you feel dizzy, you feel that you are losing your balance and are about to fall.

words.tr: adj. 有免疫力的；免疫的；不受影响的；
words.ex: Children are immune to this disease after vaccination.
words.ex_cn: 儿童接种疫苗后对这种疾病有免疫力。
words.en: If you are immune to a particular disease, you cannot be affected by it. If you are immune to something such as criticism, it does not affect you.

words.ex: He carved the meat with a sharp knife.
words.ex_cn: 他用一把锋利的刀切开了肉。
words.en: To carve means to cut into a hard material in order to produce an object, design, or inscription.

words.tr: phrase. 电网；电力网；供电网络
words.ex: The power grid failed during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风暴期间电网瘫痪了。
words.en: A power grid is a network that delivers electricity from producers to consumers. It includes generating stations that produce electrical power, high voltage transmission lines that carry power from distant sources to demand centers, and distribution lines that connect individual customers.

words.ex: The town has many individual buildings with different colors.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇有许多颜色各异的单独建筑物。

words.tr:
v. 利用；
n. 马具；
words.ex: We must harness the power of the sun.
words.ex_cn: 我们必须利用太阳的能量。
words.en: A harness is a set of straps which fit under a person's arms and fasten round their body in order to keep a piece of equipment in place or to prevent the person moving from a place.

words.tr: n. 铁路货车；铁路车厢
words.ex: The rail wagon carried coal to the factory.
words.ex_cn: 铁路货车将煤炭运送到工厂。

words.tr: v. 因某事而有声誉；以某种行为或特征闻名
words.ex: He has a reputation for being honest.
words.ex_cn: 他因诚实而有声誉。

words.tr: v. 毁坏声誉；使名誉扫地
words.ex: His lie ruined his reputation.
words.ex_cn: 他的谎言毁坏了声誉。

words.tr: v. 不负其声誉；达到预期水平
words.ex: The new restaurant lives up to its reputation for great food.
words.ex_cn: 这家新餐厅不负其美食的声誉。

words.tr: adj. 使人晕眩的；头晕的；轻浮的
words.ex: She felt giddy after spinning around.
words.ex_cn: 她转圈后感到头晕目眩。
words.en: If you feel giddy, you feel unsteady and think that you are about to fall over, usually because you are not well or because you are excited or frightened.

words.ex: The immune system fights germs in the body.
words.ex_cn: 免疫系统在体内对抗细菌。
words.en: The immune system is the body's defense against infectious organisms and other invaders. Through a series of steps called the immune response, the immune system attacks organisms and substances that invade body systems and cause disease.

words.ex: He has an autoimmune disease that affects his skin.
words.ex_cn: 他患有一种影响皮肤的自身免疫性疾病。
words.en: An autoimmune disease or condition is one in which your immune system mistakenly attacks your own body.

words.ex: This plant is resistant to drought.
words.ex_cn: 这种植物对干旱有抵抗力。
words.en: If someone is resistant to something, they are opposed to it and want to prevent it.

words.tr: adj. 不会受伤害的；攻不破的；固若金汤的
words.ex: The fortress was said to be invulnerable.
words.ex_cn: 这座要塞据说无懈可击。
words.en: If someone or something is invulnerable, they cannot be harmed or damaged.
