words.tr: phrase. v. 发狂；发疯；极度兴奋或愤怒
words.ex: The kids went ape when they saw the clown at the party.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在派对上看到小丑时兴奋得不得了。
words.en: To become extremely excited or angry.

words.tr: phrase. 便携式计算机；手提电脑
words.ex: He carries a portable computer to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天带着一台便携式电脑去上班。
words.en: A lightweight, battery-powered computer designed for easy transport, like a laptop.

words.tr: n. 移动电话；便携式电话
words.ex: He uses a portable telephone to call his family.
words.ex_cn: 他用移动电话给家人打电话。

words.ex: The departure of the train was at 8 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 火车的出发时间是晚上8点。
words.en: The act of leaving a place, especially at the start of a journey.

words.tr:
v. 颤抖；颤动；发抖
n. 颤抖
words.ex: The leaf quivers in the wind.
words.ex_cn: 树叶在风中颤抖。
words.en: To shake or tremble with a slight rapid motion; a case for carrying arrows.

words.ex: He shivered in the cold wind.
words.ex_cn: 他在寒风中哆嗦。
words.en: If you shiver, your body shakes slightly because you are cold or frightened.

words.tr:
v. 发抖；打颤；战栗；焦虑
n. 震颤；发抖；战栗
words.ex: The old man tremble in the cold wind.
words.ex_cn: 老人在寒风中发抖。
words.en: If you tremble, you shake slightly because you are frightened or cold.

words.tr:
v. 测量；衡量；度量；
n. 衡量；量度；措施；
words.ex: He uses a ruler to measure the length of the table.
words.ex_cn: 他用尺子测量桌子的长度。
words.en: To measure something means to determine its size, amount, or degree, often by using a tool or device designed for this purpose.

words.ex: The main criterion for winning is fairness.
words.ex_cn: 获胜的主要标准是公平。
words.en: A criterion is a principle or standard by which something may be judged or decided.

words.tr:
v. 估算；估价；
n. 估价；估算；
words.ex: Can you estimate how long it will take?
words.ex_cn: 你能估算一下需要多长时间吗？
words.en: If you estimate a quantity or value, you make an approximate judgment or calculation of it.

words.ex: The shopkeeper will evaluate the old watch.
words.ex_cn: 店主将估价这块旧手表。
words.en: If you evaluate something or someone, you consider them in order to make a judgment about them, for example about how good or bad they are.

words.tr:
adj. 本国的；地方的
n. 方言；土语
words.ex: He wrote the poem in the vernacular language.
words.ex_cn: 他用本国语言写了这首诗。
words.en: The vernacular is the language or dialect spoken by the ordinary people in a particular country or region.

words.ex: He refuted the claim with clear evidence.
words.ex_cn: 他用清晰的证据驳斥了这一说法。
words.en: To prove a statement or theory to be wrong or false; to deny the truth or accuracy of something.

words.ex: He rebut the claim with clear evidence.
words.ex_cn: 他用清晰的证据反驳了这一说法。
words.en: If you rebut a charge or criticism that is made against you, you give reasons why it is untrue or unacceptable.

words.ex: He gave a strong rebuttal to the claim.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个说法给出了有力的反驳。
words.en: A rebuttal is a statement or piece of evidence that contradicts or opposes a previous statement or evidence.

words.tr: adv. 无争议的；不容置疑的
words.ex: It is beyond debate that water is essential for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命至关重要，这是无争议的。

words.ex: The chair will open the debate at 3 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 主席将在下午三点开始辩论。

words.tr: v. 对某事进行辩论；就某事展开讨论
words.ex: They debate upon the new law every week.
words.ex_cn: 他们每周都对这项新法律进行辩论。

words.ex: They debate on climate change every week.
words.ex_cn: 他们每周就气候变化进行辩论。

words.tr:
n. 纠纷；争端；
v. 对（某事）有异议；
words.ex: The dispute between the two neighbors was about the fence.
words.ex_cn: 两个邻居之间的纠纷是关于篱笆的。
words.en: A dispute is a disagreement or argument about something important.

words.tr: v. 指出；表明；争论；争辩；
words.ex: He argued that the plan was too expensive.
words.ex_cn: 他指出这个计划太昂贵了。
words.en: If one person argues with another, they speak angrily to each other about something that they disagree about. You can also say that two people argue.

words.tr: v. 使某事开始进行；启动某事
words.ex: The new policy set the changes in motion.
words.ex_cn: 这项新政策使这些变化开始进行。

words.tr: v. 使某物开始运动；启动某事
words.ex: He put the toy car in motion with a push.
words.ex_cn: 他一推，就让玩具车动了起来。

words.tr: n. 理解；了解； v. “understand”的现在分词；
words.ex: His understanding of the problem helped solve it quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题的理解帮助快速解决了它。
words.en: An understanding is a mutual agreement or sympathy between people or groups.

words.ex: Under these circumstances, we had to cancel the trip.
words.ex_cn: 在这种情况下，我们不得不取消旅行。
words.en: A circumstance is a fact or event that makes a situation the way it is.

words.tr:
n. 暴躁脾气；情绪；心情；性情
v. 使…缓和；冲淡
words.ex: He loses his temper when he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 当他累了的时候，他会发脾气。
words.en: If you refer to someone's temper or say that they have a temper, you mean that they become angry very easily.

words.ex: He bought insurance for his car.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的车买了保险。
words.en: Insurance is an arrangement in which you pay money to a company, and they pay money to you if something unpleasant happens to you, for example if your property is stolen or damaged, or if you get a serious illness.

words.tr: v. 使留下深刻印象；使铭记；
words.ex: His speech impressed everyone in the room.
words.ex_cn: 他的演讲给在场的每个人留下了深刻印象。
words.en: If someone or something impresses you, you feel great admiration for them.

words.tr: v. 保持；维护；坚持认为；供养；
words.ex: He tries to maintain a healthy diet.
words.ex_cn: 他努力保持健康的饮食。
words.en: To keep something in existence or continue to provide support for it, especially over a period of time.

words.ex: He retains his old photos in a box.
words.ex_cn: 他把旧照片保存在一个盒子里。
words.en: If you retain something, you keep it or continue to have it.

words.ex: He gave a meaningful speech that helped many people.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一次有意义的演讲，帮助了很多人。
words.en: If you describe something as meaningful, you mean that it is important, serious, or useful in some way.

words.ex: Dinosaurs existed millions of years ago.
words.ex_cn: 恐龙存在于数百万年前。
words.en: If something exists, it is present in the world as a real thing.

words.tr: v. 废除；取消；宣告无效
words.ex: The court will annul the marriage.
words.ex_cn: 法院将宣布婚姻无效。
words.en: To annul something means to declare it invalid or to officially say that it no longer exists.

words.ex: The government decided to abolish the old law.
words.ex_cn: 政府决定废除这项旧法律。
words.en: If someone in authority abolishes a system or practice, they formally put an end to it.

words.ex: I clicked the button to undo my mistake.
words.ex_cn: 我点击了按钮来撤销我的错误。
words.en: To undo something means to reverse the effect of a previous action or to untie or unfasten something.

words.ex: The cold weather ails his old bones.
words.ex_cn: 寒冷的天气使他的老骨头疼痛。
words.en: If something ails a group or area of activity, it causes problems or difficulties for it.

words.ex: He had a minor ailment and stayed home from work.
words.ex_cn: 他得了一点小病，没去上班。
words.en: An ailment is a minor illness or health problem.

words.tr: adv. 在某种情况下；在特定情形下
words.ex: In circumstance, he still chose to help.
words.ex_cn: 在某种情况下，他仍然选择帮助。

words.tr: phrase. + n. 在某种情况下；在特定环境中
words.ex: He will not leave under circumstances.
words.ex_cn: 在这些情况下，他不会离开。
words.en: Given the conditions or factors present.

words.tr: phrase. 在任何情况下都不；无论如何都不
words.ex: In no circumstances should you lend money to strangers.
words.ex_cn: 无论如何你都不应该借钱给陌生人。
words.en: Under no conditions; never.

words.tr: phrase. 在任何情况下都不；决不
words.ex: Under no circumstances will I lie to you.
words.ex_cn: 我绝不会对你撒谎。
words.en: In no situation or for no reason.

words.ex: It is muggy outside today.
words.ex_cn: 今天外面闷热。
words.en: If you describe the weather as muggy, you mean that it is unpleasantly warm and damp.

words.ex: His calm temperament helps him stay peaceful in stress.
words.ex_cn: 他平静的性情让他在压力下保持平和。
words.en: Your temperament is your basic nature, especially as it is shown in the way that you react to situations or to other people.

words.ex: The temperature today is very high.
words.ex_cn: 今天的温度很高。
words.en: The degree or intensity of heat present in a substance or object, especially as expressed according to a comparative scale and shown by a thermometer or perceived by touch.

words.tr: adj. 脾气……的，性情……的；有气质的；温和的，不暴力的; v. 使……温和；使（金属）回火；调...
words.ex: He is a tempered man who never gets angry easily.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个脾气温和的人，从不轻易发怒。
words.en: Having a specified temper or disposition; moderated or balanced.

words.tr: phrase. 失业保险；为失业者提供经济补助的政府或机构保险计划
words.ex: He receives unemployment insurance while looking for a new job.
words.ex_cn: 他在寻找新工作期间领取失业保险。
words.en: Unemployment insurance is a government program that provides financial assistance to people who have lost their jobs and are actively seeking employment.

words.tr: phrase. 意外伤害保险；一种为意外事故导致的伤害或死亡提供赔偿的保险
words.ex: He bought accident insurance for his bike.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的自行车买了意外保险。
words.en: Insurance that provides financial compensation for injuries resulting from an accident.

words.tr: phrase. 人寿保险；人身保险
words.ex: He bought life insurance for his family.
words.ex_cn: 他为家人买了人寿保险。
words.en: Life insurance is a contract between an insurance policy holder and an insurer, where the insurer promises to pay a designated beneficiary a sum of money in exchange for a premium, upon the death of an insured person.

words.ex: The UN works to maintain world peace.
words.ex_cn: 联合国努力维护世界和平。
words.en: Keep international relations stable and prevent conflict.

words.tr: phrase. 保持某人的健康；维持身体健康
words.ex: It is important to maintain one's health through regular exercise and a balanced diet.
words.ex_cn: 通过定期锻炼和均衡饮食来保持健康是很重要的。
words.en: To keep the body in a good state of physical and mental well-being.

words.ex: Traveling alone was a meaningful experience for me.
words.ex_cn: 独自旅行对我来说是一次有意义的经历。

words.ex: Scientists study embryos to understand how life begins.
words.ex_cn: 科学家研究胚胎以了解生命是如何开始的。
words.en: An embryo is an unborn or unhatched offspring in the process of development, especially in the early stages.

words.ex: The existence of life on other planets is still unknown.
words.ex_cn: 其他星球上是否存在生命仍不清楚。
words.en: The state or fact of existing; being.

words.ex: The ovum is released from the ovary each month.
words.ex_cn: 卵子每月从卵巢释放。
words.en: An ovum is a female reproductive cell capable of developing into a new individual when fertilized by a male gamete.

words.ex: The old lamp burned sperm for light.
words.ex_cn: 这盏旧灯用鲸蜡油照明。
words.en: The male reproductive cell; spermatozoon.

words.ex: The doctor tested his semen for fertility.
words.ex_cn: 医生检测了他的精液以评估生育能力。
words.en: The thick, whitish fluid secreted by the male reproductive organs, containing spermatozoa and capable of fertilizing the female ovum.

words.ex: The fetus is growing inside the mother's womb.
words.ex_cn: 胎儿正在母亲的子宫内成长。
words.en: An unborn or unhatched offspring of a mammal, in particular an unborn human more than eight weeks after conception.

words.tr:
v. 挤；推；撞；争夺
n. 挤拥；推撞
words.ex: People jostle in the crowded market.
words.ex_cn: 人们在拥挤的市场里推挤。
words.en: To jostle someone means to push or knock against them, usually in a crowd.

words.ex: This is the latest version of the app.
words.ex_cn: 这是这个应用的最新版本。
words.en: A version of something is a particular form of it in which some details are different from earlier or later forms.

words.ex: There was clear hostility between the two neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 两个邻居之间明显存在敌意。
words.en: Hostility is unfriendly or aggressive behaviour towards people or ideas.

words.tr: n. 外观；外表；出现；露面；
words.ex: The appearance of the house surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子的外观让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: The way that someone or something looks or the act of coming into view.

words.ex: He grinds the coffee beans into powder.
words.ex_cn: 他把咖啡豆碾成粉末。
words.en: To reduce something to small particles or powder by crushing it.

words.ex: He is optimistic about the future.
words.ex_cn: 他对未来持乐观态度。
words.en: Someone who is optimistic is hopeful about the future or the success of something in particular.

words.tr:
adj. 紧张的；拉紧的；
n. 时态；
words.ex: He felt tense before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试前感到紧张。
words.en: If you are tense, you are anxious and nervous and cannot relax.

words.ex: He ignored the warning sign.
words.ex_cn: 他忽视了警告标志。
words.en: If you ignore someone or something, you pay no attention to them.

words.tr: phrase. 原始版本；原版；最初版本
words.ex: The original version of the novel is in French.
words.ex_cn: 这部小说的原著是法语的。
words.en: The earliest or initial form of something, before modifications or adaptations.

words.ex: His countenance showed surprise.
words.ex_cn: 他的面容流露出惊讶。
words.en: A person's face or facial expression; support or approval.

words.ex: His expression showed he was happy.
words.ex_cn: 他的表情显示他很快乐。
words.en: The act of making your thoughts, feelings, etc., known by speech, writing, or some other method.

words.tr: phrase. 日复一日的单调工作；日常的苦差事
words.ex: He's tired of the daily grind and dreams of traveling the world.
words.ex_cn: 他厌倦了日常的苦差事，梦想着环游世界。
words.en: The term 'the daily grind' refers to the monotonous routine of everyday work or life, often perceived as tedious and unfulfilling.

words.tr: n. 紧张；紧张局势；紧张关系；
words.ex: There was tension between the two friends after the argument.
words.ex_cn: 两人争吵后，彼此之间出现了紧张。
words.en: Tension is a feeling of worry and anxiety which makes it difficult for you to relax. It can also refer to the state of being stretched tight or the degree of tightness of a stretched string, wire, etc.

words.ex: The rope has high tensile strength.
words.ex_cn: 这根绳子有很高的抗拉强度。
words.en: relating to tension; capable of being stretched or drawn out

words.ex: The injured man was immobile after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，这名受伤的人无法移动。
words.en: If something is immobile, it is not moving or cannot move.

words.tr: adj. 有压力的；紧张的； v. 强调；“stress”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He felt stressed before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试前感到有压力。
words.en: If you are stressed, you feel tense and anxious because of difficulties in your life.

words.tr:
n. 压力；（动植物的）品种；
v. 竭力；
words.ex: The job gave him a lot of strain.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作给他带来了很大的压力。
words.en: To strain means to make a great effort to do something, to pull or stretch something tightly, or to injure a muscle by stretching it too much.

words.ex: He ignored the fact that he was late.
words.ex_cn: 他忽视了自己迟到的事实。

words.tr:
v. 提取；
n. 摘录；提取物；
words.ex: They extract oil from plants.
words.ex_cn: 他们从植物中提取油。
words.en: To remove or take out something, especially by effort or force.

words.ex: It rained all day, therefore the game was canceled.
words.ex_cn: 下了一整天的雨，因此比赛被取消了。
words.en: You use therefore to introduce a logical result or conclusion.

words.tr: n. 条状物；酒吧；栅栏；棒；
words.ex: He ate a chocolate bar after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后吃了一条巧克力。
words.en: A bar is a place where alcoholic drinks are served, or a long, narrow piece of metal or wood used for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The box has a label on the outside, so it is marked externally.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子外面有一个标签，所以它是从外部标记的。
words.en: In a way that relates to the outside or outer part of something.

words.ex: Fish abound in this river.
words.ex_cn: 这条河里鱼很多。
words.en: If things abound, or if a place abounds with things, there are very large numbers of them.

words.ex: His opinion is subjective and not based on facts.
words.ex_cn: 他的观点是主观的，不是基于事实的。
words.en: Based on or influenced by personal feelings, tastes, or opinions.

words.ex: I like fruits, particularly apples.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢水果，尤其是苹果。
words.en: Used to single out a subject to which a statement is especially applicable.

words.ex: The teacher gave a classification of animals into mammals and birds.
words.ex_cn: 老师将动物分为哺乳动物和鸟类。
words.en: The action or process of classifying something according to shared qualities or characteristics.

words.ex: The river is dirty because of pollution.
words.ex_cn: 这条河因为污染而变得肮脏。
words.en: Pollution is the process of making air, water, soil, etc. dirty and not safe or suitable to use.

words.ex: The kidneys excrete waste from the body.
words.ex_cn: 肾脏将废物排出体外。
words.en: If someone excretes waste matter from their body, they get rid of it in faeces, urine, or sweat.

words.ex: The dog left its excreta on the grass.
words.ex_cn: 狗在草地上留下了排泄物。
words.en: Waste matter discharged from the body, especially feces and urine.

words.ex: The dog left excrement on the grass.
words.ex_cn: 狗在草地上留下了粪便。
words.en: Excrement is waste matter that is excreted from the body, especially feces.

words.tr: v. 挑出（老弱动物）杀死；
words.ex: Farmers cull weak sheep to keep the herd healthy.
words.ex_cn: 农民挑出虚弱的羊杀死，以保持羊群健康。
words.en: To cull animals means to kill the weaker animals in a group in order to reduce their numbers or to prevent them from spreading disease.

words.tr: v. 从某物中提取；从某物中抽出
words.ex: They extract oil from plants.
words.ex_cn: 他们从植物中提取油。

words.ex: Please remove the trash from the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 请把厨房的垃圾去掉。
words.en: To take something or someone away from a place or off a surface.

words.tr:
adj. 抽象的；非具体的；
n. 摘要；概要；抽象派艺术作品；
words.ex: The painting shows an abstract shape.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画展示了一个抽象的形状。
words.en: An abstract idea or way of thinking is based on general ideas rather than on real things and events.

words.ex: Henceforth, I will wake up early.
words.ex_cn: 从今以后，我会早起。
words.en: From this time on; from now on.

words.ex: He worked hard to attain his goals.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以达到他的目标。
words.en: If you attain something, you gain it or achieve it, often after a lot of effort.

words.tr: adj. 丰富的，大量的 v. 大量存在，充满，富于( abound的现在分词 )
words.ex: The forest is abounding with wildlife.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林里充满了野生动物。
words.en: If something abounds in a particular place, it exists there in very large numbers or quantities.

words.tr: v. 充满；大量存在；富含某种事物
words.ex: The forest abounds with birds.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林里充满了鸟。

words.ex: This is my personal notebook.
words.ex_cn: 这是我的个人笔记本。
words.en: Relating to or belonging to a particular person rather than to a group or an organization.

words.ex: The app has an intuitive design.
words.ex_cn: 这个应用程序具有直观的设计。
words.en: An intuitive idea or feeling is based on an instinctive emotional response rather than on conscious thought.

words.tr:
adj. 客观的；
n. 目标；目的；
words.ex: He gave an objective opinion about the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他对这部电影给出了一个客观的看法。
words.en: An objective is something that you plan to do or achieve.

words.ex: He is an eccentric man who wears socks with sandals.
words.ex_cn: 他是个古怪的人，穿着袜子配凉鞋。
words.en: If you say that someone is eccentric, you mean that they behave in a strange way, and have habits or opinions that are different from those of most people.

words.tr: adj. 奇怪的；奇数的；余的；
words.ex: He wore an odd hat to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他戴了一顶奇怪的帽子去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as odd, you mean that they are strange or unusual.

words.ex: This town has a peculiar custom of dancing at midnight.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇有一个独特的午夜跳舞习俗。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as peculiar, you think that they are strange or unusual, sometimes in an unpleasant way.

words.ex: A moth flew into the room through the window.
words.ex_cn: 一只蛾子从窗户飞进了房间。
words.en: A moth is an insect with wings that is related to the butterfly. Moths are often attracted to light and are mostly active at night.

words.tr:
v. 脱毛；换毛
n. 脱毛；换毛
words.ex: The bird molts its feathers every spring.
words.ex_cn: 这只鸟每年春天都会脱毛。
words.en: When an animal molts, it loses its feathers, hair, or skin so that new ones can grow.

words.tr:
v. 震动；颤抖
n. 震动；地震
words.ex: The ground began to quake during the earthquake.
words.ex_cn: 地震时，地面开始震动。
words.en: To shake or tremble, especially from fear or cold.

words.tr:
n. 摇动；颤动；
v. 摇动；颤动；
words.ex: The shake of the car made me feel sick.
words.ex_cn: 汽车的摇动让我感到恶心。
words.en: To move or cause to move with quick, short movements from side to side or up and down.

words.ex: He obtained a new job last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周获得了一份新工作。
words.en: If you obtain something, you get it or achieve it.

words.ex: He speaks Mandarin every day at home.
words.ex_cn: 他每天在家说普通话。
words.en: A mandarin is a high-ranking government official, especially in China. It also refers to the official language of China, Mandarin, and a type of citrus fruit.

words.ex: He is learning optics in physics class.
words.ex_cn: 他正在物理课上学习光学。
words.en: Optics is the branch of physics that involves the study of light and its interactions with matter, including the construction of instruments that use or detect it.

words.ex: He eats fibre to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他吃纤维来保持健康。
words.en: Fibre refers to a thread or filament from which a vegetable tissue, mineral substance, or textile is formed. It can also denote dietary material containing substances such as cellulose, lignin, and pectin, which are resistant to the action of digestive enzymes.

words.ex: The internet uses fibre optics to send data quickly.
words.ex_cn: 互联网使用光纤快速传输数据。

words.ex: He worked hard to obtain a degree in engineering.
words.ex_cn: 他努力获得工程学学位。
words.en: Receive a university or college certificate upon completion.

words.tr:
n. 葡萄牙人；葡萄牙语；
adj. 葡萄牙的；葡萄牙人的；葡萄牙语的；
words.ex: He is a Portuguese from Lisbon.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位来自里斯本的葡萄牙人。
words.en: Portuguese refers to something that is related to Portugal, its people, or its language. It can also denote the people of Portugal or the Portuguese language itself.

words.tr:
n. 探测器；
v. 探查；
words.ex: The probe sent back photos from Mars.
words.ex_cn: 探测器从火星传回了照片。
words.en: If you probe into something, you ask questions or try to discover facts about it. A probe is also a long thin instrument that doctors and dentists use to examine parts of the body.

words.tr:
n. 恐慌；
v. 感到恐慌；
words.ex: A panic spread through the crowd when the fire alarm rang.
words.ex_cn: 当火警响起时，人群陷入了恐慌。
words.en: Panic is a very strong feeling of anxiety or fear, which makes you act without thinking carefully.

words.ex: Please don't disturb me while I'm reading.
words.ex_cn: 我读书时请不要打扰我。
words.en: To disturb someone means to interrupt what they are doing and cause them inconvenience or annoyance.

words.ex: The grassy field was perfect for picnics.
words.ex_cn: 长满草的田野非常适合野餐。
words.en: Covered with grass or resembling grass in color or texture.

words.ex: The glorious sunset lit up the whole sky.
words.ex_cn: 辉煌的日落染红了整个天空。
words.en: Something that is glorious is very beautiful and impressive.

words.tr: adj. 肥沃的；有繁殖力的；多产的；富饶的；
words.ex: The fertile land grows many crops.
words.ex_cn: 这片肥沃的土地长满了各种作物。
words.en: Land or soil that is fertile is able to support the growth of a large number of strong healthy plants.

words.ex: The police will investigate the accident.
words.ex_cn: 警方将调查这起事故。
words.en: If someone, especially an official, investigates an event, situation, or claim, they try to find out what happened or what is the truth.

words.tr:
n. 调查；勘测；
v. 调查；勘测；
words.ex: The school did a survey about student lunch preferences.
words.ex_cn: 学校做了一项关于学生午餐偏好的调查。
words.en: A survey is a detailed study or inspection, especially as a means of collecting information about people's opinions or behavior.

words.tr: phrase. 扰乱治安；妨害公共安宁
words.ex: He was arrested because he tried to disturb the peace at the park.
words.ex_cn: 他因为在公园试图扰乱治安而被捕。
words.en: To disturb the peace means to act in a way that disrupts public order or tranquility.

words.w: disturb the balance of the environment
words.uk: dɪsˈtɜːb ðə ˈbæləns əv ðə ɪnˈvaɪrənmənt
words.us: dɪsˈtɜːrb ðə ˈbæləns əv ðə ɪnˈvaɪrənmənt
words.ex: Cutting down trees can disturb the balance of the environment.
words.ex_cn: 砍伐树木会扰乱环境的平衡。

words.ex: The team celebrated a glorious victory after winning the final match.
words.ex_cn: 球队在赢得决赛后庆祝了一场辉煌的胜利。

words.tr: phrase. + n. 肥沃的土地；适宜耕种的土壤
words.ex: The farmers grow crops on fertile land.
words.ex_cn: 农民在肥沃的土地上种植庄稼。
words.en: Land that is capable of producing abundant vegetation or crops.

words.tr: n. 肥沃的田地；富饶的领域（比喻性用法）
words.ex: The river valley is a fertile field for growing wheat.
words.ex_cn: 这个河谷是一块种植小麦的肥沃田地。

words.tr: phrase. 肥沃的土壤；能生育的土壤
words.ex: The farmers planted crops in fertile soil.
words.ex_cn: 农民们在肥沃的土壤里种植庄稼。
words.en: Soil that is rich in nutrients and ideal for plant growth.

words.tr: n. 受精卵；可孵化的蛋
words.ex: The farmer collects fertile eggs for hatching.
words.ex_cn: 农夫收集受精卵用来孵化。

words.ex: The low-lying land floods easily in heavy rain.
words.ex_cn: 低洼的土地在大雨时容易被淹。
words.en: Located at or near a low elevation; not high or tall.

words.tr:
n. 业余爱好者；
adj. 业余的；
words.ex: He is an amateur who paints on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他是个周末画画的业余爱好者。
words.en: An amateur is someone who does something as a hobby and not as a job.

words.tr: adj. 无伪装的；不加掩饰的；公开的
words.ex: He gave an undisguised smile when he won.
words.ex_cn: 他赢的时候露出了毫不掩饰的笑容。
words.en: If a feeling or attitude is undisguised, it is not hidden or concealed.

words.ex: A sliver of wood stuck in his finger.
words.ex_cn: 一小片木头扎进了他的手指。
words.en: A sliver is a small, thin piece of something that has been cut, broken, or torn off from a larger piece.

words.ex: He feels fulfillment when he helps others.
words.ex_cn: 当他帮助别人时，他感到满足。
words.en: Fulfillment is the feeling of being happy and satisfied because you are doing something useful or important, or because you have achieved something.

words.tr: v. 向往；渴望；追求；立志
words.ex: He aspires to be a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他向往成为一名医生。
words.en: If you aspire to something, you have a strong desire to achieve it or attain it.

words.ex: Many people lost jobs during the recession.
words.ex_cn: 在经济不景气期间，许多人失去了工作。
words.en: A recession is a period when the economy of a country is not doing well, industrial production and business activity are at a low level, and many people are unemployed.

words.ex: He bought some miscellaneous items at the store.
words.ex_cn: 他在商店里买了一些各种各样的东西。
words.en: Consisting of a variety of ingredients or parts.

words.ex: The utilization of solar energy is increasing.
words.ex_cn: 太阳能的利用正在增加。
words.en: Utilization is the act of using something effectively.

words.tr:
adj. 腐蚀性的；苛性的；尖酸刻薄的
n. 腐蚀剂
words.ex: The caustic liquid burned through the metal.
words.ex_cn: 这种腐蚀性的液体腐蚀了金属。
words.en: A caustic substance is able to burn or destroy organic tissue by chemical action. Caustic remarks are extremely critical, sarcastic, or bitter.

words.tr: n. 专门知识；专门技能；
words.ex: His expertise in computers helps the team solve problems.
words.ex_cn: 他在计算机方面的专门知识帮助团队解决问题。
words.en: Expertise is special skill or knowledge that is acquired by training, study, or practice.

words.ex: He is a radio amateur who enjoys communicating with people around the world.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名无线电爱好者，喜欢与世界各地的人交流。
words.en: A radio amateur is a person who engages in the hobby of amateur radio, which involves the use of radio frequency spectrum for purposes of non-commercial exchange of messages, wireless experimentation, self-training, private recreation, radio sport, contesting, and emergency communication.

words.tr:
n. 专家；行家；
adj. 内行的；老练的；专门的；
words.ex: He is an expert in computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他是计算机科学方面的专家。
words.en: A person who is very knowledgeable about or skillful in a particular area.

words.tr:
adj. 专业的；职业的；
n. 专业人士；
words.ex: He is a professional teacher with many years of experience.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有多年经验的专业教师。
words.en: A professional is a person who has a job that requires special training and education, especially one that involves a high level of skill or knowledge.

words.tr:
n. 伪装；伪装物；
v. 伪装；掩饰；
words.ex: He wore a hat and glasses as a disguise.
words.ex_cn: 他戴了帽子和眼镜作为伪装。
words.en: To disguise means to change your appearance or behavior so that people will not recognize you, or to make something seem different from what it really is.

words.ex: The soldier wore camouflage to hide in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 士兵穿着伪装服在森林中隐藏自己。
words.en: Camouflage is the way in which some animals are colored and shaped so that they cannot easily be seen in their natural surroundings.

words.tr: adj. 不乐意的；不情愿的；
words.ex: He is loath to apologize for his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他不乐意为自己的错误道歉。
words.en: If you are loath to do something, you do not want to do it.

words.tr: adj. 不愿意的（等于 loath）；勉强的；憎恶的; n. （Loth）人名；（法、德、波）洛特...
words.ex: He was loth to leave his comfortable home.
words.ex_cn: 他不愿意离开他舒适的家。
words.en: Unwilling or reluctant; disinclined.

words.ex: He took an oath to tell the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他发誓要说出真相。
words.en: An oath is a formal promise, especially one made in a court of law or a religious ceremony, or a swear word.

words.ex: He ate the food without any loathing.
words.ex_cn: 他毫无厌恶地吃掉了那顿饭。

words.tr: adj. 不情愿做某事；勉强做某事

words.ex: The alchemist tried to turn lead into gold.
words.ex_cn: 炼金术士试图把铅变成黄金。
words.en: An alchemist is a person who studies or practices alchemy, which was a form of chemistry and speculative philosophy practiced in the Middle Ages and the Renaissance, concerned principally with discovering methods for transmuting baser metals into gold and with finding a universal solvent and an elixir of life.

words.ex: The wizard can transmute lead into gold.
words.ex_cn: 巫师可以把铅变成金子。
words.en: To change something completely, especially into something different and better.

words.ex: He worked hard to fulfill his dream.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以实现自己的梦想。
words.en: To fulfill a task, role, or function means to do or perform it as required or expected.

words.tr: phrase. 经济衰退；指一个国家的经济活动显著下降，通常表现为GDP连续两个季度负增长
words.ex: The country faced an economic recession last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年这个国家经历了经济衰退。
words.en: A period of temporary economic decline during which trade and industrial activity are reduced, generally identified by a fall in GDP in two successive quarters.

words.ex: He is a trade protectionist who wants to limit imports.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个希望限制进口的贸易保护主义者。

words.ex: He lost his keys by a mischance.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心弄丢了钥匙。
words.en: An unlucky event or accident.

words.ex: He lost his job, which was a great misfortune.
words.ex_cn: 他丢了工作，这是一场巨大的不幸。
words.en: An unfortunate condition or event.

words.tr: phrase. 杂项费用；其他各类支出
words.ex: The invoice includes miscellaneous costs such as shipping and handling.
words.ex_cn: 发票包括了运输和处理等杂项费用。
words.en: Miscellaneous costs refer to various small expenses that are not specifically categorized.

words.tr: adj. 刻薄的言辞；尖酸的评论
words.ex: His caustic remarks made everyone feel uncomfortable.
words.ex_cn: 他刻薄的言辞让每个人都感到不舒服。

words.ex: The diaphragm helps us breathe.
words.ex_cn: 横隔膜帮助我们呼吸。
words.en: The diaphragm is a muscular partition separating the thorax from the abdomen in mammals. It plays a major role in breathing, as its contraction increases the volume of the thorax and so inflates the lungs.

words.tr: n. 滤液；滤气; v. 过滤；筛选
words.ex: The filtrate is then collected in a separate container.
words.ex_cn: 滤液随后被收集在单独的容器中。
words.en: Filtrate is a liquid that has passed through a filter.

words.tr:
v. 过滤；
n. 过滤器；
words.ex: She filters the water before drinking it.
words.ex_cn: 她在喝水之前过滤水。
words.en: A filter is a device or a method that removes unwanted substances from something such as water, air, or light, by passing it through a special material or system.

words.tr: n. 洗涤剂；洗衣粉；去垢剂；
words.ex: She uses detergent to wash the clothes.
words.ex_cn: 她用洗涤剂洗衣服。
words.en: A detergent is a substance that is used for cleaning things, especially clothes and dishes.

words.tr: v. 要求归还；收回；开垦；感化
words.ex: He wants to reclaim his lost wallet.
words.ex_cn: 他想要要求归还他丢失的钱包。
words.en: If you reclaim something that you have lost or that has been taken away from you, you succeed in getting it back. If you reclaim land, you make it suitable for use, for example by draining it or by getting rid of unwanted buildings or plants.

words.ex: The mirror deflects the light to the wall.
words.ex_cn: 镜子把光线反射到墙上。
words.en: If you deflect something such as criticism or attention, you act in a way that prevents it from being directed towards you or affecting you.

words.ex: The workers dug a trench to lay the pipe.
words.ex_cn: 工人们挖了一条沟来铺设管道。
words.en: A trench is a long, narrow ditch. In warfare, trenches are dug by troops to provide shelter from enemy fire.

words.ex: The farmer dug a ditch to water the fields.
words.ex_cn: 农夫挖了一条沟来给田地浇水。
words.en: A ditch is a long narrow trench or furrow dug in the ground, especially for drainage or irrigation.

words.tr:
n. 犁沟；车辙；皱纹
v. 犁耕；使皱眉头
words.ex: The farmer plowed a deep furrow in the field.
words.ex_cn: 农夫在田里犁出了一条深深的犁沟。
words.en: A furrow is a long narrow trench made in the ground by a plow, especially for planting seeds or for irrigation. It can also refer to a deep wrinkle on a person's face.

words.ex: She thinks holistically about the problem.
words.ex_cn: 她从整体上思考这个问题。
words.en: In a way that considers the whole of something and not just its parts.

words.ex: The city is facing problems because of rapid urbanization.
words.ex_cn: 由于快速的城市化，这座城市正面临问题。
words.en: The process by which more and more people leave the countryside to live in cities.

words.ex: The insularity of Japan affects its cultural traditions.
words.ex_cn: 日本的岛国特性影响了它的文化传统。
words.en: The state of being isolated or detached from others, often resulting in a narrow or limited perspective.

words.ex: The smell of bread permeate the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 面包的香味弥漫了整个厨房。
words.en: If something permeates a place, it spreads throughout it.

words.tr:
v. 弥漫；
adj. 分散的；
words.ex: Smoke began to diffuse through the room.
words.ex_cn: 烟开始弥漫在整个房间里。
words.en: If something such as knowledge or information is diffused, or if it diffuses, it is made known over a wide area or to a lot of people.

words.ex: The beer left foam on the top of the glass.
words.ex_cn: 啤酒在杯子顶部留下了一层泡沫。
words.en: Foam is a mass of small bubbles that are formed in or on a liquid.

words.ex: The high fine will deter people from breaking the law.
words.ex_cn: 高额罚款会制止人们违法。
words.en: If something deters you from doing something, it makes you not want to do it or continue doing it.

words.ex: He paid the first installment last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周支付了第一期分期付款。
words.en: An installment is one of the amounts, usually equal, into which a debt is divided for payment at stated intervals over a fixed period.

words.tr: n. 财务公司；金融公司
words.ex: He works for a finance company that gives loans to small businesses.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家向小企业提供贷款的财务公司工作。

words.tr: n. 开垦；土壤改良；改造；回收
words.ex: The city is doing reclamation of the old factory land.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市正在对旧工厂土地进行回收利用。
words.en: The process of claiming something back or of reasserting a right.

words.ex: He went back to retrieve his keys.
words.ex_cn: 他回去取回他的钥匙。
words.en: To retrieve something means to get it back from somewhere, especially after it has been lost or taken away.

words.tr:
v. 重取；重新摄制；重考
n. 重取；重新摄制；重考
words.ex: He will retake the math test next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将重考数学考试。
words.en: To take something again, especially a photograph or a film scene, or to take control of a place again after losing it.

words.ex: We recycle plastic bottles every week.
words.ex_cn: 我们每周回收塑料瓶。
words.en: To recycle means to process used materials so that they can be used again.

words.ex: His reinstatement was approved after he apologized.
words.ex_cn: 他道歉后，他的复职得到了批准。
words.en: The act of restoring someone to a previous position or condition.

words.ex: He will pay in installments for the new car.
words.ex_cn: 他将为这辆新车分期付款。

words.tr:
adj. 犁过而未耕种的；休耕的；休闲中的
n. 休耕的田地；闲置；休整
v. 使（翻耕后的土地）休闲
words.ex: The farmer lets the field lie fallow this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年农夫让这块地休耕。
words.en: If land is fallow, it is not planted with crops, in order to improve the quality of the soil.

words.ex: The course of the river changed after the flood.
words.ex_cn: 河流的流程在洪水后发生了变化。
words.en: A course is a series of lessons or lectures on a particular subject.

words.ex: Ancient warfare used swords and shields.
words.ex_cn: 古代战争使用剑和盾。
words.en: Warfare is the activity of fighting a war.

words.ex: He wore a trench coat to protect himself from the rain.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了一件风雨衣来保护自己不被雨淋湿。
words.en: A trench coat is a type of coat made of waterproof heavy-duty cotton drill or poplin, wool, or leather. It is generally knee-length or longer, and often includes details such as shoulder straps, a belt, and a double-breasted front.

words.ex: Soldiers fought in trench warfare during World War I.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们在第一次世界大战中进行壕沟战。

words.tr: n. 回填；填充（尤指挖掘后重新填入材料）
words.ex: The workers completed the backfilling after laying the pipe.
words.ex_cn: 工人在铺设管道后完成了回填。

words.ex: The construction crew will backfill the trench after the pipes are laid.
words.ex_cn: 施工队将在铺设管道后回填沟渠。
words.en: To fill up again with material that has been excavated; to provide what is needed to make something complete or sufficient.

words.tr:
v. 提取；
n. 摘录；提取物；
words.ex: They extract oil from plants.
words.ex_cn: 他们从植物中提取油。
words.en: To remove or take out something, especially by effort or force.

words.ex: Workers excavate the old ruins with shovels.
words.ex_cn: 工人们用铲子挖掘古代遗址。
words.en: To excavate means to dig in the ground in order to find things that have been buried there, such as archaeological remains.

words.tr:
n. 海峡；渠道；河床；频道；
v. 引导；
words.ex: The English Channel separates England from France.
words.ex_cn: 英吉利海峡将英格兰与法国分隔开。
words.en: A channel is a television station and the programs that it broadcasts. A channel is also a method or system that people use to send information, goods, etc. to each other.

words.ex: This painting has a distinctive style.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画有独特的风格。
words.en: Something that is distinctive has a special quality or feature which makes it easily recognizable and different from other things of the same type.

words.tr: adj. 可识别的；可辨认的；
words.ex: The stolen bike is identifiable by its red handlebar.
words.ex_cn: 这辆被盗的自行车可以通过它的红色车把识别出来。
words.en: If something or someone is identifiable, they are able to be recognized.

words.tr: v. 隔离；使隔热；使隔音；使绝缘
words.ex: The walls insulate the house from cold air.
words.ex_cn: 墙壁将房子与冷空气隔离开。
words.en: To insulate something means to protect it from heat, cold, noise, or electricity by covering it in a material that prevents it from passing through.

words.ex: He takes insulin to control his blood sugar.
words.ex_cn: 他注射胰岛素来控制血糖。
words.en: A hormone produced in the pancreas by the islets of Langerhans, which regulates the amount of glucose in the blood. The lack of insulin causes a form of diabetes.

words.ex: The doctor gave him penicillin for his infection.
words.ex_cn: 医生给他开了青霉素治疗感染。
words.en: An antibiotic drug obtained from molds or produced synthetically, used to treat infections caused by bacteria.

words.ex: The peninsula is surrounded by water on three sides.
words.ex_cn: 这个半岛三面环水。
words.en: A peninsula is a piece of land that is almost entirely surrounded by water but is connected to the mainland on one side.

words.ex: The hospital will isolate the patient to stop the spread.
words.ex_cn: 医院将隔离这名病人以防止传播。
words.en: To isolate someone or something means to separate them from other people or things, often in order to protect them or to prevent the spread of something harmful.

words.tr:
n. 浸泡；
v. 吸收；
words.ex: The clothes went into a soak overnight.
words.ex_cn: 衣服泡了一整晚。
words.en: To soak something means to make it very wet by leaving it in a liquid, or to become very wet in this way. It can also mean to absorb or take in something.

words.tr: v. 使浸透；使湿透；使满；使饱和
words.ex: The sponge will saturate if you pour too much water.
words.ex_cn: 如果你倒太多水，海绵会吸满。
words.en: To saturate something means to make it completely wet, or to fill it completely with something so that no more can be added.

words.ex: The smell of perfume showed permeation through the room.
words.ex_cn: 香水的气味弥漫了整个房间。
words.en: The process by which a liquid, gas, or other substance passes through a material or area.

words.ex: The smell of bread is permeant in the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 面包的香味在厨房里持久不散。
words.en: A substance or agent that can permeate or pass through.

words.ex: Water can penetrate the soil slowly.
words.ex_cn: 水可以慢慢渗透进土壤。
words.en: To penetrate means to enter or pass through something, especially when this is difficult or when it is not obvious how to do it.

words.ex: The needle will pierce the skin.
words.ex_cn: 针会刺穿皮肤。
words.en: If a sharp object pierces something, or if you pierce something with a sharp object, the object goes into it and makes a hole in it.

words.tr: v. 重新包装；重新填塞；再装配；拆修
words.ex: He will repack the boxes tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会重新打包这些箱子。
words.en: To package something again, especially in a different way or for a different purpose.

words.tr: adj. 破坏性的；引起混乱的；
words.ex: The new technology caused disruptive changes in the market.
words.ex_cn: 这项新技术给市场带来了破坏性的变化。
words.en: Causing or tending to cause disruption.

words.ex: The doctor gave him a clinical exam.
words.ex_cn: 医生给他做了临床检查。
words.en: Clinical means involving or relating to the direct observation and treatment of patients, rather than theoretical or laboratory studies.

words.ex: The team gained momentum after scoring the first goal.
words.ex_cn: 球队在进第一个球后获得了势头。
words.en: Momentum is the ability of something to keep increasing, developing, or being more successful.

words.tr: v. 使失去权力或影响
words.ex: The law disempowers poor communities.
words.ex_cn: 这项法律使贫困社区失去权力。
words.en: To disempower someone means to make them less powerful or confident, especially by not giving them the rights or opportunities that they need.

words.ex: The depletion of natural resources is a serious problem.
words.ex_cn: 自然资源的损耗是一个严重的问题。
words.en: The act of reducing something by a large amount so that there is not enough left.

words.tr: adj. 真正的；真实的；真迹的；可靠的；
words.ex: This is an authentic painting by Picasso.
words.ex_cn: 这是一幅毕加索的真迹。
words.en: If something is authentic, it is real, true, or what people say it is.

words.tr: v. 证明…是真实的；鉴别
words.ex: He must authenticate his identity with a password.
words.ex_cn: 他必须用密码验证自己的身份。
words.en: To authenticate something means to prove or confirm that it is genuine or true.

words.ex: The students learned the anatomy of the human heart.
words.ex_cn: 学生们学习了人类心脏的解剖组织构造。
words.en: Anatomy is the study of the structure of the bodies of people or animals.

words.ex: He spoke with confidence during the presentation.
words.ex_cn: 他在演讲时充满信心。
words.en: Confidence is a feeling of self-assurance arising from one's appreciation of one's own abilities or qualities.

words.tr: n. 开始；毕业典礼；学位授予典礼
words.ex: The commencement of the class was at 9 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 课程的开始时间是上午9点。
words.en: The commencement of something is its beginning.

words.ex: All passengers must pass through security inspection before boarding.
words.ex_cn: 所有乘客登机前必须经过安全检查。
words.en: The examination of people and belongings for safety purposes.

words.ex: The storm disrupted the train service.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴中断了火车服务。
words.en: To disrupt a system, process, or event means to prevent it from continuing or operating in a normal way.

words.ex: He went to the clinic for a check-up.
words.ex_cn: 他去诊所做检查。
words.en: A clinic is a place where people receive medical treatment or advice, especially for a particular illness or condition.

words.ex: He propose to go to the park after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他提议午饭后去公园。
words.en: If you propose something, you suggest it as a plan or course of action.

words.ex: He made a proposal to improve the school lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他提出了一个改善学校午餐的提案。
words.en: A proposal is a plan or suggestion, especially a formal one that is put forward for people to think about and decide upon.

words.ex: The new law gave impetus to environmental protection.
words.ex_cn: 新法律为环境保护提供了推动力。
words.en: Something that gives a process impetus or an impetus makes it happen or progress more quickly.

words.tr: n. 推进剂；发射药；火箭燃料
words.ex: The rocket uses a strong propellant to fly.
words.ex_cn: 火箭使用一种强大的推进剂来飞行。
words.en: A propellant is a substance that is used to move something forward, especially a rocket or a bullet, by creating a force that pushes it.

words.ex: He is learning human anatomy in medical school.
words.ex_cn: 他正在医学院学习人体解剖学。
words.en: The scientific study of the structure of the human body.

words.ex: He learned animal anatomy in his biology class.
words.ex_cn: 他在生物课上学了动物解剖学。

words.tr: n. 自主权；自治权；自治；
words.ex: The region demands autonomy from the central government.
words.ex_cn: 该地区要求从中央政府获得自主权。
words.en: Autonomy is the ability or condition of being self-governing; independence in one's thoughts or actions.

words.tr: adj. 自治的；有自治权的；自主的；
words.ex: The region has autonomous control over its education system.
words.ex_cn: 这个地区对其教育系统拥有自治权。
words.en: An autonomous organization, country, or region is independent and has the freedom to govern itself.

words.ex: The doctor studied the anatomical structure of the heart.
words.ex_cn: 医生研究了心脏的解剖结构。
words.en: Relating to the structure of the bodies of people and animals.

words.ex: We went to the carnival last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末去了嘉年华。
words.en: A carnival is a public festival, typically one held annually in a particular place, involving processions, music, and dancing.

words.tr: n. 恶作剧；胡闹；喧闹的玩笑
words.ex: The boys were up to high jinks at the party.
words.ex_cn: 男孩们在派对上搞恶作剧。

words.tr: v. 迅速闪避；灵巧地躲闪
words.ex: The soccer player jinked to avoid the defender.
words.ex_cn: 这名足球运动员迅速闪避以躲开防守队员。

words.ex: The class will commence at 9 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 课程将在上午9点开始。
words.en: To begin something; to start.

words.ex: The broken bridge is a menace to drivers.
words.ex_cn: 这座破桥对司机来说是个危险物。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is a menace, you mean that they are likely to cause serious harm.

words.tr:
adj. 化学的；
n. 化学品；
words.ex: The lab has a chemical reaction.
words.ex_cn: 实验室里有一个化学反应。
words.en: A chemical is a substance that is used in or produced by a process involving chemistry.

words.ex: He took his words in a literal sense.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的话按字面意思理解。
words.en: If you describe something as the literal truth or a literal fact, you are emphasizing that it is true.

words.tr:
adj. 逐字的；一字不差的
adv. 逐字地；一字不差地
words.ex: He repeated the words verbatim.
words.ex_cn: 他一字不差地重复了那些话。
words.en: Using exactly the same words as were used originally.

words.ex: The teacher gave a comprehensive review before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 老师在考试前给了一个全面的复习。
words.en: Something that is comprehensive includes everything that is needed or relevant.

words.tr:
n. 胶；胶水；
v. 粘合；
words.ex: He used glue to stick the paper together.
words.ex_cn: 他用胶把纸粘在一起。
words.en: A sticky substance used for joining things together.

words.ex: The weather bureau issued a storm warning.
words.ex_cn: 气象局发布了风暴预警。
words.en: A bureau is an office, organization, or government department that collects and distributes information.

words.ex: The scientist observe the birds every morning.
words.ex_cn: 科学家每天早上观察鸟类。
words.en: If you observe a person or thing, you watch them carefully, especially in order to learn something about them.

words.tr: v. 沉思；闷闷不乐地想；n. 一窝幼崽；沉思的状态
words.ex: He sits by the window and broods over his failures.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在窗边，为自己的失败而忧思。
words.en: If someone broods over something, they think about it a lot, seriously and often unhappily. A brood is a group of young birds all born at the same time to the same mother.

words.ex: The bird hatched her eggs after three weeks.
words.ex_cn: 这只鸟在三周后孵出了她的蛋。
words.en: To hatch means to cause an egg to break open so that a young animal can come out, or to plan secretly with other people to do something bad or illegal.

words.tr: adj. 互相依赖的；相倚的；
words.ex: The two countries are interdependent in trade.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家在贸易上互相依赖。
words.en: If two or more things are interdependent, they depend on each other.

words.ex: The murder happened last night in the park.
words.ex_cn: 这起谋杀发生在昨晚的公园里。
words.en: Murder is the unlawful premeditated killing of one human being by another.

words.ex: The factory released toxic chemicals into the river.
words.ex_cn: 工厂将有毒化学物质排放到河里。
words.en: Toxic chemicals are substances that can cause harm to living organisms through chemical reactions or other activities on the molecular scale when a sufficient quantity is absorbed by the organism.

words.ex: The chemical reaction made the liquid turn red.
words.ex_cn: 这个化学反应使液体变成了红色。
words.en: A chemical reaction is a process that leads to the transformation of one set of chemical substances to another.

words.ex: He is studying chemical engineering at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学学习化学工程。
words.en: Chemical engineering is a branch of engineering that applies physical sciences (e.g., chemistry and physics) and life sciences (e.g., biology, microbiology, and biochemistry) together with mathematics and economics to produce, transform, transport, and properly use chemicals, materials, and energy.

words.tr: adv. 严格来说；字面上说
words.ex: Literally speaking, a tomato is a fruit.
words.ex_cn: 严格来说，番茄是一种水果。

words.ex: He is literally the best player on the team.
words.ex_cn: 他确实是队里最好的球员。
words.en: In a literal manner or sense; exactly.

words.ex: Children need literacy to read books and write letters.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们需要有读写能力才能读书和写信。
words.en: Literacy is the ability to read and write.

words.ex: He loves reading English literature.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢阅读英语文学。
words.en: Literature consists of written works, especially those considered to have artistic or intellectual value.

words.ex: He loves reading literary books.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢读文学书籍。
words.en: Literary means concerned with or connected with the writing, study, or appreciation of literature.

words.tr: phrase. 综合学校（英国的一种非选拔性中学，接收所有能力的学生）
words.ex: He goes to a comprehensive school in London.
words.ex_cn: 他在伦敦的一所综合学校上学。
words.en: A comprehensive school is a type of secondary school in the UK that admits students of all abilities.

words.ex: He cannot comprehend the simple math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他无法理解这个简单的数学问题。
words.en: To comprehend something means to understand it fully.

words.tr:
n. 账户；叙述；账目；
v. 占…；说明；
words.ex: I opened a bank account last week.
words.ex_cn: 我上周开了一家银行账户。
words.en: An account is a detailed report or description of an event or situation.

words.tr: n. 职业介绍所；就业服务机构
words.ex: He went to an employment bureau to find a job.
words.ex_cn: 他去职业介绍所找工作。

words.tr:
v. 交配繁殖；饲养；
n. 品种；
words.ex: The farmers breed cows to get more milk.
words.ex_cn: 农民让奶牛交配繁殖以获得更多牛奶。
words.en: If you breed animals or plants, you keep them for the purpose of producing more animals or plants with particular qualities, in a controlled way.

words.tr:
v. 藏匿；隐藏
n. 一批贮藏物
words.ex: He stashes his money under the bed.
words.ex_cn: 他把钱藏在床底下。
words.en: If you stash something valuable in a secret place, you store it there to keep it safe.

words.tr: v. 沉思；冥想；考虑；仔细计划
words.ex: He meditates every morning to feel calm.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上冥想以保持平静。
words.en: To meditate means to spend time in quiet thought for religious purposes or relaxation.

words.tr: phrase. 对…苦思冥想；为…绞尽脑汁；反复琢磨
words.ex: He puzzles over the math problem for hours.
words.ex_cn: 他花了好几个小时思考那道数学题。
words.en: If you puzzle over something, you think hard about it because you find it difficult to understand or solve.

words.ex: He sat by the window to ponder his future.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在窗边深思自己的未来。
words.en: If you ponder something, you think about it carefully.

words.tr: v. 考虑；深思；凝视；思考…的可能性
words.ex: He contemplates quitting his job.
words.ex_cn: 他正在考虑辞去工作。
words.en: If you contemplate an action, you think about whether to do it or not.

words.ex: He lives independently and makes his own decisions.
words.ex_cn: 他独立生活，并自己做决定。
words.en: If one thing or person is independent of another, they are separate and not connected, so that the first one is not affected or influenced by the second.

words.tr: adj. 突出的；杰出的；显著的；
words.ex: He is a prominent scientist in the field of medicine.
words.ex_cn: 他是医学领域的一位突出的科学家。
words.en: Someone or something that is prominent is important and well-known, or is positioned in a way that makes them easily seen or noticed.

words.ex: He is an eminent scientist who won the Nobel Prize.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位获得诺贝尔奖的杰出科学家。
words.en: An eminent person is well-known and respected, especially because they are good at their profession.

words.tr: adj. 卓越的；杰出的；出类拔萃的
words.ex: He is a preeminent scientist in his field.
words.ex_cn: 他是该领域最杰出的科学家。
words.en: Standing out in importance or reputation; superior to all others.

words.tr: adj. 杰出的；尚未处理的；
words.ex: He is an outstanding student who always gets top grades.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名杰出的学生，总是取得最高分。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as outstanding, you think that they are very remarkable and impressive.

words.ex: The salient point in the report is the cost increase.
words.ex_cn: 报告中最显著的要点是成本上升。
words.en: The most noticeable or important.

words.ex: He wears conventional clothes to work.
words.ex_cn: 他穿传统服装去上班。
words.en: Conventional ideas, methods, or systems are the ones that are generally accepted and used, and that have been used for a long time.

words.ex: The factory improved its productivity by using new machines.
words.ex_cn: 工厂通过使用新机器提高了生产率。
words.en: Productivity is the rate at which goods are produced or work is completed.

words.ex: Honey is a viscous liquid.
words.ex_cn: 蜂蜜是一种黏稠的液体。
words.en: A viscous liquid is thick and sticky and does not flow easily.

words.ex: The new teacher transformed the class into a lively group.
words.ex_cn: 这位新老师把班级变成了一个充满活力的团体。
words.en: To transform something or someone means to change them completely and usually improve their appearance, form, or structure.

words.tr: n. 战略家；善于筹划部署的人；
words.ex: He is a strategist who plans every move carefully.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位仔细规划每一步的战略家。
words.en: A strategist is someone who is skilled in planning, especially in military, political, or business contexts.

words.ex: Parents shouldn't indulge their children's bad habits.
words.ex_cn: 父母不应该放任孩子的坏习惯。
words.en: To indulge means to allow yourself or someone else to have something enjoyable, especially more than is good for you.

words.ex: She pampered her baby with warm baths and soft blankets.
words.ex_cn: 她用温水浴和柔软的毯子细心照顾她的婴儿。
words.en: To treat someone very kindly, often too kindly, by letting them have or do whatever they want.

words.ex: Parents often spoil their children with too many toys.
words.ex_cn: 父母经常用太多玩具宠坏孩子。
words.en: To spoil something means to reduce its quality or value, often by damaging it in some way. It can also mean to treat someone, especially a child, with too much kindness or indulgence, leading to their detriment.

words.ex: His personality is very friendly and outgoing.
words.ex_cn: 他的个性非常友好和外向。
words.en: The combination of characteristics or qualities that form an individual's distinctive character.

words.ex: The dictionary gives a clear definition of the word.
words.ex_cn: 词典给出了这个词的清晰定义。
words.en: A statement of the exact meaning of a word, phrase, or concept.

words.ex: Many people choose conventional food because it is cheaper.
words.ex_cn: 许多人选择常规食品，因为它更便宜。

words.tr: n. 传统价值；惯常价值
words.ex: Many families still hold to conventional value in raising children.
words.ex_cn: 许多家庭在教育孩子时仍坚持传统价值。

words.ex: The factory's output increased last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂上个月的产量增加了。
words.en: The amount of something produced by a person, machine, or industry.

words.ex: He has the capacity to solve hard math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他有能力解决复杂的数学问题。
words.en: The capacity of a place or container is the amount of things or people that it can hold.

words.ex: The honey is sticky.
words.ex_cn: 蜂蜜是黏的。
words.en: Something that is sticky is covered with a substance that things stick to.

words.ex: The teacher gave extra praise to satisfy the students.
words.ex_cn: 老师给予额外的表扬来使学生满意。
words.en: If someone or something satisfies you, they give you enough of what you want or need to make you pleased or contented.

words.ex: He gratifies his parents by getting good grades.
words.ex_cn: 他通过取得好成绩来让父母感到欣慰。
words.en: If you are gratified by something, it gives you pleasure or satisfaction.

words.tr: adj. 可满足的；可使饱足的
words.ex: Her curiosity was satiable only after she read the entire book.
words.ex_cn: 她的好奇心只有在读完这本书后才得到满足。
words.en: Capable of being satisfied or appeased.

words.ex: He has an insatiable hunger for knowledge.
words.ex_cn: 他对知识有着无法满足的渴望。
words.en: If someone is insatiable, they always want more of something and are never satisfied.

words.tr:
n. 主人；主持人；
v. 主持；
words.ex: The host welcomed us with tea and cookies.
words.ex_cn: 主人用茶和饼干欢迎了我们。
words.en: A host is a person who receives or entertains guests, especially in their own home. A host is also a person who presents a television or radio program.

words.tr: n. 女权运动；男女平等主义
words.ex: She believes in feminism and wants equal rights for women.
words.ex_cn: 她相信女权主义，希望女性享有平等权利。
words.en: Feminism is the belief and aim that women should have the same rights, power, and opportunities as men.

words.ex: The wind began to abate after the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风暴过后，风开始减弱。
words.en: If something bad or undesirable abates, it becomes much less strong or severe.

words.ex: His expectation was to pass the test.
words.ex_cn: 他的期待是通过考试。
words.en: An expectation is a belief about what might happen in the future, especially about something that you think is likely or that you hope will happen.

words.ex: Her expectance of a promotion kept her motivated at work.
words.ex_cn: 她对晋升的期待使她在工作中保持动力。
words.en: The feeling of expecting something to happen.

words.ex: He ate excessive amounts of candy.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了过多的糖果。
words.en: If you describe the amount or level of something as excessive, you disapprove of it because it is more or higher than is necessary or reasonable.

words.tr: adj. 卓越的；极好的；明亮的；灿烂的；
words.ex: He gave a brilliant answer to the math question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这道数学题给出了卓越的回答。
words.en: A brilliant person, idea, or performance is extremely clever or skilful.

words.ex: He attended a seminar on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他参加了一个关于气候变化的研讨会。
words.en: A seminar is a meeting where a group of people discuss a problem or topic.

words.tr: v. 导航；应付（复杂情况）；
words.ex: He uses a map to navigate the city.
words.ex_cn: 他用地图来导航这座城市。
words.en: To navigate is to plan and direct the route or course of a ship, aircraft, or other form of transport, especially by using instruments or maps.

words.tr: adj. 可航行的；适于通航的；
words.ex: The river is navigable by small boats.
words.ex_cn: 这条河可供小船航行。
words.en: If a stretch of water is navigable, it is deep and wide enough for ships to travel through.

words.tr:
adj. 肮脏恶臭的；
v. 对…犯规；
words.ex: The foul smell came from the garbage bin.
words.ex_cn: 那股恶臭来自垃圾桶。
words.en: If you describe something as foul, you mean it is dirty and smells or tastes unpleasant. In sports, a foul is an act that is against the rules of the game.

words.tr: n. 大量的；众多的（某物）
words.ex: There is a host of books on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书架上有大量的书。

words.ex: The host country provided excellent facilities for the athletes.
words.ex_cn: 东道国为运动员提供了极好的设施。
words.en: The country where an event, especially a sports event or a conference, takes place.

words.tr:
n. 辩论；讨论；
v. 辩论；讨论；
words.ex: The students had a debate about homework.
words.ex_cn: 学生们就作业进行了一场辩论。
words.en: If you maintain something, you continue to have it, and do not let it stop or grow weaker.

words.tr: n. 角色期望；对某人在特定角色中应有行为的预期
words.ex: The teacher knows the role expectation of helping students learn.
words.ex_cn: 老师知道帮助学生学习的角色期望。

words.ex: He has high expectancy for the future.
words.ex_cn: 他对未来有很高的预期。
words.en: The feeling of excitement about something that is going to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 预期寿命；平均寿命
words.ex: Life expectancy has increased in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 许多国家的预期寿命已经增加。
words.en: The average period that a person may expect to live.

words.tr: adj. 期待的；未来的（母亲、父亲、父母）
words.ex: The expectant mother looked at the baby toys with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 这位期待的准妈妈看着婴儿玩具微笑着。
words.en: If someone is expectant, they are hopeful or excited because they think something interesting or pleasant is going to happen.

words.ex: The brilliant sunshine made the beach look beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 耀眼的阳光让海滩看起来很漂亮。

words.ex: He had a brilliant idea to fix the bike.
words.ex_cn: 他想到了一个绝妙的主意来修自行车。
words.en: An exceptionally clever or effective concept.

words.ex: He got a penalty for breaking the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他因违反规则而受到惩罚。
words.en: A penalty is a punishment that is imposed on someone for doing something that is against the rules or the law.

words.tr: v. 对…予以惩罚；使处于不利地位
words.ex: The teacher will penalize students who cheat.
words.ex_cn: 老师会惩罚作弊的学生。
words.en: To penalize someone means to punish them or make them suffer in some way because they have done something wrong.

words.tr: v. 处罚；使处于不利地位
words.ex: The team was penalized for delaying the game.
words.ex_cn: v. 队伍因为拖延比赛而受到处罚。
words.en: To penalize someone means to punish them or make them suffer in some way because they have broken a rule or law.

words.ex: I consider going to the park tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我考虑明天去公园。
words.en: If you consider something, you think about it carefully.

words.tr:
n. 预算；预算金额；
adj. 廉价的；花钱少的；
v. 为 ... 做预算；
words.ex: We made a budget for our vacation.
words.ex_cn: 我们为旅行制定了一个预算。
words.en: A budget is a plan that shows how much money a person or organization will earn and how much they will need or be able to spend.

words.ex: He will flee from the burning house.
words.ex_cn: 他会从着火的房子里逃走。
words.en: If you flee from something or someone, you leave them quickly because you are afraid of them or because you do not want to be involved with them.

words.ex: It is worthwhile to learn a new language.
words.ex_cn: 学习一门新语言是值得的。
words.en: If something is worthwhile, it is enjoyable or useful enough to make the effort or money spent on it seem reasonable.

words.tr: adj. 值得…的；值得尊敬的；
words.ex: This book is worthy of reading.
words.ex_cn: 这本书值得读。
words.en: If something or someone is worthy of something, they deserve it because they have the qualities or abilities required.

words.ex: He used a clamp to hold the wood together.
words.ex_cn: 他用夹具把木头固定在一起。
words.en: A clamp is a device that holds two things firmly together. As a verb, to clamp means to hold or fasten something tightly.

words.ex: The store is open 24 hours for your convenience.
words.ex_cn: 商店24小时营业，以方便您。
words.en: The state of being able to proceed with something with little effort or difficulty.

words.ex: The migrant found a new job in the city.
words.ex_cn: 这位移居者在城市里找到了一份新工作。
words.en: A migrant is a person who moves from one place to another, especially in order to find work.

words.ex: Please specify the time for the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 请详细说明会议的时间。
words.en: If you specify something, you give information about what is required or should happen in a certain situation.

words.ex: His deviance from the rules caused problems.
words.ex_cn: 他违反规则的行为引起了问题。
words.en: Deviance refers to actions or behaviors that violate social norms or expectations.

words.ex: The government has a big budget deficit this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年政府有巨大的预算赤字。
words.en: A budget deficit occurs when expenses exceed revenue and indicate the financial health of a country. The government generally uses the term budget deficit when referring to spending rather than businesses or individuals. Budget deficits affect the national debt, the sum of annual budget deficits, and the cumulative total a country owes to creditors.

words.tr: 短语动词. 削减预算；减少开支
words.ex: The company decided to cut down the budget to save money.
words.ex_cn: 公司决定削减预算以节省资金。
words.en: To reduce the amount of money that is available to be spent.

words.ex: They plan a budget for their monthly expenses.
words.ex_cn: 他们为每月的开销制定预算。

words.tr: phrase. 在预算有限的情况下；精打细算地；经济地
words.ex: She had to decorate her apartment on a budget.
words.ex_cn: 她不得不在预算范围内装修她的公寓。
words.en: In a way that carefully plans and controls the amount of money spent, especially when there is not much money available.

words.ex: The castle was besieged by enemy forces for months.
words.ex_cn: v. 城堡被敌军包围了数月。
words.en: To surround a place with armed forces in order to capture it or force its surrender.

words.ex: They enclose the garden with a wooden fence.
words.ex_cn: 他们用木栅栏把花园围起来。
words.en: If you enclose something with a letter, you put it in the same envelope as the letter.

words.ex: The cows graze in the enclosure.
words.ex_cn: 奶牛在围场里吃草。
words.en: An enclosure is an area that is surrounded by a barrier or fence, often used to keep animals in or to protect something.

words.tr: adj. 做某事是值得的；有價值的
adj. 值得做某事；做某事是值得的

words.ex: She buys convenience food for dinner because she is tired.
words.ex_cn: 她因为累了，所以买即食食品当晚餐。
words.en: Convenience food refers to food that is commercially prepared and designed for ease of consumption, often requiring minimal preparation by the consumer.

words.ex: I bought milk at the convenience store.
words.ex_cn: 我在便利店买了牛奶。
words.en: A convenience store is a small retail business that stocks a range of everyday items such as groceries, snack foods, confectionery, soft drinks, tobacco products, and may also offer money order and wire transfer services. These stores are known for their extended operating hours and convenient locations.

words.tr: phrase. 在某人方便的时候；根据某人的便利
words.ex: You can call me at your convenience.
words.ex_cn: 你可以方便的时候给我打电话。
words.en: At a time or place that suits someone.

words.ex: The road closure caused an inconvenience to commuters.
words.ex_cn: 道路封闭给通勤者带来了不便。
words.en: Inconvenience refers to the state or quality of being inconvenient; trouble or difficulty caused to one's personal requirements or comfort.

words.tr:
adj. 不正常的；离经叛道的
n. 不正常的人
words.ex: His deviant behavior surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他不正常的行为让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: Deviant behavior or thinking is different from what people normally consider to be acceptable.

words.tr:
v. 估算；估价；
n. 估价；估算；
words.ex: Can you estimate how long it will take?
words.ex_cn: 你能估算一下需要多长时间吗？
words.en: If you estimate a quantity or value, you make an approximate judgment or calculation of it.

words.ex: Farming is his main livelihood.
words.ex_cn: 务农是他的主要生计。
words.en: A person's livelihood is the way they earn money in order to live.

words.tr:
n. 制造；
v. （用机器大量）制造；虚构；捏造；
words.ex: The manufacture of cars needs many workers.
words.ex_cn: 汽车的制造需要很多工人。
words.en: To manufacture something means to make it in a factory, usually in large quantities.

words.tr:
v. 谴责；责难；指责
n. 谴责；责难；指责
words.ex: The teacher censured the student for cheating.
words.ex_cn: 老师谴责了那个作弊的学生。
words.en: If you censure someone for something that they have done, you tell them that you strongly disapprove of it.

words.ex: My mom scolded me for coming home late.
words.ex_cn: 妈妈因为我回家晚而责备了我。
words.en: If you scold someone, you speak angrily to them because they have done something wrong.

words.tr:
v. 责备；指责
n. 责备；指责
words.ex: She reproached him for being late.
words.ex_cn: 她责备他迟到了。
words.en: To express disapproval or disappointment towards someone because of their actions or behavior.

words.ex: The battery has a voltage of 9 volts.
words.ex_cn: 这节电池的电压是9伏特。
words.en: Voltage is the electrical force measured in volts that is needed to make a current flow in a circuit.

words.ex: He uses logic to solve the puzzle.
words.ex_cn: 他用逻辑来解决这个谜题。
words.en: Logic is a method of reasoning that involves a series of statements, each of which must be true if the statement before it is true.

words.ex: The estimated time of arrival is 5 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 预计到达时间是下午五点。
words.en: The expected time when someone or something will arrive.

words.tr: abbr. 预计到达时间；“estimated time of arrival”的缩写
words.ex: The eta of the bus is 5 minutes late.
words.ex_cn: 公交车的到达时间晚了5分钟。
words.en: The seventh letter of the Greek alphabet.

words.ex: The estimated time of departure is 3 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 预计出发时间是下午三点。
words.en: The estimated time when a vehicle, especially an aircraft, is expected to depart.

words.tr: abbr. 预计离开时间；“Estimated Time of Departure”的缩写
words.ex: The flight's ETD is 3 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 航班的预计离开时间是下午三点。
words.en: Estimated Time of Departure; the projected time when a vehicle, flight, or service is expected to leave.

words.ex: The estimated number of people attending the concert is around 10,000.
words.ex_cn: 预计参加音乐会的人数大约为10,000人。
words.en: An estimated number of people refers to a calculation or judgment about the number of individuals in a particular group or population, often made without having exact data.

words.tr: phrase. 保守的估计；一种倾向于低估而非高估的估算方式
words.ex: The company provided a conservative estimate of its quarterly earnings.
words.ex_cn: 公司提供了其季度收益的保守估计。
words.en: A conservative estimate is a cautious or restrained calculation or prediction, often used to avoid overestimating or being overly optimistic.

words.ex: He drives an automobile to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天开车去上班。
words.en: A vehicle that is powered by an engine and is used for carrying passengers on roads.

words.ex: The government does a census every ten years.
words.ex_cn: 政府每十年进行一次人口普查。
words.en: A census is an official count or survey of a population, typically recording various details of individuals.

words.ex: The team reached a consensus on the project plan.
words.ex_cn: 团队就项目计划达成了共识。
words.en: A consensus is general agreement among a group of people.

words.ex: The warden checks the prison every morning.
words.ex_cn: 狱长每天早上检查监狱。
words.en: A warden is a person who is responsible for the supervision of a particular place or thing, or for ensuring that laws or rules are obeyed.

words.tr:
n. 瘟疫；疫病；
v. 困扰；折磨；
words.ex: The plague killed many people in medieval Europe.
words.ex_cn: 瘟疫在中世纪的欧洲杀死了许多人。
words.en: A plague is a very infectious disease that spreads quickly and kills a lot of people. It can also refer to a large number of insects or animals that cause damage or are a nuisance.

words.ex: The village was destroyed by pestilence last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年这个村庄被瘟疫摧毁了。
words.en: A pestilence is a fatal epidemic disease, especially bubonic plague.

words.tr:
n. 犁；犁形器具
v. 犁；耕；艰苦前进
words.ex: The farmer uses a plow to turn the soil.
words.ex_cn: 农夫用犁翻土。
words.en: A plow is a farm tool with one or more heavy blades that breaks the soil and cuts a furrow for sowing seeds.

words.ex: The farmer ploughs the field every spring.
words.ex_cn: 农民每年春天都犁地。
words.en: A plough is a large farming implement with one or more blades fixed in a frame, drawn over soil to turn it over and cut furrows in preparation for the planting of seeds. It can also mean to move forward with difficulty or to work hard at something.

words.ex: The family is in a difficult plight after losing their home.
words.ex_cn: 这家人在失去家园后陷入了困境。
words.en: A plight is a difficult or adverse situation, especially one that is hard to escape. It can also refer to a solemn promise or pledge.

words.ex: He will enrol in the English course next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将登记参加英语课程。
words.en: To officially arrange to join a school, university, or course, or to arrange for someone else to do this.

words.ex: Ancient Egypt is one of the oldest civilizations.
words.ex_cn: 古埃及是最早的文明之一。
words.en: A civilization is a human society with its own social organization and culture.

words.ex: He read a compendium of math rules.
words.ex_cn: 他读了一本数学规则的汇编。
words.en: A compendium is a short but complete collection of information, usually in a book.

words.ex: He gave a summary of the story at the end.
words.ex_cn: 他在结尾对故事做了总结。
words.en: A summary is a brief statement or account of the main points of something.

words.tr:
adj. 抽象的；非具体的；
n. 摘要；概要；抽象派艺术作品；
words.ex: The painting shows an abstract shape.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画展示了一个抽象的形状。
words.en: An abstract idea or way of thinking is based on general ideas rather than on real things and events.

words.tr:
v. 提取；
n. 摘录；提取物；
words.ex: They extract oil from plants.
words.ex_cn: 他们从植物中提取油。
words.en: To remove or take out something, especially by effort or force.

words.ex: He decided to embark on a new career.
words.ex_cn: 他决定从事一份新职业。
words.en: To embark on something means to start it, especially something new, difficult, or exciting.

words.ex: He deserves a break after working so hard.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作后值得休息一下。
words.en: If you say that a person or thing deserves something, you mean that they should have it or receive it because of their actions or qualities.

words.tr: v. 喷射；喷出；驱逐；逐出
words.ex: The volcano ejects lava during an eruption.
words.ex_cn: 火山在喷发时喷出岩浆。
words.en: If you eject someone or something from a place, you force them to leave.

words.ex: The verification of the password took only a few seconds.
words.ex_cn: 密码的验证只花了几秒钟。
words.en: Verification is the process of establishing the truth, accuracy, or validity of something.

words.ex: He has an autoimmune disease that affects his skin.
words.ex_cn: 他患有一种影响皮肤的自身免疫性疾病。
words.en: An autoimmune disease or condition is one in which your immune system mistakenly attacks your own body.

words.ex: He received his father's watch as an inheritance.
words.ex_cn: 他收到了父亲留给他的手表作为遗产。
words.en: Inheritance is money or property which you receive from someone who has died.

words.tr: v. 注册加入某课程/项目；报名参加某事物
words.ex: He will enroll in a math course next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月将注册参加一门数学课程。

words.ex: The pendulum swings back and forth in the clock.
words.ex_cn: 钟摆在钟里来回摆动。
words.en: A pendulum is a weight that is hung from a fixed point so that it can swing freely, especially a rod with a weight at the end that regulates the mechanism of a clock.

words.tr: adj. 松垂的；悬垂摆动的
words.ex: The pendulous branches swayed in the wind.
words.ex_cn: 垂下的枝条在风中摇曳。
words.en: Something that is pendulous hangs or swings freely.

words.ex: Scientists mapped the human genome last year.
words.ex_cn: 科学家们去年绘制了人类基因组。
words.en: The complete set of genes or genetic material present in a cell or organism.

words.tr: v. 开始从事；着手进行
words.ex: He will embark on a new job next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月将开始一份新工作。

words.tr: v. 开始从事；着手进行（某事）
words.ex: He decided to embark upon a new career.
words.ex_cn: 他决定开始从事一份新职业。

words.tr:
n. 板；董事会；
v. 上船（或火车、飞机等）；
words.ex: He nailed the picture to the board.
words.ex_cn: 他把照片钉在板上。
words.en: A board is a flat, thin, rectangular piece of wood or other material used for a particular purpose, such as cutting food on or as a surface for writing or playing games. It can also refer to a group of people who manage or control a company or organization, or to the meals provided by an institution such as a school or hospital. As a verb, it means to get onto a ship, aircraft, or other vehicle, or to provide meals and lodging for someone.

words.ex: The passengers disembark at the port.
words.ex_cn: 乘客们在港口上岸。
words.en: To disembark means to leave a ship, aircraft, or other vehicle.

words.tr: v. 有所成就；有重要意义；最终产生重要结果
words.ex: He worked hard and finally amounted to something.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作，最终有所成就。

words.tr: v. 将某人或某物从……中驱逐/排出
words.ex: The teacher will eject the student from the classroom for breaking rules.
words.ex_cn: 老师会因为学生违反规则而将他逐出教室。

words.ex: The ejection of the pilot saved his life.
words.ex_cn: 飞行员的弹射救了他的命。
words.en: The act of ejecting someone or something; expulsion.

words.ex: The body expels waste through the kidneys.
words.ex_cn: 身体通过肾脏排出废物。
words.en: If someone is expelled from a school or organization, they are officially told to leave because they have behaved badly or broken the rules.

words.ex: Please remove the trash from the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 请把厨房的垃圾去掉。
words.en: To take something or someone away from a place or off a surface.

words.ex: The machine extrudes plastic into long tubes.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器将塑料挤出成长管状。
words.en: To force or push out through a small opening.

words.ex: The landlord will evict the tenant for not paying rent.
words.ex_cn: 房东会因为租客不付房租而将他驱逐。
words.en: To evict someone means to force them to leave a house or piece of land, usually because they have not paid the rent or have broken the law.

words.tr: adj. 不上学、不就业、不接受培训的（指年轻人）
words.ex: Many neet youths spend their days at home without working or studying.
words.ex_cn: 许多不上学、不就业、不接受培训的年轻人整天待在家里，不工作也不学习。

words.tr: n. 历史遗产；具有历史意义的传承
words.ex: The old castle is a historic inheritance of the region.
words.ex_cn: 这座古老城堡是该地区的历史遗产。

words.ex: The relentless rain flooded the streets.
words.ex_cn: 无情的雨水淹没了街道。
words.en: Someone who is relentless is determined to do something and refuses to give up, even if what they are doing is unpleasant or cruel.

words.tr: adj. 必需的；必备的；必不可少的；
words.ex: A passport is a requisite for international travel.
words.ex_cn: 护照是国际旅行所必需的。
words.en: Something that is necessary for a particular purpose.

words.ex: You need basic math as a prerequisite for this course.
words.ex_cn: 你学习这门课程的前提是掌握基础数学。
words.en: A prerequisite is something that must exist or happen before something else can exist or happen.

words.tr: n. 头晕；昏眩；头昏眼花
words.ex: He felt dizziness after standing up quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他站起来后感到头晕。
words.en: A sensation of spinning around and losing one's balance.

words.ex: The small village lies on the periphery of the city.
words.ex_cn: 这个小村庄位于城市的外围。
words.en: The outer limits or edge of an area or object.

words.tr: n. 证明书；资格证书；证件
words.ex: He showed his credential to enter the building.
words.ex_cn: 他出示了证件以进入大楼。
words.en: A credential is a document that proves your identity or qualifications.

words.tr: n. 复制本；摹本；仿制品；传真
words.ex: He sent a facsimile of the document to his office.
words.ex_cn: 他把文件的传真发到了办公室。
words.en: An exact copy of a document, picture, or piece of writing, especially one that has been made by a machine.

words.ex: The scientist did a replication of the experiment.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家重复了这个实验。
words.en: The act of copying or reproducing something.

words.ex: He bought a replica of the ancient statue.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一件古代雕像的复制品。
words.en: A replica of something such as a statue, building, or weapon is an accurate copy of it.

words.tr: v. 复制；复印；再做一次；
words.ex: He duplicated the file to save a copy.
words.ex_cn: 他复制了该文件以保存一份副本。
words.en: To duplicate something means to make an exact copy of it.

words.tr: n. 对应物；相当之物；副本；
words.ex: The CEO's counterpart in China signed the agreement.
words.ex_cn: 中国方面的对应人物签署了协议。
words.en: Someone's or something's counterpart is another person or thing that has a similar function or position in a different place.

words.ex: He wound the fishing line onto the reel.
words.ex_cn: 他把鱼线绕在卷筒上。
words.en: A reel is a cylinder on which film, wire, thread, or other flexible materials can be wound. It can also refer to a lively Scottish or Irish dance, or to the act of staggering or lurching violently.

words.tr:
n. 线轴；缠线框
v. 缠绕；卷在线轴上
words.ex: The thread wound around the spool.
words.ex_cn: 线缠在了线轴上。
words.en: A spool is a round object onto which thread, tape, or film can be wound, or the act of winding it onto such an object.

words.tr:
v. 剧烈搅动；（使）猛烈翻腾
n. 搅乳器
words.ex: The machine churns the butter in the cream.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器剧烈搅动奶油来制作黄油。
words.en: To churn means to stir or shake milk or cream in order to make butter, or to move something around violently in water or air.

words.ex: Owls are nocturnal animals.
words.ex_cn: 猫头鹰是夜间活动的动物。
words.en: Nocturnal means happening in the night or active at night.

words.tr: v. 发慈悲；动怜悯心；缓和
words.ex: The teacher finally relented and gave the students more time.
words.ex_cn: 老师终于发慈悲，给了学生们更多时间。
words.en: If you relent, you allow someone to do something that you had previously refused to allow them to do.

words.ex: The keyboard is a peripheral device.
words.ex_cn: 键盘是一个外围设备。
words.en: A peripheral activity or issue is one that is not very important compared with other activities or issues.

words.ex: The scientist tried to replicate the experiment.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家试图复制这个实验。
words.en: To replicate something means to do or make something again in exactly the same way.

words.ex: They have a reciprocal agreement to help each other.
words.ex_cn: 他们有一个互相帮助的互惠协议。
words.en: A reciprocal action or agreement involves two people or groups who do the same thing to each other or agree to help each other in a similar way.

words.ex: They have mutual respect for each other.
words.ex_cn: 他们彼此相互尊重。
words.en: Mutual is used to describe a situation, feeling, or action that is experienced, felt, or done by each of two or more parties towards the other or others.

words.tr:
n. 愚蠢的错误；失误
v. 犯愚蠢的错误；失误；跌跌撞撞地走
