words.tr: v. 负担得起做某事；有能力支付或承担某事的后果
words.ex: I can't afford to buy a new car.
words.ex_cn: 我负担不起买一辆新车。

words.tr: v. 负担得起（某物）；有能力支付或承受（某物）
words.ex: They cannot afford a new car.
words.ex_cn: 他们负担不起一辆新车。

words.ex: This phone is affordable for students.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机对学生来说价格合理。
words.en: If something is affordable, most people have enough money to buy it.

words.ex: This painting has a distinctive style.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画有独特的风格。
words.en: Something that is distinctive has a special quality or feature which makes it easily recognizable and different from other things of the same type.

words.ex: Her talent is unparalleled.
words.ex_cn: 她的才华是无比的。
words.en: Having no parallel or equal; unmatched.

words.tr: v. 连接到某物；与某物建立联系
words.ex: He connects his phone to the Wi-Fi.
words.ex_cn: 他把手机连接到Wi-Fi。

words.tr: v. 与某物建立联系；与某事物连接或产生关联
words.ex: He tries to connect with nature by walking in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他通过在公园散步来与自然建立联系。
words.en: To establish a link or relationship with a subject, idea, or object.

words.ex: The worker stored the gas cylinder in a safe place.
words.ex_cn: 工人把气瓶存放在安全的地方。

words.ex: The diamond is encased in glass.
words.ex_cn: 钻石被包裹在玻璃里。
words.en: To encase something means to cover or surround it completely in a case or close-fitting covering.

words.ex: The old tree has a stout trunk.
words.ex_cn: 这棵老树有一个粗壮的树干。
words.en: Someone who is stout is rather fat or heavy.

words.tr: adj. 强健的；强壮的；结实的；
words.ex: The dog is robust and runs every day.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗很强健，每天跑步。
words.en: Strong and healthy; vigorous. (of an object) sturdy in construction.

words.ex: They enclose the garden with a wooden fence.
words.ex_cn: 他们用木栅栏把花园围起来。
words.en: If you enclose something with a letter, you put it in the same envelope as the letter.

words.ex: The cows graze in the enclosure.
words.ex_cn: 奶牛在围场里吃草。
words.en: An enclosure is an area that is surrounded by a barrier or fence, often used to keep animals in or to protect something.

words.ex: The army besiege the small town.
words.ex_cn: 军队围攻这座小镇。
words.en: To surround a place with armed forces in order to capture it or force its surrender; to overwhelm someone with requests or complaints.

words.ex: The ice cream is in a conical cup.
words.ex_cn: 冰淇淋装在一个圆锥形的杯子里。
words.en: Something that is conical is in the shape of a cone.

words.ex: He wants to participate in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他想参加学校的戏剧表演。
words.en: To take part in an activity or event.

words.w: air quality in many parts of the world
words.tr: n. 世界上许多地区的空气质量
words.uk: ˈeə ˈkwɒləti ɪn ˈmɛni ˈpɑːts əv ðə wɜːld
words.us: ˈɛr ˈkwɑːləti ɪn ˈmɛni ˈpɑːrts əv ðə wɜːrld
words.ex: Air quality in many parts of the world is getting worse.
words.ex_cn: 世界上许多地区的空气质量正在变差。

words.ex: He works hard to improve his English.
words.ex_cn: 他努力改善自己的英语。
words.en: To make something better, or to become better.

words.ex: The new policy will ameliorate living conditions.
words.ex_cn: 新政策将改善生活条件。
words.en: To make something better or improve a situation.

words.ex: The sun scorch the ground in summer.
words.ex_cn: 夏天阳光灼烧地面。
words.en: To burn the surface of something so as to discolour or damage it.

words.ex: He is cooking dinner. In the meantime, she is setting the table.
words.ex_cn: 他正在做晚饭，与此同时，她正在摆桌子。
words.en: In the meantime is used to indicate that something else is happening or will happen while a particular event or situation is continuing.

words.ex: He felt listless after the long illness.
words.ex_cn: 他生病后感到无精打采。
words.en: If someone is listless, they lack energy or enthusiasm.

words.ex: The hot weather enervates him.
words.ex_cn: 炎热的天气让他感到乏力。
words.en: If something enervates you, it makes you feel weak and lacking in energy.

words.tr: adj. 精力充沛的；茂盛的；
words.ex: He is a vigorous man who runs every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个精力充沛的人，每天早上都跑步。
words.en: A vigorous person does things with great energy and enthusiasm. A vigorous campaign or activity is done with great energy and enthusiasm.

words.ex: The benevolent man gave food to the poor.
words.ex_cn: 这位慈善的人给穷人提供了食物。
words.en: If you describe a person in authority as benevolent, you mean that they are kind and fair.

words.tr: adj. 宽厚的；仁慈的；不严格的；
words.ex: The teacher was lenient with students who were late.
words.ex_cn: 老师对迟到的学生很宽厚。
words.en: If you are lenient with someone, you are not strict in the way you treat them, especially when they have done something wrong.

words.ex: The boy is an innocent child who trusts everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩是个天真的孩子，他相信每个人。

words.ex: He emphasizes the importance of homework.
words.ex_cn: 他强调作业的重要性。
words.en: To give special importance or prominence to (something) in speaking or writing.

words.ex: She accentuates the first syllable when she says the word.
words.ex_cn: 她说这个词时重读第一个音节。
words.en: To accentuate something means to emphasize it or make it more noticeable.

words.ex: The teacher underlined the key point.
words.ex_cn: 老师强调了这个关键点。
words.en: To draw a line under a word or phrase, especially in order to emphasize it.

words.tr: n. 音调；语气；强健状况；色调；氛围；
words.ex: His tone sounded angry.
words.ex_cn: 他的音调听起来很生气。
words.en: The tone of a sound is its particular quality. In music, tone refers to the pitch of a note. In art, tone refers to the lightness or darkness of a color. In speech, tone refers to the quality of the voice which expresses the speaker's feelings or intentions.

words.tr:
v. 突出；强调；高光；
n. 最突出的部分；
words.ex: The teacher highlighted the key words in the text.
words.ex_cn: 老师把文中的关键词突出了。
words.en: To highlight something means to make it stand out or to emphasize it, often because it is important or interesting.

words.tr: v. 强调某事；重视某事
words.ex: The teacher places emphasis on reading every day.
words.ex_cn: 老师强调每天都要阅读。

words.ex: The teacher is very approachable and always smiles.
words.ex_cn: 这位老师非常和蔼可亲，总是面带微笑。
words.en: If you describe someone as approachable, you think that they are friendly and easy to talk to.

words.tr: adj. 和蔼可亲的；亲切友好的
words.ex: He is an amiable man who always smiles.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个和蔼可亲的人，总是面带微笑。
words.en: Someone who is amiable is friendly and pleasant to be with.

words.tr: n. 对某事的方法；对待某事的方式
words.ex: His approach to learning English is very patient.
words.ex_cn: 他学习英语的方法非常有耐心。

words.tr: adj. 首要的；小学的；初等的；原来的；最初的；
words.ex: Primary goal is to stay safe.
words.ex_cn: 首要目标是保持安全。
words.en: Something that is primary is more important than anything else.

words.tr:
adj. 腐蚀性的；苛性的；尖酸刻薄的
n. 腐蚀剂
words.ex: The caustic liquid burned through the metal.
words.ex_cn: 这种腐蚀性的液体腐蚀了金属。
words.en: A caustic substance is able to burn or destroy organic tissue by chemical action. Caustic remarks are extremely critical, sarcastic, or bitter.

words.ex: The smell of rotten eggs comes from a sulfur compound.
words.ex_cn: 臭鸡蛋的气味来自一种硫化合物。

words.ex: The refinery makes gasoline from oil.
words.ex_cn: 炼油厂从石油中生产汽油。
words.en: A refinery is a factory where a substance such as oil or sugar is refined.

words.ex: He was late due to traffic.
words.ex_cn: 他因为交通堵塞迟到了。
words.en: If an event is due to something, it happens or exists as a direct result of that thing.

words.tr: phrase. 在适当的时候；到时候；最终
words.ex: He will get the results in due course.
words.ex_cn: 他会在适当的时候收到结果。
words.en: If you say that something will happen or take place in due course, you mean that it will happen or take place at the appropriate time, not before.

words.ex: The teacher gave timely help when I was stuck.
words.ex_cn: 当我遇到困难时，老师及时提供了帮助。
words.en: done or occurring at a favorable or useful time; opportune.

words.tr: adj. 渴望的；热心的；敏锐的；
words.ex: He is keen to learn English.
words.ex_cn: 他渴望学习英语。
words.en: If you are keen on doing something, you very much want to do it. If you are keen that something should happen, you very much want it to happen.

words.ex: The bird ate a worm.
words.ex_cn: 鸟吃了一条蚯蚓。
words.en: A worm is a small, long, thin creature with no bones or legs that lives in soil.

words.ex: The butterfly starts as a larva.
words.ex_cn: 蝴蝶从幼虫开始。
words.en: An insect in the stage of development when it has just come out of an egg and before it changes into its adult form.

words.ex: His neck was stiff after sleeping wrong.
words.ex_cn: 他睡姿不对，脖子变得僵硬。
words.en: If something is stiff, it is firm and does not bend easily. It can also describe a person who is not relaxed or friendly.

words.ex: He bought timber to build a fence.
words.ex_cn: 他买了木材来建篱笆。
words.en: Wood prepared for use in building and carpentry.

words.ex: The factory buys lumber to make furniture.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂购买木材来制造家具。
words.en: Lumber refers to wood that has been processed into beams and planks, a stage in the process of wood production. It is also used to describe the action of moving in a slow, heavy, awkward way.

words.tr: adj. 不关心的；漠视的；不相干的
words.ex: He was unconcerned about the noise.
words.ex_cn: 他对噪音毫不在意。
words.en: If you are unconcerned about something, you are not interested in it or worried about it.

words.ex: His words had a profound effect on her life.
words.ex_cn: 他的话对她的生活产生了深远的影响。
words.en: If you describe something as profound, you mean that it is very great or intense.

words.ex: The meaning of the poem is obscure.
words.ex_cn: 这首诗的意思不清楚。
words.en: If something is obscure, it is not well known or not easily understood.

words.ex: The abstruse math problem confused the students.
words.ex_cn: 这个深奥的数学问题让学生们感到困惑。
words.en: Difficult to understand; obscure.

words.ex: The recondite math problem confused most students.
words.ex_cn: 这道深奥的数学题让大多数学生感到困惑。
words.en: Recondite knowledge or information is known and understood by very few people.

words.ex: The pond is shallow, so you can see the bottom.
words.ex_cn: 这个池塘很浅，所以你能看到底部。
words.en: If something is shallow, it does not extend far down from the top surface.

words.tr: adj. 对某事非常喜爱或热衷

words.ex: He is a man of keen perception who notices small details others miss.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个洞察力敏锐的人，能注意到别人忽略的细小之处。

words.tr:
n. 螺纹；涡 
v. 盘旋
words.ex: The fingerprint has a clear whorl pattern.
words.ex_cn: 这个指纹有一个清晰的旋涡图案。
words.en: A whorl is a pattern of spirals or concentric circles, especially in the arrangement of leaves or petals around a stem.

words.ex: The machine uses a worm gear to reduce speed.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器使用蜗杆齿轮来降低速度。

words.tr:
n. 索具装备；钻探设备；装备
v. 配备索具；操纵；舞弊
words.ex: He uses a rig to hold the camera steady.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个支架来固定相机。
words.en: To rig something means to arrange or set it up in a particular way, often in a temporary or makeshift manner. It can also refer to the equipment used in drilling for oil or gas, or the sails and ropes on a ship.

words.ex: He shifted the gear to slow down the car.
words.ex_cn: 他换挡以减慢车速。
words.en: Gear refers to a toothed wheel that works with others to alter the relation between the speed of a driving mechanism (such as the engine of a vehicle) and the speed of the driven parts (the wheels). It can also mean equipment that is used for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The timber industry is a major part of the local economy.
words.ex_cn: 木材工业是当地经济的主要部分。
words.en: The sector of the economy that deals with the production, processing, and distribution of wood and wood products.

words.ex: He fell into a profound sleep after the long journey.
words.ex_cn: 长途旅行后，他进入了深沉的睡眠。

words.tr: n. 深刻的思想；深刻的见解
words.ex: His profound idea changed the way we think about education.
words.ex_cn: 他的深刻思想改变了我们对教育的看法。

words.tr: adj. 不透明的；难懂的；晦涩的
words.ex: The glass is opaque, so I cannot see through it.
words.ex_cn: 这扇玻璃是不透明的，所以我看不到它后面的东西。
words.en: If an object or substance is opaque, you cannot see through it.

words.ex: He asked for permission to leave early.
words.ex_cn: 他请求允许早点离开。
words.en: If someone who has authority over you gives you permission to do something, they say that they will allow you to do it.

words.tr:
n. 劳动；体力劳动；劳工；
v. 辛勤工作；
words.ex: Hard labour helps people build strong skills.
words.ex_cn: 辛勤的劳动帮助人们培养强大的技能。
words.en: Labour is very hard work, especially physical work. It can also refer to the workers of a country or industry, considered as a group, or the process of childbirth.

words.ex: The factory has a quota of 1000 units per day.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂每天有1000件的配额。
words.en: A quota is the limited number or quantity of something which is officially allowed.

words.ex: I suspect it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我猜想明天会下雨。
words.en: If you suspect someone of doing something wrong or dishonest, you believe that they have done it, although you have no proof.

words.ex: The deterioration of the road made driving dangerous.
words.ex_cn: 道路的恶化使驾驶变得危险。
words.en: The process of becoming progressively worse.

words.tr:
v. 成为三倍；使增至三倍；
n. 三倍的数；三个一组；
adj. 三部分的；
words.ex: The company's profits tripled last year.
words.ex_cn: 该公司去年的利润增长了三倍。
words.en: To triple something means to make it three times as much in size or number.

words.ex: The public condemned the corrupt politician.
words.ex_cn: 公众谴责了这位腐败的政客。
words.en: If you condemn something, you say that it is very bad and unacceptable.

words.tr: phrase. 未经许可地；擅自地
words.ex: He entered the room without permission.
words.ex_cn: 他未经允许就进了房间。
words.en: If you do something without permission, you do it without asking for or receiving the approval of the person in authority.

words.tr: phrase. 特殊许可；特别批准
words.ex: He needs special permission to enter the lab.
words.ex_cn: 他需要特别许可才能进入实验室。
words.en: Special permission refers to an authorization that is granted under exceptional circumstances, allowing someone to do something that is not normally permitted.

words.tr: phrase. 建筑规划许可；规划许可（指政府批准的土地开发或建筑施工许可）
words.ex: He needs planning permission to build a new house.
words.ex_cn: 他需要规划许可来建造一栋新房子。
words.en: Official approval required for building or development projects, granted by local government authorities.

words.ex: The factory lowered labour costs by using robots.
words.ex_cn: 工厂通过使用机器人降低了劳动力成本。
words.en: The amount of money that a company spends on paying its workers.

words.tr: n. 劳动经济学；研究劳动力市场、工资决定、就业与失业等问题的经济学分支
words.ex: He studies labour economics to understand wages and jobs.
words.ex_cn: 他学习劳动经济学以了解工资和工作。

words.ex: He gave a laboured smile, tired from the long day.
words.ex_cn: 他露出一个吃力的微笑，因为漫长的一天而疲惫。
words.en: If something is laboured, it is done with a lot of effort, often in a way that is not natural or relaxed.

words.ex: Hiking up the mountain was a strenuous task.
words.ex_cn: 爬山是一项艰苦的任务。
words.en: Requiring or using great effort or exertion.

words.tr: adj. 引起疲劳的；累人的； v. “tire”的现在分词；
words.ex: The long walk was tiring.
words.ex_cn: 这次长时间的散步让人感到疲惫。
words.en: If you describe something as tiring, you mean that it makes you tired so that you want to rest or sleep.

words.ex: He is a studious student who always does his homework carefully.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个认真学习的学生，总是认真完成作业。
words.en: Someone who is studious spends a lot of time studying and reading.

words.ex: The teacher will allot five minutes for questions.
words.ex_cn: 老师会分配五分钟提问。
words.en: If something is allotted to someone, it is given to them as their share.

words.ex: The teacher will allocate books to students.
words.ex_cn: 老师将给学生分配书籍。
words.en: To allocate something means to give it to a particular person or use it for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The teacher will distribute the books to students.
words.ex_cn: 老师将把书分发给学生。
words.en: If you distribute things, you hand them or deliver them to a number of people.

words.ex: The teacher will assign homework today.
words.ex_cn: 老师今天会布置作业。
words.en: To give someone a particular job or task; to allocate a resource or responsibility to a particular person or purpose.

words.ex: Each family was given an allotment of land to farm.
words.ex_cn: 每个家庭都被分配了一块土地来耕种。
words.en: An allotment is a share or portion of something that has been divided or distributed.

words.tr: n. 某事物的配额制度
words.ex: The country has a quota system for fish catching.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家对捕鱼实行配额制度。

words.ex: I suspect something is wrong with the machine.
words.ex_cn: 我怀疑这台机器出了问题。

words.tr: v. 被怀疑做某事；被怀疑涉及某事
adj. 怀疑的；令人怀疑的；
words.ex: The police felt suspicious about the man's behavior.
words.ex_cn: 警察对这个人的行为感到怀疑。
words.en: If you are suspicious of someone or something, you do not trust them, and are careful when dealing with them.

words.tr:
n. 化合物；
adj. 复合的；混合的；
words.ex: Water is a compound of hydrogen and oxygen.
words.ex_cn: 水是由氢和氧组成的化合物。
words.en: A compound is a substance that consists of two or more elements chemically combined in fixed proportions.

words.ex: The weather will deteriorate tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天天气会恶化。
words.en: If something deteriorates, it becomes worse in some way.

words.ex: The rain will worsen the traffic.
words.ex_cn: 雨会加重交通拥堵。
words.en: If a situation worsens or something worsens it, it becomes more difficult, unpleasant, or unacceptable.

words.ex: Smoking can exacerbate asthma.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟会使哮喘加重。
words.en: If something exacerbates a problem or bad situation, it makes it worse.

words.tr: v. 公开指责；告发；揭发
words.ex: He denounces corruption in his speech.
words.ex_cn: 他在演讲中谴责腐败。
words.en: If you denounce a person or an action, you criticize them severely and publicly because you feel strongly that they are wrong or evil.

words.tr:
n. 责任；责备；
v. 责怪；归咎于；
words.ex: He took the blame for the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他承担了这个错误的责任。
words.en: If you blame a person or thing for something bad, you believe or say that they are responsible for it or that they caused it.

words.ex: The court condemned him to death for murder.
words.ex_cn: 法院因谋杀罪判处他死刑。

words.ex: The house is connected to the water supply.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子连接到供水系统。
words.en: To be joined or linked to something else, allowing communication or passage between them.

words.tr:
n. 竞争者；敌手；
v. 竞争；相匹敌；
words.ex: He is my main rival in the race.
words.ex_cn: 他是我在比赛中主要的竞争者。
words.en: A rival is a person, group, or organization that you are competing with in the same activity or the same area.

words.ex: The rivalry between the two teams is very strong.
words.ex_cn: 这两支队伍之间的竞争非常激烈。
words.en: Competition for the same objective or for superiority in the same field.

words.tr: adj. 无与伦比的；无双的
words.ex: Her singing is unrivalled.
words.ex_cn: 她的歌唱无人能及。
words.en: If you describe something as unrivalled, you are emphasizing that it is better than anything else of the same kind.

words.ex: The public expressed condemnation for the violent act.
words.ex_cn: 公众对这一暴力行为表示谴责。
words.en: Condemnation is the act of saying that something or someone is very bad and unacceptable.

words.tr: n. 告发；痛骂；公开抨击
words.ex: He made a denouncement of the corrupt leader.
words.ex_cn: 他谴责了那位腐败的领导人。
words.en: A denouncement is a public condemnation or criticism of someone or something.

words.ex: After work, he likes to unwind by listening to music.
words.ex_cn: 下班后，他喜欢听音乐来放松。
words.en: If you unwind, you relax after doing something that has made you tense or tired.

words.ex: He unraveled the knotted string.
words.ex_cn: 他把打结的绳子拆散了。
words.en: To unravel means to separate or disentangle the threads of a fabric or a rope, or to solve or explain something that is complicated or mysterious.

words.tr: v. 摘下面纱；揭幕；揭露
words.ex: They will unveil the statue tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们明天将摘下雕像的面纱。
words.en: If someone unveils something such as a new statue or painting, they show it to the public for the first time.

words.ex: She transcended her fears to speak on stage.
words.ex_cn: 她超越了自己的恐惧，在舞台上发言。
words.en: If something transcends normal limits or boundaries, it goes beyond them, because it is more significant than them.

words.ex: The car exceeded the speed limit.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车超过了限速。
words.en: To be greater in quantity, degree, or intensity than something else.

words.ex: He surpassed his brother in math scores.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学成绩上超过了他弟弟。
words.en: If one person or thing surpasses another, the first is better than, or has more of a particular quality than, the second.

words.tr: v. 胜过某人；优于某人
words.ex: He excelled his brother in math competitions.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学竞赛中胜过了他的哥哥。

words.ex: The cumulative score is the total of all previous points.
words.ex_cn: 累积得分是所有之前分数的总和。
words.en: If a series of events have a cumulative effect, each event makes the effect greater.

words.ex: The line is horizontal on the graph.
words.ex_cn: 这条线在图上是水平的。
words.en: Parallel to the plane of the horizon; at right angles to the vertical.

words.ex: The doctor will certify that you are healthy.
words.ex_cn: 医生将证明你身体健康。
words.en: To officially declare something to be true, correct, or genuine, often in writing.

words.ex: Please verify your email address.
words.ex_cn: 请核实你的电子邮件地址。
words.en: To verify something means to check or prove that it is true, accurate, or justified.

words.ex: The movie caused a strong arousal of emotions.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影唤起了强烈的情感。
words.en: Arousal is the state of being awake or of reacting to stimuli; it can also refer to the act of arousing someone or something.

words.ex: He has an addiction to video games.
words.ex_cn: 他对电子游戏上瘾了。
words.en: Addiction is the condition of being unable to stop using or doing something as a habit, especially something harmful.

words.ex: He alleges that the manager stole money.
words.ex_cn: 他声称经理偷了钱。
words.en: If you allege that something bad is true, you say it but do not prove it.

words.tr: v. 断言；宣称；坚持；维护
words.ex: He asserts that the answer is correct.
words.ex_cn: 他坚持认为答案是正确的。
words.en: To state a fact or belief confidently and forcefully.

words.ex: The president will declare a holiday next week.
words.ex_cn: 总统将在下周宣布放假。
words.en: If you declare something, you state it formally, publicly, or officially.

words.ex: The king proclaimed a new law.
words.ex_cn: 国王宣告了一项新法律。
words.en: If you proclaim something, you formally announce it or declare it publicly.

words.tr: v. 慷慨陈词；高声朗诵
words.ex: He likes to declaim poetry in front of the class.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在全班面前朗诵诗歌。
words.en: To declaim means to speak or recite something in a dramatic or impassioned way, often in public.

words.ex: The frog is an amphibious animal.
words.ex_cn: 青蛙是一种两栖动物。
words.en: An amphibious vehicle or craft is one that can operate on both land and water.

words.ex: The balloon will ascend into the sky.
words.ex_cn: 气球将升上天空。
words.en: If you ascend a hill or staircase, you go up it. If a staircase or path ascends, it leads up to a higher place.

words.ex: The rain cumulates in the valley.
words.ex_cn: 雨水在山谷中积聚。
words.en: To cumulate means to gather or amass in increasing quantities over time.

words.ex: He accumulates coins from different countries.
words.ex_cn: 他收集来自不同国家的硬币。
words.en: To accumulate means to gradually gather or acquire an increasing number or quantity of something.

words.ex: There is a pile of books on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌子上有一堆书。
words.en: A pile of things is a quantity of them lying on top of one another. If you pile things somewhere, you put them there so that they form a pile.

words.ex: The growth of the tree is a cumulative process.
words.ex_cn: 树木的生长是一个累积过程。

words.ex: The police caught the culprit who stole the bike.
words.ex_cn: 警察抓住了偷自行车的罪犯。
words.en: A culprit is someone who has done something wrong or illegal.

words.tr:
adj. 犯罪的；
n. 罪犯；
words.ex: He made a criminal mistake by stealing money.
words.ex_cn: 他偷钱犯了一个犯罪的错误。
words.en: A criminal is a person who has committed a crime.

words.tr: n. 得罪人的人；犯罪者；违法者；
words.ex: He was punished because he was an offender who hurt his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他因为是一个得罪朋友的人而受到惩罚。
words.en: An offender is a person who commits a crime or does something wrong.

words.tr: v. 增加；引起；筹募；提起；养育；
words.ex: The company will raise wages next month.
words.ex_cn: 公司下个月将提高工资。
words.en: To raise something means to move it to a higher position or to increase it in amount or level.

words.ex: The movie aroused his curiosity.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影激起了他的好奇心。
words.en: If something arouses a particular reaction or attitude in people, it causes them to have that reaction or attitude.

words.ex: He has a television addiction and watches TV all day.
words.ex_cn: 他有电视成瘾，整天看电视。

words.tr: v. 登上；升至（某地位或层次）
words.ex: He will ascend to the throne next year.
words.ex_cn: 他明年将登上王位。

words.ex: This castle dates back to the 12th century.
words.ex_cn: 这座城堡可以追溯到12世纪。
words.en: If something dates back to a particular time, it started or was made at that time.

words.tr: phrase. 追溯到；回溯至（某时间、地点或源头）
words.ex: The origins of this tradition trace back to the 12th century.
words.ex_cn: 这个传统的起源可以追溯到12世纪。
words.en: To find the origin or cause of something by examining the way it has developed or the events that have happened.

words.ex: I assure you that everything will be fine.
words.ex_cn: 我向你保证一切都会好起来的。
words.en: If you assure someone that something is true or will happen, you tell them that it is definitely true or will definitely happen, often in order to make them less worried.

words.tr:
v. 使困惑；难倒；阻碍
n. 挡板；遮护物；阻碍体
words.ex: The magic trick baffled the children.
words.ex_cn: 这个魔术让孩子们感到困惑。
words.en: If something baffles you, you cannot understand it or explain it.

words.ex: The riddle perplexed the children.
words.ex_cn: 这个谜语让孩子们感到困惑。
words.en: If something perplexes you, it confuses and worries you because you do not understand it or because it causes you difficulty.

words.tr: v. 使慌张；使窘迫；使不安
words.ex: The sudden noise disconcerted her.
words.ex_cn: 突然的噪音让她感到不安。
words.en: If something disconcerts you, it makes you feel anxious, confused, or embarrassed.

words.tr: v. 使迷惑；使...不知所措
words.ex: The strange signs bewilder the children.
words.ex_cn: 这些奇怪的符号让孩子们感到迷惑。
words.en: If something bewilders you, it is so confusing or difficult that you cannot understand it.

words.ex: He solved the crossword puzzle quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快解开了这个填字谜。
words.en: If something puzzles you, you do not understand it and feel confused.

words.ex: The instructions confuse me.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明让我感到困惑。
words.en: If you confuse two things, you mix them up in your mind so that you think one is the other.

words.ex: The forest has high biodiversity.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林生物多样性很高。
words.en: Biodiversity refers to the variety of life in the world or in a particular habitat or ecosystem.

words.ex: The trees bud in spring.
words.ex_cn: 树木在春天发芽。
words.en: A bud is a small pointed lump that appears on a tree or plant and develops into a leaf or flower.

words.tr: adj. 天空的；天体的；天国的；
words.ex: The celestial lights shone brightly in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 天空中的光芒在夜空中明亮地闪耀。
words.en: Relating to the sky or the heavens; belonging or relating to heaven as the abode of the gods.

words.ex: The air rarefies at high altitudes.
words.ex_cn: 在高海拔地区，空气会变稀薄。
words.en: To make or become less dense or solid; to purify or refine.

words.tr: adj. 高雅的； v. “rarefy”的过去式；
words.ex: He enjoys rarefied art and classical music.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢高雅的艺术和古典音乐。
words.en: Rarefied means made less dense or concentrated, especially in the context of air or gases. It can also refer to something that is elevated in character or nature, often in a way that is considered refined or exclusive.

words.ex: The detective tried to ascertain the truth.
words.ex_cn: 侦探试图查明真相。
words.en: If you ascertain the truth about something, you find out what it is, especially by making a deliberate effort to do so.

words.tr: phrase. 坚持自己的权利或意见；表现自信；维护自我
words.ex: He finally decided to assert himself at work.
words.ex_cn: 他终于决定在工作中表现自己。
words.en: To behave or speak in a confident and forceful way, especially in order to make sure that one's own rights or opinions are respected.

words.ex: He stood up to assert his rights.
words.ex_cn: 他站出来主张自己的权利。

words.ex: The country refused to surrender and asserted national independence.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家拒绝屈服，坚持国家独立。

words.ex: She is assertive when she speaks up for her rights.
words.ex_cn: 当她为自己权利发声时，表现得坚定自信。
words.en: Someone who is assertive behaves confidently and is not frightened to say what they want or believe.

words.ex: He showed assertiveness when speaking up in the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上发言时表现出了自信。
words.en: Assertiveness is the quality of being self-assured and confident without being aggressive.

words.ex: His assertion was simple: the project will finish on time.
words.ex_cn: 他的断言很简单：项目会按时完成。
words.en: A statement that is made with confidence but without proof.

words.tr:
v. 抗议；
n. 抗议活动；
words.ex: The students protest against the new school rules.
words.ex_cn: 学生们抗议新的校规。
words.en: A protest is the act of saying or showing publicly that you object to something.

words.tr: v. 承认；公开宣称声明
words.ex: He avows his love for her.
words.ex_cn: 他坦承自己对她的爱。
words.en: If you avow something, you declare it or admit it openly.

words.ex: He finally admit his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他终于承认了自己的错误。
words.en: If you admit that something bad, unpleasant, or embarrassing is true, you agree, often unwillingly, that it is true.

words.ex: He finally acknowledged his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他终于承认了自己的错误。
words.en: If you acknowledge a fact or a situation, you accept or admit that it is true or that it exists.

words.tr: adj. 离奇的；奇特的；奇怪的；
words.ex: The clown wore a bizarre hat with three eyes.
words.ex_cn: 小丑戴着一顶有三只眼睛的离奇帽子。
words.en: Something that is bizarre is very odd and strange.

words.ex: His strange answer caused her bafflement.
words.ex_cn: 他奇怪的回答让她感到困惑。
words.en: The state of being perplexed or confused; a feeling of bafflement.

words.ex: He looked at the map with bewilderment.
words.ex_cn: 他困惑地看着地图。
words.en: Bewilderment is the feeling of being confused and unable to understand something or decide what to do.

words.tr:
adj. 令人困惑的；使人糊涂的
v. 使迷惑；使昏乱；“bewilder”的现在分词
words.ex: The maze was bewildering.
words.ex_cn: 这个迷宫令人困惑。
words.en: If something is bewildering, it is very confusing and difficult to understand or to make a decision about.

words.tr: phrase. 生物多样性丧失；指生态系统、物种或遗传多样性的减少或消失
words.ex: The forest fire caused a loss of biodiversity.
words.ex_cn: 森林火灾导致了生物多样性的丧失。
words.en: The decline or disappearance of the variety of life in a particular habitat or ecosystem.

words.ex: The taste bud detects sweet food.
words.ex_cn: 味蕾能尝出甜食。
words.en: A taste bud is a small organ on the tongue that allows you to recognize the flavors of food and drink.

words.ex: She smells the jasmine in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 她在花园里闻着茉莉花的香味。
words.en: A shrub or climbing plant which bears fragrant flowers used in perfumery or tea.

words.ex: The moon is a celestial body.
words.ex_cn: 月亮是一个天体。
words.en: A celestial body is any natural body outside the Earth's atmosphere, such as the Moon, the Sun, an asteroid, planet, or star.

words.ex: The lock uses a simple combination of three numbers.
words.ex_cn: 这个锁使用三个数字的简单组合。
words.en: A combination is a mixture of things or people that are combined.

words.tr:
n. 影响力；冲击（力）；
v. 对…产生影响；
words.ex: The new law had a big impact on education.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法律对教育产生了重大影响。
words.en: The effect or influence of one person, thing, or action, on another.

words.ex: He will renew his passport next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会更新他的护照。
words.en: To renew something means to begin it again or to make it new again.

words.ex: The archer drew the bow and shot the arrow.
words.ex_cn: 弓箭手拉弓射出了箭。
words.en: A bow is a knot with two loops and two loose ends that is used in tying shoelaces and decorative ribbons. It is also the front part of a ship or boat.

words.tr:
n. 失败；
v. 击败；战胜；
words.ex: The team accepted the defeat with pride.
words.ex_cn: 球队以自豪的态度接受了失败。
words.en: If you defeat someone, you win a victory over them in a battle, game, or contest.

words.ex: The song evokes happy memories of childhood.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌唤起了对童年的美好回忆。
words.en: To evoke a particular memory, idea, emotion, or response means to cause it to occur.

words.tr:
v. 振翼；颤动；飘动；挥动
n. 鼓翼；飘扬；激动不安
words.ex: The flag is fluttering in the wind.
words.ex_cn: 旗帜在风中飘扬。
words.en: If something thin or light flutters, or if you flutter it, it moves up and down or from side to side with a lot of quick, light movements.

words.tr:
v. 拍动；摆动；
n. 薄片；
words.ex: The bird flaps its wings to fly.
words.ex_cn: 鸟拍动翅膀飞翔。
words.en: A flap is a piece of cloth, paper, skin etc that is fixed at one edge to a surface, which you can lift up easily. If something such as a piece of cloth or paper flaps or if you flap it, it moves quickly up and down or from side to side.

words.ex: He works on the front-line in the hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他在医院的前线工作。
words.en: Involving or relating to the most important or active part of a particular activity or area of work.

words.tr: adj. 不顾一切的；极度渴望的；绝望的；
words.ex: He made a desperate attempt to save the child.
words.ex_cn: 他不顾一切地试图救那个孩子。
words.en: If you are desperate, you are in such a bad situation that you are willing to try anything to change it.

words.tr: n. 半决赛；半决赛阶段; adj. 半决赛的；参加半决赛的
words.ex: He reached the semifinal of the tennis tournament.
words.ex_cn: 他进入了网球锦标赛的半决赛。
words.en: A semifinal is one of the two matches or races in a competition that are held to decide who will compete in the final.

words.ex: The flower has a sweet fragrance.
words.ex_cn: 这朵花有一种甜美的香味。
words.en: A fragrance is a pleasant smell, especially that of a flower or perfume.

words.tr:
v. 奉承；讨好
adj. 更平坦的；更扁平的；“flat”的比较级
adv. 更平直地；更直截了当地；“flat”的比较级
words.ex: He flatters his boss to get a raise.
words.ex_cn: 他奉承老板以获得加薪。
words.en: If someone flatters you, they praise you in an exaggerated way that may be sincere or may be intended to persuade you to do something.

words.tr: v. 强迫吞下；强行压下
words.ex: They forced down the bitter medicine.
words.ex_cn: 他们强迫吞下了苦涩的药。

words.tr: n. 最低档位；最低齿轮
words.ex: He shifted into the bottom gear to climb the hill.
words.ex_cn: 他换到最低档位来爬山。

words.tr: phrase. 调整……以适应；使……适合（某人或某物）
words.ex: The teacher geared the lesson to the students' level.
words.ex_cn: 老师将课程内容调整到适合学生的水平。
words.en: To adjust or adapt something to suit a particular purpose or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 使针对；使适应；调整以应对
words.ex: The school gears its lessons towards helping students speak better.
words.ex_cn: 学校把课程重点放在帮助学生提高口语上。
words.en: To design or adapt something to suit a particular purpose or group of people.

words.tr: v. 将计划导向某事物；使计划针对某目标
words.ex: They geared the plan towards helping poor students.
words.ex_cn: 他们将计划导向帮助贫困学生。

words.ex: The band is playing music.
words.ex_cn: 这个乐队在演奏音乐。
words.en: A band is a group of musicians who play music together, especially popular music. It can also refer to a strip of material used for binding or decoration, or a range of frequencies or wavelengths in a spectrum.

words.tr:
v. 交配繁殖；饲养；
n. 品种；
words.ex: The farmers breed cows to get more milk.
words.ex_cn: 农民让奶牛交配繁殖以获得更多牛奶。
words.en: If you breed animals or plants, you keep them for the purpose of producing more animals or plants with particular qualities, in a controlled way.

words.tr: adj. 可理解的；明白易懂的；清楚的
words.ex: His explanation was intelligible to everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他的解释人人都能听懂。
words.en: Capable of being understood; comprehensible.

words.ex: The teacher spoke in a comprehensible way.
words.ex_cn: 老师用容易理解的方式讲话。
words.en: If something is comprehensible, you can understand it.

words.ex: The essence of love is caring for others.
words.ex_cn: 爱的本质是关心他人。
words.en: The essence of something is its basic and most important characteristic which gives it its individual identity.

words.tr: v. 使预先有倾向；使易接受；使易于患（病）
words.ex: Genes can predispose a person to diabetes.
words.ex_cn: 基因可能使人更容易患糖尿病。
words.en: If something predisposes you to think or behave in a particular way, it makes it likely that you will think or behave in that way.

words.tr:
n. 展示；陈列；
v. 展示；陈列；
words.ex: The store has a big display of new phones.
words.ex_cn: 商店里有一个新手机的展示。
words.en: To display something means to put it in a place where people can see it easily, or to show it to people.

words.ex: He will retire next year.
words.ex_cn: 他明年将退休。
words.en: If you retire, you stop working, usually because you have reached a certain age or because you are ill.

words.ex: The company plans to enlarge its office space.
words.ex_cn: 公司计划扩大其办公空间。
words.en: To make something bigger or more extensive.

words.ex: They breed fish in the pond to sell at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他们在池塘里繁殖鱼类以便在市场出售。
words.en: To raise and care for fish in a controlled environment, often for commercial purposes.

words.tr:
adj. 智力的；
n. 知识分子；
words.ex: He is an intellectual person who loves solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个热爱解决数学问题的智力型人。
words.en: An intellectual is someone who spends a lot of time studying and thinking about complicated ideas.

words.tr: adj. 有才智的；聪明的；明智的；
words.ex: The intelligent boy solved the math problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这个有才智的男孩很快解出了这道数学题。
words.en: Someone who is intelligent has the ability to think, understand, and learn things quickly and well.

words.tr: adj. 聪明的；时髦的；衣冠楚楚的；
words.ex: He is a smart student who solves math problems quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个聪明的学生，能快速解决数学问题。
words.en: If you describe someone as smart, you mean that they are clean, tidy, and stylish in their appearance.

words.tr: phrase. 清晰易懂的言语；可理解的讲话
words.ex: His intelligible speech helped everyone understand.
words.ex_cn: 他清晰的讲话帮助了每个人理解。
words.en: Speech that is clear and easily understood, allowing the listener to comprehend the intended meaning without difficulty.

words.tr:
adj. 清楚的；明确的；清晰的；清澈的；晴朗的；
v. 清空；清除；放晴；使明确；
adv. 清楚地；彻底地；
words.ex: The instructions are clear.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明很清楚。
words.en: Free from anything that marks or darkens; transparent; bright; not obscure or ambiguous; easily understood; free from guilt or blame.

words.ex: The two colors are distinct.
words.ex_cn: 这两种颜色有区别。
words.en: If something is distinct, it is easily seen, heard, or understood.

words.tr: adj. 难以理解的；难懂的
words.ex: The handwriting was unintelligible.
words.ex_cn: 字迹无法辨认。
words.en: If speech or writing is unintelligible, it is impossible to understand.

words.tr: adj. 不能理解的；费解的
words.ex: The instructions were incomprehensible.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明让人完全看不懂。
words.en: If something is incomprehensible, you cannot understand it because it is so complex or unusual.

words.ex: This segment of the book is very interesting.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的这一部分非常有趣。
words.en: A segment of something is one of the parts into which it is divided or from which it is formed.

words.ex: In essence, he is a kind person.
words.ex_cn: 本质上，他是一个善良的人。
words.en: You use in essence to emphasize that you are talking about the most important or central aspect of an idea, situation, or event.

words.tr: adj. 必需的；基本的；本质的；
words.ex: Water is essential for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命是必需的。
words.en: Something that is essential is extremely important or absolutely necessary to a particular subject, situation, or activity.

words.ex: He has a predisposition to catch colds easily.
words.ex_cn: 他容易感冒的倾向。
words.en: A predisposition is a tendency to behave in a particular way or to suffer from a particular condition.

words.ex: The paintings are on display in the museum.
words.ex_cn: 这些画在博物馆里展出。
words.en: If something is on display, it is arranged for people to look at in a public place.

words.ex: He walks on the carpet every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都走在地毯上。
words.en: A carpet is a thick covering of soft material which is laid over a floor or a staircase.

words.ex: The accident occurred yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 事故昨天发生了。
words.en: If something occurs, it happens.

words.tr: v. 有关；把…联系起来；认同；叙述；理解；
words.ex: This story relates to your childhood.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事与你的童年有关。
words.en: If you relate a story, you tell it. If two things relate, they are connected in some way.

words.tr: adj. 完全的；荒凉的；光秃秃的；僵硬的；严厉的
words.ex: There was a stark difference between the two results.
words.ex_cn: 这两个结果之间有完全的差异。
words.en: Stark means complete, severe, or obvious in a way that is impossible to avoid noticing.

words.ex: Please inform me when the meeting starts.
words.ex_cn: 请在会议开始时通知我。
words.en: To inform someone means to tell them about something.

words.tr:
v. 中断；暂停；
n. 停顿下来；
words.ex: The storm halted the flight.
words.ex_cn: 风暴中断了航班。
words.en: to bring or come to a stop; a temporary or permanent stop

words.ex: The nerve in his finger was damaged.
words.ex_cn: 他手指里的神经受到了损伤。
words.en: A nerve is a bundle of fibers that transmits impulses of sensation to the brain or spinal cord, and impulses from these to the muscles and organs. It also refers to the courage or control needed to do something difficult or dangerous.

words.ex: He finished his homework before the deadline.
words.ex_cn: 他在截止日期前完成了作业。
words.en: A deadline is a time or date before which a particular task must be finished or a particular thing must be done.

words.ex: The child hurt his limb while playing.
words.ex_cn: 孩子玩耍时伤到了肢体。
words.en: A limb is one of the jointed appendages of an animal used for locomotion or grasping: arm; leg; wing; flipper.

words.ex: The ball is a perfect sphere.
words.ex_cn: 这个球是一个完美的球体。
words.en: A sphere is a perfectly round three-dimensional shape, like a ball. It can also refer to a particular area of interest, activity, or knowledge.

words.ex: It did not occur to him to call for help.
words.ex_cn: 他没想到要打电话求助。
words.en: If a thought or idea occurs to you, it comes into your mind.

words.ex: The occurrence of rain surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 下雨这件事让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: An occurrence is something that happens or takes place.

words.tr:
adj. 相对的；相关联的；
n. 亲戚；
words.ex: His success is relative to his hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他的成功是相对于他的努力而言的。
words.en: A relative is someone who is part of your family. Parents, siblings, uncles, aunts, grandparents, cousins, nieces and nephews — they're all relatives.

words.ex: There is a clear relation between exercise and health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼与健康之间有明显的关联。
words.en: A relation between two things is a connection or link between them.

words.tr:
n. 市场；行情；商场；销路；
v. 营销；
words.ex: The market sells fresh vegetables every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这个市场每天早上卖新鲜蔬菜。
words.en: A market is a place where goods are bought and sold, or an area or country where there is a demand for particular goods or services.

words.ex: He resolved the problem with a simple plan.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个简单的计划解决了问题。
words.en: If you resolve to do something, you make a firm decision to do it.

words.tr:
n. 压力；（动植物的）品种；
v. 竭力；
words.ex: The job gave him a lot of strain.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作给他带来了很大的压力。
words.en: To strain means to make a great effort to do something, to pull or stretch something tightly, or to injure a muscle by stretching it too much.

words.ex: The evolution of birds from dinosaurs took millions of years.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类从恐龙进化而来花了数百万年。
words.en: The gradual development of something, especially from a simple to a more complex form.

words.ex: This shirt is suitable for the party.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫适合这场派对。
words.en: Something that is suitable for a particular person or thing is right or acceptable for them.

words.ex: He is undoubtedly the best student in class.
words.ex_cn: 他无疑是班上最好的学生。
words.en: Without doubt; certainly.

words.ex: Applications arrived in an avalanche after the job posting.
words.ex_cn: 职位发布后，申请纷至沓来。
words.en: An avalanche is a large mass of snow, ice, and rocks that falls quickly down the side of a mountain.

words.ex: The long silence caused alienation between them.
words.ex_cn: 长久的沉默导致了他们之间的离间。
words.en: Alienation refers to the state or experience of being isolated from a group or an activity to which one should belong or in which one should be involved.

words.tr: phrase. 人类的进化；人类演化过程
words.ex: The evolution of man is a fascinating topic for many scientists.
words.ex_cn: n. 人类的进化是许多科学家感兴趣的话题。
words.en: The process by which humans developed from earlier forms of life over millions of years.

words.ex: This is an evolutionary change in the species.
words.ex_cn: 这是该物种的一种进化的改变。
words.en: Relating to or denoting processes of development or growth, especially in a biological context.

words.tr: adj. 适合某事的；恰当的；相配的
words.ex: This shirt is suitable for a job interview.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫适合求职面试。

words.w: a suitable time to do something
words.tr: n. 适合做某事的时间
words.uk: ə ˈsjuːtəbəl taɪm tə duː ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.us: ə ˈsuːtəbəl taɪm tə duː ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.ex: We found a suitable time to do something important.
words.ex_cn: 我们找到了一个适合做某件重要事情的时间。

words.tr:
n. 内容；含量；
adj. 满足的；
words.ex: The content of the video is very interesting.
words.ex_cn: 这个视频的内容非常有趣。
words.en: Content refers to the things that are held or included in something, or the state of being happy and satisfied.

words.ex: He felt discontent with his job.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己的工作感到不满。
words.en: Discontent is a feeling of being unhappy because you are not satisfied with your situation or with what you have.

words.ex: He felt discontentment with his job.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己的工作感到不满。
words.en: A feeling of dissatisfaction with one's circumstances.

words.ex: The suitability of the job for her is clear.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作适合她，这一点很明显。
words.en: The quality of being right or appropriate for a particular person, purpose, or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 犯罪行为；违法行为
words.ex: Stealing is considered one of the criminal acts.
words.ex_cn: 偷窃被认为是犯罪行为之一。
words.en: Actions that are against the law and punishable by the state.

words.tr: adj. 可疑的；怀疑的；拿不准的；
words.ex: The deal seemed dubious to me.
words.ex_cn: 这个交易在我看来很可疑。
words.en: If you describe something as dubious, you mean that you do not consider it to be completely honest, safe, or reliable.

words.ex: The two roads converge at the town center.
words.ex_cn: 这两条路在镇中心交汇。
words.en: If roads or lines converge, they meet or join at a particular place.

words.ex: He will restore the old bike.
words.ex_cn: 他将修复这辆旧自行车。
words.en: To restore something means to bring it back to its original condition or to a state of health, efficiency, or good management.

words.ex: He reverted to his old habits after the holiday.
words.ex_cn: 假期后，他恢复了旧习惯。
words.en: To return to a former state, practice, topic, etc.

words.ex: He converts old paper into new notebooks.
words.ex_cn: 他把旧纸张转换成新笔记本。
words.en: To change something into a different form or to change someone's beliefs, especially their religious beliefs.

words.ex: His rude behavior alienated his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他粗鲁的行为使朋友们疏远了他。
words.en: To cause someone to feel isolated or estranged; to transfer the ownership of property to another.

words.tr: n. 对某事的疏离；与某事物的情感脱离或心理隔绝
words.ex: He felt alienation from his old friends after moving to a new city.
words.ex_cn: 搬到新城市后，他感到与旧朋友疏离了。

words.tr: n. 孤立感；疏离感；与社会或他人脱节的感觉
words.ex: He felt a strong sense of alienation after moving to a new city.
words.ex_cn: 搬到新城市后，他感到强烈的孤立感。

words.tr:
n. 地址；演讲；
v. 解决；向…讲话；
words.ex: Please write your address on the form.
words.ex_cn: 请把你的地址写在表格上。
words.en: The particulars of the place where someone lives or an organization is situated; a formal speech delivered to an audience.

words.tr:
n. 压力；强调；
v. 着重；强调；
words.ex: He feels stress from too much work.
words.ex_cn: 他因为工作太多而感到压力。
words.en: Stress is a state of mental or emotional strain or tension resulting from adverse or demanding circumstances.

words.ex: He left a heap of clothes on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他把一堆衣服扔在地上。
words.en: A heap of things is a pile of them, especially a pile arranged in a rather untidy way.

words.ex: He saves money every month to accumulate funds for his dream house.
words.ex_cn: 他每个月存钱，为他的梦想房子积累资金。

words.ex: The accumulation of snow made the road dangerous.
words.ex_cn: 积雪使道路变得危险。
words.en: The process by which something increases in amount or is collected together over time.

words.ex: The radio transmits music to listeners.
words.ex_cn: 收音机将音乐传递给听众。
words.en: To send or pass something from one person, place, or thing to another.

words.ex: The police used fingerprint identification to find the suspect.
words.ex_cn: 警察使用指纹识别来找到嫌疑人。
words.en: Identification is the act of recognizing and naming someone or something, or the process of proving who or what someone or something is.

words.ex: He likes to wander in the park after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢晚饭后在公园里徘徊。
words.en: If you wander in a place, you walk around there in a casual way, often without intending to go in any particular direction or to any particular place.

words.ex: The cat likes to roam around the garden.
words.ex_cn: 这只猫喜欢在花园里游荡。
words.en: To roam means to move about or travel without any definite purpose or destination.

words.tr:
v. 闲逛；漫步
n. 闲逛；漫步
words.ex: We decided to saunter along the beach.
words.ex_cn: 我们决定沿着海滩漫步。
words.en: If you saunter somewhere, you walk there in a slow, relaxed way.

words.tr:
v. 闲逛；散步；漫步；
n. 闲逛；散步；漫步；
words.ex: They stroll in the park after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他们晚饭后在公园里闲逛。
words.en: If you stroll somewhere, you walk there in a slow, relaxed way.

words.ex: He listens to classical music every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上听古典音乐。
words.en: Classical refers to music, literature, or art that is considered to be of the highest quality and of lasting value, especially from the ancient Greek or Roman periods or from the 18th and early 19th centuries.

words.tr:
n. 滥用；虐待；辱骂；
v. 滥用；虐待；辱骂；
words.ex: The abuse of power led to many problems.
words.ex_cn: 权力的滥用导致了许多问题。
words.en: Abuse is the improper usage or treatment of a thing, often to unfairly or improperly gain benefit. Abuse can come in many forms, such as physical or verbal maltreatment, injury, assault, violation, rape, unjust practices, crimes, or other types of aggression.

words.tr:
v. 伪造；假装；冒充；
adj. 假的；冒充的；伪造的；
words.ex: He faked a signature to get the money.
words.ex_cn: 他伪造了一个签名来拿到钱。
words.en: If something is fake, it is not real, genuine, or true, but is made to appear so.

words.tr:
n. 运输；
v. 运输；
words.ex: He uses public transport to go to work.
words.ex_cn: 他乘坐公共交通去上班。
words.en: To transport something or someone is to move them from one place to another, especially over long distances.

words.ex: The transit of goods takes three days.
words.ex_cn: 货物的运输需要三天。
words.en: The act or process of passing through or across; the conveyance of people or goods from one place to another.

words.tr: adj. 传染性的；有感染力的；
words.ex: The flu is contagious and spreads easily.
words.ex_cn: 流感具有传染性，容易传播。
words.en: A contagious disease can be caught by touching someone who has the disease or by touching an infected object or by breathing in infected air.

words.tr: adj. 传染性的；有感染力的；
words.ex: The virus is infectious and spreads quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这种病毒具有传染性，传播迅速。
words.en: An infectious disease can be passed from one person to another, especially through the air they breathe.

words.tr: n. 传播者；发射机；送话机
words.ex: The radio transmitter sends signals to the receiver.
words.ex_cn: 无线电发射器将信号发送给接收器。
words.en: A transmitter is a device that sends out signals in the form of radio waves, or someone who sends or passes on something.

words.ex: He showed his identity card to enter the building.
words.ex_cn: 他出示了身份证以进入大楼。
words.en: Your identity is who you are, or the qualities of a person or group that make them different from others.

words.ex: He can identify the bird by its song.
words.ex_cn: 他能通过鸟的叫声识别它。
words.en: If you can identify someone or something, you are able to recognize them or distinguish them from others.

words.tr: phrase. 身份证；识别卡；身份证明卡
words.ex: He showed his identification card at the door.
words.ex_cn: 他在门口出示了他的身份证。
words.en: A card bearing the holder's name, photograph, and other personal details, used to prove their identity.

words.ex: He wandered from the topic during the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议中偏离了主题。

words.tr: phrase. 走失；偏离；漫无目的地走开
words.ex: The child wandered off while playing in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在公园里玩耍时走丢了。
words.en: To leave a place or person without permission or without telling anyone.

words.ex: He often wanders from the subject during meetings.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议中经常偏离主题。

words.ex: He often wanders from the point during meetings.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议中经常偏离主题。

words.tr: v. 漫游世界；四处游荡
words.ex: He wants to wander about the world and see different countries.
words.ex_cn: 他想漫游世界，看看不同的国家。

words.tr: v. 漫游世界；游历全球
words.ex: He wants to wander over the world and see different cultures.
words.ex_cn: 他想漫游世界，了解不同的文化。

words.ex: After an hour, his attention begins to wander during the lecture.
words.ex_cn: 一小时后，他在听课时注意力开始分散。

words.ex: Drug abuse can lead to serious health problems.
words.ex_cn: 药物滥用会导致严重的健康问题。
words.en: The habitual taking of illegal drugs.

words.ex: The officer abused his authority to punish innocent people.
words.ex_cn: 这名官员滥用职权惩罚无辜的人。

words.ex: He abused his office to help his friend get a job.
words.ex_cn: 他滥用职权帮助朋友得到一份工作。

words.tr: phrase. 言语虐待；口头辱骂
words.ex: He suffered from verbal abuse at school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校遭受了言语虐待。
words.en: The act of using words to bully, threaten, or belittle someone.

words.tr:
n. 伪装；伪装物；
v. 伪装；掩饰；
words.ex: He wore a hat and glasses as a disguise.
words.ex_cn: 他戴了帽子和眼镜作为伪装。
words.en: To disguise means to change your appearance or behavior so that people will not recognize you, or to make something seem different from what it really is.

words.ex: The soldier wore camouflage to hide in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 士兵穿着伪装服在森林中隐藏自己。
words.en: Camouflage is the way in which some animals are colored and shaped so that they cannot easily be seen in their natural surroundings.

words.ex: He pretends to sleep when his mom asks him to clean his room.
words.ex_cn: 当妈妈让他打扫房间时，他假装睡觉。
words.en: If you pretend that something is the case, you act in a way that is intended to make people believe that it is the case, although in fact it is not.

words.ex: He tried to conceal the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他试图隐藏真相。
words.en: If you conceal something, you prevent it from being seen or known about.

words.tr:
v. 藏匿；隐藏
n. 一批贮藏物
words.ex: He stashes his money under the bed.
words.ex_cn: 他把钱藏在床底下。
words.en: If you stash something valuable in a secret place, you store it there to keep it safe.

words.ex: The new plan incorporates feedback from students.
words.ex_cn: 新计划包含了学生的反馈。
words.en: If one thing incorporates another thing, it includes the other thing.

words.ex: The book encompasses all basic math skills.
words.ex_cn: 这本书包含了所有基础数学技能。
words.en: If something encompasses particular things, it includes them.

words.ex: They enclose the garden with a wooden fence.
words.ex_cn: 他们用木栅栏把花园围起来。
words.en: If you enclose something with a letter, you put it in the same envelope as the letter.

words.ex: The cows graze in the enclosure.
words.ex_cn: 奶牛在围场里吃草。
words.en: An enclosure is an area that is surrounded by a barrier or fence, often used to keep animals in or to protect something.

words.tr:
n. 痕迹；轨迹；微量；
v. 追踪；追溯；仔细查找；
words.ex: There was no trace of blood on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 地板上没有血迹。
words.en: If you trace something such as a pattern or a shape, you draw it carefully over a piece of thin paper. You can also trace someone or something that is missing or has disappeared, by following their movements or actions.

words.ex: He conveyed his thanks with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 他微笑着表达了谢意。
words.en: If you convey information or a message, you communicate it to someone, often in a way that is not direct.

words.ex: The fence marks the boundary between the two gardens.
words.ex_cn: 这道围栏标志着两个花园的分界线。
words.en: A boundary is a real or imagined line that marks the edge or limit of something.

words.ex: He was frank about his mistakes.
words.ex_cn: 他坦率地承认了自己的错误。
words.en: If someone is frank, they state or express things in an open and honest way.

words.ex: He works for a small company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家小公司工作。
words.en: A company is a business organization that makes money by producing or selling goods or services.

words.ex: This small enterprise makes handmade toys.
words.ex_cn: 这家小企业生产手工玩具。
words.en: An enterprise is a company or business, often a large one, or a difficult or important project, especially one that involves a lot of planning and organization.

words.ex: The corporate office is in New York.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司的总部在纽约。
words.en: Corporate relates to large companies or to a particular large company.

words.ex: The corporation sells smartphones worldwide.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司向全球销售智能手机。
words.en: A corporation is a large company or group of companies that is controlled together as a single organization.

words.ex: He cannot comprehend the simple math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他无法理解这个简单的数学问题。
words.en: To comprehend something means to understand it fully.

words.tr: v. 体现；使具体化；包含
words.ex: He embodies kindness and patience.
words.ex_cn: 他体现了善良和耐心。
words.en: To embody means to represent a quality or an idea exactly; to include or contain something.

words.tr: 短语. 无影无踪；毫无痕迹
words.ex: The missing hiker disappeared without a trace.
words.ex_cn: 失踪的徒步旅行者毫无踪迹地消失了。
words.en: If someone or something disappears without a trace, they disappear completely and no one knows what has happened to them.

words.tr: phrase. 微量元素；痕量元素（指生物体或物质中含量极微但具有重要生理或化学作用的元素）
words.ex: Bananas contain a trace element called potassium.
words.ex_cn: 香蕉含有被称为钾的微量元素。
words.en: A chemical element present in extremely small amounts in a living organism or environment.

words.tr: adj. 可追踪的；可追溯的；
words.ex: The package is traceable using the tracking number.
words.ex_cn: 使用跟踪号码可以追踪这个包裹。
words.en: If something is traceable, it can be tracked or followed back to its source or origin.

words.tr:
v. 驾驶；驱使；
n. 动力；
words.ex: He drives a car to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天开车去上班。
words.en: To operate and control the direction and speed of a motor vehicle; to push, propel, or carry along forcibly or strongly.

words.tr: phrase. 传达信息；传递消息
words.ex: He used a sign to convey a message.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个标志来传达信息。
words.en: To communicate or make known a message or information.

words.ex: He filed a grievance about the unfair treatment.
words.ex_cn: 他因不公平的对待提出了不满。
words.en: A grievance is a feeling of resentment over something believed to be wrong or unfair.

words.ex: He felt deep grief after his dog died.
words.ex_cn: 他的狗去世后，他感到深深的悲痛。
words.en: Intense sorrow, especially caused by someone's death.

words.ex: He felt sadness after losing his dog.
words.ex_cn: 他失去狗后感到悲伤。
words.en: Sadness is the feeling of being unhappy, especially because something bad has happened.

words.ex: He felt deep sorrow when his dog died.
words.ex_cn: 当他的狗去世时，他感到深深的悲痛。
words.en: Sorrow is a feeling of deep sadness or regret.

words.ex: He felt great distress when he lost his job.
words.ex_cn: 当他失去工作时，他感到非常忧虑。
words.en: Distress is a feeling of extreme worry, sadness, or pain.

words.tr: v. 推动……的边界；拓展……的极限
words.ex: Scientists push back the boundary of human knowledge.
words.ex_cn: 科学家推动人类知识的边界。

words.ex: The earth's crust is made of rock.
words.ex_cn: 地球的地壳由岩石组成。
words.en: The crust is the hard outer layer of something, such as bread or the Earth's surface.

words.ex: To be frank, I don't like this movie.
words.ex_cn: 老实说，我不喜欢这部电影。
words.en: Used to indicate that the speaker is being honest or straightforward in their statement.

words.ex: Frankly, I don't like this idea.
words.ex_cn: 坦率地说，我不喜欢这个想法。
words.en: In a frank manner; honestly or directly.

words.tr: n. 奖金；红利；额外津贴；
words.ex: He received a bonus for working overtime.
words.ex_cn: 他因加班获得了奖金。
words.en: A bonus is an extra amount of money that is added to someone's pay, usually because they have worked very hard.

words.tr:
adj. 激进的；好战的
n. 激进；好战
words.ex: He is a militant who protests every day.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个每天抗议的激进分子。
words.en: A militant person is someone who is engaged in warfare or combat, or who is aggressively active in a cause.

words.ex: The children starve without food.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们没有食物就会挨饿。
words.en: To suffer or die from lack of food.

words.tr: v. 使恢复精力；使复原；使变新
words.ex: A short nap can refresh you.
words.ex_cn: 小睡一会儿能让你恢复精力。
words.en: To refresh someone means to make them feel less tired or less hot.

words.tr: n. 营养不良；营养失调
words.ex: The child has muscle dystrophy from poor nutrition.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子因营养不良而患有肌肉营养不良。
words.en: Dystrophy refers to any of various disorders involving the degeneration or wasting away of an organ or tissue, often due to nutritional deficiencies or abnormal metabolism.

words.ex: He went to the consulate to get a visa.
words.ex_cn: 他去领事馆办理签证。
words.en: A consulate is the place where a consul works, which is an official who is sent by their country to live in a foreign city in order to help other citizens from their own country and to represent their country's commercial interests.

words.ex: The water has a dangerous contaminant.
words.ex_cn: 这种水含有危险的污染物。
words.en: A contaminant is something that makes a place or a substance (such as water, air, or food) no longer suitable for use, often by adding harmful substances to it.

words.ex: He got a demerit for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他因迟到而被扣分。
words.en: A demerit is a fault or disadvantage.

words.ex: The flaw in the glass made it break easily.
words.ex_cn: 玻璃上的瑕疵让它很容易碎。
words.en: A flaw is a mistake or weakness in something that makes it less effective or valuable.

words.ex: The defect in the phone made it hard to use.
words.ex_cn: 手机的缺陷让它很难使用。
words.en: A defect is a fault or imperfection in a person or thing.

words.tr:
n. 小块；碎片；废金属；吵架
v. 废弃；取消
adj. 废弃的
words.ex: He picked up a scrap of paper from the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他从地上捡起一张纸片。
words.en: A scrap is a small piece or amount of something, especially one that is left over after the greater part has been used. It can also mean to discard or get rid of something as being no longer useful or necessary.

words.tr:
v. 刮；擦；刮出刺耳声；勉强通过
n. 刮；擦；擦痕；刮擦声
words.ex: He scraped his knee on the rough ground.
words.ex_cn: 他在粗糙的地面上擦伤了膝盖。
words.en: To remove something from a surface using a sharp or rough edge, or to injure a part of the body by rubbing it against a rough surface.

words.tr: n. 鼓动者；煽动者；搅拌器
words.ex: The agitator spoke loudly to stir up the crowd.
words.ex_cn: 煽动者大声讲话以激起人群的愤怒。
words.en: agitator

words.tr: n. 搅动；煽动；激动；不安
words.ex: The agitation of the water made the dirt rise.
words.ex_cn: 水的搅动使灰尘浮起。
words.en: Agitation is a state of anxiety or nervous excitement.

words.tr: n. 火把；燃烧的木柴；煽动者
words.ex: He is a firebrand who speaks loudly against injustice.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个大声反对不公的激进分子。
words.en: A firebrand is a person who is passionate about a particular cause, often inciting others to action or rebellion.

words.tr:
n. 和平主义者；反战主义者
adj. 非战主义的
words.ex: He is a pacifist and refuses to fight in wars.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名和平主义者，拒绝参与战争。
words.en: A pacifist is someone who believes that war and violence are unjustifiable and that disputes should be settled by peaceful means.

words.ex: The two countries signed a pacific agreement.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家签署了一项和平协议。
words.en: A pacific person, country, or policy is peaceful and seeks to avoid conflict.

words.ex: He is combative in every meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在每次会议上都好斗。
words.en: Someone who is combative is aggressive and eager to fight or argue.

words.tr:
n. 鸽子；鸽派人物；温和派人物
v. 潜水；跳水；“dive”的过去式
words.ex: The dove flew over the garden.
words.ex_cn: 鸽子飞过花园。
words.en: A dove is a bird that is often used as a symbol of peace. It is known for its gentle nature and the soft cooing sound it makes.

words.ex: He looked at the notes to refresh his memory before the test.
words.ex_cn: 他看了看笔记，以便在考试前唤醒记忆。
words.en: To remind someone of something they have forgotten or to help someone remember something more clearly.

words.ex: We had a snack and some drinks as refreshment after the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 会议结束后，我们吃了点心和喝了一些饮料作为茶点。
words.en: Refreshment refers to the act of refreshing or the state of being refreshed, especially by food or drink. It can also mean a light meal or drinks served in a social setting.

words.tr: n. 恢复精神的人或物；
words.ex: A short nap is a good refresher after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 午饭后小睡一会儿是恢复精神的好方法。
words.en: A refresher is a course that helps people to learn or remember something that they have already been taught, or something that makes you feel more energetic or less tired.

words.tr: phrase. 肌肉萎缩症；肌营养不良症
words.ex: Muscular dystrophy is a group of genetic diseases that cause progressive muscle weakness.
words.ex_cn: 肌肉萎缩症是一组导致肌肉力量逐渐减弱的遗传性疾病。
words.en: A group of genetic diseases characterized by progressive weakness and degeneration of the skeletal muscles that control movement.

words.tr: phrase. 遗传缺陷；基因缺陷
words.ex: The baby was born with a genetic defect that affects its heart.
words.ex_cn: 这个婴儿出生时就患有一种影响心脏的遗传缺陷。
words.en: A genetic defect is a problem caused by one or more abnormalities in the genome, especially a condition that is present from birth.

words.ex: Good habits conduce to a healthy life.
words.ex_cn: 良好的习惯有助于健康的生活。
words.en: To help to bring about a particular situation or outcome.

words.tr: adj. 有助于；促进；对……有利

words.ex: Eating vegetables is beneficial to your health.
words.ex_cn: 吃蔬菜对你的健康有益。
words.en: To be beneficial to something means to have a good effect or influence on it.

words.tr:
n. 律师；劝告
v. 提供咨询；劝告
words.ex: He hired a counsel to defend him in court.
words.ex_cn: 他聘请了一名律师为他在法庭上辩护。
words.en: Counsel refers to the act of giving advice or guidance, especially in a legal context, or to the person who provides such advice.

words.ex: The consul helped the tourist with a lost passport.
words.ex_cn: 领事帮助这位游客处理了遗失的护照。
words.en: A consul is an official appointed by a government to live in a foreign city and protect and promote the government's citizens and interests there.

words.ex: He will consult a doctor for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 他将咨询医生治疗他的头痛。
words.en: to seek information or advice from someone, especially someone who is an expert in a particular field

words.tr: n. 顾问；咨询师；法律顾问；
words.ex: He asked his counselor for advice about his future.
words.ex_cn: 他向他的顾问咨询了关于未来的问题。
words.en: A counselor is a person whose job is to give advice to people who need it, especially advice on their personal problems.

words.ex: The school counsellor helped me with my study problems.
words.ex_cn: 学校的辅导员帮我解决了学习问题。
words.en: A counsellor is a person whose job is to give advice to people who need it, especially advice on their personal problems.

words.ex: He is a consultant for a big company.
words.ex_cn: 他是这家大公司的顾问。
words.en: A consultant is a person who gives expert advice to a person or organization on a particular subject.

words.ex: The river is contaminated by factory waste.
words.ex_cn: 这条河被工厂废料污染了。
words.en: To contaminate something means to make it impure or polluted by contact or mixture with something unclean or harmful.

words.ex: The laboratory had to be closed due to the presence of a biological contaminant.
words.ex_cn: 实验室因存在生物污染物而不得不关闭。
words.en: A biological contaminant is any living organism or substance derived from a living organism that can cause harm to humans, animals, or the environment.

words.ex: The merit of this plan is its simplicity.
words.ex_cn: 这个计划的优点是简单。
words.en: If something has merit, it has good or worthwhile qualities.

words.ex: There are many denominations in Christianity.
words.ex_cn: 基督教中有许多宗派。
words.en: A denomination is a recognized autonomous branch of the Christian Church or a unit of value, especially in currency.

words.ex: The noise from the construction caused a disturbance.
words.ex_cn: 建筑工地的噪音造成了干扰。
words.en: A disturbance is an event or situation in which people behave in a noisy or violent way, or something that interrupts what you are doing.

words.ex: The picnic was an enjoyable day with friends.
words.ex_cn: 野餐是和朋友一起度过的愉快一天。
words.en: Something that is enjoyable gives you pleasure.

words.ex: The expiry of the contract will be next month.
words.ex_cn: 合同的满期将在下个月。
words.en: The end of the period for which something is valid.

words.ex: The stock market shows daily fluctuation.
words.ex_cn: 股票市场每天都有波动。
words.en: A fluctuation is a change in something, especially in a continuous process such as temperature, prices, or levels of activity.

words.ex: The frequency of the radio station is 101.5 MHz.
words.ex_cn: 这个电台的频率是101.5兆赫。
words.en: The rate at which something happens or is repeated over a particular period of time.

words.ex: It rained all day, hence the game was canceled.
words.ex_cn: 下了一整天的雨，因此比赛被取消了。
words.en: You use hence to indicate that the statement you are about to make is a consequence of what you have just said.

words.ex: The food supply was inadequate for the number of people.
words.ex_cn: 食物供应对人数来说是不充分的。
words.en: If something is inadequate, there is not enough of it or it is not good enough.

words.ex: The keystone holds the arch together.
words.ex_cn: 拱顶石将拱门固定在一起。
words.en: A keystone is the central, topmost stone in an arch, which holds all the other stones in place. Metaphorically, it refers to the central principle or part of a system, plan, etc., upon which all else depends.

words.ex: His sadness manifested in his quiet eyes.
words.ex_cn: 他的悲伤表现在他安静的眼神中。
words.en: To manifest something means to show it clearly and visibly.

words.ex: The temperature rose marginally yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 昨天温度略微上升了。
words.en: To a very small extent; slightly.

words.ex: He dominates the conversation.
words.ex_cn: 他主宰了谈话。
words.en: To dominate means to control or govern someone or something, or to be the most important or noticeable feature of something.

words.ex: The committee decided to denominate the new park 'Green Haven.'
words.ex_cn: 委员会决定将新公园命名为'绿洲'。
words.en: To give a name to something or someone, often in a formal or official way.

words.ex: They will nominate her for the award.
words.ex_cn: 他们将提名她获得这个奖项。
words.en: If someone is nominated for a job or position, their name is formally suggested as a candidate for it.

words.tr: phrase. 终止日期；借书期限
words.ex: The date of expiry is tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 到期日期是明天。
words.en: The date on which something, especially a contract, agreement, or product, is no longer valid or usable.

words.tr: phrase. 显示出波动；表现出起伏
words.ex: The graph displays a fluctuation in prices.
words.ex_cn: 这张图表显示了价格的波动。
words.en: To show changes or variations, especially in an irregular way.

words.ex: The tribe lives in a primitive hut.
words.ex_cn: 这个部落住在原始的小屋里。
words.en: Belonging to a very early period in the history of the world, or to a time before modern things existed.

words.ex: The forest looked primeval and untouched.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林看起来远古而未被破坏。
words.en: relating to the earliest ages of the world or the universe; ancient or prehistoric.

words.ex: The primal forest has never been touched by humans.
words.ex_cn: 这片原始森林从未被人类触碰过。
words.en: Primal means relating to an early stage in the development of something, or being the most important or basic part of something.

words.ex: He has a high fever as a symptom of the flu.
words.ex_cn: 他发烧是流感的症状。
words.en: A symptom is a physical or mental feature which is regarded as indicating a condition of disease, particularly such a feature that is apparent to the patient.

words.tr: adj. 边缘的；页边的；微不足道的；不重要的
words.ex: The village is on the marginal area of the city.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄位于城市的边缘地区。
words.en: If you describe something as marginal, you mean that it is small or not very important.

words.tr: adv. 适度地；不过分地；有节制地；
words.ex: He eats moderately to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他适度饮食以保持健康。
words.en: In a manner that is neither too much nor too little; to a moderate extent.

words.ex: The change in her mood was noticeable.
words.ex_cn: 她情绪的变化显而易见。
words.en: Something that is noticeable is very obvious, so that it is easy to see, hear, or recognize.

words.tr: adj. 眼的；视觉的；光学的
words.ex: He wears optic glasses to see clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他戴光学眼镜以便看得清楚。
words.en: Relating to the eye or vision.

words.ex: The benefits outweigh the risks.
words.ex_cn: 好处超过了风险。
words.en: If one thing outweighs another, the first thing is of greater importance, benefit, or significance than the second thing.

words.ex: The adverse weather delayed the flight.
words.ex_cn: 不利的天气延误了航班。
words.en: If something is adverse, it is harmful or unfavorable.

words.ex: Smoking is detrimental to your health.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟对你的健康有害。
words.en: Something that is detrimental has a harmful or damaging effect on something else.

words.ex: Smoking is harmful to your health.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟对你的健康有害。
words.en: Something that is harmful has a bad effect on something else, especially on a person's health.

words.ex: The finale of the concert was very exciting.
words.ex_cn: 音乐会的终曲非常激动人心。
words.en: The finale is the last part of a piece of music, a performance, or a public event, especially when this is particularly dramatic or exciting.

words.ex: The magic trick will astonish you.
words.ex_cn: 这个魔术会让你惊讶。
words.en: If something or someone astonishes you, they surprise you very much.

words.tr:
n. 收费；负责；指控；
v. 收费；充电；
words.ex: The hotel charge is $50 per night.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的收费是每晚50美元。
words.en: If you charge someone, you ask them to pay an amount of money for something that you have sold to them or done for them.

words.ex: The army corps marched through the town.
words.ex_cn: 军队军团穿过城镇行进。
words.en: A corps is a military unit consisting of a large number of soldiers, typically organized for a specific purpose.

words.ex: The optical fiber carries light for fast internet.
words.ex_cn: 光纤用于传输光以实现高速互联网。
words.en: A thin, flexible fiber made of glass or plastic, used to transmit light signals over long distances.

words.tr: adj. 光纤的；光导纤维的
words.ex: The fiber optic cable transmits data quickly.
words.ex_cn: 光纤电缆快速传输数据。

words.tr: n. 光纤电缆；用于传输光信号的电缆，由细玻璃或塑料纤维组成
words.ex: The internet signal travels through a fiber optic cable.
words.ex_cn: 互联网信号通过光纤电缆传输。

words.tr: adj. 不同的；多种多样的；
words.ex: The class has diverse students from many countries.
words.ex_cn: 这个班级有来自许多国家的不同学生。
words.en: If a group or range of things is diverse, it is made up of a wide variety of things.

words.tr:
n. 反面；
v. 使倒转；（使）倒车；撤销；
words.ex: The reverse of the coin has a picture of a tree.
words.ex_cn: 硬币的反面有一棵树的图案。
words.en: If you reverse the order of a set of things, you arrange them in the opposite order, so that the first thing comes last.

words.tr: phrase. 不利的情况；逆境；困难的处境
words.ex: He stayed strong in adverse circumstances.
words.ex_cn: 他在逆境中保持坚强。
words.en: Unfavorable or difficult situations.

words.ex: The weather was unfavorable for the picnic.
words.ex_cn: 天气对野餐不利。
words.en: If conditions or circumstances are unfavorable, they make it difficult for something to happen or exist.

words.ex: He will take charge of the project next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将负责这个项目。
words.en: To assume control or responsibility over something.

words.ex: He is in charge of the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 他负责这个教室。
words.en: Having control over or responsibility for someone or something.

words.ex: There is no charge for parking here.
words.ex_cn: 这里停车免费。
words.en: If there is no charge for something, it means that you do not have to pay for it.

words.ex: The library gives books free of charge.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆免费提供书籍。
words.en: If something is free of charge, it does not cost anything.

words.ex: There is an extra charge for late payment.
words.ex_cn: 迟交款项会收取额外费用。
words.en: An additional amount of money that is required to be paid for a service or product beyond the standard or advertised price.

words.tr:
v. 发射；发起；启动；
n. 发射；投掷；启动；
words.ex: They will launch a rocket tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们明天将发射一枚火箭。
words.en: To launch something means to send it into the air, space, or water, especially with a lot of force or effort, or to start an activity, event, or project.

words.ex: The machinist fixes machines in the factory.
words.ex_cn: 这位机械师在工厂修理机器。
words.en: A machinist is a person who operates or maintains machines, especially in a factory or workshop.

words.ex: The police found a corpse near the river.
words.ex_cn: 警察在河边发现了一具尸体。
words.en: A corpse is a dead body, especially the dead body of a human.

words.ex: The marine birds fly over the sea.
words.ex_cn: 这些海鸟在海面上飞翔。
words.en: Marine is used to describe things relating to the sea or to the ships and boats which sail on it.

words.ex: The clay is malleable and easy to shape.
words.ex_cn: 这种黏土是可塑的，容易塑形。
words.en: If you say that someone is malleable, you mean that they are easily influenced or controlled by other people.

words.ex: The software has five different modules.
words.ex_cn: 这个软件有五个不同的模块。
words.en: A module is one of the separate parts of a course of study, especially at a college or university.

words.ex: The car runs on petroleum.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车使用石油运行。
words.en: A naturally occurring, yellow-to-black liquid found in geological formations beneath the Earth's surface, which is commonly refined into various types of fuels.

words.ex: She wears stylish clothes to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿着时髦的衣服去参加派对。
words.en: Something that is stylish is fashionable and attractive.

words.ex: He dumped the trash into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 他把垃圾倒进了垃圾桶。
words.en: To dump something means to get rid of it quickly and without care, often because it is no longer wanted or needed. It can also refer to the place where waste is left.

words.ex: The storm left debris on the road.
words.ex_cn: 风暴在道路上留下了碎片。
words.en: The remains of something that has been destroyed or broken up.

words.ex: It's an irony that the fire station burned down.
words.ex_cn: 消防站着火了，这真是讽刺。
words.en: Irony is a subtle form of humor which involves saying things that you do not mean.

words.ex: A car has many components, like wheels and engines.
words.ex_cn: 汽车有许多部分，比如轮子和发动机。
words.en: A component is a part of a larger whole, especially a part that can be separated from or attached to a system.

words.tr: n. 野外考察；实地调查；
words.ex: The students went on fieldwork to collect soil samples.
words.ex_cn: 学生们去野外考察以采集土壤样本。
words.en: Fieldwork refers to the collection of raw data outside a laboratory, library, or workplace setting.

words.ex: He buys petrol every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五买汽油。
words.en: A liquid obtained from petroleum, used especially as a fuel in cars.

words.ex: She got a stylish hairstyle for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对做了一个时尚的发型。

words.ex: The dredger was used to clear the silt from the riverbed.
words.ex_cn: 挖泥船被用来清除河床上的淤泥。
words.en: A dredger is a boat or machine that is used to remove mud or sand from the bottom of a river, canal, or harbor.

words.ex: The machine will dump on the waste at night.
words.ex_cn: 机器会在晚上把废物转储打开。

words.tr:
v. 疏浚；挖掘
n. 挖泥船；疏浚机
words.ex: They dredge the river to remove mud.
words.ex_cn: 他们疏浚河流以清除淤泥。
words.en: To dredge means to remove mud, sand, or other material from the bottom of a river, lake, etc., in order to make it deeper or to search for something.

words.ex: The floor is slippery after it rains.
words.ex_cn: 下雨后地板很滑。
words.en: Something that is slippery is smooth, wet, or oily and is therefore difficult to walk on or to hold.

words.tr:
n. 幻灯片；滑梯；
v. （使）滑动；下滑；
words.ex: He showed a slide of his vacation photos.
words.ex_cn: 他展示了一张他度假照片的幻灯片。
words.en: To move smoothly along a surface while maintaining continuous contact with it; to pass or move quietly or smoothly; a structure with a smooth sloping surface for children to slide down; a decline from a higher to a lower level or status.

words.tr: v. 滑动；“slide”的现在分词； adj. 变化的；
words.ex: The book is sliding off the table.
words.ex_cn: 书正从桌子上滑下来。
words.en: Moving smoothly along a surface or moving gradually from one condition to another.

words.ex: The earthquake devastated the small town.
words.ex_cn: 地震摧毁了这个小镇。
words.en: To devastate means to destroy or ruin something completely, or to cause someone to feel extreme sadness or shock.

words.ex: They will demolish the old building next week.
words.ex_cn: 他们下周会拆掉那座旧建筑。
words.en: To demolish something such as a building means to destroy it completely. It can also mean to defeat someone completely in a discussion, argument, or competition.

words.tr:
n. 损害；破损；
v. 损害；破坏；
words.ex: The storm caused serious damage to the house.
words.ex_cn: 风暴对房屋造成了严重损害。
words.en: Damage is physical harm that is caused to something which makes it less attractive, useful, or valuable.

words.tr:
n. 遇难船只；残骸；
v. 破坏；毁坏；
words.ex: The wreck lies at the bottom of the sea.
words.ex_cn: 这艘遇难船只沉在海底。
words.en: If something such as a ship or a plane is wrecked, it is damaged so much that it cannot be repaired or it is completely destroyed.

words.tr:
n. 毁坏；残骸；失事船只；（波浪打到岸上的）海草
v. 摧毁；破坏
